jobs.title: AI Research Scientist/ Research Engineer: Materials Discovery
jobs.description: At **Logical Intelligence**, our mission is to accelerate the discovery of materials that make the next generation of technology possible, from light emitters and semiconductors to batteries, electric vehicles, and the chips behind AI and robotics. Large language models alone are not enough to get there. Discovering new materials requires an understanding of chemistry and physics to guide the search, and energy\-based models let us build that understanding directly into our discovery loop. We work closely with industry and lab partners to shorten the path from research to real products. **About the Role** As a Research Scientist on our material discovery team, you will help turn that idea into new molecules. You will build the AI systems that propose and evaluate candidates, and work with our partner labs so that every synthesis and measurement teaches the models something. You will join a highly interdisciplinary team of chemists, physicists, and machine learning scientists and engineers, where the biggest impact comes from working together. **What You’ll Do** * Build and improve the AI systems behind our discovery loop, from candidate generation and screening to selecting which molecules to test next. * Develop energy\-based models that combine learned representations with physical and chemical knowledge to search chemical space more efficiently. * Own model evaluation, including benchmarks on held\-out chemical families, accuracy against both quantum\-chemistry calculations and experiment, calibration of uncertainty estimates, prospective tests where the model predicts before the lab measures, and tracking across model versions. * Compare AI predictions with measurements, investigate disagreements, and turn what you learn into concrete model changes, in collaboration with AI researchers and engineers. * Design experiments with our partner labs so that each round of synthesis and testing is as informative as possible. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** * A background in machine learning, computational chemistry, physics, or a related field, with a PhD, or a Master’s plus relevant industry experience, and hands\-on experience building ML models for real scientific problems. * Familiarity with energy\-based models, diffusion or score\-based models, or similar generative approaches, and an interest in going deeper. * Knowledge of chemistry, or a genuine interest in learning it alongside our chemists. * Experience designing evaluations and experiments that correlate with downstream performance * A strong record of impactful research, shown through publications, patents, open\-source software, or methods used in real discovery programs. * Excellent scientific writing and communication, and comfort working in an interdisciplinary team. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** * Hands\-on research experience with energy\-based models, or with methods that combine learning with search and optimization. * Experience with molecular ML, such as property prediction, generative molecular design, ML interatomic potentials, or quantum\-chemistry workflows (e.g. DFT). * Experience with closed\-loop design using real lab feedback logicalintelligence.com

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Health Data Innovations** --------------------------------- Founded in 2010, Health Data Innovations (HDI) allows providers and payers to seamlessly integrate external administrative data into their internal systems. HDI’s tech\-enabled data management system and processes codify decades of knowledge to ingest, cleanse, standardize, and validate payer claims and administrative data. The system reflects HDI’s extensive experience with data from a broad spectrum of payers and vendors. By outsourcing data acquisition and integration to HDI, clients can spend more time working with the data and less time on data integration issues. In 2023, Hughes \& Company invested in HDI to build on the company’s success enabling healthcare providers in value\-based care arrangements. HDI provides clients with mission\-critical data that is necessary for contractual obligations and underpins programs of substantial value. As risk\-based arrangements proliferate and increase in complexity, HDI’s differentiated technology is a critical tool to enable the success of these programs. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to build and run the AI tools, integrations, and workflows that put AI to work across HD Innovations, and to lead our move to agentic AI. Our AI initiative is already live: enterprise AI assistants and coding tools, a private model gateway on Amazon Bedrock, custom connectors to our business systems, and local models running on our own GPU hardware. Our next step is AI agents that take action across our systems, and we want to get there quickly. This is a hands\-on role on a small team. Most of your time goes to building AI solutions and agents; the rest goes to the infrastructure they run on, including cloud services, identity, servers, and GPU hosts, all in a security\-first, HITRUST\-governed environment. **Why This Role** ----------------- * Build AI that does real work across the whole business, not just one department * Work directly with executives and every function at HDI to find where AI can make the biggest difference * Shape how HDI adopts AI — your ideas influence the roadmap * Build agents that handle complex work in a high\-stakes, regulated healthcare environment **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work with business users to find processes where AI can help, and decide the right approach: an assistant, an AI\-assisted workflow, or an agent * Build and improve AI\-assisted workflows, skills, and plugins that put AI into everyday processes * Lead the move to agentic AI: design, build, and deploy agents and multi\-step workflows using tool use / function calling, prompt and context design, and agent frameworks * Build and support Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, database bridges, and Microsoft 365 integrations so AI tools and agents can safely reach the data and systems they need * Test and evaluate AI output for accuracy and reliability, and catch regressions before they reach users * Build in guardrails, least\-privilege permissions, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, and audit logging, especially where AI touches sensitive healthcare data * Own AI solutions in production: monitor behavior, usage, and cost; troubleshoot issues; and version, maintain, and retire them * Write scripts and code, mainly in Python, managed through Git and pull\-request review * Track new models, agent frameworks, and vendor releases; run proofs of concept and recommend what to adopt * Support the infrastructure behind our AI services, including Amazon Bedrock, Entra ID / SSO, Linux and Windows servers, VMs, and GPU hosts * Write clear documentation, runbooks, and guides that stand up to compliance audits **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required:** * 3\+ years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, DevOps, or software development * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents (tool use, MCP, multi\-step workflows), from work, prototypes, or personal projects * Experience with LLM APIs or cloud AI platforms (Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI) * Solid Linux skills (RHEL or Ubuntu), plus working knowledge of Windows Server and Docker * Networking and security fundamentals: firewalls, segmentation, least privilege * Scripting and automation skills (Python preferred; PowerShell or Bash a plus) * Experience integrating with APIs, databases, and business systems * Familiarity with Git workflows and code review * Curiosity about AI and the discipline to turn experiments into reliable, documented systems * Ability to work independently, manage your own priorities, and support non\-technical users in a small\-team environment **Preferred:** * Building MCP servers or using agent frameworks * Experience taking an agent from prototype to production * Experience testing and evaluating LLM output * Software development experience in Python, Go, or TypeScript * RAG pipelines and vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Chroma, Milvus) * Experience with Entra ID / Azure AD, SSO, and OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC * Experience working under a compliance framework such as HITRUST, HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 * AWS IAM, cost management, and Bedrock guardrails * Local AI experience: running open\-weight models with vLLM or llama.cpp on NVIDIA GPUs, including vGPU or GPU passthrough * Remote Desktop Services, Azure Arc, and virtualization (VMware, Proxmox, or Hyper\-V) * OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana * MySQL Server or PostgreSQL administration * Microsoft Graph API * Terraform, Ansible, or Packer **Tech You'll Work With** ------------------------- Claude (Desktop, Code) · Amazon Bedrock · Model Context Protocol · Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 · Azure Arc · Windows Server 2025 RDS · Forgejo · OpenTelemetry · Python and Go · Docker · Proxmox with NVIDIA vGPU · vector databases · VMware vSphere · RHEL and Ubuntu **In\-Office Expectations** --------------------------- While this is a hybrid role, periodic in\-office presence in Cleveland is required. This includes attendance at team meetings and onboarding/training sessions, as well as scheduled visits to collaborate with stakeholders during planning and rollout phases.

jobs.title: Engineering Generalist - Product Impact (Full Stack)
jobs.description: **About Pocket** *At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.* Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it. We’ve built an AI\-powered device that captures real\-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26\), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices. Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet. **About the Role** Sometimes the most useful thing to build is a better onboarding flow. Sometimes it is a backend service, a faster API or the instrumentation that explains why customers leave. We’re looking for an engineer who can follow the problem across those boundaries. You’ll work across backend and frontend, ship changes end to end and measure whether they made the product better. You’ll work closely with product, design, marketing and support, without needing every task to fit one narrow specialty. **What You’ll Own** * Projects from instrumentation and data models through services, user interfaces, rollout and iteration. * Features and experiments that improve activation, retention, paid conversion and the core experience. * Backend APIs, pipelines, jobs and systems that stay reliable as usage grows. * Frontend improvements across the web product, internal tools, landing pages and onboarding. * Clear hypotheses and measurement, followed by the work needed to make successful experiments production\-ready. **What We’re Looking For** * 6–10\+ years shipping production software, ideally in a startup environment. * Strong backend fundamentals: APIs, databases, asynchronous jobs, caching, performance and reliability. * The ability to ship frontend changes in React/TypeScript or a comparable stack. * Product judgment: you can turn an unclear problem into useful work and explain the result. * Performance and reliability habits, including profiling, latency budgets, observability and graceful degradation. * A preference for simple systems, fast learning and responsible delivery over unnecessary complexity. **Bonus Points** Experience with experiments, analytics instrumentation, funnels or cohorts; internal tools; or building products from zero to one. **Our Stack** Flutter for mobile; React and TypeScript on the frontend; Go and Node on the backend; Postgres and Redis for data. **What Success Looks Like** Shipped work improves activation, retention or revenue. Production systems are observable and reliable. The architecture remains simple enough for the team to keep moving. **Why Join Pocket?** You’ll work close to the product and the people building the company. Your scope follows the problem, so you can connect a technical change to a customer or business result instead of handing it off at the edge of one codebase. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. We turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into formal representations that support reasoning people can inspect and check. Our architecture pairs models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, Pramaana brings together researchers and formal methods experts from Google, DeepMind, and Glean. **The Role** ------------ The hardest questions in AI emerge when systems meet messy reality. Can ambiguous, exception\-filled rules be formalized faithfully? Can we distinguish what is proved from what is assumed, and make the results reliable enough to use? As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work where applied research, software engineering and customer problems meet. Alongside Pramaana engineers and researchers, you'll prototype and evaluate verifiable AI workflows, build tools and integrations, and help take promising systems into production. You'll investigate failures and turn lessons from the field into improvements to our research, models and core technology. We're looking for engineers who think from first principles, learn fast and care deeply about making AI reasoning verifiable. You don't need years of enterprise deployment experience. You'll have strong technical guidance while owning your work and handling real customer challenges with maturity. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Understand the real technical problem. Work with customers and domain experts to turn source material, rules, exceptions and constraints into clear requirements and success criteria. * Prototype verifiable AI workflows. Experiment with model\-based formalization, symbolic reasoning and proof checking on challenging real\-world inputs. Find out what works and where it breaks. * Build rigorous evaluations. Create representative examples, edge cases and benchmarks to measure rule fidelity, correctness, coverage and robustness. Reproduce failures and investigate them carefully. * Take systems into production. Build and debug applications, APIs, tools and integrations. Iterate with customer teams, explain limitations and help deliver reliable workflows. * Close the loop with research. Work with researchers to turn customer issues and evaluation results into better representations, models, proof workflows and core technology. * Own problems and improve what comes next. Ask sharp questions, take responsibility for scoped work, communicate blockers early and turn one\-off fixes into reusable patterns where possible. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * Strong software engineering fundamentals. You can write clean code, reason about data structures and algorithms, and debug unfamiliar problems. * First\-principles and logical thinking. You question assumptions, isolate the essential problem and explain your reasoning clearly. * High initiative and a habit of learning quickly. You have examples of making meaningful progress without waiting for detailed instructions. * A genuine interest in Pramaana's mission. You are deeply excited about reliable, verifiable AI to study the problem and build in this space. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the maturity to stay calm, be candid about uncertainty and work constructively with customers. * Comfort learning from more experienced engineers, asking for help when needed and incorporating feedback quickly. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Built an impressive personal project, research prototype, hackathon project or meaningful open\-source contribution from scratch. * Experience with Python or TypeScript, APIs, backend development, LLM applications, evaluation or developer tools. * Explored formal verification, theorem proving, Lean, logic, symbolic reasoning or AI reliability through work or self\-directed learning. * Hands\-on experience working with users, handling unexpected problems or explaining technical ideas to non\-specialists.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Who are we?** Newcode helps legal organizations build, govern, and deploy AI workflows connected to their knowledge and existing systems. Our Aurora workflow platform enables teams to turn firm expertise into repeatable workflows that operate within the firm’s technology environment. ### **The role** You'll own the backend behind our AI features. That's the APIs, the data pipelines, and the orchestration sitting between our product and the language models doing the work. In practice it means running retrieval over large sets of documents, getting dependable results out of LLMs and their tool calls, streaming responses to the UI, and processing long jobs in the background without things falling over. It isn't CRUD work. The hard parts here are keeping AI systems accurate and fast with confidential data, at production scale. You'll make architecture calls early and live with them. **Requirements** **Turn how legal work gets done into AI workflows lawyers trust** Newcode helps legal organizations build, govern, and deploy AI workflows connected to their knowledge and existing systems. Our Aurora workflow platform enables teams to turn firm expertise into repeatable workflows that operate within the firm's technology environment. Our clients are law firms and professional\-services teams. They know exactly where their work is slow, repetitive, or risky. What they don't know is how to turn that into an AI workflow they can trust with real client work. We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to do exactly that. This role reports to the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering. ### **The Opportunity** You'll work directly with clients to understand how their work actually gets done, and then build it in Aurora, our visual AI workflow builder. Aurora is low\-code. You design flows by connecting components on a canvas, configure the models, prompts, document search, and integrations, and write a short script where the canvas stops. The hard part isn't the code. It's understanding a messy process well enough to break it into steps a model can do reliably, seeing where it will fail before it does, and showing a skeptical partner at a law firm that it works. This role rewards judgment and engineering discipline more than seniority. We care more about how you think than how many years you've written code. You need to be comfortable with hands\-on technical work. For example, you can read API documentation to connect two systems, edit JSON files, write a short Python function when the canvas is not enough, and find out why a flow stopped working. ### **How the team works** You'll report to the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, who manages the FDEs across our client pods and owns engineering quality, staffing, coaching, and technical delivery practices. What you will own * Sit with clients alongside the senior legal engineer and map how a piece of work gets done today: the inputs, the decisions, the exceptions, and who signs off. * Turn the workflow requirements into working flows in Aurora, such as document intake, clause extraction, contract review, drafting, and multi\-step agents. * Configure the building blocks: prompts, model choice, search over client documents, and connections to the systems clients already use, within each firm's access controls and confidentiality boundaries. * Write python scripts where configuration isn't enough, such as a custom component, a data transformation, or an API call, and flag the ones worth reusing across clients. * Test every flow against real examples and the evals agreed with the firm, find where it fails, and fix it before a client finds it. Show with evidence against the legal acceptance criteria, not a demo, that it works. * Run workshops and pilots, help deliver the AI Academy for each firm's Aurora users, and stay responsible for the flow after it goes live, with a named owner and support plan agreed before release. * Follow the FDE team's delivery playbook and technical standards, including design and code reviews, testing, traceability, monitoring, and human review suited to each flow's intended use. * Give realistic estimates, and raise scope changes, risks, and dependencies early with the senior legal engineer and the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering. * Bring what you learn back, through the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, to Product and Engineering as patterns rather than anecdotes: missing features in Aurora, recurring requests and how often they come up, and bugs. * Help the team track delivery time, effort, workflow adoption, and component reuse, so that estimates and client outcomes improve over time. ### **What you bring** * You think in structure. Give you a vague process and you break it into clear steps, inputs, and decisions, and you see where it will go wrong. * You learn a new domain fast. You don't need a law degree, but you'll want to understand how a lawyer reviews a contract or runs a due diligence. * You explain things clearly to a law their needs, and help them realize the immense value AI can create. As part of our collaborative, high\-growth team, you'll work side by side with visionary founders at the forefront of AI and legal innovation, shaping both our product and the definition of AI native legal work. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work directly with clients on AI that ends up in real legal work, not in a demo. You'll help shape how we deploy Aurora, contributing to the Aurora playbook and the field patterns that make it into the product, and you'll grow with regular coaching from the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, clear technical standards, and a team that delivers repeatably rather than through individual heroics. We believe in being transparent about what it's like to work at Newcode.ai. As a fast\-growing startup, we're building and evolving every day. That means not every process, playbook, or framework is already in place, and priorities can shift quickly. The people who thrive here are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership, and don't wait for perfect direction. They are resourceful, proactive, and able to "figure it out", solving problems, creating structure where needed, and helping build the company as they go. If you are good with this, great! Keep reading to learn more. **Company stage.** Newcode is a growth\-stage legal AI company founded in 2021\. It has moved beyond early product validation into scaling deployments and expanding in the U.S. The company describes its product as a configurable AI platform that connects a firm's data, systems, and workflows, with controls for permissions, models, and deployment. **Funding.** Newcode has a total funding of $20 million. The Series A was led by OnDean Forward, with participation from The LegalTech Fund, Antiportfolio Ventures, Relativity's investment arm Rel Labs, and existing investors. **Traction and deployments.** Today Newcode serves more than 100 law firms and government agencies in Europe and the United States, with annual recurring revenue more than tripling over the prior 12 months. Check out our webpage for our most recent customers. **Why now is a compelling time to join.** Newcode is at an exciting stage of growth. With fresh Series A funding and strong customer and revenue growth, we are investing in the next chapter of our growth in Europe and the U.S. Our platform is moving beyond standalone AI tools and into the everyday workflows of leading legal teams. From firmwide deployments to integrated legal research, we are helping customers put AI to work on meaningful, real\-world challenges. As we expand our product, customer support, go\-to\-market, and partnerships, you will have the opportunity to take on important work and help shape how we grow. You will join a global team of more than 60 people, with the scale to serve major organizations and the agility to make a visible impact. If you are excited to build practical AI for the legal industry and help shape a company's next stage of growth, this is a great time to join Newcode. **Benefits** We offer competitive salary, **equity**, and bonus across all locations. Benefits are tailored to each country to meet local requirements and market practice: * **US (Chicago):** Medical, dental, and vision; 401(k); paid time off; * **Norway (Oslo) and Poland (Wrocław):** Statutory benefits plus local offerings, including pension, paid leave, and parental leave ### **The hiring process** * Stage 1: Screening call (15 minutes) * Stage 2: Case assessment: design and build a flow for a realistic client problem (1 hours) * Stage 3: Presentation of your case to the team, including the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering (3 hours) * Stage 4: CEO interview (15 minutes) Newcode is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. **Visa Sponsorship:** At this time, Newcode is unable to provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the applicable country without employer sponsorship.

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Alex \& the Role** -------------------------- Alex is an AI recruiter. Alex screens and interviews candidates over voice — on the web and over the phone — and it works inside the systems companies already recruit with: their applicant tracking system, their requisitions, their hiring process. Enterprises and staffing firms use it to run interviews at a volume they otherwise couldn't. Forward\-Deployed Engineers are the technical owners of every Alex deployment. When a customer signs, FDEs are the people who make Alex work inside their systems and their process — and keep it working. It is the most end\-to\-end engineering role at the company: you design the solution, build it, integrate it, ship it to production, and own it afterwards. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Design and build how a customer uses Alex.** Turn a hiring process described in a meeting into workflows that actually run — triggers, filters, interview guides, and the actions we take back in their ATS. When a customer needs something their setup doesn't do yet, you drive it: design, build, test, roll out, verify. * **Own the integration surface.** We integrate with roughly two dozen applicant tracking systems, some directly and some through a unified API partner. You'll build new integrations, maintain existing ones, and go deep on the ones you own — along with the other systems a customer's workflow reaches into, like assessment providers and identity verification. * **Run the technical side of onboarding.** Connection, permissions and scopes, job import, field mapping, workflow build, test interviews, go\-live — sequenced so nothing is discovered in front of a candidate. * **Own the deployments in production.** The team owns the support queue — for customers and candidates both — and diagnoses to root cause rather than working around it. Turning that into an evidenced case our product engineering team can act on is part of the job. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Real engineering ability. This role reads code, writes code, and ships changes. It is not a technical\-adjacent role. * Comfort working inside someone else's system with incomplete documentation. Much of this job is finding out what a third\-party API actually does, as opposed to what its docs claim. * Debugging instinct — the reflex to go get the evidence rather than reason from the symptom. * Direct customer contact without a buffer. You'll run your own working sessions and say hard things clearly. * Strong writing. A large fraction of the output of this role is a clear written explanation. ### **Nice to have** * Forward\-deployed, implementation, solutions, or integrations engineering experience — especially anywhere with a long tail of third\-party systems. * You've built against a messy enterprise API and lived with the result. * Fluency with observability tooling — logs, traces, dashboards, alerting you had to live with. **Why join** * High ownership and growth opportunities * Collaborate with a tight\-knit team of talented builders * Launch products that directly impact people’s careers * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * FSA, DCFSA, HSA options * Flexible paid time off (PTO) * 401(k) plan * Fully paid parental leave program If you've gotten this far and this role resonates with you, we want you to apply. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Location: New Haven, CT, on\-site Full\-time Reports to: Chief Technology Officer Compensation: $200,000 \- $260,000/yearly plus bonus Company: Bexorg (Bexorg.com (https://bexorg.com)) **About Bexorg:** Bexorg is a precision neurology company working to transform how new medicines for central nervous system (CNS) diseases are discovered and developed. At the intersection of cutting\-edge neuroscience, AI, engineering, and translational drug development, our team combines scientific rigor, responsible stewardship, and cross\-disciplinary collaboration to advance innovative approaches to CNS therapeutics. Our flagship platform, **BrainEx**, is the world's first system to perfuse fresh, whole human postmortem brains through their intact vasculature, restoring and maintaining cellular biology, vascular reactivity, CSF circulation, and an intact blood\-brain barrier. This groundbreaking technology serves as the foundation of an active CNS therapeutics pipeline, including a Phase 1 program in Alzheimer's disease. Our second platform, **NeuroScale**, builds on this foundation by enabling high\-throughput, robotically handled brain\-slice experiments that extend research capabilities from hours to weeks. Every experiment conducted on these platforms carries significant scientific and ethical responsibility. The tissue is generously donated, each experiment is irreplaceable, and the resulting data must meet rigorous standards for accuracy, reliability, and regulatory scrutiny. The software that designs, records, and analyzes these experiments is therefore more than a supporting tool. It is an essential part of our technology, developed in\-house to ensure precision, accountability, and scientific integrity. To support this work, we are looking for curious, accountable individuals who are eager to take on meaningful challenges. At Bexorg, you will collaborate with colleagues who ask thoughtful questions, share ideas openly, and take ownership of moving complex work forward. Whether your expertise is in neuroscience, biology, engineering, data science, or operations, you will have the opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking research and help build a stronger foundation for the development of new CNS medicines. **The Role** We are seeking a **Principal Software Engineer** to own the software through which Bexorg's scientists design experiments on living human brain tissue and interrogate the data those experiments produce. You will lead two flagship efforts: our custom **LIMS**, which supports two applications, **Cortex** for BrainEx and **NeuroscaleOps** for NeuroScale; and **Neurolens**, our AI research harness, which you will re\-architect as a multi\-tenant platform for large pharma partners. This is a hands\-on principal role reporting to the CTO. You will set the technical direction, write a good share of the code, and ship to users who sit a few meters away. The first users of everything you build are the surgeons, perfusionists, neuroscientists, and drug discovery scientists who run the platforms. Their experiment designs become the data model, and the data model becomes the evidence behind our therapeutics. You will spend real time in the lab learning how an experiment on a human brain is actually designed: donors, protocols, dosing arms, sampling timepoints, regions, slices, plates, assays, readouts. You will turn that understanding into systems that make the right thing easy and mistakes hard, and that still make sense of the data years later. You will build on a strong foundation rather than a blank page: a multi\-account AWS estate, an S3\-based datalake, a LIMS in daily production use, and a working AI harness with 200\+ skills. The job is to take systems that already work for one company and make them precise enough for the FDA and general enough for our partners. **What You'll Build** * *1\. The LIMS: experiment design as the data model* Our custom **LIMS** supports two applications, **Cortex** for BrainEx and **NeuroscaleOps** for NeuroScale, on the backend data models beneath them. It is in daily production use. Its most pressing gap is also the most interesting software problem in the company: a first\-rate experience, and a first\-rate data model, for *designing* experiments. An experiment on a donated human brain is designed once and run once. Its design determines what every downstream dataset means: which regions are sampled, which compounds are dosed at which concentrations and timepoints, which slices go to which plates, wells, and assays. Captured as free text, the design leaves the datalake full of results nobody can fully interpret. Captured as validated structure, every readout arrives already knowing what it measures. You will build the loop that makes the second case the default: * Scientists describe our systems and protocols in natural language. * LLMs translate those descriptions into ontologies: the entities, relationships, and constraints of a BrainEx run or a NeuroScale slice ca r SOC 2\. * Real interest in drug discovery, and the patience to learn experiment design in depth from the scientists who do it. * Product sense: you notice when a tool is clumsy and fix it, and you can tell the difference between the feature scientists asked for and the one they need. * Fluency with LLM\-assisted engineering as a daily practice, paired with the judgment to know when the model is wrong. * Excellent written and verbal communication, and demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and setting technical standards. * Proven ability to operate as an aggressive self\-starter: you take ownership, move quickly, and drive projects forward with minimal supervision. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience with a strong track record of impact. * Based in, or willing to relocate to, the New Haven, CT area for an on\-site role. **Nice to Have** * Experience building or operating large multimodal omics datalakes: single\-cell or single\-nucleus transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, or high\-content imaging at scale, and the bioinformatics tooling around them (workflow engines such as Nextflow or Snakemake; scanpy, Seurat, or similar). * Experience with LIMS, ELN, or sample\-tracking systems, commercial (e.g., Benchling) or custom\-built, and strong opinions about why scientists dislike most of them. * Ontology engineering in the life sciences: OBO Foundry ontologies (UBERON, ChEBI, GO, Cell Ontology), knowledge graphs, or semantic\-web tooling. * Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture for enterprise or regulated customers, including security questionnaires, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits, and partner identity federation (SAML, OIDC). * Agentic AI infrastructure: tool and skill protocols, sandboxed execution, evaluation frameworks, and cost and latency control; experience with Amazon Bedrock or comparable model platforms. * Event\-sourced or bitemporal data architectures, and experience versioning schemas and data together. * Background in biopharma, preclinical research, or regulated environments (GLP, IND\-enabling studies, FDA submissions). * Hardware\-adjacent software: telemetry ingestion, IoT fleets (e.g., AWS IoT Greengrass), or lab automation and robotics integration. * Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in computer science, applied mathematics, computational biology, or a related field. **Why Bexorg** * Build software for a platform that exists nowhere else: perfused, metabolically active human brains and robotically handled human brain slices, producing data no other dataset on earth contains. * See the consequences of your work daily. The scientists using your experiment designer and your AI harness sit down the hall from the rigs, and the data they produce feeds an active CNS pipeline that includes a Phase 1 program in Alzheimer's disease. * Solve problems that matter beyond Bexorg. LLM\-derived ontologies as a validation layer, reproducible agentic research under regulatory scrutiny, and multi\-tenant AI infrastructure for pharma are open problems across the industry. You will solve them with real users and real stakes. * Own two systems at principal level, reporting directly to the CTO, in a fast\-moving, well\-funded TechBio company with active partnerships across major biopharma, leading academic institutions, government grantors, and the Michael J. Fox Foundation. * Work on\-site in New Haven, CT, with daily access to the lab, the rigs, the robots, and the people who run them. Compensation includes a competitive salary, meaningful equity, and benefits. This role is on\-site. The work depends on being beside the scientists and the systems they run, and we expect the person in this seat to be here. For a truly exceptional candidate, we are open to a conversation about location. If you want to build the software that lets an experiment on a human brain be designed once, run once, and trusted for years, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. **A few reasons why we think you’d love working here:** * **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE\&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach \& Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney\+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN\+, and much more. * **Innovation:** We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment \& news. **Media Engineering** is an innovative organization that is focused on providing the best possible video playback experience, art, and metadata to customers around the world, powered by exceptional technology. Validated knowledge of operating large\-scale high\-availability backend services and JVM services * Expertise in functional programming patterns and experience building RESTful services (Scala APIs) * Understanding of async programming models (events, callbacks, promises, async/await) and threading/concurrency * Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, databases, etc.) and strong understanding of design patterns and principles * Experience operating within a Public Cloud Provider (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) * Understanding of source control concepts and systems, CI/CD pipelines and exposure to Git * Experience with build and deployment technologies such as Jenkins and Docker. Experience with messaging technologies (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, SQS, etc.) * Experience with observability tools for metrics, logging, and monitoring (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, Grafana) * Knowledge of caching technologies * Knowledge of AGILE/Scrum practices * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Self\-learner, independent, excellent problem\-solving skills \#DISNEYTECH **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Santa Monica, CA is $119,200 \- $159,800 per year, and in New York, NY, it’s $124,900 \- $167,400 per year. jobs.title: Research Engineer - Voice Intelligence
jobs.description: **About Pocket** *At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.* Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it. We’ve built an AI\-powered device that captures real\-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26\), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices. Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet. **About the Role** Real conversations are messy. People interrupt, rooms are noisy, speakers sound similar and a missed detail can change the meaning of a summary. You’ll improve the voice systems that make Pocket useful in those conditions. The work connects applied research to production: define the problem, build an evaluation, test an approach and ship what works. You’ll partner with product and design so technical progress becomes something customers can notice. **What You’ll Own** * Improvements to diarization, voice activity detection, noise robustness, transcription, speaker identification and post\-processing. * Voice\-powered capabilities such as better summaries, action extraction, memory and personalization. * Research loops with explicit metrics, representative evaluation sets and repeatable comparisons. * Moving promising models and algorithms from prototypes into reliable product features. * Streaming performance, latency, fallbacks and behavior when systems cannot produce a confident answer. **What We’re Looking For** * 6–10\+ years shipping production systems with strong technical ownership. * Applied ML or research\-engineering experience, including turning prototypes into dependable software. * A working understanding of audio and voice fundamentals, modern models and evaluation workflows. * Care for performance, reliability and the failure cases that a demo can hide. * The ability to work with product and design and explain technical tradeoffs clearly. **Bonus Points** Streaming audio and real\-time systems; LLM post\-processing and structured extraction; or tools for labeling, dataset curation and quality assurance. Signal\-processing fundamentals are useful too. **What Success Looks Like** Voice quality improves on meaningful evaluations and in everyday use. An offline and online evaluation system catches regressions. New capabilities reach customers with predictable latency and reliable behavior. **Why Join Pocket?** You’ll work on voice captured by a real consumer device, with a direct path from an experiment to a shipped feature. The job gives you room to investigate hard problems without losing the connection to the person relying on the result. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior / Staff AI Research Engineer, Real-Time Inference
jobs.description: **Why RoboForce** RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo\-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company's robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real\-world deployment and scalability. We are looking for a **Senior / Staff AI Research Engineer, Real\-Time Inference** to make embodied AI practical on the edge. In this role, you will drive the full stack of model optimization — from CUDA kernel engineering to quantization and compression — to deploy high\-performance AI models on edge compute platforms powering RoboForce robots in the field. **Responsibilities** * Develop and optimize inference pipelines for embodied AI models (VLA, perception, world models) targeting real\-time execution on edge hardware such as NVIDIA Jetson platforms. * Implement CUDA\-level optimizations including custom kernels, memory layout tuning, and hardware\-aware graph compilation to minimize model latency. * Apply and advance model compression techniques — quantization (INT8/FP16/INT4\), pruning, distillation, and structured sparsity — to achieve production\-grade throughput on constrained devices. * Profile and debug end\-to\-end inference stacks using tools such as NSight, TensorRT, and Triton to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks. * Collaborate with ML research and robotics teams to co\-design model architectures that meet real\-time control\-loop latency requirements. * Establish benchmarking frameworks to evaluate model performance across latency, throughput, power consumption, and accuracy tradeoffs on target hardware. **Requirements** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 4\+ years of experience, or a PhD degree. * Deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and low\-level kernel optimization, including custom kernel authoring with tools such as Triton. * Hands\-on experience with model quantization, pruning, distillation, and deployment using frameworks such as TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, TVM, or Triton. * Proficiency in C\+\+ and Python; strong systems programming and performance profiling skills. * Experience deploying ML models on edge or embedded hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Orin, or equivalent ARM/GPU SoCs). * **Requires 5 days/week in\-office collaboration with the teams.** **Bonus Qualifications** * Familiarity with embodied AI models — VLA, multimodal transformers, or diffusion\-based policies — and their inference characteristics. * Familiarity with compiler\-based optimization pipelines such as XLA, torch.compile, or MLIR for graph\-level model acceleration. * Understanding of robotics system constraints such as control\-loop timing, sensor fusion latency, and memory bandwidth limits on edge SoCs. * Publication or production work in efficient deep learning or on\-device ML systems. **Benefits** * Competitive stock options/equity programs. * Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plan. * Visa sponsorship and green card support for qualified candidates. * Lunches and dinners, a fully stocked kitchen, and regular team\-building events. Compensation: Salary $185,000–$325,000 USD \+ Bonus \+ Equity The base salary range above represents the expected compensation for this full\-time U.S. position. Final compensation will be determined based on role scope, level, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training, and may fall outside the listed range in exceptional cases.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** As a Senior Embedded Engineer, you’ll design, build, and validate firmware and embedded software for connected devices. You’ll work across hardware, operating systems, networking, and application development to turn product requirements into reliable solutions. Your impact: thoughtful design and rigorous testing help product teams deliver dependable devices that work well for the people who use them. **Responsibilities** * Develop embedded systems programming and firmware in C, C\+\+, and Embedded C for ARM microcontrollers, real\-time operating systems (RTOS), and Linux. * Design software and algorithms; integrate sensors, printed circuit boards (PCBs), field\-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), and Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity such as Zigbee and Ethernet. * Debug and test hardware and software using soldering tools, logic analyzers, unit testing, test automation, and software quality assurance practices. * Build and troubleshoot interfaces, RESTful application programming interfaces (APIs), and data flows using JSON, TCP/IP, and relevant cloud or database services. * Collaborate in Agile or Scrum workflows; document designs with Unified Modeling Language (UML) and tools such as Jira, Git, Jenkins, and Confluence. **Requirements** * Demonstrated experience with embedded systems, microcontroller programming, firmware, computer hardware, and engineering troubleshooting. * Proficiency in C or C\+\+ and embedded debugging; familiarity with Python, Bash or other scripting languages, software testing, and version control. * Working knowledge of real\-time systems, operating systems, computer networking, signal processing, and device interfaces. * Helpful additional experience includes FPGA, machine learning, MATLAB or Simulink, Raspberry Pi, AWS, SQL databases, Android, or application development. * Exposure to other listed technologies—including Java, JavaScript, C\#,.NET, PHP, Objective\-C, Perl, Visual Basic, VBA, HTML, CSS, XML, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, SVN, Eclipse, Visual Studio, and network monitoring—is welcome, but not required. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Design Engineer
jobs.description: Portland, Oregon, USA OR Austin, Texas, USA OR The Senior Firmware Design Engineer will spend 100% of working time performing the following duties: CPU Firmware Architecture and Development: Architect, develop, and maintain low\-level firmware and device drivers in C/C\+\+ and assembly language targeting bare\-metal and pre\-OS execution environments on RISC\-V processor platforms. Define firmware module boundaries, hardware abstraction layer (HAL) interfaces, and initialization sequencing for novel proprietary CPU designs. Write production\-quality firmware for CPU bring\-up, power management, system initialization, diagnostics, and hardware debug. Hardware\-Software Interface Definition and RISC Architecture Support: practical knowledge of RISC\-based processor architectures, including assembly code understanding and execution flow, to define and implement firmware interfaces for custom CPU features. Collaborate directly with CPU architecture and RTL design teams on custom instruction set extensions, machine\-mode control and status registers (CSRs), and memory\-mapped I/O peripheral configuration. Translate hardware architectural specifications into firmware\-level interface requirements and implementation plans. Bootloader and Platform Bring\-Up Development: Design, implement, and validate bootloaders, ROM initialization sequences, and full platform bring\-up code. Implement firmware\-controlled memory initialization routines including DRAM training and initialization procedures. Optimize system boot performance and firmware runtime behavior for latency, power efficiency, and reliability. Develop and maintain support for firmware standards including UEFI/ACPI and open\-source bootloaders such as U\-Boot where applicable. Pre\-Silicon and Post\-Silicon Validation Support: Develop and deploy firmware for use in hardware verification, RTL simulation, and FPGA emulation environments to validate and stress CPU designs prior to physical silicon tape\-out. Perform hardware model bring\-up and debug activities using GDB\-based debug mechanisms and associated tooling including JTAG debug infrastructure (e.g., OpenOCD, Lauterbach). Support post\-silicon lab bring\-up including board initialization, failure analysis, and root cause analysis on hardware\-firmware interaction failures. Firmware Security Implementation (approx. 15%) Design and implement security\-critical firmware features including secure boot, hardware root\-of\-trust, key provisioning, and trusted firmware components. Ensure firmware security architecture complies with industry best practices and relevant platform security standards. Collaborate with security\-focused architecture teams to translate hardware security primitives into robust firmware\-enforced security policies. **Minimum Requirements**: * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field, plus three (3\) years of post\-baccalaureate professional experience to include: * Developing low\-level device drivers and infrastructure firmware for SoC, CPU and/or GPU emulation platforms in C/C\+\+ programming language, targeting pre\-silicon execution environments. * ing practical knowledge of RISC\-based assembly code understanding and execution flow and verification purposes. * Performing hardware model bring\-up and debug activities using GDB\-based debug mechanisms and associated tooling. * Experience with memory\-mapped I/O peripheral configuration and DRAM initialization procedures. * Experience with industry\-standard software build systems (e.g. Make, CMake) and maintaining codebases using version control software (Git or Perforce). * Documenting infrastructure firmware design decisions and collaborating with hardware engineering and architecture teams to support software\-hardware integration. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary and benefits package. * Opportunities for professional growth in an innovative startup environment. * Collaboration with talented engineers passionate about cutting\-edge CPU technologies. * Opportunity to disrupt the CPU ecosystem

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Pinecliff Software Group is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to design, build and maintain the infrastructure supporting its freight and logistics software. Based at 1020 Rosario St, Laredo, TX 78040, this role involves developing deployment pipelines, establishing monitoring systems and improving the reliability of cloud\-based platforms. You will work closely with software development and infrastructure teams to maintain deployment environments, automate operational processes and ensure that critical systems remain available. The position also involves participating in an on\-call rotation, investigating production incidents and mentoring other engineers. The regular work schedule is Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Central Time, with additional on\-call responsibilities according to the team rotation. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop and maintain deployment pipelines for freight and logistics software. * Build and maintain CI/CD workflows to automate application builds, testing and releases. * Develop monitoring systems, dashboards and alerts to track infrastructure performance and service availability. * Manage cloud infrastructure and container\-based environments. * Improve deployment reliability and reduce manual problem is clear * Strong presentation skills, with a track record of value\-based demos that lead with outcomes instead of features * Experience supporting complex, high\-value deals with sales cycles of three months or longer * The ability to manage several active deals at once and respond on the prospect's timeline * Clear communication with audiences from operations staff to executives expectations for the Revenova implementation team with achievable on\-time go\-lives * Strong partnership with Account Executives, who rely on you as a trusted advisor to their prospects * Prospects jobs.description: AssistCall, a product of Starling Global, builds AI receptionist and business calling software. RESPONSIBILITIES * Design dialogue state, structured tool contracts, retrieval boundaries and durable workflow state for live voice agents. * Implement cancellation, retries, timeouts and idempotency across model requests, telephony events and external business APIs. * Build evaluation sets from consented, appropriately handled examples; prevent train/test leakage and track scenario coverage. * Separate model reasoning from execution authority, including confirmation before payments, account changes and other consequential actions. * Diagnose latency across speech detection, model inference, tool calls and audio playback using traces and reproducible experiments. * Lead design reviews and mentor engineers while continuing to write and operate production code. jobs.description: **Overview** **Role: Staff ML Engineer – experience in Semiconductor Domain.** **Location: San Jose, CA, USA. Day 1 onsite** **Department: ML** Job Description About the role We're looking for an ML engineer who works across the full stack from model to silicon — comfortable optimizing training and inference performance on GPU/AI\-accelerator infrastructure, building or tuning models, and adapting model and inference\-engine design to the constraints of the underlying chip and its NPU. You'll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. What you'll do Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring Qualifications What we're looking for 5–7\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master's required, PhD preferred Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don't expect all five: NPU / AI\-accelerator — hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work Systems / Sys\-level software — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software Inference engine / runtime — built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints Test / verification harness — built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness Cyber security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security Pay: $75\.00 \- $78\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Method is a global design and engineering consultancy founded in 1999\. We believe that innovation should be meaningful, beautiful, and human. We craft practical, powerful digital experiences that improve lives and transform businesses. Our teams \[based in New York, Charlotte, Atlanta, Tokyo, London, Bengaluru, and remote] work with a wide range of organizations in many industries, including Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, Automotive, Aviation, and Professional Services. Method is part of Hitachi Digital, a digital product engineering company. Hitachi Digital integrates experience design and complex engineering to help our clients imagine what's possible and accelerate their transition into tomorrow's digital businesses. Hitachi Digital is a Hitachi Group Company. We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our team working with a client in the energy sector. Our client is a non\-profit organization that plans for and coordinates the electrical grid across its region. It doesn't own any part of the grid. Our team builds the software that helps them make the best decisions they can about how that grid grows. This is a complicated domain, and the software is more complicated still. You will crunch large volumes of planning data, build and secure APIs, and work through authentication and access across many systems. The people you build for are electrical engineers, not software engineers, so much of the job is translation. You'll need to understand what they're asking, go to them with your own questions, and turn the answers into working software. You don't need to arrive knowing how transmission planning works. You do need to want to find out. The people who do well here watch the YouTube videos, ask the LLMs, read the documentation, and come back with better questions. If Ohm's Law makes you curious rather than nervous, that's a good sign. From a technology side, the client is building APIs with Java and Spring Boot, with some existing code in Python and front ends in React and TypeScript. Java is the core of the work, but we care more about how you learn than what you already know. Use AI to write code where it helps, provided you can read it, validate it, and stand behind it. Method has a core value centered on learning, so if you wonder if you're qualified (or need to learn one of the tech stacks), please apply and we can decide together if this opportunity is a good fit for you. At Method, we strive to work in a collaborative and supportive environment, and we look for people who can work flexibly and enjoy working as part of a team. In this role, you will be part of a small, dedicated team contributing to the day\-to\-day delivery of a key work stream, working alongside engineers in parallel workstreams to keep cross\-team dependencies aligned. Strategic thinking and creative problem solving are key skills to have at Method, as well as the love of continuously learning and sharing knowledge. Travel for team and client meetings may be required, typically up to 15%. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain APIs and back\-end services in Java and Spring Boot that support the client's transmission planning work. * Process, validate, and move large volumes of grid and planning data between systems, including batch job orchestration. * Design and implement security, authentication, and access control across services. * Own CI/CD pipelines, environments, and deployments, and keep systems observable through logging and metrics. * Work directly with the client's electrical engineers to understand their problems, ask the questions that matter, and translate domain needs into technical requirements. * Work problems through on your own first, then bring options and a recommendation to the team. * Help the team prioritize when there is more to build than time to build it, and be clear about the trade\-offs. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to raise delivery speed, and review and test what they produce before it ships. * Mentor teammates and share what you learn about the domain so the whole team gets sharper. ### **Qualifications** You will succeed in this role if you have: * 6\+ years of experience building back\-end systems and APIs, with Java and Spring Boot strongly preferred. * A track record of learning new languages, codebases, and domains quickly and becoming productive in them. * Curiosity about how complex systems work, shown in what you've chosen to learn on your own. * Strong problem\-solving skills. You figure things out yourself first, and you know when to ask. * Strong communication skills, including explaining technical ideas to experts from other fields and drawing out what they need. * Comfort reaching out to the client directly, without waiting for someone to do it for you. * Broad technical range across APIs, data, security, and infrastructure, rather than depth in a single layer. * Strong understanding of RESTful principles, with experience using OpenAPI standards, Swagger, and Postman to design, document, and test APIs. * Experience with API security, authentication, and authorization (e.g., OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, role\-based access control). * Experience working with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle) and data\-heavy workloads. * DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), cloud platforms, logging, and metrics. * Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools, with the judgment to validate their output. * Experience in agile development methodologies and tools for version control (i.e., Git, Bitbucket), continuous integration, and deployment. * Experience leading pieces of work and mentoring other engineers. ### **Beneficial Qualities** * Experience in the energy or utility industry * Familiarity with power systems or electrical grid concepts such as transmission planning, power flow, or generation interconnection * Proficiency with Python * Experience with React and TypeScript for building user interfaces that consume APIs * Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) * Work well with others * You love the journey as much as the destination ### **Why Method?** We look for individuals who are smart, kind and brave. Curious people with a natural ability to think on their feet, learn fast, and develop points\-of\-view for a constantly changing world find Method an exciting place to work. Our employees are excited to collaborate with dispersed and diverse teams that bring together the best in thinking and making. We champion the ability to listen, and believe that critique and dissonance lead to better outcomes. We believe everyone has the capacity to lead and look for proactive individuals who can take and give direction, lead by example, enjoy the making as much as they do the thinking, especially at senior and leadership levels. We believe in work/life balance. Seriously. We offer a ton of competitive perks, including: * Continuing education opportunities * Flexible PTO and work\-from\-home policies * 401K matching * Health, Dental and Vision benefits, starting on day 1 * Company lunches, company outings, along with a lot of snacks * Health and wellness programs * Other location specific perks (just ask!) ### **Next Steps** If Method sounds like the place for you, please submit an application. Also, let us know if you have a presence online with a portfolio, GitHub, Dribbble or other platform. *For information on how we process your personal data please see* *Privacy**.* *If you are a California resident, more details on how we process your personal information can be found in the* *CCPA Recruitment Privacy Notice**.* **Colorado Applicants** *(Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act Disclosure): The starting salary range for this role to be performed in Colorado is estimated to be between* **$145,000** ***to*** **$175,000** *annually. This salary range is specific to Colorado residents only, and provided as a general estimate. The amount offered may be higher or lower. Method takes many factors into making an offer, including candidate qualifications, work experience, operational needs, travel and onsite requirements, internal peer equity, prevailing wage, responsibilities, and other market and business considerations.* **New York City Applicants** *(New York City Local Law 32; Pay Transparency Law): The starting salary range for this role to be performed in New York City is from* **$160,000** ***to*** **$195,000** annually. *This salary range is specific to New York City residents only, and provided as a general, good faith estimate. The amount offered may be higher or lower. Method takes many factors into making an offer, including candidate qualifications, work experience, operational needs, travel and onsite requirements, internal peer equity, prevailing wage, responsibilities, and other market and business considerations.*

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer-Marketing Technology
jobs.description: **This is a remote position** The Opportunity AAPC seeks a hands\-on lead software engineer to help build and evolve the customer\-facing digital products, e\-commerce experiences, and marketing technology that take people from discovery through membership, certification, and renewal. Our Marketing team relies on capable platforms, including HubSpot, Contentful, RudderStack, and our CRM. The opportunity now is to connect them with a clear integration strategy, so data flows reliably into a holistic view of our members and customers, and Marketing has the insight it needs to do its best work. This role is for someone who can see the whole forest and still build what is needed. We default to buying proven platforms and integrating them well, and you know how to work inside those systems as designed. But purchased tools are only part of the picture. Some needs call for custom software: customer\-facing applications, e\-commerce and member experiences, services, APIs, and event pipelines that fill gaps between platforms and carry logic unique to AAPC. When building is the right call, you design, deliver, and support that software to the same standard as any production system: well\-tested, secure, observable, and maintainable. You will not do this alone. You will work closely with our platform engineering team, understanding and contributing to the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability that everything you build runs on. You will also partner with our data platform team to ensure member and customer data, including the identifiers and events needed to connect identities across systems, arrives complete, consistent, and ready to use. Modern tooling has fundamentally changed what an exceptional engineer can accomplish. In this role, you will treat AI as an extension of your engineering team. By leveraging agentic coding tools, reusable skills, agentic engineering practices, established components, and internal frameworks, you will orchestrate work that historically required a much larger team. You will bring the same thinking to Marketing itself, building AI\-enabled tools and workflows that make marketers more self\-sufficient. This is primarily a hands\-on engineering role. You will serve as the technical lead for our Marketing Technology team, helping set standards and supporting a team with strong front\-end and CMS skills as they grow into well\-rounded engineers across integration and data work, automated testing and observability, and agentic engineering practices. From time to time, you will also step into interim team leadership to keep work moving. What You’ll Do * Help define the integration strategy and target architecture for AAPC’s marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Contentful, RudderStack, our CRM, and the other systems Marketing depends on. * Design, build, and operate custom services, APIs, and customer\-facing applications, including e\-commerce and member experiences for both anonymous visitors and logged\-in members, where purchased platforms fall short. Support them in production after launch, held to the same standards as the rest of our production software. * Build and maintain the integrations, adapters, and CMS components that connect our platforms and let Marketing self\-serve routine changes, with loose coupling, well\-defined data contracts, and security built in. * Partner with our data platform and platform engineering teams to get member, customer, and engagement data flowing reliably into our data platform, including the events, identifiers, and consent data needed to connect identities across web, email, CRM, and commerce, so Marketing has a trustworthy, holistic view of the people we serve. * Translate our search and AI\-visibility strategy (SEO, GEO, and AEO) into technical capabilities, such as structured data, machine\-readable content, metadata architecture, and crawler\-friendly application patterns, so people and AI agents can find and understand what we offer. * Recommend when to build, buy, integrate, or retire. Reduce our technology footprint by consolidating overlapping tools and moving one\-off solutions onto trusted, supported platforms. * Partner with our platform engineering team to meet the platform’s infrastructure, deployment, and observability standards, so the software and integrations you build run on our cloud infrastructure with the same monitoring and incident response as the rest of our platform. * Go beyond system health to behavioral observability: confirm that critical customer journeys, authentication, integrations, GA4 measurement, consent behavior, and e\-commerce flows still work correctly after every release, so engineering catches and owns problems rather than customers discovering them. * Contribute to our shared engineering lifecycle: build automated test coverage into your work, use and strengthen the quality gates in platform engineering’s CI/CD pipelines, and verify releases across application boundaries  consolidation without disrupting live campaigns. We value demonstrated capability, judgment, and personal drive. This role calls for someone who has seen marketing technology done well and done poorly, has the scars to show for it, and can use that experience to help a team move quickly and deliberately. We will level this role based on demonstrated capability, from senior through principal. Show Us What Drives You We want to know what you chose to build, not just what an employer assigned to you. We encourage you to share something that demonstrates your curiosity, initiative, and passion for the craft. The subject matter does not need to align with AAPC’s products. We are interested in what you chose to learn, the problems you encountered, the decisions you made, and whether you cared enough to bring the idea to life. If you have an integration, data, or marketing technology story you are proud of, or one that taught you a hard lesson, we would love to hear it. AAPC (www.aapc.com) is the world’s largest and fastest\-growing healthcare training, certification, and solutions association. **AAPC Values:** DRIVEN \| Self\-starts and stays highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals. Shares contagious energy and enthusiasm liberally. Takes initiative without always being directed. Demonstrates confidence in decision\-making and effectively balances autonomy and authority with accountability. HUMBLE \| Learns, adapts, and improves relentlessly. Seeks feedback without insecurity and implements coaching. Recognizes others' contributions gratefully. Approaches work and relationships with an abundance mentality. Places the needs of others above self. TRANSPARENT\| Integrity\-centered, honest, truthful, and trustworthy in all aspects of work. Keeps commitments to external and internal parties. Holds self strictly accountable, valuing the trust placed in them by others. SUPPORTIVE \| Empowers and uplifts others. Listens actively and responds with empathy and understanding. Prioritizes well\-being and growth of team members and customers ahead of own interest. Faces challenges together, believing in collective strength and unity. INNOVATIVE \| Entrepreneurial spirit with a scrappy mentality. Dreams big, sees opportunity, pursues full potential, and finds ways to accomplish the impossible. Rolls up sleeves and does real work. Works quickly, intelligently, and flexibly. **What we Offer:*** Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance * Health Savings Account * Generous PTO and Holiday Pay * 401(k) retirement plan * Remote/virtual\-office consideration AAPC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company is committed to fairness and equal opportunity in our hiring practices. We do not discriminate on grounds unrelated to a candidate's ability to perform the duties of the job. Our focus is on finding the best person for each role, based on merit and fit, to ensure success both for our company and for the individual's professional growth. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company does not and will not discriminate in employment and personnel practices on the basis of race, sex, age, disability, religion, national origin, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Hiring, transferring and promotion practices are performed without regard to the above\-listed items. AAPC uses artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted tools in parts of our recruiting process for some positions.
