jobs.title: Senior Warehouse Automation & Systems Engineer
jobs.description: In 2002, AKIRA opened the doors to its first women's clothing boutique in Chicago. Since then, the company has extended its reach to 40\+ stores across the United States, as well as a thriving eCommerce business (shopAKIRA.com). AKIRA is extremely well\-poised for sustained growth as we continue to build a nationally recognized brand. AKIRA's culture has one very large, distinct difference from other high fashion competitors: Other\-Worldly Customer Service and Fanatical, Obsessive Attention to the consumer's needs and desires. The core principle for all employees at AKIRA is to Act and Think Like an Owner, and this belief can be reflected across all areas of the company. **The Position:** Senior Warehouse Automation \& Systems Engineer **Location:** Bolingbrook, IL, with time at Chicago HQ (200 N Fairfield Ave) as needed. **Reports to:** Director of IT **Position Type:** Temp\-to\-Hire. This role starts as a temporary position with the intent to convert to full\-time employment. The temporary term is typically 6 months, and conversion may happen sooner based on performance. ###### **Position Overview** As the Senior Warehouse Automation \& Systems Engineer, you will own robot uptime, warehouse automation, and warehouse IT at our Bolingbrook warehouse. This is a senior engineering role that also covers day\-to\-day helpdesk support for the warehouse. You will keep our Geekplus robots, warehouse systems, and floor technology running at a high level. You will find the root cause of failures and fix them for good. You will also build the maintenance plans, documentation, and automated workflows that prevent downtime before it happens. You will work closely with warehouse leadership, operations staff, the Director of IT, and Geekplus to keep operations efficient and productive. Our Bolingbrook warehouse supports production, packing, and retail operations. It runs Geekplus goods\-to\-person robots, TSC and Zebra label printers, RF scanners, and our warehouse management system (WMS). You will be the site owner for this equipment. You will diagnose and repair robot hardware, and manage the vendor relationship with Geekplus. **Essential Functions** * **Solution\-Oriented Mindset:** Focus not just on the problems but on the most efficient ways to solve. Embrace challenges as opportunities to innovate and improve. * **Hands\-On Problem Solving:** Approach technical challenges with practical, efficient solutions tailored to the warehouse environment. * **Proactiveness:** Instead of merely reacting to issues, foresee potential challenges and strategize to mitigate them. This forward\-thinking approach will significantly reduce escalations and improve overall system stability. * **Clear Communication:** Effectively explain technical solutions to non\-technical staff. * **Integrity \& Transparency:** Being open about challenges, mistakes, and victories creates a culture of trust. Uphold ethical standards and communicate transparently with all stakeholders. * **Calm Under Pressure:** When unexpected issues arise, maintaining a calm demeanor, and leading the team effectively through the crisis will be a key determinant of success. * **Safety First:** Follow all vendor and site safety procedures when working on or near robots and automated equipment. Put safety ahead of speed. * **Creative Problem Solving:** Think outside the box. Find practical, low\-cost fixes with what is on hand, build smart workarounds when parts or vendors are delayed, and question how things are done today. * **Independent Ownership:** Work with a high degree of autonomy. Use sound judgment, set priorities, and be the go\-to person for warehouse technology. **Key Responsibilities** * **Internal Customer Support:** Provide hands\-on helpdesk support for warehouse staff and leadership, including computers, accounts, printers, scanners, and Wi\-Fi. Deliver unsurpassed support. Take ownership of complex and high\-impact issues from start to finish. * **Expert Technical Troubleshooting:** Own system stability for warehouse technology. Troubleshoot advanced hardware, software, and network problems. Find the root cause and put lasting fixes in place. * **Warehouse IT Ownership:** Own the warehouse IT environment, including the WMS, network, end\-user devices, and floor hardware. Set priorities for site support work based on impact to operations. * **Process \& Best Practices:** Maintain and improve IT and equipment documentation so it stays accurate and useful. * **Ticketing and ITSM:** Manage warehouse tickets in Freshservice. Follow SLAs and prioritize by impact on operations. Make sure each resolution is documented clearly so it can be reused. * **Label Printers and Scanners:** Own support and configuration for TSC and Zebra label printers, handheld barcode and RF scanners, and similar warehouse hardware. Keep these devices running so production, packing, and shipping are not delayed. * **Runbooks:** Write and maintain clear runbooks for robot repair and  experience working with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). * Experience with ITSM and ticketing processes, such as working tickets in Freshservice or a similar tool, following SLAs, prioritizing, and documenting resolutions. * Hands\-on experience with TSC and Zebra label printers and handheld barcode or RF scanners in a warehouse environment. * Experience with Geekplus or similar warehouse robotics, such as autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) or goods\-to\-person systems. * Proven mechanical troubleshooting and repair skills. * Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi networks and wireless access points. * Ability to follow safety procedures step by step, including PPE, lockout, and lithium battery safety rules. * Willingness to complete Geekplus training on the robots and related equipment, including service and repair training. * Ability to provide on\-call support for the Bolingbrook location as needed. * Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and tickets with a calm, proactive mindset. * Problem\-solver who can research and recommend solutions independently and knows when to escalate to the Director of IT or Geekplus. * Self\-motivated, eager to learn, and always looking for ways to improve systems, processes, or documentation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Mechanical or electromechanical background, such as industrial maintenance, mechatronics, or a robotics technician program. * Hands\-on replacement of motors, wheels, drive units, sensors, belts, or batteries on AMRs, conveyors, or similar equipment. * Ability to read mechanical and electrical diagrams and vendor service manuals. * Hands\-on use of AI tools and LLMs in an operations setting. * Experience with workflow automation tools, such as n8n or Power Automate. * Basic scripting in Python or PowerShell. * Working knowledge of cloud architecture, such as Microsoft Azure virtual machines, virtual networks, DNS, identity, and backups, and how cloud services connect to on\-site warehouse systems. * Experience working with APIs and robot management system data. **Physical Demands** * Lift and carry robot components and IT equipment. * Stand and walk on the warehouse floor for extended periods. * Bend, kneel, and reach to service robots and charging stations. * Work safely around moving robots and automated equipment. * Follow warehouse safety rules and wear required PPE, such as safety shoes, gloves, and goggles. **Employment Terms** * This is a temp\-to\-hire position. The role starts as a temporary position with the intent to convert to full\-time employment. * The temporary term is typically 6 months. * Conversion to full\-time employment may happen before the 6 months are complete, based on performance and business needs. * The role is based at the Bolingbrook warehouse. It includes travel between Bolingbrook and Chicago HQ as needed. * This role may include on\-call support for the Bolingbrook location, including evenings or weekends as needed. * Eligibility for the full\-time benefits listed below begins on conversion to full\-time employment. **Benefits and Perks:** AKIRA offers competitive benefits for full\-time employees, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Pet Insurance, Life, LTD, FSA/HSA/Dependent Care FSA, Flex Transit (CTA), 401(k), and a generous employee discount. Compensation for this position will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job\-related factors. Additional compensation and benefits may also apply and will be discussed during the hiring process. We may utilize AI\-assisted and automated tools as part of the recruiting and hiring process. All employment decisions are made in compliance with applicable laws and without discrimination.

jobs.description: Actionstep is a pioneer in the development and sale of software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) products, specializing in the delivery of Legal Practice Management software. Our platform runs on TypeScript services, React micro\-frontends and a shared design system, on AWS across multiple regions. Our Product Development teams work across North America, the UK and Asia\-Pacific. Each team works within one time\-zone band, so its members share a working day. This role leads teams in both North America and Asia\-Pacific. **Engineering Director – AI Products** AI Products owns the AI features built into our products along with the AI, data and workflow capabilities that the power our platform, such as agents, open APIs and MCP, search, analytics and workflow automation. You lead several teams through their engineering managers, and work alongside a product lead and product managers for each area. **Location \-** Denver, Colorado (hybrid). In this role, you will: * **Lead through managers \-** you set direction, standards and priorities for a group of teams, and grow the managers who run them. * **Ship AI to production \-** you work with product to turn the AI roadmap into features firms use every day, with permissions, privacy and audit built in. * **Build shared platform capabilities \-** you make sure agents, APIs, search, data and workflow work reliably for every Actionstep product. * **Run AI responsibly and efficiently \-** you build evaluation, observability and cost discipline into how AI features are designed and run. * **Raise the bar on how we build \-** you bring every team in the group onto our AI development lifecycle and make delivery predictable. * **Lead across time zones \-** you run a group split between North America and Asia\-Pacific, which means some early or late calls. **Other Responsibilities:** * Undertaking any other reasonable duties as required **Requirements** **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS** * **Director\-level leadership \-** you have led multiple teams through engineering managers. * **AI in production \-** you have shipped AI or agent features in a production SaaS product, including the evaluation, permissions, observability and cost management that come with them. * **Led AI PDLC adoption** \- you have moved an engineering org to AI\-driven development and can show what changed, with data. You use AI coding tools yourself and have led a team that builds with them. * **Platform and API experience \-** you have built services and APIs that other teams and outside developers depend on. * **Trust and privacy \-** you have built software that handles confidential or regulated data. * **Hands\-on AI experience \-** you use AI coding tools yourself and have led teams that build with them. * **Distributed team leadership \-** you have led teams across distant time zones. **Desirable:** Experience with search, data platforms or workflow engines, or with software for legal or other professional services, is a plus. **Leadership qualities:** * Leads through managers and tech leads, and raises the hiring bar. * Makes sound calls with incomplete information, and changes course when the data says so. * Explains complex technical trade\-offs simply to executives and non\-technical colleagues. * Coaches and grows engineers and engineering managers. * Builds trust across teams, functions and time zones. * Holds a high bar for quality and owns outcomes, not just activity. **WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH** **Reports To:** * CTO **INTERNAL RELATIONSHIPS** * Engineering leadership and engineering teams * Product and design * Executive team * Finance, implementation and customer teams **Benefits** We have a fantastic and inspirational working environment! * Robust medical, dental, vision offerings * 401K with company match * Flexible working and PTO * Take your birthday off * Frequent team building events * Fantastic training and development opportunities * 200\-225k salary

(ADTI), is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to support our Ponca City, Oklahoma manufacturing facility. ASC is a leading manufacturer of air distribution and ventilation products serving commercial, industrial, and institutional construction markets throughout North America. operation. **What You'll Do** ------------------ As a Manufacturing Engineer, you will support day\-to\-day manufacturing operations while driving improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost engineering experience within a production environment. * Experience supporting sheet metal fabrication, metal forming, assembly, or similar manufacturing processes. * Working knowledge of: + Design jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Our mission** =============== Ajax is on a mission to help law firms capture and organize their latent knowledge and put it to work. The legal services industry takes in over $1T in annual revenue and boasts 1\.5 million practicing attorneys just here in the US, but AI has clients wondering what exactly they're paying so much for. These clients are half\-right: AI makes it faster to draft rote motions and review voluminous documents during discovery. But law firms have never been in the business of mutating and transmitting documents; they're paid to apply their firm's institutional knowledge and best practices to their clients' specific cases. Ajax automatically captures this knowledge and helps firms redeploy it toward faster, cheaper, and more effective legal services. **The Company** =============== Our mission is lofty, but our product provides tangible, day\-1 benefit to firms. We started by addressing the firm’s core revenue driver: our AI timekeeping product tracks attorneys' work and draftsbillable time entries for them, finding each attorney tens of thousands of incremental dollars per year. This product has 5x annual growth, hundreds of law firms, and thousands of DAUs. **Metrics we’re proud of** * **14** customers have invested in Ajax with their own money * **\<1% Customer Churn**: we build long\-term partnerships with our customers *(\<10% annual is considered good)* * **97% Pilot Conversion Rate**: when we start pilots, we win them *(\>70% is considered good)* * **130% Net Dollar Retention:** after firms convert with Ajax, happy users share it with more and more colleagues *(\>120% is considered good)* **The Role** ============ The core function of this role is to extend Ajax's data capture mechanism to solve previously\-intractable technical problems for America's largest law firms. You will: * Discover customer problems * Prototype solutions * Extend these prototypes into paid products **By day 30**: you'll have built a new billing system integration, unlocking meaningful revenue in a new segment of the legal market. Building these integrations requires a bit of grit, but it's all worth it to see new firms start pilots and convert \- and that starts the flywheel of customer trust that unlocks meaningful product work. **By day 60**: you'll ship a meaningful customer\-facing feature. To figure out what to build, you'll lean on your initial relationships and get up to speed on how law firms operate. Some sample first projects you might work on: a client\-management page, our iOS application, or **By day 90**: you'll work with bigger law firms, build on your customer relationships, and help us figure out what to build next. ### **Who you are** * **Ownership:** a wise man\* once said the difference between senior engineers and junior engineers is that senior engineers own the feature into production and beyond. Is that you? * **Empathy**: to build features end\-to\-end, you must be able to walk in our customers' shoes. Our company makes BS work go away for lawyers that work really hard; that needs to speak to you. * **Resourceful**: you're scrappy: you prefer figuring bugs out yourself to throwing your hands up. * my coworker Andrew ### **You’ll excel here if:** * You'd rather be a Product Engineer than a Solutions Architect \- you like to build new features, prototype with customers, and drive solutions to scale * Your reward function is customer happiness (stolen verbatim from our 2nd engineer). * You want ownership \- that means shipping your ideas and owning the results. * You like adventure. We’re solving an unsolved problem, so we need to be brave and rigorous in our exploration. The optimal number of unsuccessful experiments is higher than 0\. I like working here because we win a lot, we’re solving thorny technical challenges, and at least once a week a customer tells me that our product is saving their life. If that sounds fun to you, please apply! **FAQs** -------- * **How far along are we?** + We have over 250 paying law firms and thousands of users + Our team is 16 people + We’ve raised $15mm in venture funding from excellent VCs * **Can I work remotely?** + We usually work 5 days/week in\-person in FiDi, NYC. We’re flexible, though, and we get that people are adults \- Tyler worked from home when he had some family staying over, and Nat took a Wednesday off recently because she had to take delivery of a rare fish (don't ask). * **Compensation:** $210\-$270k base \+ .25%\-.75% equity. + The range is wide because we’re open to a range of seniorities. + Offers may extend above but will not dip below the stated range. + We also offer unlimited PTO, paid lunch/dinner on Fridays, and health/dental/vision. *Roger slept through his alarm and joined standup* *Innovation that excites from Brandon* *Tyler can be a lot* Compensation Range: $210K \- $270K

jobs.description: **Akur8** **is a fast\-growing InsurTech scale\-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.** **Our next\-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data\-driven systems.** Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to **10x faster** while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust. As our product suite expands, we are building an end\-to\-end platform supporting pricing, reserving, and forward\-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment. **Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:** * *CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025\)* * *CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025\)* * *InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025\)* * *Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025\)* **With 40\+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 320\+ clients across 4 continents while maintaining a strong engineering and product culture.** *We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions.* **Akur8 is a global insurance technology company trusted by leading carriers. We build software that shapes billions of dollars in risk decisions every year, turning complex data into actionable intelligence at scale.** Insurance pricing depends heavily on unstructured regulatory and market data — filings, forms, exhibits, bulletins, and countless other documents that are hard to search, interpret, and operationalize. We're building the OS for pricing: systems that reliably transform tens of millions of messy documents into queryable, trustworthy intelligence embedded directly in pricing workflows. **Our AI team is small, talent\-dense, and operates with real ownership. We maintain open\-source projects with thousands of stars and publish work recognized across the AI ecosystem. The problems we work on are active research areas where no one has great answers yet.** **You'll own the full feedback loop: diagnose where the product falls short, rigorously analyze root causes, build evaluations, and ship improvements that customers feel.** **The work spans agent systems, evaluation and data quality, and production engineering in roughly equal measure.** You'll work directly with customers when it helps you understand the problem deeply \- we believe engineers should have a clear line of sight to the people using what they build. **The type of projects that you can expect to work on:** * **Design and refine tool\-calling patterns and agent orchestration to handle multi\-step research tasks** that requires reasoning across thousands of related documents. * **Build ingestion and normalization systems for complex structured documents at scale** \- millions of filings where formats vary and each version builds on the last. * **Build and iterate on reinforcement fine\-tuning harnesses**, including training graders for research tasks with non\-verifiable reward. * **Develop tooling to measure, profile, and optimize agent pipeline performance** \- latency, cost, and quality across millions of calls. * **Run experiments end\-to\-end**: design, analyze, and translate into clear product recommendations. **Why this role ?** You'll **work on genuinely hard, unsolved problems at the intersection of AI systems and a massive real\-world data** domain. You'll ship to production regularly, **talk to customers, and see your work change how people make consequential decisions**. The team is small enough that **your judgment directly shapes the product** \- and we're building it to be best in class. * ***This role is a hybrid position to be based in New York City, with a necessity for 3 days a week of office presence.*** **Candidates must be team players with strong interpersonal skills,** **as well as:** * **2 \- 5 years of experience building software professionally, with strong programming fundamentals** (we work mostly in Python). * **Proficiency with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and modern retrieval patterns.** You stay current as the field moves. We don't need classical ML expertise \- we need someone on the frontier of applied AI. * **Strong track record of shipping high\-impact work in ambiguity**. You take a vague problem, define what "good" looks like, ship a v0, and iterate. * **Experience shipping user\-facing products**, either backend or full\-stack. * **Drawn to the question "how do we know this is actually better?"** \- excited to build the evaluation infrastructure that answers it rigorously. * **Curiosity over domain experience.** No insurance background needed \- **you learn fast and care about understanding the problem space deeply.** * Strong written and spoken English **As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.** We care about strong teamwork and a positive day\-to\-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after\-work gatherings. **In addition to this, we will provide you with:** * Competitive salary \+ annual bonus * Health insurance , Dental and Vision coverage (including spouse and family coverage) * 401K Company match * Life insurance * Cell Phone \& Internet reimbursement * 25 days of PTO/year * Commuter benefit * Gym membership via ClassPass * IT equipment allowance * Professional development \& trainings * Team fun: regular company gatherings and team events ### ***As part of our recruitment process, we may carry out background checks in line with the applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.*** ***We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain stages of the recruitment process. These tools are used to support our recruitment team and do not replace human decision\-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by people. If you would like further information about how your data is processed, you can contact us at*** ***dpo@akur8\.com******.*** Compensation Range: $170K \- $190K

jobs.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** At Alteva RCM, we're dedicated to helping healthcare providers thrive through expert revenue cycle management, strategic insight, and innovative solutions. We're always looking for passionate, driven professionals who want to make a meaningful impact, grow their careers, and be part of a collaborative team committed to excellence. **Senior DevOps Engineer** **Alteva RCM \| Technology \| Full\-Time \| Queens, NY** **About Alteva RCM** ==================== Alteva RCM is a healthcare revenue cycle management company that partners with medical practices and surgical centers nationwide. We help providers operate more efficiently, strengthen revenue cycle operations, and navigate the complexity of today's healthcare environment. We serve a wide range of specialties and operate at scale, with technology playing a central role in how we support clients and internal operations. **About the Role** ================== This is Alteva's first dedicated DevOps hire. Today, infrastructure is run by a managed service provider, and DevOps work is handled piecemeal across IT, vendors and developers. The engineering team is growing quickly, and we need one person who owns how code gets from a developer's machine to production, safely and repeatably. You will own our environments, deployment pipelines and infrastructure standards, and serve as the technical authority directing our managed service provider on production. You will set and hold the balance between developer productivity and security in a HIPAA\-regulated environment as the team scales. This is a hands\-on role. You will build things yourself, not only write policy. **What You'll Own** =================== **Environments \& Infrastructure** ---------------------------------- * Own development, test and staging environments end to end: provisioning, configuration, access and cost * Define the target architecture and standards for production, and direct the managed service provider's work against them * Manage infrastructure as code across Azure, plus a smaller AWS footprint * Isolate environments so production data stays in production, and provide realistic masked or synthetic data for development and testing **CI/CD \& Release** -------------------- * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications and supporting services * Own release mechanics: deployment automation, rollback readiness and environment promotion * Become the single intake point for infrastructure and environment requests from the development teams **Security \& Compliance** -------------------------- * Implement least\-privilege access, secrets management and audit logging that meet HIPAA requirements * Work with IT and security on endpoint and network controls so developers can work effectively without weakening protection * Keep infrastructure and access documentation current enough to pass an audit **Reliability \& Support** -------------------------- * Set up monitoring, alerting and logging so issues are caught early and routed to the right people * Write the runbooks, escalation paths and setup documentation the managed service provider uses to support systems after hours, on weekends and on holidays * Lead incident response and post\-incident review for platform issues **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Required** ------------ * 5\+ years in DevOps, platform engineering or SRE, including ownership of production environments * Deep hands\-on Azure experience: networking, identity (Entra ID), compute and app hosting, Key Vault, Azure Monitor * Infrastructure as code with Terraform or Bicep * CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, ideally for .NET workloads * Containers: Docker required, Kubernetes or AKS a strong plus * Scripting in PowerShell plus Bash or Python * Experience securing environments that handle sensitive or regulated data * Experience directing or working closely with an external infrastructure provider * Clear written documentation habits; your runbooks will be used by people you are not in the room with **Preferred** ------------- * HIPAA, SOC 2 or HITRUST experience * AWS experience * Salesforce deployment pipelines or other enterprise SaaS release management * Test data masking or synthetic data generation * Supporting AI or LLM\-based workloads, and using AI\-assisted tooling in your own work * Background in healthcare, RCM, fintech or another high\-volume operational environment **What This Isn't** =================== This is not a 24/7 on\-call role. Part of the job is building the documentation and monitoring that let our managed service provider handle off\-hours support, so the company does not depend on one person being reachable at all hours. It is also not a ticket\-taking role. You will be expected to set direction, say no when something is unsafe, and shape how the team ships as it grows. **Your First 90 Days** ====================== * Learn the current environments, pipelines and pain points directly from the developers and the managed service provider * Audit what moves between production and non\-production, and close the gaps * Publish a target picture and the first set of standards before the next wave of hiring lands **Why Join** ============ * Be the first DevOps hire, with the mandate to build the function properly from the start * Direct impact as the engineering team scales several times over * Work on live healthcare systems where reliability and security matter to real outcomes Alteva RCM \| Technology **Benefits** Alteva RCM offers our employees a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, employee assistance plan, paid family leave, short\-term disability and life insurance. We also provide a 401(k) plan with employer match, flexible spending accounts, employee discount program and an employee referral program.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Annapurna ML Systems, Trainium
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We're seeking a Sr.Software Development Engineer with deep storage expertise to architect, build, and operate the high\-performance storage infrastructure that accelerates silicon development at Annapurna Labs. In this role, you'll own the storage platforms—spanning Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, FSx for Lustre, and S3—that enable chip design teams to iterate faster, run regressions more efficiently, and bring transformative custom silicon to market. Key job responsibilities You will design, deploy, and operate high\-performance storage platforms—Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP (Gen1/Gen2\) and FSx for Lustre—optimized for EDA and HPC workloads. This includes managing NFS exports, ONTAP SVMs, intelligent tiering (FabricPool), snapshot policies, SnapMirror replication, and quota enforcement across multi\-tenant environments. You'll deploy all storage infrastructure using AWS CDK, architect cross\-VPC and multi\-account solutions via Transit Gateway and Route 53 private hosted zones, enable EFA for high\-throughput Lustre access, and manage data synchronization using DataSync and S3 integrations. You'll build a Storage as a Service platform with self\-service provisioning, defined SLOs, cost attribution, and automated lifecycle management that enables teams to consume storage without deep specialization. You will build monitoring and observability for storage health, utilization, and cost trends, and establish incident response processes for storage\-related failures. You'll continuously evaluate and adopt new AWS storage features—Gen2 scale\-out, NVMe\-over\-TCP, enhanced backup performance—to keep the platform at the leading edge. You'll profile I/O patterns across EDA workloads, tune file system configurations for optimal performance, and partner with silicon design and verification teams to proactively scale capacity and mentor others on storage best practices. A day in the life You might start your day reviewing storage utilization dashboards and tiering efficiency reports, identifying file systems approaching capacity thresholds or workloads that would benefit from tier migration. Mid\-morning, you could be collaborating with a verification team to provision a new FSx for Lustre file system optimized for their regression suite—sizing it based on their I/O profiles, enabling EFA access, and deploying it through your CDK pipeline. In the afternoon, you might be building the next iteration of your Storage as a Service platform—adding automated quota enforcement for a new team onboarding, implementing a snapshot policy that aligns with their project milestones, or extending cross\-VPC access to a new account. You'll review pull requests for CDK constructs, investigate a DataSync job that stalled, and discuss FSx ONTAP Gen2 migration plans with your team. Throughout the day, you'll balance immediate customer needs—expanding a volume for a team blocked on disk space, troubleshooting NFS mount latency—with longer\-term platform investments like evaluating intelligent tiering policies or prototyping NVMe\-over\-TCP access patterns. You'll engage with AWS service teams on feature requests and roadmap alignment, ensuring Annapurna Labs gets the most from the storage platform. About the team At Annapurna Labs, your storage infrastructure work directly enables breakthrough innovations in custom silicon that power AWS and transform industries. The EDA Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the compute, storage, and networking platforms that hundreds of chip designers and verification engineers depend on daily. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation. AWS has the world's largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Chief Engineers (CE) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market. We have a passion for learning and evolving, it's how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let's work hard, have fun, and make history! As the Chief Engineer for the ATL Regional Services Team, you will be the technical lead for generator services and non\-destructive testing (NDT) across the Atlanta region. You'll set the standard for how we maintain, test, and repair critical equipment, and you'll help build a new team from the ground up, including the processes, training, and mechanisms it will scale on. Key job responsibilities * Serve as the primary technical expert for generator systems and non\-destructive testing (NDT) of electrical equipment, including emergency response for critical power systems * Perform troubleshooting, repair, and root cause analysis on generator failures and electrical anomalies identified through NDT within established Service Level Agreements (SLA), and assess the impact on critical power infrastructure * Conduct and oversee generator preventive maintenance, fluid sampling (oil, coolant, fuel), load bank testing, and emissions stack testing to OEM, NFPA 110, and air permit requirements, and NDT of switchgear and transformers * Develop and implement standard operating procedures for generator maintenance and testing and NDT inspection programs * Train technicians on generator maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair, and on NDT methods including infrared thermography and partial discharge analysis * Establish performance benchmarks for generator systems, analyze NDT and fluid sampling trends, and prepare reports on testing results and maintenance activities * Communicate technical findings and risk from NDT and generator performance data to facility management and stakeholders * Collaborate with facility managers and vendors to coordinate generator maintenance schedules, stack testing, NDT programs, and OEM repairs * Ensure compliance with safety procedures, including NFPA 70E and LOTO, during generator maintenance and NDT operations * Maintain detailed records of generator maintenance, fluid sampling, stack test results, and NDT results using facility management software and Microsoft Office tools * Perform rotational on\-call duties as the after\-hours Services Team Manager for the data centers in the region, including responding to generator failures, NDT anomalies, and other site issues, and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s) A day in the life The Services Team Chief Engineer is Amazon's front\-line specialist for generator systems and non\-destructive testing (NDT) of electrical equipment in mission\-critical data center facilities that must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Primary equipment responsibilities include standby diesel generators and NDT of critical 3\-phase electrical infrastructure. The Chief Engineer leads and trains technicians in generator maintenance, troubleshooting, emissions stack testing, and emergency operations and in NDT procedures (including thermography and partial discharge analysis), while developing comprehensive training programs for these core areas. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. We are looking for a talented Data Engineer to join the Manufacturing Operations, Transportation Operations, and Reverse (MOTOR) organization in support of our Supply Chain Intelligence team. MOTOR manages the manufacturing of datacenter racks and the movement of racks/parts through the supply chain, consisting of transportation, warehousing, and reverse logistics into and out of the data centers. This role performs helps connect the different systems across the supply chain together so operational teams have clean, actionable data to work with. This requires someone with strong analytic skills and business acumen who can work with stakeholders on strategic projects across MOTOR. The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. Must be an expert working with data modeling with un/structured data, ingestion pipelines and ETL design and business intelligence tools with the business to identify strategic opportunities where improvements in data infrastructure creates out\-sized business impact. Candidate is a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), mentors other engineers in team on high quality tech, and enjoys working in a fast\-paced team. Candidate will have a chance to architect the data pipelines needed for optimization and predictive analysis. We're excited to talk to those up to the challenge! Key job responsibilities * Build and maintain the infrastructure to answer questions with data, using software engineering best practices, data management fundamentals, data storage principles, recent advances in distributed systems, and operational excellence best practices. Build datasets that analysts and scientists use to generate actionable insights. * Define the data engineering processes that leverage various AWS services to improve accessibility, redundancy, data integrity, cost, and storage requirements. * Develop high quality solutions for the faster development of the products/models that solve the business needs in a scalable format, while also anticipating future requirements. * Collaborate with Research/Applied Scientists, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and Product/Program Managers to understand the business and technical requirements, and make decisions that help make the products/programs smoother. * Interface with other technology/data engineering teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using and AWS data technologies. * Lead the technical design and implementation of the data infrastructure. * Design and manage data audit, quality, and reconciliation processes in collaboration with various stakeholders. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. \*Diverse Experiences\* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. \*Work/Life Balance\* We value work\-life harmony. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. \*Mentorship and Career Growth\* We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. Would you enjoy being able to tell your friends your team shipped code that made buying on Amazon easier and safer in your first few weeks? As a Software Development Engineer on the Selling Partner Services team you will be actively working on systems and features that accomplish this for buyers and sellers on Amazon.com everyday. Who you are: You’re a a technical leader with the prowess to deliver world\-class software. You have great intuition \- Amazon teams run like businesses giving you the ownership, allowing you as an engineer to be responsible for the technical solutions that deliver exceptional customer experience. The Selling Partner Trust team is geared to protect Amazon customers (Buyers, Brand owners and Sellers) from bad actors, abuse and fraud. This is a senior, hands\-on individual\-contributor role that sets technical direction across the full stack \- a TypeScript/React front end, a Node.js/Express backend, a Python AI service, and the Google Cloud infrastructure that runs it. The Senior Software Engineer owns key architecture and security decisions, mentors other engineers, and partners directly with leadership to turn strategy into working software, all within the security and privacy practices required of a HIPAA\-regulated healthcare environment. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: * Contribute to the ownership of the platform and assist in making the core technical decisions that directly impact cloud topology, data model, and AI/LLM approach. * Design, build, and maintain features end to end, from backend services and APIs to user\-facing tools. * Develop and improve AI workflows on Google Cloud and Vertex AI, including prompt design, retrieval, and evaluation. * Model and evolve the data layer in PostgreSQL and integrate the platform with existing systems and data sources. * Package and deploy services as containers to Cloud Run, working with supporting Google Cloud services (Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Artifact Registry). * Impact security and privacy architecture decisions for a product handling protected health information (PHI). * Monitor and improve performance, reliability, and cloud costs while working closely with other Software Engineer(s) and Cloud Engineer(s). * Perform code reviews and establish engineering standards and patterns. * Write clear documentation and share knowledge across the team. * Take ownership of projects from scoping through delivery, often working independently. SKILLS: * Expert TypeScript/JavaScript and Python skills for full\-stack and AI/service development. * Proficiency with React (front end) and Node.js/Express (backend/APIs). * Strong SQL skills, including schema design and performant queries against operational data (PostgreSQL; ORMs such as Drizzle a plus). * Experience architecting and operating containerized applications on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage). * Experience designing and shipping LLM/AI features (Vertex AI / Gemini; OpenAI). * Ability to speak, read and write English sufficiently to perform the job. QUALIFICATIONS: * 6\-8\+ years of professional software development experience, including ownership of production systems end to end. * Deep proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and Python. * Proven experience architecting and building full\-stack web applications \- a modern front\-end framework (e.g., React) and a server\-side runtime (e.g., Node.js/Express). * Strong experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), REST APIs, and version control (Git). * Hands\-on experience architecting, building, and deploying applications on a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud (Cloud Run or a comparable container service), including cost\-aware design. * Demonstrated experience building and shipping AI and large language model applications in production. * Ability to lead ambiguous problems from definition through delivery, and to make sound build\-vs\-buy and architecture trade\-offs independently. * Experience mentoring engineers, performing code review, and setting engineering standards (testing, CI/CD, documentation). * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including representing technical direction to non\-technical leadership. * A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Authorized to work in the United States. * Must be 18 years of age or older.

jobs.title: Software & System Test Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID: 13263 Raymond, Ohio, 43067 1st Shift $73,900\.00 \- $110,800\.00 **What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda** Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future\-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.” We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team. If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future! **Job Purpose** --------------- The Software \& System Test Engineer supports the development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical/electronic systems and software. The role executes assigned engineering activities, supports troubleshooting and issue resolution, and ensures system integrity while developing technical expertise. Working with Technical Experts and cross\-functional teams, the engineer identifies potential system impacts, communicates issues proactively, and gradually assumes greater ownership of assigned functions and components. **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ * Project Management: Breaking down project concept details into required development activities and deciding the overall ECU development plan with Technical Leadership’s guidance and support, correlating technical project details with key stakeholders and negotiating the schedule for deliverables. Informing technical leadership of project status often is expected. * Engineering specification design for Body/Powertrain ECU applications, including electrical circuit hardware and software in tools such as Vector CAN, MATLAB Simulink. Support Senior members to set the direction to create design concepts before converting to requirements and functional specifications, then conducting design reviews with technical leadership. * Engineering troubleshooting, root cause analysis and solution design: Working hands\-on in prototype or mass production level vehicles to identify responsible system(s) functional issues and deciding the steps required for resolution. * Testing and verification of ECU specifications related to hardware and software: Performing testing in prototype or mass production level vehicles related to electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) or verification of technical change points to ensure proper electrical functional performance, quality and reliability. Accountable to create test result reports and conduct verification reviews with technical leadership. * Improvement and innovation: Identify shortcomings and suggest improvements to existing processes, systems and procedures to increase efficiency and other key metrics. * Documentation: Demonstrates the ability to manage multiple concurrent development activities while proactively identifying potential issues before they become critical. **Qualifications, Experience, and Skills** ------------------------------------------ * BSEE or BSME degree, or equivalent experience. * 0 to 2 years of closely related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required. * Effective communication skills (written, verbal and presentation). * Ability to cultivate and manage relationships of varying levels in/out of the organization, including supplier. * Ability to acclimate to new environments, negotiate through unknowns and meet new people. * Ability to manage time effectively and productively. * Solid quantitative/analytical problem\-solving and decision\-making skills. * Computer skills, such as PowerPoint, Excel, MS Project, Word, CANalyzer etc. * Ability to multi\-task and work independently. * Acute attention to detail. * Strong collaboration skill(s). **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Commitment to work necessary work hours to achieve all responsibilities, including overtime and operating periodically at early and late day hours. * Must be able to lift 20 lbs. * Kneeling, bending, sitting, standing, and maneuvering inside of vehicles is required. * Travel is sometimes required \- \~5% (International travel may be requested). * This is a hands\-on position; associate is expected to work on the actual vehicle with tools. Candidate can expect to spend a portion of their time working in the lab – confirming their systems on bench, on the car, in thermal chambers, and on HILS system Office work is split between on\-site (80%) and remote (20% Work from Home). * Vehicle\-level testing is conducted either on\-site in a specified lab or offsite at a supplier/contracted facility. **What differentiates Honda and make us an employer of choice?** **Total Rewards:** * Competitive Base Salary (pay will be based on several variables that include, but not limited to geographic location, work experience, etc.) * Paid Overtime * Regional Bonus (when applicable) * Industry\-leading Benefit Plans (Medical, Dental, Vision, Rx) * Paid time off, including vacation, holidays, shutdown * Company Paid Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability * 401K Plan with company match \+ additional contribution * Relocation assistance (if eligible) **Career Growth:** * Advancement Opportunities * Career Mobility * Education Reimbursement for Continued Learning * Training and Development programs **Additional Offerings:** * Tuition Assistance \& Student Loan Repayment * Lifestyle Account * Childcare Reimbursement Account * Elder Care Support * Wellbeing Program * Community Service and Engagement Programs * Product Programs Honda is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.

jobs.title: Lab & Integration Engineer
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **About the Team** Platform Engineering \& Integration (PEI) is the Chief Engineering integration function that brings strong subsystems together into a deployable platform. PEI owns the seams: platform architecture coherence, cross\-domain interfaces, integration risk, verification strategy, configuration maturity and readiness evidence across multiple autonomous airpower programs. The Platform Integration pillar owns the integration roadmap and its sequencing, the integration environments, the integrated build, and readiness for test and flight. We treat laboratories and rigs as capacity, not only as usage, and the most valuable thing we can say about any environment is what it actually proves and, explicitly, what it does not. **About the Role** You will engineer and integrate on the lab fleet behind our flagship autonomous air vehicle: software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop rigs for vehicle management, flight controls and mission systems, plus an iron bird with hydraulics, loaded actuation and power. Every software release, mission systems integration and flight\-test preparation runs through these rigs, and the rigs are being designed, brought up and put to work at the same time. This is an individual\-contributor engineering role. You will work for the Lab \& Integration Lead alongside lab technicians, own specific rigs and lab subsystems end to end, and spend most of your time between the design tools, the bench and the integration floor. You will be trusted with real design and integration decisions early, and you will be expected to close them. **What You'll Do** * **Engineer the rigs.** Develop and maintain rig designs within the lab architecture: block diagrams, rack and power layouts, network design, harness definitions and pin\-to\-pins, and rig interface control documents (rig\-to\-LRU, rig\-to\-sim, rig\-to\-ground\-station). Review build drawings and work instructions before material is released. * **Bring rigs up.** Plan and lead bring\-up of the rigs you own: safe\-to\-mate, power\-on and BIT, LRU checkout, network and time\-sync verification, and host/sim reference\-scenario runs. Work the readiness checklist to closure before a rig is declared operational. * **Own the HITL host and simulation integration.** Integrate the real\-time host, I/O, plant models and simulation with flight hardware. Characterize latency and timing, check simulation behaviour against reference data, and document what each rig can and cannot be used to show. * **Integrate on the rigs.** Run integration for software releases and new hardware on the rigs: execute integration procedures, triage failures across software, avionics, mission systems and lab causes, write and drive discrepancy reports to closure, and run regression after each change. * **Hold configuration discipline.** Maintain each rig's configuration baseline with Configuration Management (LRU part and serial numbers, software and firmware loads, harness revisions, sim versions) and make sure every for\-record run has a complete as\-tested record. * **Capture data that holds up.** Set up data recording and logging so results trace back to requirements and configuration. Build the scripts and tools that pull, check and summarize rig data for integration, qualification and flight\-readiness reviews. * **Automate.** Automate repetitive checkout, configuration capture and regression runs. Treat rig time as scarce: every manual hour removed is capacity returned to the program. * **Support capacity and planning.** Provide rig\-hour estimates, build and bring\-up schedules, and long\-lead material inputs for your rigs. Assess the rig changes each new hardware lot needs, and keep sustainment, spares and obsolescence plans current. * **Work safely and securely.** Contribute to the lab hazard analysis and network and classified\-lab accreditation for your rigs, and follow and improve the controls for hydraulics, high power, rotating machinery and classified operations. * **Raise the bar for the team.** Write the procedures, checklists and lessons learned that let technicians and the next engineer work without you, and mentor technicians on troubleshooting and documentation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * B.S. i atalinks, crypto and key management, or C2 ground segments. * Iron bird, hydraulic, flight\-control actuation or power\-system test experience. * Lab CI and test automation: automated regression on hardware rigs, test frameworks and results dashboards. * Lab network design and accreditation experience (RMF / ATO, JSIG). * Familiarity with MIL\-STD\-704 and MIL\-STD\-461, and with linking verification evidence to a system model. * Flight test or ground test support on a developmental aircraft program. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Engineering
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long\-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier. We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely. We're seeking exceptional researchers with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of frontier AI and your field, developing rigorous methods to measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and to test Claude's designs against real\-world feedback. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and implement evaluation methodologies for assessing AI model capabilities relevant to engineering and applied science research and applications * Design realistic tasks and training environments, and curate data from your field * Develop and validate simulations and computational tools for your field, and calibrate them against real\-world data * Work with industry partners, manufacturers, and labs to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and bring that real\-world feedback into evaluation and training * Think through how Claude's engineering capabilities can permeate the real world: where they can have the most impact across industry and research, and what it takes to get them adopted * Advise the team on which problems, tools, and workflows matter most in your field * Collaborate with domain experts and partners to establish benchmarks and gather high\-quality data for training * Translate between engineering domain knowledge and machine learning objectives **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Deep expertise and hands\-on R\&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, structural, industrial, or manufacturing engineering; applied physics; computational simulation * Experience with AI or machine learning, whether evaluating and training AI systems or applying these tools in your field * Track record of taking work from concept through to a working result, such as a product, process, device, experiment, or tool * Hands\-on proficiency with the computational design, analysis, or simulation tools used in your field * Basic programming proficiency, for example in Python * Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop solutions in a rapidly evolving research environment * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams, and to explain your field clearly to people outside it * Commitment to using AI to accelerate engineering and scientific progress while maintaining high ethical standards **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of hands\-on R\&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline * Ph.D. in an engineering or applied science field, or equivalent industry experience * Industry experience in product design and manufacturing, or in developing engineering or scientific simulation software * Breadth across more than one discipline, or across several stages of the path from design to production * Familiarity with modern AI model training methods * Track record of building high\-fidelity solvers or simulation engines that were validated against real\-world data and used in practice * Experience working with manufacturers, vendors, contract research organizations, or academic labs * Experience managing data pipelines and working with large\-scale technical datasets * Publications, patents, or contributions to open\-source scientific or engineering software The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $405,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Agent Harness
jobs.description: Summary Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be. As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world’s most widely used AI assistants. It runs on our next generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on\-screen awareness, and it is built with privacy from the ground up. We build the harness, the foundation that turns a model into an assistant that can act. This is a systems engineering role for people who understand how large language models behave. Description A model can't act on its own. The harness runs the agent loop, carries context and tools to the model, executes the tool calls it makes, and streams results back reliably. It spans models running on device and larger models in Private Cloud Compute. It handles everything from single\-turn requests to long multi\-step tasks that span apps, survive interruptions, and resume cleanly. We're looking for a strong systems engineer who is fluent in how LLMs behave. The work is real\-time and resource\-constrained: responses must start fast enough for a voice assistant to feel instant, under tight latency, memory, and power limits on everything from Mac and iPhone to Apple Watch. Failures rarely have a single cause. In a typical week you might track down why a streamed response stalls, make tool calls cancel cleanly when the user interrupts, or replay a failed request to tell whether the model, the context, or the runtime was at fault. Every change to the harness changes how the model behaves, so we measure our work with evals, not just tests. You'll join the team that owns the core runtime and work alongside senior engineers and researchers. You'll also partner closely with the modeling, tools, and context teams and with app and framework teams across Apple. You'll take features from design through production and grow your ownership of the system over time. You'll use agent harnesses every day while building one for an assistant used by hundreds of millions of people.
