jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer, Sr AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== Baker Tilly is seeking a **Principal AI Engineer, Sr AI Engineer** to join the founding team of the firm's AI Product Group (APG) Agent Factory, responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI\-powered applications and intelligent agentic workflows across Tax, Assurance, and Advisory. This hands\-on, full\-stack engineering role focuses on building production\-ready AI solutions that combine advanced AI capabilities with intuitive user experiences and practical business workflows. Working directly with firm practitioners and subject matter experts, this individual will translate complex business processes into scalable AI\-enabled solutions, develop applications that support professional review and decision\-making, and deliver innovative technology that drives measurable business value. As an early member of the AI Product Group, this individual will collaborate closely with product, design, data, platform engineering, and globally distributed technical teams to develop and deliver AI solutions from initial concept through production deployment. The role emphasizes strong software engineering fundamentals, evaluation\-driven development, hands\-on execution, and direct collaboration with business stakeholders. The ideal candidate is a highly capable, adaptable engineer with demonstrated experience delivering full\-stack applications, deploying LLM\-powered features to real users, and learning emerging technologies quickly. **Responsibilities** * **Design and Develop AI\-Powered Solutions:** Build, implement, and maintain AI agents and multi\-step workflows, including task decomposition, orchestration, context and memory management, tool integration, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and failure handling. * **Deliver Full\-Stack Applications:** Develop production\-quality applications, backend services, APIs, data models, dashboards, conversational interfaces, and user\-facing workflows that enable practitioners to interact effectively with AI\-powered solutions. * **Translate Business Needs into Technical Solutions:** Collaborate directly with Tax, Assurance, and Advisory professionals and subject matter experts to understand business processes, identify opportunities for automation, and translate professional expertise into actionable requirements and working software. * **Drive Evaluation\-Based Development:** Establish measurable hypotheses, testing criteria, evaluation frameworks, and performance baselines to validate AI capabilities, assess solution quality, and inform technical decisions before production deployment. * **Develop Testing and Quality Standards:** Build and maintain  rticipate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned to advance the firm's AI engineering capabilities and business priorities. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. * **5 years of hands\-on software engineering experience**, including demonstrated success designing, developing, and delivering multiple production\-quality applications or products from concept through deployment. * Required experience deploying at least one LLM\-powered feature or application to real users, regardless of scale. * Required experience working directly with domain experts, business stakeholders, or customers to translate requirements into technical solutions and take ownership of delivered outcomes. * Strong full\-stack software engineering experience, including backend services, data models, APIs, and modern user\-facing applications. * Deep proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java, with demonstrated understanding of language fundamentals, design patterns, and production\-quality development practices. * Ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies; familiarity with Python and TypeScript preferred. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, application architecture, automated testing, debugging, performance optimization, and development of scalable, maintainable systems. * Experience developing and integrating modern web applications, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and secure enterprise services. * Demonstrated ability to validate technical solutions through measurable outcomes, including automated testing, benchmarks, experiments, evaluation frameworks, or A/B testing. * Strong analytical thinking, technical judgment, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs, resolve ambiguity, and develop practical solutions to complex challenges. * Experience collaborating with nontechnical stakeholders and subject matter experts, with the ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations in clear, business\-focused language. * Familiarity with LLM applications, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI evaluation methodologies, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) preferred. * Exposure to agentic AI concepts, including orchestration, tool use, context management, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows preferred; prior experience building AI agents is not required. * Experience with cloud\-based application development and technologies such as Microsoft Azure, containers, PostgreSQL, and React preferred. * Experience working in professional services, regulated industries, or environments serving highly specialized business users preferred; prior Tax, Assurance, or Accounting experience is not required. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions, articulate design decisions, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to evolving requirements, and deliver high\-quality solutions in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience using AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to enhance engineering productivity, or a strong willingness to incorporate these technologies into daily development practices. * No professional certifications or licenses required. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employee*s. *The national pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* *In California: pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* \#LI\-AC1

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy\-grow\-and\-hold\-for\-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. **About the role** ================== **Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI** Medicat builds MedicatOne, the EHR used by college health and counseling centers across the US. Banyan Software acquires and grows vertical software companies like ours, and we're investing in AI that reaches clinicians and students in production. This is an engineering role first. You will write production code most days: LLM integrations, automations, data workflows and the APIs that connect them to MedicatOne. You'll also sit close to our clinic customers and internal teams, turning what you see in their workflows into working software, often in days, not quarters. If you're happiest owning a roadmap and writing specs for others to build, this isn't the role. If you want to be the person who ships the feature, debugs it with the customer on the call, and hardens it for HIPAA, keep reading. **What you'll do** ================== Expect roughly 70% hands\-on engineering and 30% embedded with customers and internal teams. * **Build and ship AI features end to end.** Design, code, test and deploy LLM\-powered features in MedicatOne: prompt design, tool calling, retrieval where it earns its place, and evaluation harnesses. * **Pick the simplest reliable solution.** Sometimes that's an LLM, often it's plain code. * **Integrate with real clinical data.** Write the services, SQL and data pipelines that move PHI safely between MedicatOne, customer systems and model providers. * **Deploy alongside customers.** Join clinic implementation and discovery calls as the technical lead, scope what can be built, prototype against their data, and stay through go\-live. * **Embed with internal teams.** Find and automate repetitive work, and help analysts and developers get the most out of AI tools. * **Own production quality.** Instrument, monitor and debug what you ship: latency, cost, accuracy and failure modes. Write evals so regressions are caught before customers see them. * **Make AI safe for healthcare.** Implement HIPAA\-compliant patterns for PHI handling, logging, access control, de\-identification and vendor data boundaries. * **Harden internal tools.** Review and productionize AI tools built by non\-engineering teams before they touch customer data. * **Feed the roadmap with evidence.** Bring back what you learned in the field as working prototypes and technical recommendations, not slide decks. **What you bring** ================== * **3\+ years as a software engineer** shipping production code in B2B SaaS, with an individual\-contributor track record. You still write code every week. * **Strong in at least one backend language** (Python, C\#/.NET or TypeScript/Node) and comfortable reading the others. * **Hands\-on LLM API experience**: you've shipped production features on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI), including prompt design and function/tool calling, and you know when not to use one. * **End\-to\-end system design**: you've designed a production system from the ground up, including data flow, security and multi\-tenancy. * **Solid data skills**: production SQL, schema design and data pipelines against relational databases. * **API and integration experience**: REST API design, authentication, webhooks and third\-party integrations. * **Production engineering habits**: Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and deploying to a major cloud (Azure or AWS). * **Regulated or sensitive data experience**: you've built software that handles PHI, PII, financial or similarly protected data, with the access controls and audit trails it requires. * **Comfort with customers and colleagues**: you can explain a technical trade\-off to a clinic director or an analyst, then go build it. * Authorized to work in and resides in the US; we can't sponsor visas. **Nice to have** ================ * RAG, embeddings and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone or similar), plus the judgment to know when retrieval is worth the complexity * HL7 v2, FHIR or EHR integration experience (we can teach this) * HIPAA experience specifically * Prior Forward Deployed, Solutions Engineering or implementation\-engineering experience at a software company * LLM evaluation and observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, custom eval suites) * Agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * College health, student health or behavioral health software * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio of shipped AI projects Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance. **Please Note**: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed. ***Recruitment Notice*** Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation. ***Beware of Recruitment Scams*** We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. **Protect yourself by following these steps:** * Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address. * Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process. * If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

jobs.title: Engineer, Security Solutions
jobs.description: Des Moines, IA \-OR\- Cedar Rapids, IA \-OR\- Kansas City, MO **Why Basepoint Building Automations** Basepoint was built on the belief that the best companies are owned by the people who show up every day to do the work. As an employee\-owned building automation company, we approach every project with a long\-term mindset, shared accountability, and pride in doing the work right. Our people are owners, which means higher standards, stronger teamwork, and a long\-term mindset. When you join Basepoint, you're not just taking a job – you're helping build something you own. **What We Have to Offer:** * Paid Time Off * 9 Paid Holidays * Generous Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * 401k Retirement Plan * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Spending Accounts – HSA, FSA, DCFSA * Company Paid Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Company Paid Life Insurance * Supplemental Life Insurance * Employee Assistance Program **Job Summary** The Engineer, Security Solutions is responsible for designing, integrating, and supporting secure building automation and electronic security systems, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and the networked controls that connect them. This role interprets project requirements, prepares detailed technical submittals, and collaborates with project teams and field personnel to resolve design and installation issues, support project handoffs, and maintain accurate documentation. The engineer applies security and controls expertise, along with continuous improvement practices, to deliver solutions that protect client facilities and meet project goals, budgets, and client needs. **Core Values In Action** * **Confident:** Apply security and controls expertise to develop reliable, defensible designs and clearly explain technical and risk\-based decisions. Recognize the impact of design accuracy on field teams, value others’ expertise, and continually build knowledge of building automation security technologies and best practices. * **Committed:** Take ownership of accurate security submittals, documentation, and project handoffs. Address design and vulnerability gaps head\-on, follow through on commitments, and support project teams in delivering secure solutions that meet client requirements and project budgets. * **Compassionate:** Listen to understand the security needs and operational challenges of clients, project teams, technicians, and programmers. Respond to questions and feedback without judgment, acknowledge knowledge gaps, and seek help when needed to resolve issues collaboratively. * **Innovative:** Explore creative, practical solutions to security integration and cybersecurity challenges in building automation environments. Adapt to emerging threats, technologies, and parts obsolescence, and use field feedback to improve the accuracy, clarity, and effectiveness of engineering deliverables. * **One:** Partner with sales representatives, project managers, technicians, programmers, and client IT teams to combine expertise and achieve shared project goals. Support clear handoffs, solve problems together, and share lessons from both successes and setbacks to strengthen the team. **Supervisory Responsibilities** * No **Essential Duties** * Interpret construction drawings, specifications, and security requirements to design integrated building automation and security systems that align with the project design intent. * Incorporate access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and related security devices with building automation and DDC controls platforms. * Apply cybersecurity best practices to building automation networks, including network segmentation, device hardening, credential management, and secure BAS communication protocols. * Resolve discrepancies among security design intent, system capabilities, network constraints, and installed equipment configurations. * Collaborate with sales representatives, project managers, and client IT and facilities teams to ensure designs meet project goals, budget constraints, and client requirements. * Prepare detailed security submittals, including system diagrams, device schedules, riser and network diagrams, wiring details, panel layouts, and third\-party system integration details. * Coordinate project deliverables, respond to requests for information, and support project orientation, commissioning, and handoff. * Maintain accurate records to support long\-term maintenance, troubleshooting, and security audits. * Stay current on building automation and physical security industry trends, emerging threats, technologies, parts obsolescence, and best practices. * Conduct site visits to assess security requirements, help resolve installation issues, and validate system effectiveness. * Seek constructive feedback from technicians and programmers who use the department’s deliverables to continually improve their accuracy and clarity. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the growing department. **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, computer, or controls engineering, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience. * Strong technical skills, including proficiency in CAD or Visio and the ability to interpret mechanical, electrical, and security blueprints. * Hands\-on experience designing and integrating security and control systems for complex projects, with a focus on reliability, efficiency, This position translates customer blueprints and engineering requirements into accurate SolidWorks models that can be fabricated efficiently on our shop floor. This role is built around Design for Manufacturing. Every model and drawing must be buildable, standardized, and designed to support Lean Manufacturing and one\-piece flow through cutting, forming, welding, and assembly — so production builds it right the first time, on time, every time. **Performance Metrics** * First\-Pass Drawing Accuracy (Right First Time) * On\-Time Drawing Release * Design\-Related Shop Rework \& RFI Reduction * Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) per Project * Design Hours vs. Estimate * Material Utilization \& Scrap Reduction * Part Standardization \& Library Reuse * DFM Improvements Implemented * Quality Escapes/NCRs Attributed to Design * Support of One\-Piece Flow \& Production Throughput \*Must be 18 years or older to apply\* **Key Responsibilities** **SolidWorks 3D Modeling – Data Center Products** * Create detailed 3D part models, large assemblies, and weldments in SolidWorks for modular data center structures, enclosures, skids, platforms, and related components. * Build top\-level and sub\-level assemblies that accurately represent the complete data center product for fabrication, assembly, and installation. * Produce fabrication\-ready drawings including dimensions, tolerances, GD\&T where required, weld symbols, BOMs, cut lists, and sheet metal flat patterns. * Maintain clean model structure, file naming, configurations, and revision control per department standards. * Develop and maintain a library of standard parts, templates, and reusable design components. **Design for Manufacturing (DFM)** * Ensure every model and drawing can be fabricated with our available equipment, processes, materials, and tooling. * Design sheet metal, structural steel, and welded components with correct bend allowances, material thicknesses, hole patterns, and weld access. * Reduce part count, material waste, cutting and welding time, and assembly complexity through design. * Standardize components and hardware across projects to simplify purchasing, inventory, and production. * Work directly with fabrication and production teams to resolve build issues and incorporate shop feedback. **Lean Manufacturing \& One\-Piece Flow** * Apply Lean Manufacturing principles to eliminate waste (overprocessing, motion, waiting, rework, and defects) at the design stage. * Design parts and assemblies that move through production in one\-piece flow, minimizing batching and work\-in\-process. * Develop modular, sequenced assemblies aligned with production cells and takt time. * Participate in Kaizen events, value stream mapping, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Support visual work instructions, assembly sequences, and exploded views for the shop floor. **Blueprint Review \& Interpretation** * Read, review, and interpret engineering blueprints, architectural and structural drawings, customer specifications, and vendor submittals. * Translate customer drawings and requirements into accurate SolidWorks models and fabrication packages. * Perform design checks for dimensions, fit, interferences, tolerances, and constructability before release to production. * Identify discrepancies or missing information and communicate them through RFIs to engineering leadership and customers. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Work closely with Development, Sales, Customer, and Production \& Support Engineering to meet project schedules. * Support engineering change orders (ECOs), revisions, and as\-built documentation. * Communicate clearly with engineers, fabricators, installers, and customers in English. **Physical Demands** The physical demands and work environment described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work Environment: Work is primarily performed in an indoor office setting at a computer workstation for extended periods, with regular time on the manufacturing shop floor to review fabrication and assembly. Required PPE must be worn on the shop floor. **Benefits** Offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package: * Medical, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Paid time off (PTO) * Life and disability Insurance *Benefits may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.* **Equal Opportunity Employer** Bentley Mission Critical is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Requirements: **Required** * Minimum 5 years of SolidWorks 3D design experience in a manufacturing or fabrication environment. * Engineering background: degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent engineering experience. * Advanced SolidWorks proficiency: parts, large assemblies, weldments, sheet metal, configurations, and detailed drawings. * Demonstrated portfolio of SolidWorks projects (portfolio required with application). * Strong Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA) knowledge — models that can be fabricated. * Lean Manufacturing knowledge with a strong one\-piece flow mentality. * Proven ability to review and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and specifications. * Fluent in English, written and spoken. **Preferred** * Data center or mission\-critical infrastructure design experience. * Spanish is a plus (bilingual English/Spanish). * Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification. * SolidWorks PDM experience and/or CSWP/CSWE certification. * Experience with nesting software and CNC, laser, or plasma cutting workflows. * Knowledge of GD\&T and AWS welding symbols; familiarity with AutoCAD or Revit.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Audio Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview**Boston Dynamics is looking for a **Senior Staff Audio Machine Learning Engineer** to join the Spot Sensing team. In this role, your core mission will be driving the evolution of our Acoustic Change Detection (ACD) capability—taking beamformed and raw audio and turning it into actionable machinery prognostics. While **acoustic intelligence is your primary domain** , mechanical inspection on Spot is multimodal. Beyond mastering the audio pipeline, you will contribute to the integration of acoustic features with complementary modalities, such as image, video, and thermal, fusing multimodal representations with LLMs/VLMs to empower our end users with prescriptive maintenance actions, not indecipherable data. You will leverage the world’s largest fleet\-gathered industrial sensor dataset, utilizing Spot equipped with the Sorama L642 acoustic camera and SpotCAM2 . **Key Responsibilities*** **Acoustic ML \& DSP Ownership (Core Focus):** Design, refine, and scale digital signal processing and machine learning pipelines for our Acoustic Change Detection (ACD) system. * **Anomaly Detection \& Failure Classification:** Lead the improvement and modernization of our acoustic detection stack—transitioning from unsupervised models (e.g., BGMM) to state\-of\-the\-art anomaly architectures, and architecting our end\-to\-end supervised multimodal pipelines for automated fault diagnosis. * **Multimodal Integration \& Prescriptive Maintenance:** Partner with the broader Spot Apps organization to integrate acoustic insights with visual, thermal, and VLM/LLM data streams into unified machine health indicators, delivering both clear mechanical diagnoses and recommended corrective actions to plant operators. * **Industrial Deployment \& Verification:** Benchmark, optimize, ship, monitor, and continuously improve our solution for our industrial customers. **Qualifications \& Requirements** **Experience \& Domain Expertise*** **Experience:** 7\+ years of deep practical expertise in audio feature extraction, audio fingerprinting (e.g., Shazam, DMCA enforcement) and segmentation (e.g., DCASE), machine learning applied to audio data (beamformed and raw), preferably in industrial environments or another domain with similar problems, for the purposes of anomaly detection. **Technical Skills \& Hardware*** **Languages \& Core Tooling:** Advanced proficiency in Python and C\+\+, with mastery of numerical and scientific stacks (e.g., NumPy, SciPy, scikit\-learn, PyTorch). * **Acoustic Processing:** Expertise in time domain and frequency domain data analysis. * **Array Processing:** Expertise in multi\-channel array processing, including beamforming (Delay\-and\-Sum, MVDR, null\-steering), Direction of Arrival (DoA) estimation, and synthetic aperture techniques. * **Machine Learning \& Modeling Paradigms:** Expertise in unsupervised and supervised classification architectures for anomaly detection in real\-world conditions. **Bonus Points*** Hands\-on experience in cross\-modal fusion (combining audio representations with computer vision, thermal imaging, or multimodal foundation models/VLMs). * Background in rotating machinery health monitoring (bearings, gearboxes, pumps) and familiarity with mechanical vibration/acoustic failure standards. Familiarity with TypeScript/modern web services for integrating your work into Orbit, our fleet management software. * *We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.* The base pay range for this position is between $180,000 to $220,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and a annual bonus structure. Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

jobs.title: WordPress Developer
jobs.description: Build Websites. Solve Problems. Grow Your Skills. Brevard SEM is a digital marketing and web development agency in Melbourne, Florida, and we’re looking for a hands\-on WordPress developer to join our in\-house team. We’re looking for someone who enjoys building websites, solving problems, learning new technology, and getting things done. You don’t need to know everything. You do need to have real WordPress experience, a solid understanding of how websites work, and the confidence to jump into existing projects. You’ll work alongside experienced designers, developers, and digital marketing professionals who can help you expand your skills while you contribute to real client projects. We care more about your ability, initiative, and willingness to learn than the number of years on your résumé. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be involved in a variety of website projects for businesses across different industries. * Building and updating WordPress websites for new and existing clients. * Troubleshooting website problems, plugin conflicts, layout issues, and functionality. * Maintaining client websites, including updates, backups, and performance improvements. * Creating new pages, landing pages, forms, and website features. * Working on ecommerce websites, including WooCommerce and Shopify. * Making changes to existing websites, including projects built by other developers. * Turning designs and creative direction from our team into responsive, functional websites. * Working with hosting platforms, domains, website migrations, and staging environments. * Helping improve website speed, mobile usability, and overall performance. * Testing your work carefully before updates go live. * Collaborating with our team to complete projects efficiently and meet deadlines. You’ll have a mix of new builds, ongoing improvements, and technical troubleshooting. We value someone who can stay organized, move between projects, and take initiative when challenges arise. What We’re Looking For WordPress experience is essential. You should already be comfortable working in WordPress, building pages, managing plugins, making website changes, and troubleshooting common issues. Beyond that, we’re looking for someone who has: * A solid understanding of website structure, functionality, and responsive design. * Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with an interest in developing broader coding skills. * Experience building and maintaining professional websites, not just updating content. * The ability to investigate problems, research solutions, and follow through. * Good attention to detail and pride in producing polished work. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to complete assigned tasks promptly. * Clear communication skills and a willingness to work closely with a team. * The motivation to learn new platforms, tools, and development techniques. Additional skills we’d love to see, but don’t require: * Shopify and WooCommerce experience. * JavaScript, PHP, or custom WordPress development. * WordPress Gutenberg, Advanced Custom Fields, or custom themes. * Git, GitHub, and version control. * Hosting management, DNS, and website migrations. * Website speed optimization and technical SEO. * Figma or experience implementing professional website designs. * React, Next.js, or other modern web development technologies. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools. If you have strong WordPress skills but haven’t worked with every platform on this list, we still encourage you to apply. A Little About How We Work We believe good websites require more than installing a template and changing a few pictures. We appreciate developers who understand how websites function, care about performance, and are willing to learn better ways of building things. We don’t rely exclusively on drag\-and\-drop page builders, although experience with those tools can still be useful. We’re also enthusiastic about AI\-assisted development. We use modern tools to work smarter and faster, but we believe developers should understand what they’re building and be able to recognize and fix problems independently. You won’t be expected to figure everything out alone. Our experienced team is available to collaborate, provide direction, and help you expand your technical knowledge. Who Would Do Well Here? Someone who enjoys technology and naturally looks for solutions. You might be a relatively new developer with strong practical skills, or someone who’s been building websites for years and wants to work in a more collaborative environment. What matters most is that you: * Take initiative and don’t need constant reminders to move work forward. * Enjoy solving problems and learning how things work. * Ask good questions when you need help. * Can manage your time and complete work without unnecessary delays. * Communicate progress and take responsibility for your work. * Want to become better at what you do. Why Join Brevard SEM? We’re an established digital marketing agency working with businesses across a variety of industries. Joining our team means you’ll gain exposure to much more than WordPress. You’ll have opportunities to learn about ecommerce, digital marketing, search engine optimization, website performance, analytics, design, and modern web technologies. You’ll work directly with experienced professionals who are happy to share their knowledge, while gaining hands\-on experience with real client websites and meaningful projects. We encourage curiosity, new ideas, professional growth, and the responsible use of modern technology. This is a long\-term opportunity for someone who wants to develop their career and become an important part of our team. Position Details * Location: Melbourne, FL (Brevard County) * Work environment: In\-office, working directly with our team * Employment: Full\-time * Schedule: Monday through Friday, regular business hours * Compensation: $20–$30 per hour, based on experience and demonstrated skills * Start: We’re actively interviewing and looking to fill the position soon How to Apply Send us your résumé along with two or three examples of websites you’ve built or substantially worked on. Tell us a little about what you personally contributed to those projects and which platforms you used. A college degree is not required. We’re more interested in what you can do, how you approach problems, and your willingness to grow. If you enjoy building websites and want to be part of a team where you can contribute, learn, and develop your skills, we’d like to hear from you. Brevard SEM is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Benefits: * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Describe a real WordPress website you independently built, maintained, or troubleshot. What work did you personally perform, and how did you test the results? * Describe a real technical website issue you encountered. How did you investigate and diagnose it, what did you do to resolve it, and how did you verify the fix? * Provide links to 2–3 real websites you built or substantially worked on. For each, explain your specific contributions and the platforms used. * Are you available to work full\-time, in our Melbourne, Florida office, Monday through Friday during regular business hours? This is an in\-office position. Please confirm your availability. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer, Client Interfaces
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** The Client Interfaces team owns every surface customers and internal users touch when they use Crusoe Cloud: the Console and Admin Console, customer and admin CLIs, MCP servers, the Terraform provider, our docs, and the Intelligence Foundry / AI Studio. We're the glue between product, design, and the platform teams that power Crusoe Cloud. In 2026 our focus is *one experience, one quality bar* across every surface; a shared design system, a single API/CLI style guide extended to MCP and Terraform, and a foundation solid enough to support the polish, defaults, and micro\-interactions that make a developer cloud feel great to use. You'd be the first dedicated quality engineer on the team, and the person who defines what "one quality bar" means in practice. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Test Strategy Ownership:** Own end\-to\-end test strategy across the Console, CLIs, Terraform provider and MCP servers. This includes Playwright E2E suites, Go\-based integration and acceptance tests (with real plan/apply/destroy lifecycles through terraform\-plugin\-testing), and contract tests against generated API clients. * **Framework Development:** Build automation frameworks from scratch and keep them reliable through parallel execution, flakiness reduction and GitHub Actions CI integration, so a red build always means a real bug. * **Cross\-Surface Consistency:** Verify that features shipping to Console, CLI, Terraform and MCP at the same time behave like one product, and build harnesses that catch drift automatically. * **Release Readiness:** Define quality gates and release criteria with engineering and product, balancing shipping speed against reliability. * **AI\-First Testing:** Use agents to generate test suites from OpenAPI specs and tickets, review AI\-generated tests to make sure the assertions are meaningful, and use AI triage to separate real failures from flakes. * **Exploratory Testing:** Cover what automation can’t, including micro\-interactions, empty states, error copy, accessibility, upgrade paths and docs that don’t match the product. * **Complex Problem Solving:** Tackle issues that span every surface, such as breaking\-change management in the Terraform provider, API contract changes that ripple through generated clients, and design system migrations. * **Coaching and Collaboration:** Help software engineers get better at test design through code review and pairing, and work directly with design, product and platform teams. * **Measurable Quality:** Turn “this should feel great to use” into concrete, testable criteria the team can build against. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Quality Engineering Experience:** 5\+ years in quality engineering, test automation or SDET roles on customer\-facing products. * **Framework Building:** You’ve built, or helped build, a TypeScript automation framework from scratch and run it in CI. You can talk specifics about parallelization, retries, network interception, flakiness and what you’d do differently next time. * **Testing Beyond the Browser:** You’re comfortable testing HTTP APIs, CLIs and infrastructure tooling, and you’re willing to ramp up on Go and Terraform provider acceptance testing. * **AI Tool Fluency:** You use AI coding and testing tools (Claude Code or similar agents) every day to generate and maintain suites. You know where their output falls short and can teach others to use them well. * **Exploratory Instinct:** You find the bug the suite missed, then decide whether it’s worth automating. * **Clear Written Communication:** Your bug reports, test plans and release notes stand on their own. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \-$205,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. observability. * Provide supporting design documentation and traceability artifacts. * Stay up to date with emerging trends in web, application and AI development. **Knowledge/Educational front\-end and service development. * Web and mobile application development, with modern front\-end technologies and frameworks ideally including Blazor. * Experience developing solutions using jobs.title: AI Engineer 4
jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss * You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies * At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience leading development AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy * 6\+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud , throughput, and cost * Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows * Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * Proficiency in designing distributed systems for model training, evaluation, and online inference at petabyte scale * Experience defining AI model governance processes, including producibility, lineage tracking, and automated retaining schedules * Demonstrated ability to influence architectural decisions across multiple AI product lines or platforms ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. jobs.description: Staff Applied Researcher (Remote Eligible) At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real\-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world\-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Front End
jobs.description: **Who we are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years. **What we do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role overview** The Dealer team at CarGurus is looking for a Software Engineer II to advance our Inventory products. This role involves transforming CarGurus market data into impactful experiences for dealers. As we develop brand\-new dealer\-facing inventory products from scratch, you will have extensive opportunities to work across the entire technical stack. Success in this position requires the ability to adapt swiftly and work harmoniously within a cross\-functional environment. **What you'll do** * Develop and deploy clean, well\-tested and efficient code, ensuring high standards of architecture, quality and performance * Provide support and improvements to core systems while maintaining high standards for internal stakeholder teams * Integrate modern AI tools into your development pipeline to boost productivity, troubleshoot efficiently, and stay at the forefront of engineering workflows * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including data scientists and product managers, to guide projects from concept through technical design, implementation, quality testing, and performance measurement **What you'll bring** * 2\-5 years of hands\-on software development experience in a professional setting * Proficiency in React and Javascript fundamentals * Proficiency in Java and SQL * Experience and/or interest in leveraging AI coding tools * Practical knowledge of distributed systems and microservice architecture design * A strong understanding of data structures, algorithms and complexity analysis * Ability to iterate and ship ideas quickly in collaboration with your peers * Curiosity and a passion for learning new technologies and concepts quickly **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in\-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That's why we hope you'll apply even if you don't check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. \#LI\-Hybrid

The truth is, most of us will help a parent, spouse, family member, friend, or neighbor navigate aging and care at some point in our lives. We've been there ourselves. That's why we're building better ways to help people find, fund, and understand aging care all while being supported every step of the way. We're a team of curious problem\-solvers, compassionate listeners, and people who care about making a difference. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic self. Our four values guide our strategy, our decisions, and our interactions: * **Make it human.** We care about the people that make up our customers, colleagues, and communities. * **Make it about others** . We do what’s best for our customers and collaborate to drive progress. * **Make it happen.** We work with intention toward a common purpose and forge ways forward together. * **Make it better.** We create fulfilling purpose\-driven careers by learning from the world and each other. If you’re looking to build a meaningful career while helping transform the aging experience for millions of families, we’d love to hear from you. **POSITION TITLE** Lead Software Engineer **POSITION LOCATION** Remote US (Eastern/Central Time) This position is available to Virginia residents as Richmond, Virginia in\-office applicants or remote applicants residing in states/locations under Eastern or Central Standard Time: Alabama, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington DC, Vermont, West Virginia or Wisconsin. **YOUR ROLE** We are seeking a highly experienced and driven **Lead Software Engineer** to lead the modernization of our Assessment platform. This role requires deep expertise in modern software development practices, a passion for emerging technologies, and the ability to provide strong technical leadership and mentorship. You will play a critical role in shaping the future of the platform, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable for long\-term growth. **What you will be doing** * Responsibilities + Architect and implement a modern Assessment platform using technologies such as TypeScript, React, React Native, Flutter, and GraphQL. + Establish and champion best\-in\-class engineering practices to ensure systems are modular, scalable, resilient, and flexible. + Define and enforce coding standards, architectural patterns, and quality metrics to maintain high engineering standards. + Lead technical design discussions, perform code reviews, and provide hands\-on guidance across the engineering team. + Design and implement CI/CD pipelines and contribute to DevSecOps practices. Contribute to platform hosting, deployment, and runtime strategies, ensuring reliability and performance at scale. + * Deliverables / Results + A modernized, production\-ready Assessment platform supporting both B2B and B2C use cases. + Well\-documented, maintainable codebases aligned with agreed architectural standards. + Consistent, repeatable deployments enabled by standardized CI/CD pipelines. + Improved system performance, reliability, and scalability across web and mobile platforms. Strong technical foundations that support future feature development and platform expansion. + * Impact / Value Add + Raise the technical bar across the organization by modeling engineering excellence and best practices. + Reduce long\-term technical debt through thoughtful architecture and disciplined execution. + Accelerate delivery by enabling teams to build on a stable, scalable platform. + Improve customer and partner experiences through reliable, high\-quality applications. + Enable the business to confidently scale assessments, integrations, and transaction volumes. * Ownership + Own the technical vision and architecture of the Assessment platform. + Serve as a key decision\-maker for technology choices, architectural trade\-offs, and implementation approaches. + Take accountability for platform quality, performance, and long\-term sustainability. + Identify and proactively address technical risks, scalability challenges, and architectural gaps. * Collaboration + Partner closely with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. + Collaborate with engineering peers, mobile and web teams, and shared services to ensure architectural alignment. + Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a culture of learning, quality, and continuous improvement. Work cross\-functionally with s bilities. In this role, you will lead backend engineering efforts to build a unified new website architecture, consolidate existing digital properties, and transfer and synchronize content across legacy platforms and our modern headless stack. Founded in 1987, CCG provides third\-party authentication and grading services that protect the integrity of the hobby and empower confident buying and selling decisions. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
jobs.description: **About CircleCI Engineering** ------------------------------ CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. **About Delivery Engineering** ------------------------------ Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil. Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on. We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build AI\-natively.** AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. * **Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents.** Help define the end\-to\-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on. * **Start from how our teams actually work.** Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate. * **Build platforms, not one\-offs.** Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done. * **Measure what matters.** Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns. * **Make build\-vs\-buy calls.** Evaluate models, vendors, and open\-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage. * **Lead through influence.** Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts.** You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work. * **Hands\-on depth with agentic tooling.** You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics. * **A platform mindset.** You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption. * **Backend depth in Go.** You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration. * **A track record at staff scope.** 8\+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed. * **Decision\-making grounded in your users.** You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along. This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone. **Sound like you?** ------------------- You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **About CircleCI** CircleCI is the world's largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most\-used DevOps tools \- processing more than 3 million jobs a day \- CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture\-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. **How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring** At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. jobs.title: Data Engineer-Integration Specialist
jobs.description: **Company Description** With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation \& Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia \- increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. **Job Description** Data Engineering at the City is a unique opportunity for meaningful, exciting work and professional development using state\-of\-the art technologies and software development best practices. This is a position on a diverse team of engineers, analysts, and GIS specialists, contributing to developing, maintaining, and optimizing our data pipelines and integration strategies, assisting departments and agencies in innovating, and enhancing the City’s service to its residents. The data engineer/integration specialist will develop an intimate understanding of the City’s diverse data and contribute to improving the City’s data engineering infrastructure, pipelines, models, and integrations. The team uses a blend of open source, custom developed and off\-the\-shelf tools, including Python, Bash, SQL, DBT, GIS, Docker, Terraform, Apache Airflow, Jenkins, Postgres, PostGIS, AWS, GitHub, Github actions, MuleSoft as an iPaaS and SAS API providers like ArcGIS Online and CARTO. Some prominent services the team is responsible for include DataBridge, OIT’s enterprise data warehouse, AIS, the City’s custom address information systems which supports public address search and internal geocoding, and Databridge\-Airflow, a custom workflow generator and orchestrator for departmental integrations (https://metadata.phila.gov/) and open data publishing (https://opendataphilly.org/). Some examples of OIT’s commitment to serving the public through the effective and innovative integration of City open data include: https://Atlas.phila.gov https://property.phila.gov https://Openmaps.phila.gov https://streetsmartphl.phila.gov/ www.phila.gov/solarmap www.phila.gov/stressmap We are looking for a candidate who is not only technically skilled but also passionate about leveraging data to improve City operations and community life. This team is fundamental to the innovation of City services that directly affect residents. If you are eager to contribute to a team that values innovation, efficiency, service\-oriented work and data\-driven decision\-making, we encourage you to apply. **Essential Functions** * Working with business partners of varying technical ability to understand how their data is produced, stored, and updated, designing enhancements to optimize enterprise integrations and public data accessibility. * Design and develop new and expand and refine existing data pipelines using Apache Airflow, custom Python\-based software, and other tools to connect diverse systems of record, centralized databases, and SaaS environments, improving data platform components, data governance, master data management, data standardization, enrichment and quality assurance. * Play a key role in enterprise integration and open data initiatives, developing and supporting critical systems like the City’s DataBridge, Databridge\-Airflow and AIS. * Write clear, descriptive technical documentation for systems/applications, partner with data stewards of various technical levels and communicate technical details to non\-technical stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Geography/GIS, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered. * Demonstrated experience in data engineering or a similar role, with a focus on data management/integration/ETL/ELT. * Proven track record with Python, SQL, and database management. * Experience with working with modern data engineering tech stack. * Familiarity with development of custom ETL/CI/CD tools and the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies. Previous work in a public sector or large organization setting is a plus. Competencies: * Clear and concise writing and communication skills. * Creative problem\-solving and critical thinking. * Ability to work with data from diverse domains. * Efficient time management and the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously. * Ability to seek innovative opportunities and continuous improvement. * Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools, packages, and best practices. * Eagerness to participate in knowledge sharing and contribute to team discussions on coding standards. Knowledge and Skills: * Proficient in Python * Familiarity with modern Python development practices (e.g., type annotations, data validation, automated testing) a plus * Strong SQL skills and experience with databases (Postgres preferred). * Familiarity with Docker, bash and minimal Linux server administration. * Experience with cloud services (AWS preferred). * Understanding of Git/GitHub for version control and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience or ability to learn Airflow, DBT, Terraform, Kubernetes, Mulesoft. * Experience working with spatial datasets a plus. * Experience using command line interfaces. Abilities: * To reason about, model and manipulate complex datasets. * To maintain clean and secure data environments. * To work effectively in a hybrid (on\-premises and cloud) environment. * To communicate complex technical concepts in understandable terms. To thoughtfully evaluate new data engineering tools and practices within a public service context. **Additional Information** **Salary cannot exceed $95,605** **We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply.** **Please include:** * Resume * A cover letter **Please note: Applications will not be considered without a cover letter.** Did you know? * We are a Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program qualified employer : 25% tuition discount program for City employees (and sometimes spouses and dependents as well) in partnership with area colleges and universities * We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan * Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays * Generous retirement savings options are available **\*The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire** Effective May 22, 2023, vaccinations are **no longer required** for new employees that work in non\-medical, non\-emergency or patient facing positions with the City of Philadelphia. As a result, only employees in positions providing services that are patient\-facing medical care (ex: Nurses, doctors, emergency medical personnel), must be fully vaccinated.
