jobs.description: **Company Description** With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation \& Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia \- increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. **Job Description** Dev\-ops / data integration systems administration at the City offers a unique opportunity for impactful, dynamic work and professional growth, leveraging cutting\-edge technologies. This is a position on a diverse team of engineers, analysts, and GIS specialists, contributing to developing, maintaining, and optimizing our data pipelines and integration strategies, assisting departments and agencies to innovate and enhance the City’s service to its residents. This role will work closely with a senior Systems Engineer to support and enhance existing infrastructure. The dev\-ops / data integration systems engineer will help deploy and streamline the team’s various server stacks and automations that host the City’s data engineering infrastructure, pipelines, models, and integrations. The team (CityGeo) uses a blend of open source, custom developed and off\-the\-shelf tools, including Kubernetes, Docker, OpenTofu (Terraform), Python, Bash, DBT, GIS, Apache Airflow, Jenkins, Postgres, PostGIS, AWS, GitHub, GitHub actions, MuleSoft as an iPaaS and SAS API provides like ArcGIS Online and CARTO. Some prominent services the team is responsible for include DataBridge, OIT’s enterprise data warehouse, AIS, the City’s custom address information systems which supports public address search and internal geocoding, and Airflow, a custom workflow generator and orchestrator for departmental integrations (https://metadata.phila.gov/) and open data publishing (https://opendataphilly.org/). Some examples of OIT’s commitment to serving the public through the effective and innovative integration of City open data include: https://Atlas.phila.gov https://property.phila.gov https://Openmaps.phila.gov https://streetsmartphl.phila.gov/ www.phila.gov/solarmap www.phila.gov/stressmap We are looking for a candidate who is not only technically skilled but also passionate about leveraging data to improve City operations and community life. This team is fundamental to the innovation of City services that directly affect residents. If you are eager to contribute to a team that values innovation, efficiency, service\-oriented work and data\-driven decision\-making, we encourage you to apply. **Essential Functions** * Design and implement new deployment and automation strategies for maintaining and updating various server stacks in the cloud (AWS(primary)/Azure) on Linux and Windows servers, using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and other best practices * Configuring various system health monitors using Grafana, AlertManager, and Prometheus, AWS CloudWatch, SNS * Work closely with data engineers to support integration and open data initiatives, developing and maintaining critical systems like the City’s DataBridge, Airflow, MuleSoft and AIS. * Design, develop, expand and refine existing data pipelines using Apache Airflow, custom Python\-based software, and other tools. * Write clear, descriptive technical documentation for systems/applications, partner with data stewards of various technical levels and communicate technical details to non\-technical stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Previous work experience in a dev\-ops or related role that included managing systems/software stacks in a production environment with proper testing/deployment practices. * Bachelor’s/advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field or equivalent work experience. * Dedication to making Philadelphia municipal government more robust, efficient, and equitable. * Previous work in a public sector or large organization setting is a plus. Competencies: * Clear and concise writing and communication skills – documentation driven. * Creative problem\-solving and critical thinking. * Efficient time management and the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously. Knowledge and Skills: * Proficient in Systems Administration (Linux preferred, but we work with Windows too). * Proficient with CLI (Linux and PowerShell), Bash and Python. * Proficient with Kubernetes and Docker * Automation Mindset: Leverages automation for maintainability/security with CI/CD pipelines. * Familiar or ability to learn tools like GitHub Actions, Terraform, Jenkins, Airflow. * Understanding of Git/GitHub for version control and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience or ability to learn databases administration (Postgres preferred) and SQL (proficiency a plus). * Experience working with cloud technologies, containers, and orchestration tools (AWS: Batch, ECS, EKS, CloudWatch). * Experience working with spatial datasets a plus. Abilities: * Troubleshoot system health and understand the basics of deploying maintainable systems. * Maintain clean and secure data environments. * Work effectively in a hybrid (on\-premises and cloud) environment. * To communicate complex technical concepts in understandable terms. **Additional Information** **Salary cannot exceed $87,550** **We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply.** **Please include:** * Resume * A cover letter **Please note: Applications will not be considered without a cover letter.** Did you know? * We are a Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program qualified employer : 25% tuition discount program for City employees (and sometimes spouses and dependents as well) in partnership with area colleges and universities * We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan * Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays * Generous retirement savings options are available **\*The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire** Effective May 22, 2023, vaccinations are **no longer required** for new employees that work in non\-medical, non\-emergency or patient facing positions with the City of Philadelphia. As a result, only employees in positions providing services that are patient\-facing medical care (ex: Nurses, doctors, emergency medical personnel), must be fully vaccinated. The City of Philadelphia is an Equal Opportunity employer and does not permit discrimination based on race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, source of income, familial status, genetic information or domestic or sexual violence victim status. If you believe you were discriminated against, call the Philadelphia Commission on Human Relations at 215\-686\-4670 or send an email to faqpchr @phila.gov. For more information, go to: Human Relations Website: http://www.phila.gov/humanrelations/Pages/default.aspx

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Science
jobs.description: Shape the future of AI in Intellectual Property. As Vice President, Data Science, you will set the vision for our Data Science \& AI organization and turn advances in machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI into scalable products, smarter operations, and measurable business value. This is an opportunity to pair technical ambition with executive leadership—guiding a global, multidisciplinary organization from AI strategy to production\-grade solutions. If you have led enterprise\-scale AI teams and brought AI solutions into production, we invite you to help define what comes next for our IP business. **About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments** ================================================================== * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 15\+ years of progressive experience in Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or related fields, including 8\+ years leading enterprise\-scale global teams. * Experience managing Data Scientists, Applied Scientists, AI Researchers, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and MLOps professionals. * At least 7 years of experience defining AI strategy and leading the delivery of production\-grade AI/ML systems and data products at enterprise scale. * At least 7 years of experience in AI and machine learning, with experience spanning deep learning, NLP, RAG, LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps, and responsible AI practices. * At least 7 years of experience presenting AI or machine learning technical strategy to executive stakeholders and partnering with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Customer Success teams. * At least 7 years of experience developing or leading AI/ML solutions involving predictive modeling, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, forecasting, computer vision, graph methods, or experimentation. * At least 7 years of experience developing or leading AI solutions, including experience with Generative AI, LLMs, SLMs, RAG, multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, evaluation, AI safety, and hallucination mitigation. * At least 7 years of experience developing or leading AI/ML model development, including experience with pretraining, fine\-tuning, PEFT/LoRA, quantization, distillation, explainability, benchmarking, and A/B testing. * At least 7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or production deployment, including experience with deployment pipelines, monitoring, feature stores, vector databases, drift detection, observability, data quality, cloud\-native platforms, and Kubernetes. * At least 7 years of experience managing AI/ML costs and measuring business value, including experience with LLM cost management, model routing, GPU and inference optimization, hybrid model strategies, FinOps, and AI ROI measurement. * At least 7 years of experience presenting AI strategy and outcomes to executives, customers, boards, investors, or industry forums. **It would be great if you also have . . .** ============================================ * PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * Experience in Intellectual Property, Legal Technology, Information Services, Scientific Research, SaaS, or Knowledge Management industries. * Recognized AI/ML contributions through patents, publications, conference talks, or AI Centers of Excellence leadership. **What will you be doing in this role?** ======================================== * Define and execute the enterprise data science and AI vision, aligning investment and delivery with business strategy, product innovation, and long\-term growth. * Differentiate our products, operations, and customer experiences through AI. * Create a multi\-year roadmap for machine learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and advanced analytics adoption. * Lead the strategy, architecture, and implementation of Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions across the business. * Build scalable AI agents, copilots, assistants, reasoning systems, and workflow automation capabilities. * Set standards for prompt engineering, context management, retrieval, orchestration, and agent evaluation. * Lead predictive modeling, recommendation systems, forecasting, analytics platforms, and reusable AI capabilities. * Translate business opportunities into scalable AI solutions that improve decisions, customer outcomes, and operational performance. * Define the strategy for foundation model selection, fine\-tuning, deployment, benchmarking, governance, lifecycle management, and cost optimization. * Evaluate responsible uses of proprietary enterprise data and open\-source and commercial model ecosystems. * Establish enterprise standards for responsible AI, governance, transparency, security, compliance, explainability, monitoring, and risk mitigation. * Build, lead, and develop a global Data Science \& AI organization with technical excellence, talent depth, a culture of innovation, and accountability for business impact. * Partner with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Legal, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders to align AI capabilities with business priorities and communicate technical strategy. * Establish KPIs for AI adoption, model performance, ROI, productivity, customer impact, cost efficiency, and delivery of high\-value initiatives. **About the Team** ================== Our Data Science \& AI organization drives innovation and competitive advantage across the IP business through advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI. The team brings together Data Scientists, Applied Scientists, ML Engineers, MLOps Engineers, and specialists focused on customer insight, workflow automation, product intelligence, and strategic decision\-making. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Customer Success to turn AI capabilities into business and customer outcomes. **Hours of Work** ================= You will primarily work full\-time business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to support global business needs. **Compensation – US only** The expected base salary for this position is $240,000–$300,000 USD per year. This role is eligible for bonus earnings. Individual pay is based upon experience, education, skill and ability, expertise, and relevant factors. In addition to a competitive remuneration package, you will be eligible to participate in a benefits package that includes medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k with match, long term disability coverage, vacation, sick time, volunteer time, discount programs, and many more. At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cygnus Education \& VEGA** At Cygnus Education, we build technology that empowers higher education institutions to connect more effectively with students and streamline the enrollment journey. Our flagship product, VEGA, is a modern, data\-driven solution that powers lead management, compliance workflows, and marketing operations for higher education nationwide. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to take a lead role in shaping VEGA’s architecture and codebase as we scale. This is an opportunity to have end\-to\-end ownership of systems that directly impact student outcomes and institutional efficiency. **Role Overview** As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the VEGA team, you’ll help lead the evolution of our platform architecture, with a Ruby on Rails backend, React/TypeScript front\-end, hosted on AWS. You’ll collaborate with cross\-functional teams across product, design, DevOps, and data to deliver secure, scalable, and high\-performing solutions. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role where your ability to mentor peers, influence architecture, and implement best practices will shape both our product and team culture. This role, while remote does require occasional onsite collaboration in either central Florida or Philadelphia PA. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the development and maintenance of the VEGA web application using Ruby on Rails, React, and TypeScript. * Drive the architecture and technical design of the VEGA system with an emphasis on scalability, maintainability, availability, and performance. * Design and maintain our high\-availability cloud infrastructure hosted on AWS and managed with Terraform. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to define and deliver new features and core improvements aligned with higher education workflows. * Optimize performance and scalability across the platform, including backend services and frontend UI. * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code, ensuring system reliability and rapid iteration. * Monitor and maintain platform health using Datadog and other observability tools. * Lead by example with clean code, thoughtful pull requests, and proactive mentorship of senior and mid\-level engineers. * Champion a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. **Required Qualifications** * 5 \- 10 years of experience designing, building, and deploying large\-scale full stack applications and distributed systems. * Proven experience in system design and architecture of SaaS products or enterprise\-grade web platforms. * Strong backend skills in Ruby on Rails, with production experience building and maintaining high\-availability APIs and services. * Frontend proficiency with React and TypeScript, with strong UI development sensibilities. * Familiarity with testing frameworks such as RSpec, Capybara, and Chromatic/Storybook. * Practical experience with AWS, including services like IAM, ECS, RDS, and S3\. * Deep understanding of SQL, query optimization, and relational data modeling. * Experience managing infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform. * Experience with CI/CD tooling such as CircleCI and AWS CodeBuild/CodePipeline. * Familiarity with monitoring, tracing, and alerting via Datadog or similar tools. * Strong debugging skills. * Ability to lead initiatives and mentor peers while collaborating cross\-functionally. * Excellent communication skills—able to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * A self\-driven mindset: curious, resourceful, and passionate about education technology and impact\-driven development. **Nice to Have** * Experience in edtech, lead management, or compliance\-heavy applications. * Experience building integrations with CRMs like Salesforce, IdPs like Google and Entra, and advertising platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, and Snap. * Contributions to open source or technical community engagement. Pay: $135,000\.00 \- $155,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * AD\&D insurance * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Tampa, FL 33619

jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer (Hybrid - Westford, MA)
jobs.description: Who We Are Cynosure Lutronic is a global leader in energy\-based dermatology and medical aesthetic technologies, shaping the future of skin health. Our mission is to empower people to feel confident in their skin, and we deliver on it through intelligent, results\-driven solutions across laser, RF, IPL, LED, and EMS platforms. Backed by more than three decades of innovation and over 100,000 installed systems worldwide, we combine advanced engineering, breakthrough clinical insights, and manufacturing excellence to raise the standard in safety, precision, and efficacy. With 1,100 employees across North America, EMEA, and APAC, we partner with providers globally to deliver quality outcomes and exceptional patient experiences. How We Work Our values define how we show up for our customers, for the patients they treat, and for each other: * Customers at our core. We deeply understand our customers' needs and act with urgency and accountability to earn their trust, every time. * Everyone innovates. Innovation is a mindset, not a job title. We improve, adapt, and challenge the status quo in every role, every day. * One team, all in. We win together across teams, time zones, and titles. We share credit, break silos, and support one another. * Right over easy. We do the right thing, especially when it's hard or unseen. * Outcome oriented. We focus on what moves the needle, with clear purpose and aligned goals. We look for people who make an impact, and we invest in them, building careers alongside a high\-performance, culture\-driven organization. Learn more at www.cynosurelutronic.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram. Job Summary The Sr. AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) is a software engineer and technical consultant who works directly with business teams to solve high\-value problems in their real\-world operating environments. Embedded with functional stakeholders, this role translates ambiguous needs into working AI and automation solutions, guides opportunities from discovery and business\-case development through prototyping, integration, governed production deployment, adoption, and value realization, and ensures that technology capabilities produce measurable business outcomes. The initial focus will be activating and extending capabilities already available within Microsoft’s enterprise AI and automation ecosystem, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, Copilot agents, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and related capabilities. The role will then help deliver purpose\-built solutions integrated with enterprise applications and, as the organization’s AI maturity grows, support more advanced use cases requiring deeper AI engineering, systems integration, data, application development, and agentic solution skills. Success requires curiosity, strong consulting and facilitation skills, technical credibility, a bias for action, and a commitment to responsible AI. Essential Duties and Responsibilities The incumbent may be asked to perform other function\-related activities in addition to the below\-mentioned responsibilities as reasonably required by business needs. * Partner with leaders, functional teams, and end users to understand business goals, map current workflows, identify pain points, and define opportunities for AI and automation. * Facilitate discovery workshops and translate business needs into clear use cases, requirements, solution options, expected benefits, risks, and success measures. * Assess and prioritize opportunities using a standardized business case that evaluates business value, cost, feasibility, data readiness, security, compliance, user impact, risk, time\-to\-value, scalability, and total cost of ownership. * Design, prototype, code, configure, test, integrate, deploy, and support AI and automation solutions using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, Copilot agents, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI services, APIs, and appropriate software\-development frameworks. * Partner with the VP, AI Transformation, Information Systems (IS), business sponsors, and applicable governance stakeholders to provide technical feasibility, architecture, effort, dependency, and delivery\-risk inputs while maintaining primary accountability for solution design and implementation. Support coordinated intake, prioritization, benefits tracking, and executive reporting as the organization’s AI operating model matures. * Lead assigned solutions with a high degree of autonomy, balancing rapid experimentation with enterprise standards, documenting technical decisions, managing delivery commitments, and escalating material risks or dependencies early. * Develop reusable prompts, agent instructions, workflows, connectors, templates, and solution patterns; maintain the associated documentation and inventory so approved capabilities can be discovered, governed, supported, and scaled across the organization. * Collaborate with Information Systems (IS), Information Securit f experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or a related field, including hands\-on delivery of AI, data, integration, low\-code, or automation solutions. Demonstrated experience working directly with business stakeholders from discovery and business\-case development through architecture, prototyping, production deployment, adoption, and value measurement is required. Hands\-on experience with at least one enterprise AI platform is required; experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI services, or comparable technologies is strongly preferred, along with experience evaluating whether to extend, buy, or build solutions. Skills * Exceptional consulting, active\-listening, facilitation, and relationship\-building skills; able to establish trust, surface competing needs, and build shared ownership with business and technical stakeholders at all levels across functions. * Strong business\-process analysis and problem\-framing skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous needs into clear use cases, requirements, experiments, solution options, delivery plans, and measurable success criteria. * Hands\-on knowledge of generative AI, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agents and multi\-agent patterns, workflow automation, APIs, integrations, and evaluation methods for grounding, accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, and cost. * Demonstrated experience building enterprise solutions with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, Azure AI services, or related Microsoft technologies. * Demonstrated ability to design, build, test, debug, deploy, and maintain solutions using Python and at least one enterprise application language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or C\#, together with SQL, REST APIs, source control, cloud services, and modern software\-development practices. * Ability to design secure, governed integrations between AI agents and enterprise tools, APIs, applications, and data sources, including appropriate authentication, authorization, identity, permissions, privacy, compliance, responsible AI, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, architectural trade\-offs, risks, and recommendations to nontechnical audiences and executive stakeholders. * Demonstrated change\-management and user\-enablement skills, including training, documentation, demonstrations, community engagement, and adoption support. * Outcome orientation with experience defining value hypotheses and measuring adoption, efficiency, quality, risk reduction, reuse, and business impact. * Preferred: experience delivering production AI solutions, agentic workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation, custom copilots, Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI solutions, data pipelines, enterprise integrations, DevOps and CI/CD practices, observability, automated testing, and secure cloud application development. Experience designing, deploying, or governing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and familiarity with Microsoft Work IQ, Microsoft IQ, or comparable enterprise intelligence, semantic\-grounding, and agent\-context capabilities are also preferred. Physical Demands The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. * Sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. * Stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. * Other (please specify): Domestic \& International travel (approx. 15%), including extended flights and work across multiple time zones. Cynosure is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Disability, Veteran

jobs.title: AI and DevOps Engineer – Human Capital
jobs.description: **Human Capital** **New York** ------------------------------ The D. E. Shaw group seeks an AI and DevOps engineer to join its Human Capital Generative AI (HC GAI) team, which designs, builds, and operates generative AI solutions that transform how the firm attracts, assesses, develops, and retains talent. Working at the intersection of people strategy, product design, and emerging AI capabilities, the team delivers tools for both technical and non\-technical users across the firm. This role serves as the operational backbone for HC GAI, keeping the team's shared data and AI infrastructure healthy and reliable, from back\-end pipelines to developer tooling and user\-facing reporting. **What you’ll do day\-to\-day** ------------------------------- * Build, deploy, and maintain the HC GAI team's automated reporting products and dashboards, primarily in Python, along with the ETL pipelines and people\-analytics data infrastructure behind them. * Manage release and testing for people\-analytics tooling and data pipelines, keep repositories healthy (CI checks, dependency updates), and onboard new developers. * Ensure the reliability of HC GAI's shared infrastructure and applications by setting up monitoring and alerting, tracking usage, and leading incident response. * Administer prompt versioning and change control for AI systems, including first\-line investigation of feature issues. * Run AI model evaluations, carry out migrations as models are updated or retired, and manage query logging and usage analytics with appropriate privacy safeguards. * Maintain the team's Claude skills and plugins for both technical and non\-technical users. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * A bachelor's degree in a technical field and at least three years of relevant experience in DevOps, data engineering, or AI operations. * Fluency in Python, including for data transformation and analysis, and hands\-on experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated experience managing deployment pipelines, environment setup, and developer onboarding, along with prompt management and troubleshooting in AI or machine learning environments. * An affinity for data wrangling and finding the perfect way to visualize data for a senior audience; people\-analytics experience is preferred. * Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments, see how small details impact the bigger picture, and drive work forward across cross\-functional dependencies. * Excellent organizational and communication skills, along with the ability to partner with technical leads, support non\-technical users, and exercise extreme discretion with confidential information. * The expected annual base salary for this position is $150,000 to $200,000\. Our compensation and benefits package includes variable compensation in the form of a year\-end bonus, guaranteed in the first year of hire, and benefits including medical and prescription drug coverage, 401(k) contribution matching, wellness reimbursement, family building benefits, and a charitable gift match program. The D. E. Shaw group is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Web Developer Sr.
jobs.description: For more than 60 years, Data Device Corporation (DDC) has been recognized as a world leader in the design and manufacture of high\-reliability Connectivity, Power, and Control solutions for the Aerospace, Defense, and Space industries. Our dedication to supplying quality products, on\-time delivery, and superior support has contributed to the success of our customers and the critical missions they serve. **This position is 100% onsite at our Bohemia, NY office.** **The salary range for this position is $100,000 to $130,000 annually and will depend upon experience.** This position requires a U.S Person or a person who can qualify for a Department of State or Department of Commerce License. **Position Summary:** Serve as the senior technical resource responsible for the design, development, enhancement, security, and ongoing support of DDC and PDC websites, web applications, and related databases, with a strong emphasis on PHP development. Independently lead complex web application initiatives from requirements analysis through deployment and maintenance; evaluate technical approaches and recommend sustainable solutions that meet business and security needs. Partner with stakeholders and Corporate IT to ensure reliable, secure, and well\-documented systems and to resolve critical application issues. **Key Position Accountabilities:** * Independently design, develop, enhance, and support complex PHP websites and web applications, including backend logic, database connections, and integrations. * Lead assigned web development initiatives through requirements gathering, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support. * Develop responsive, accessible, browser\-compatible interfaces using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. * Act as the primary escalation resource for complex website and application errors, performance problems, outages, and integration failures; conduct root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes. * Coordinate content updates and maintain accurate website pages, forms, and navigation. * Evaluate application architecture, code quality, security risks, and technical debt; recommend and implement improvements to reliability, maintainability, and performance. * Apply secure development practices, including input validation, access controls, vulnerability remediation, and appropriate testing. * Administer and troubleshoot Ubuntu web servers, PHP environments, database connections, TLS certificates, logs, patches, and monitoring. * Own disciplined application change practices, including Git/source control, code review where applicable, testing, documented deployments, and rollback planning. * Maintain website, application, and database backups; test restores and document recovery procedures in coordination with Corporate IT. * Design, maintain, and optimize database tables, views, stored procedures, functions, and SQL queries; resolve complex data and performance issues. * Develop reports, scripts, integrations, and automations to improve workflows and information access. * Consult with business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical solutions, assess options, communicate tradeoffs, and establish priorities. * Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and documentation to colleagues and application users, as appropriate; no direct supervisory responsibility is required. * Maintain technical documentation and follow company security, change management, quality, and safety procedures. **Qualifications:** * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. * Minimum five years of progressively responsible experience in web or application development and support, including substantial hands\-on PHP development experience. * Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex web application enhancements and troubleshooting production issues. * Advanced proficiency in PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including debugging, code maintenance, and application design. * Experience with PHP frameworks such as Laravel or Symfony. * Experience developing database\-driven websites and applications using SQL, particularly MySQL and/or SQL Server. * Experience diagnosing websites, application, database connection, and performance issues. * Experience administering Ubuntu, Apache or Nginx, PHP, TLS certificates, permissions, logs, backups, and updates. * Knowledge of secure web development, including SQL injection and cross\-site scripting prevention and access controls. * Proficiency with Git or similar source control, application testing, and controlled deployments. * Strong independent judgment, communication, documentation, problem\-solving, and prioritization skills; ability to explain technical solutions to nontechnical stakeholders. **Desired Characteristics:** * Experience supporting CMS platforms such as WordPress, including themes, plugins, updates, and security. * Experience integrating websites and business systems using REST APIs. * Familiarity with website accessibility, performance optimization, and monitoring. * Experience with .NET, C\#, Visual Basic, and/or Python. * Experience with SSRS or similar reporting tools and ERP or PDM systems. * Engineering or manufacturing experience. * Familiarity with IT ticketing platforms. * Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Security\+, or Linux certifications. This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. This job description indicates, in general, the nature and levels of work, knowledge, skills, abilities and other essential functions (as covered under the ADA) expected of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice as required. *Data Device Corporation is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all persons in all facets of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected status.*

jobs.title: Python Developer I
jobs.description: **HIRING A PYTHON DEVELOPER I IN HOUSTON** **ACCOUNTABILITY** The Python Developer I is an entry\-level role responsible for designing, building, and supporting automations and AI\-enabled tools that reduce manual effort and improve quality across the firm’s MEP engineering, design, and business operations. Working under the guidance of Director of IT, the developer delivers Python and PowerShell scripts, Microsoft Power Automate workflows, and pyRevit scripts that support engineers, designers, and project staff. The developer works within established coding standards, Azure DevOps processes, and the firm’s IT security and AI\-use policies; production deployments, access to sensitive project or client data, and changes to firm\-wide systems require review and change management approval. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** * Develop, test, and maintain Python scripts and small applications that automate repetitive engineering, design, and administrative workflows (e.g., load and equipment schedules, calculation spreadsheets, report and file generation). * Build and maintain no\-code/low\-code automations using Microsoft Power Automate and related Microsoft 365 tools (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Excel, Forms, Power Apps). * Create and support Autodesk Revit automation using pyRevit, Dynamo, and/or the Revit API to help MEP design teams with model QA/QC checks, sheet and view setup, parameter management, and data export. * Assist in integrating AI capabilities—such as large language models and document/data extraction tools—into internal workflows, in line with the firm’s data security and responsible AI\-use guidelines. * Meet with engineers, designers, and project staff to understand manual processes and pain points, document requirements, and translate them into user stories and technical tasks. * Use Azure DevOps for source control (Git), work item tracking, code reviews, and build/release pipelines. * Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, and provide accurate estimates and status updates. * Write clear documentation and user guides, train end users on new tools, and provide troubleshooting and support for deployed automations. * Monitor, maintain, and improve existing automations to keep them reliable as software versions, templates, and firm standards change. * Perform additional assignments as requested/needed. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field preferred. * Associate's degree combined with a strong portfolio of Python or automation projects (e.g., GitHub repositories, internship work, or class projects) will be considered. * Degree Required: Associate degree or higher in a technical field. * Experience: 0–2 years of related experience; internships, co\-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects count toward this requirement. **CERTIFICATIONS** * No certifications are required. * Microsoft jobs.description: As a Sr. Solutions Engineer on the AI native team supporting the Digital Natives business, you will shape the future of the big data landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with customers, product teams, and the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform and APIs. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way. **The impact you will have:** * You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems. * Consult on Big Data architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects, spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications * Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users * Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community. **What we look for:** * 4\+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre\-sales/consulting role * Experience building distributed data systems * Comfortable programming in and debugging Python and SQL * Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * Expertise in one of the following: * + Data Engineering technologies (*Ex: Spark, Hadoop, Kafka*) + Data Science and Machine Learning technologies (*Ex: pandas, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, Tensorflow*) * Available to travel to customers in your region * \[Desired] Degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research) * Nice to have: Databricks Certification * Location: Remote (Pacific Time preferred; Mountain Time considered). NOTE: If your experience isn’t a perfect match for the job description, but you feel like you’re a good fit for the role, apply. We want to work with smart, passionate, people who are good at their job, and, a lot of times, those people have non\-linear career paths. **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. Local Pay Range $152,300—$209,450 USD **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. **Compliance** **If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - AI Accounts
jobs.description: As a Senior Sales Engineer on Datadog's AI Accounts team, you'll serve as the technical lead for a small portfolio of the world's leading AI labs — accounts that today represent a meaningful share of Datadog's revenue and are growing faster than any cohort in our business. You'll own the technical relationship end to end, work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customer engineering teams in production, and help define how Datadog shows up for a cohort whose buying behavior looks nothing like traditional enterprise. This team was piloted earlier this year and is now being formalized. You'll be joining early enough to shape the playbook rather than inherit one. **What You'll Do** * Own the technical relationship across a small portfolio of AI labs, go deep on how each customer trains, serves, and scales their models (and/or the downstream products and platforms), and become the person their engineers call first * Partner with your AE to drive expansion inside accounts that grow unpredictably and fast: identify new workloads and teams as they spin up, and get in front of them before a need becomes a ticket * Lead discovery inside flat, engineering\-led organizations where influence sits with individual contributors rather than titles, and where there are no formal scoping calls to rely on * Run full\-scale POVs in production rather than controlled pilots: instrument real workloads at real scale, prove value against the customer's own success criteria, and work through the operational realities of doing that safely * Act as an extension of the customer's engineering/observability team rather than an external operator \- this requires judgment about which standard gates serve the customer and which to break * Work Slack\-native and asynchronously as the default, with the responsiveness and proactive posture these accounts expect: flag new features, bugs, and incidents before they ask * Bring product and engineering in early and often, and close the loop fast — leadership needs near\-real\-time signal from this cohort, and you'll be a primary source of it * Deliver technical narratives that land with engineers who pay for capability first and rationalize cost second \- savings is a downstream conversation, not an opener * Build reusable assets and patterns from each engagement so the next lab onboards faster than the last * Keep activity, deal progress, and customer context documented and current **Who You Are** * 7\+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable technical customer\-facing role; equivalent depth gained inside an AI lab, AI infrastructure company, or ML platform team is equally welcome * Hands\-on depth in the AI/ML infrastructure stack: GPU fleet management, distributed training, inference serving, model and agent evaluation, and the observability challenges specific to each * Strong foundation in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM and distributed tracing, and modern, agentic observability practice and usage patterns (i.e. MCP) * Comfortable in flat organizations \- able to engage an IC and a founder in the same week and calibrate to both without reaching for hierarchy * Biased toward doing: you'd rather solve a customer's problem and explain the shortcut afterward than ask permission first, and you have the judgment to know where that line sits * Thrive in ambiguity and unpredictable growth \- scoping, timelines, and account trajectories will change under you, repeatedly * Actively coachable. The strongest people we hire ask for a dry run, take the feedback, and visibly change what they do on the next attempt * Persistent about access. Getting time with people operating at this pace is hard, and you treat that as an interesting problem rather than a demoralizing one * Demonstrated capability using AI tooling in your own workflow and scaling it to others — credibility with this cohort depends on being a practitioner, not an observer * Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement * Willing to travel for multi\-day onsites with customer engineering teams and for industry and research conferences *Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.* **Benefits and Growth:** * Best\-in\-breed onboarding * Generous global benefits * Intra\-departmental mentor and buddy program for in\-house networking * New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) * Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing * An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks *Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.* **About Datadog:** Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high\-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about \#DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center. **Equal Opportunity at Datadog:** Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference. Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. **Privacy and AI Guidelines:** Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Performance, GenAI, DeepMind
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM field or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in software development, systems programming, or applied ML engineering or equivalent education credit (e.g., internships, student research, pre\-graduate working experience). * 3 years of experiencewith performance optimization, systems data analysis, visualization tools, or debugging. * 3 years of experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning and related frameworks. * 1 year of experience designing and launching production software products or foundation AI systems. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, or related technical field. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role setting architectural direction and guiding project teams. * Experience developing, evaluating, or serving large language models, agentic workflows, multimodal pipelines, or AI runtime APIs (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, Triton, vLLM, Gemini API). * Expertise or strong interest in the following areas: performance debugging and optimization of complex workloads, design of performance tools, compiler design and code optimization, high\-performance software development techniques, concurrent programming, or multi\-core computer architectures. **About the job** ----------------- At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general\-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission\-driven team. We focus on identifying and achieving performance improvements in production and research ML workloads, with an emphasis on LLM inference—including serving latency, throughput, and cost per token—as well as the emerging demands of agentic workflows on current and next\-generation TPU platforms. We work across the entire stack, ranging from model architecture and sharding strategies to Pallas/Mosaic kernels and XLA. Additionally, we partner closely with the Gemini modeling, Deployment, Compiler, and TPU hardware teams to shape the capabilities of next\-generation accelerators. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Drive down the cost per token of Gemini inference by optimizing throughput, accelerator utilization, batching, scheduling, and KV cache efficiency. Achieve these gains through expert optimization and by building agentic workflows that enable AI agents to discover, implement, and validate performance improvements at scale. * Be among the first to bring Gemini to new TPU generations by characterizing hardware at launch, tuning kernels, sharding, and serving configurations for specific memory hierarchies and interconnects, and delivering production\-ready performance. Share these insights to influence future TPU hardware and compiler roadmaps. * Implement model compression techniques—such as quantization and sparsity—to reduce the cost\-per\-token for production Gemini models. Evaluate new architectures, optimizers, and training methods to achieve target quality with reduced compute requirements. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * Software Engineer$173\.8K – $212\.4K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • 10% Bonus This range is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills and experience. There may be instances where a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits. **Company Overview** ==================== Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. **Company Operating Rhythm** ============================ At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\. **Team Overview** The Applied AI team takes on the voice AI problems that don’t have off\-the\-shelf answers. We work directly with enterprise customers and technology partners, from conversational AI and customer experience platforms to restaurant brands, and much of the work is zero to one. Current focus areas include robust ASR in noisy outdoor environments, self\-service fine\-tuning and model adaptation, domain\-aware voice agents for drive\-thru and phone ordering, agent scoring and evaluation, real\-time operational analytics, and on\-site hardware integration. We’re a small team that works in person in San Francisco, ships to production quickly, and stays close to the customers we build for. **Key Goals** * Ship production features in live voice agent products, such as drive\-thru and phone ordering, within your first quarter. * Own customer problems end to end: hear the issue, find the root cause, and get the fix into production. * Help build reusable agent modules, like ordering and reservations, so new customers and industries launch faster. * Make agents more accurate on real\-world menus and catalogs, keeping structured data consistent across hundreds of locations. * Contribute to fine\-tuning and model adaptation so customers get accurate results on their own vocabulary and domains. * Spot problems across the product before anyone asks, then fix them or bring a proposed solution. * Run experiments that show whether new functionality improves outcomes for customers. **Minimum Skills, Knowledge \& Capabilities** * Experience building and shipping backend services that run in production in the cloud. * Operates AI\-native: you build with modern AI coding tools as your default way of working, not occasionally, and use them to move fast without lowering the quality bar. * Learns quickly and takes on unfamiliar parts of the stack with little ramp\-up. * Finds work instead of waiting for it: you recognize problems, propose solutions, and follow them through. * Has taken something from idea to production, at work or on your own time. * Communicates clearly with teammates and is comfortable working directly with customers. * Builds for the customer’s outcome, with a high bar for quality and no over\-engineering. * Comfortable working across languages. Our stack is mainly Kotlin and Python, with TypeScript on the front end. **Preferred Qualifications (nice\-to\-have)** * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, or adapting models, through work, research, or substantial projects. * Experience building evaluation or scoring for models or agents. * Experience with audio, speech\-to\-text, or text\-to\-speech. * Experience as a founder or early startup engineer, or taking a system from zero to one. * Typically 2\+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience. ***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.* Compensation Range: $173\.8K \- $212\.4K

jobs.title: AI and Data Science Engineer III - Marketing Measurement
jobs.description: Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in data and technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **AI and Data Science Engineer III** **\- Marketing Measurement,** you will have the opportunity to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery. **Work you'll do/Responsibilities** You will support Data \& Analytics initiatives across numerous business product teams in a scaled staff augmentation model, working with a broader team of approximately 235 onshore and offshore resources. As a Senior Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement, you will design and execute rigorous analyses to measure the impact of marketing initiatives and customer strategies. * Evaluate experimental and quasi\-experimental results to assess the effectiveness and incremental impact of marketing initiatives. * Design and assess geo\-based test\-and\-control approaches for paid media measurement, including platform ecosystems such as Google and YouTube. * Apply causal inference and incrementality measurement techniques to inform marketing investment decisions. * Interpret Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) outputs and explain their implications for marketing strategy and investment allocation. * Support experiment design, execution, and analysis, including A/B testing. * Use advanced SQL and Python or R to analyze marketing and customer data. * Validate data, perform quality checks, investigate discrepancies, and document analytical assumptions and limitations. * Translate complex analytical findings into clear, business\-friendly recommendations for stakeholders. * Strengthen measurement approaches across marketing programs and customer strategies. * Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management * Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated solutions across software, data, AI, networks, and cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission\-critical operations. AI \& Data teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms while delivering scalable, high\-value outcomes tailored to their business needs. **Qualifications** **Required** * 6\+ years of relevant experience in data science, marketing analytics, marketing measurement, or a related field. * Advanced proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience using Python or R for analysis. * Experience in marketing analytics. * Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), including interpreting outputs and their implications for investment decisions; * Experience with causal inference and geo\-based test\-and\-control design for paid media measurement, including platforms such as Google and YouTube. * Experience with incrementality measurement, experiment design, running experiments, and A/B testing. * Experience with data validation and quality assurance. * Ability to communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders in business\-friendly language. * Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Preferred * Experience with campaign effectiveness management. * Experience with customer segmentation. * Experience measuring promotions management and effectiveness. * Additional experience in marketing analytics. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,300 to $188,900\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. **Recruiting tips** From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters. **Our people and culture** Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. **Our purpose** Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more. **Professional development** From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Qualified applicants with criminal histories, including arrest or conviction records, will be considered for employment in accordance with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, City of Los Angeles's Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act. See notices of various fair chance hiring and ban\-the\-box laws where available. **Fair Chance Hiring and Ban\-the\-Box Notices \- Deloitte US Careers**

jobs.title: Edge Strategist Senior Consultant
jobs.description: Our Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end\-to\-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey\-before, during, and after any major transformation project or transaction. Our AI Strategy practice helps clients identify and validate AI opportunities before investing at scale. As an Edge Strategist, you'll combine business strategy, AI fluency, and rapid experimentation to demonstrate value, develop evidence\-based business cases, and build sequenced roadmaps. Apply today! Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026\. **Work You'll Do** As an Edge Strategist on the AI Strategy team, you will be responsible for: * Conduct stakeholder and end\-user interviews and lead working sessions to identify business needs, process gaps, and readiness for adoption. * Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, and risk. * Partner with client leaders, product owners, architects, engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to validate and prototype AI\-enabled solutions using client data, tools, and accelerators. * Define business requirements, success measures, user experience, and future\-state operating\-model requirements for AI\-enabled solutions. * Develop evidence\-based business cases, value\-tracking frameworks, reusable assets, sequenced roadmaps, and change plans that support adoption and inform decisions on quality, cost, latency, and risk. A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** Strategy architects bold strategies across the enterprise, enabling growth, competitive advantage, and continuous digital and AI transformation.
