jobs.title: Staff AI Architect
jobs.description: **Company Description** Domino’s is a purpose\-inspired, performance\-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90\+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's. **Job Description** As Staff AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual\-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build\-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped. This is a deeply hands\-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure\-primary with Databricks. **Responsibilities** Architecture Ownership and Direction * Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups. * Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build\-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning. * Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API\-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re\-solving solved problems. * Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build\-versus\-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real\-load latency. Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture * Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re\-embedding and versioning. * Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re\-ranking; manage the recall\-versus\-precision and latency trade\-off explicitly. * Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers. Generative AI Portfolio * Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes. * Own the AI gateway and multi\-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re\-tested as the landscape shifts. * Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM\-as\-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below. * Hold a clear, evidence\-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine\-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever. Agentic AI Portfolio * Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives. * Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts. * Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step\-level tracing, regressio data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text\-to\-SQL, multi\-turn dialogue). * Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM\-as\-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles. * Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI\-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply\-chain risk. * Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality\-versus\-performance trade\-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale. * Business and value\-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target\-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value\-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs. * End\-to\-end delivery with hands\-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross\-layer failures, and defend technical trade\-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving. * Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike. * Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10\+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft environment: Azure (AI Foundry and Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AI Search, API Management, Functions), Databricks and Copilot Studio; agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and MCP. * Experience in retail, restaurant, e\-commerce, or supply chain with high\-volume, real\-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management. * Production multi\-agent systems and agent runtimes, policy\-aware agent gateways with authenticated tool routing and server registries, and GPU\-accelerated serving stacks. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects, published work, or recognized community involvement. **Additional Information** Benefits: * Paid Holidays and Vacation * Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment * No\-cost mental health support for employee and dependents * Childcare tuition discounts * No\-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs * Fertility benefits * Adoption assistance * 401k matching contributions * 15% off the purchase price of stock * Company bonus All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash's mission is to empower local economies. As a Full Stack Engineer on our Applied AI team, you'll build the products that bring AI agents to life, from the interfaces customers, merchants, and Dashers interact with, to the backend services and infrastructure that power them at global scale. We have an applied AI lab at DoorDash, a team that is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This team is for builders who want to see their work directly impact millions of consumers, merchants, and Dashers every day. We operate with a flat structure: everyone is expected to be hands\-on and contribute directly to the mission. Initiative and consistent delivery are how people grow and lead here. **About the Role** ------------------ You'll work directly with our cofounder and own major pieces of how AI shows up in DoorDash's products. In this role, you will build complete product experiences end\-to\-end, including web and mobile frontends, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines, that turn AI agent capabilities into polished, reliable features. You'll partner closely with researchers to take prototypes to production, build internal tools that speed up iteration, and design systems that hold up under real\-world traffic. This is hands\-on work with immediate product impact at real\-world scale. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Work directly with leadership and see your work shipped to millions of users, with a small team and massive reach. * Move fast without bureaucracy, with rapid iteration, high autonomy, and no layers of politics. * Own features across the entire stack, from UI to infrastructure, rather than a narrow slice. * Have access to global data scale, robust compute, and a platform primed for AI transformation. * Shape how AI transforms commerce, building intelligent and adaptive experiences for Consumers, Merchants, and Dashers. **We're excited about you because you have…** --------------------------------------------- * Strong full stack engineering experience, with depth in modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React, TypeScript) and backend development (e.g. Python, Go, Kotlin, or Java). * Experience designing and shipping production systems, including APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure, with a focus on reliability and performance. * A track record of shipping user\-facing products quickly and iterating based on real usage. * Interest in AI and familiarity with integrating LLMs or AI APIs into products (prior agent or ML experience is a plus, not a requirement). * A builder mindset: you're energized by experimentation, move quickly, and stay close to the work. * Strong cross\-functional instincts and a natural ability to bridge product, design, and research. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** **Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools:** To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview. **How it works:** Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support \- rather than replace \- human decision\-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI\-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law. **Data Retention, Privacy \& Bias Audit:** Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en\-us/legal/article/ax\-privacy\-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden\-ai.com/metaview/application\-review.

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: **Project Engineer** The Project Engineer is responsible for the technical support associated with customer products, including quoting, planning, and implementing new business, value engineering, production start\-up and maintenance, and continuous improvement programs. They will act as the interface between customers and internal operations to ensure that all customer engineering requirements are met. The Project Engineer must be able to translate 3D Model Based Definition (MBD) and legacy drawing data into internal documents such as engineering models, production and quality plans, and tool designs. **Who are we?** Founded in 1849, Ducommun is the oldest company in California. Starting as a hardware supply store during the California Gold Rush and eventually assisted in the birth of the aerospace industry in Southern California by providing aircraft aluminum to early aerospace pioneers like Lindbergh, Douglas and Lockheed. Today Ducommun is a global provider of innovative manufacturing solutions for customers in the aerospace, defense and industrial markets. We specialize in electronic and structural systems, producing complex products and components for commercial aircraft platforms, mission\-critical military and space programs, and sophisticated industrial applications. Our Facility in Coxsackie, NY manufactures large, complex contoured structural components and assemblies for aerospace and other applications. Our integrated processes include stretch\-forming, thermal\-forming, chemical processing, precision fabrication, machining, finishing processes, and integration of components into subassemblies. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Acts as the lead interface between customers and internal operations, ensuring that all customer requirements are translated, defined, and incorporated into our business and manufacturing systems. * Understands and implements a Risk Management Assessment in support of Projects. * Prepares quotations from inquires and supports Value Analysis (VA) Engineering, including improvements to producibility as well as continuous improvement efforts. * Identifies and manages tooling requirements, including forming, functional gauging, and assembly fixtures. * Performs the following activities associated with new product development and initial launch: \- Plans manufacturing operations to produce quality components. \- Creates and maintains accurate Bill of Material (BOM) requirements. \- Updates planning as required for customer engineering and purchase order changes. \- Provides cost estimates to support Customer RFQ’s. \- Interfaces with customer and supplier engineering to coordinate engineering data and ensure proper flow down of customer requirements. \- Coordinates all tooling requirements, including production rate tooling and projected tool life cycle expectations. \- Assists in Prioritizing project activities for supporting departments and outside suppliers. \- Defines project schedules and establish major milestones. Tracks and updates using Microsoft Project as required. \- Provides status of each project to the customer using appropriate format and methodology. \- Works with the Engineering Manager in regards to establishing budget base lines. \- Assists in writing work instructions (SOP’s) to describe in detail the processing steps necessary to produce component or sub\-assemblies. \- Coordinates and assists with First Article Inspection requirements. \- Coordinates information flow with other Engineering team members to make corrections or improvements to planning, tooling, or processes. * Responsible for the proper handling and management of hazardous waste generated in their work area. * Must be willing and able to work overtime as necessary. * Acceptable attendance is an essential function of the position. * Performs other duties as assigned or required by the position. **Skills and Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering required, preferably in a mechanical, aerospace, industrial or systems field. * Working knowledge of aerospace manufacturing is desirable. Shop experience desired. * Strong communication skills are required. * Demonstrated fluency in a CAD software system, preferably CATIA. * Advanced knowledge in Microsoft Project, Excel, and Power Point. * Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Value Analysis (VA) Engineering, including design for manufacturability. * Strong communication skills are required. * Must be able to document and present project status to customers and management. Pay Range: $70,000\-82,000/year Equal Opportunity Employer Veterans/Disabled 171 Stacey Road Coxsackie, NY, 12051 United States

jobs.title: Staff AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It's a big mission, and that's where you come in! At Duolingo, you'll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300\+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data\-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You'll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world\-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that's both fun and meaningful. Join our life\-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an experienced AI Research Engineer to join our Speech team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record as an AI research engineer, with experience across various machine learning techniques, and a particular focus on speech modeling: ASR, TTS, speech\-to\-speech models, audio tokenization, and more. They will have experience at all levels of the ML stack, including feature engineering, developing training data, fine\-tuning, reinforcement learning, benchmarks and evaluations, deployment, and monitoring. On the Speech team, we're training custom models to understand the speech of non\-native learners, working closely to support product teams working on features like Video Call and the learning path. #### **You will...** * Join a full\-stack team of frontend, backend, and other AI Research engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. * Contribute to the development and training of speech models and large\-scale neural network models. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand their needs, to align the models' outputs with company objectives. * Participate in and help drive strategic product and business decision making as a member of the Speech leadership group. * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest developments in machine learning, particularly in speech models, and apply this knowledge to drive advancements in our projects. * Mentor team members, providing guidance and support in their professional development. * Ensure the delivery of high\-quality, scalable, and efficient machine learning solutions. #### **You have...** * Proven experience as an AI research engineer, for example, in speech recognition, TTS, LLMs, or related fields. * Strong background in training and fine\-tuning large models in an applied setting. * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a focus on machine learning or artificial intelligence, or equivalent experience. * Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage and inspire a team. * Deep understanding of machine learning concepts, frameworks, and best practices. **Benefits:** Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well\-being with our benefits here. **Job Alerts:** Sign up for job alerts here. **Accommodations:** We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. **Fraud Warning:** Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we'll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double\-check these details before sharing any information. By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Frontend / UI Engineer REMOTE
jobs.description: **Company Description** Our client is a technology\-driven organization working on advanced artificial intelligence initiatives that require high\-quality software engineering expertise. The company collaborates with experienced frontend engineers, UI developers, and technical contributors to design, implement, and evaluate complex coding tasks based on real\-world visual interfaces and application workflows. Through flexible, project\-based remote opportunities, our client engages skilled professionals worldwide to contribute their technical expertise to AI\-related development and evaluation projects. The organization values strong engineering practices, verifiable open\-source contributions, technical accuracy, and the ability to deliver objectively measurable results. **Job Description** **Position Overview** Our client is seeking experienced Frontend / UI Engineers to contribute to advanced AI\-related software engineering projects. This fully remote, project\-based opportunity focuses on transforming visual materials—including screenshots, UI mockups, diagrams, and screen recordings—into challenging, technically accurate coding tasks with clearly defined and objectively verifiable success criteria. Selected professionals will leverage their expertise in frontend development, user interface engineering, and debugging to create realistic technical challenges, develop working reference implementations, and evaluate the quality of tasks produced by other contributors. **Key Responsibilities** * Design complex, multi\-step frontend coding tasks based on screenshots, UI mockups, diagrams, and videos of real application workflows. * Translate visual requirements into precise technical specifications and expected application behavior. * Identify relevant source code, components, files, and artifacts required to complete each task. * Establish objective, reproducible success criteria to verify the correctness of completed coding assignments. * Develop functional reference implementations demonstrating the expected solution. * Read, modify, debug, and validate real\-world frontend application code. * Review coding tasks created by other contributors for technical accuracy, clarity, and verifiability. * Identify and flag ambiguous, incomplete, or technically ungradable tasks. * Apply frontend engineering best practices to ensure reliable and measurable outcomes. * Collaborate through structured, task\-based workflows supporting AI evaluation and development initiatives. **Engagement Details** * **Position:** Frontend / UI Engineer * **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor * **Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote * **Location:** Worldwide * **Available Opportunities:** 50 * **Compensation:** USD $80–$100 per hour equivalent * **Estimated Task Duration:** Approximately 8 hours * **Estimated Payment per Task:** USD $640–$800 * **Payment Structure:** Project\-based, paid per approved task This opportunity is ideal for experienced frontend engineers and technically proficient UI professionals with strong, publicly verifiable GitHub contributions who are interested in applying their software engineering expertise to advanced AI\-related projects. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Strong professional experience in frontend engineering, particularly with **React, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable modern frontend technologies**. * **A public GitHub profile with substantial, verifiable contributions is mandatory.** Candidates must demonstrate meaningful activity through commits, merged pull requests, maintained repositories, or open\-source contributions. * Proven experience developing, implementing, and delivering complex user interfaces and interactive web applications. * Strong ability to read, understand, modify, debug, and validate real\-world application code. * Solid understanding of frontend architecture, UI components, application behavior, and interactive workflows. * Ability to interpret screenshots, UI mockups, diagrams, and screen recordings and translate them into clear technical requirements. * Experience defining objective, reproducible testing criteria and validating software functionality. * Ability to develop working reference implementations that demonstrate expected application behavior. * Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and technical problem\-solving skills. * **Strong written English communication skills**, including the ability to document technical requirements, expected behavior, and verification procedures. * Ability to work independently in a fully remote, project\-based environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with **SVG, Canvas, graphics programming, or advanced UI rendering**. * Experience in product design or UI design combined with practical frontend development skills. * Contributions to open\-source projects involving graphical interfaces, visualization, or interactive applications. **Additional Information** **Compensation and Work Arrangement** * **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor * **Work Location:** 100% Remote – Worldwide * **Engagement:** Flexible, project\-based assignments * **Compensation:** USD $80–$100 per hour equivalent * **Estimated Payment:** USD $640–$800 per approved task * **Estimated Task Duration:** Approximately 8 hourS * **Payment Terms:** Compensation is based on approved and completed tasks, rather than guaranteed hourly employment.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering, ARS
jobs.description: Eaton is hiring a Vice President of Engineering to lead the engineering function for the Assemblies \& Residential Solutions (ARS) Group. This executive will provide technical leadership, strategic direction, and engineering execution across Power Distribution Controls and Assemblies (PDCA), Commercial Products and Assemblies (CPA), Residential and Wiring Devices (RWD), Energy Transition, and Fibrebond. The role has responsibility for innovation, new product development, sustaining engineering, value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE), and Engineer\-to\-Order (ETO) front\-end engineering across electrical power distribution assemblies, circuit protection, wiring devices, and energy transition solutions. The Vice President of Engineering will develop and execute an integrated technology and product engineering strategy across ARS, aligning innovation, product roadmaps, engineering investments, program management, and codes and standards with business priorities. This leader will support growth across data centers, residential, commercial, and industrial markets through scalable product platforms, AC and DC power distribution, intelligent and connected products, and energy transition technologies. This role will also establish a consistent engineering execution model across the product lifecycle, partnering with division leadership, operations, supply chain, marketing, and enterprise engineering teams to standardize product architectures, designs, processes, and tools. A key priority will be improving engineering quality, productivity, and cycle time while enabling multisite manufacturing, capacity expansion, and repeatable programmatic production. **Essential Functions** * Technology Strategy: Establish and execute the ARS technology and engineering strategy, aligning innovation priorities, product roadmaps, and engineering investments with Group and Division business objectives. * Product Development \& Innovation: Lead engineering teams to accelerate time\-to\-market for ARS products and assemblies while meeting customer requirements, quality standards, technical requirements, and program commitments. * Engineering Talent \& Organization: Build and execute the talent strategy for the ARS engineering organization, ensuring the technical capabilities, leadership pipeline, organizational structure, and succession plans required to support current programs and future growth. * Technology Roadmaps \& R\&D Investment: Oversee integrated technology roadmaps and product platform architectures across ARS. Lead the annual product roadmapping and waterlining process and manage an R\&D budget exceeding $100 million. * Engineering Execution \& Program Management: Establish a disciplined engineering execution model incorporating program and portfolio management, technical reviews, performance metrics, resource planning, global engineering capabilities, and cross\-functional governance. * ProLaunch: Drive rigorous and consistent application of ProLaunch, Eaton’s stage\-gate process, across ARS product lines and Divisions through a standardized operating rhythm. * ETO \& Front\-End Engineering: Continuously improve front\-end engineering processes, systems, and tools across ARS, including ETO design automation, standardized engineering deliverables, and engineering quality practices. Improve ETO productivity while ensuring high\-quality designs are delivered on time for customer approvals and manufacturing releases. * Programmatic Manufacturing \& Capacity Expansion: Enable growth and capacity expansion in historically Engineer\-to\-Order product lines by developing scalable, repeatable programmatic build methodologies. Align product architectures and engineering deliverables with multisite manufacturing, production replication, and new\-site launch readiness. * Engineering Collaboration \& Innovation Ecosystem: Build a collaborative innovation environment and leverage resources including Eaton Research Labs (ERL), Eaton Centers of Excellence, Global Product Lines (GPLs), universities, strategic technology partners, and other external resources. * Codes \& Standards: Provide leadership and engagement with relevant standards organizations, including UL, NEMA, IEEE, and IEC, to anticipate regulatory and industry requirements and ensure business objectives are effectively represented. * Intellectual Property: Strengthen Eaton’s intellectual property portfolio while protecting the company’s intellectual capital and improving the quality of patents, trademarks, trade secrets, and other proprietary technologies. * Safety: Foster an engineering culture in which employee and product safety are fundamental expectations and ensure employees work safely. The expected annual salary range for this role is $227000 \- $333000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifi s. * Demonstrated experience in electrical components and/or systems design, new product development, and engineering program management. * Experience developing and executing technology strategies, product roadmaps, and product platform architectures. * Demonstrated experience managing significant R\&D budgets and investment portfolios. * Experience leading engineering across the full product lifecycle, including new product development, sustaining engineering, VA/VE, and Engineer\-to\-Order environments. * Experience applying structured stage\-gate and program management methodologies to complex product development portfolios. * Experience improving engineering productivity through standardization, automation, design reuse, common platforms, and engineering process transformation. * Experience supporting multisite manufacturing, capacity expansion, and new manufacturing site or production\-line launches. * Strong knowledge of power distribution products and technologies, including low\- and medium\-voltage assemblies, switchboards, panelboards, busway, motor control, circuit protection, miniature circuit breakers (MCBs), residential load centers, wiring devices, connected products, and energy transition applications. * Working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and industry standards, including UL, NEMA, IEEE, and IEC. * Demonstrated success building engineering organizational capability through recruiting, coaching, leadership development, succession planning, and organizational design. * Experience developing and protecting intellectual property, including familiarity with patents, trademarks, trade secrets, and product\-liability considerations. * Experience working across engineering, operations, supply chain, marketing, product management, and business leadership within a complex matrixed organization. All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. Employment decisions are based upon job\-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law. jobs.title: LillyDirect Pharmacy Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. We are seeking a highly motivated Data Engineer for our LillyDirect Pharmacy Covered Entity (LDPCE) Master Data team. This role involves designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support our critical scientific and business initiatives, ultimately contributing to the delivery of life\-changing medicines. As a Data Engineer for Master Data, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the data solutions that ensure the availability, quality, and integrity of data for analysis and/or business transactions for our LillyDirect Pharmacy Covered Entity business. You will design and implement efficient data storage, processing, and retrieval solutions, build data pipelines, and optimize data models, working closely with the Technical Lead, DevOps engineer, architects, and business analysts. You will need strong skills in data integration, acquisition, cleansing, harmonization, and transformation, and you will play a key role in turning raw data into reliable, governed datasets that downstream teams can trust. **What you’ll be doing:** * Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines for batch and near\-real\-time processing in Python and PySpark on Databricks and AWS. * Develop and optimize data models, ETL/ELT workflows, and data integration across multiple systems and platforms, using Delta Lake and lakehouse (medallion) patterns. * Support data integrations with Reltio and Transcend, including data loads, extracts, and reconciliation. * Build data quality, lineage, and reconciliation checks so that profile and consent data is accurate, complete, and auditable. * Implement data governance, security, and quality standards across data assets, including access controls, masking, and retention for sensitive data (PII/PHI) and consent data. * Collaborate with the Technical Lead, product owners, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions. * Own pipelines and work streams from design through production, and contribute to architectural and design decisions. * Promote best practices in coding, code review, automated testing, and deployment, and release code through CI/CD pipelines. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance, reliability, and cost of data pipelines, and support production incidents and root cause analysis. * Automate manual processes and identify opportunities to optimize data workflows and reduce costs. **How You Will Succeed:** * Deliver scalable solutions by designing robust data pipelines and architectures that meet performance and reliability standards. * Build in privacy and consent by treating consent and data protection as a design principle in pipelines from the start, and by raising risks early. * Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to turn business needs into technical outcomes. * Share expertise, mentoring junior engineers and adopting best practices in data engineering and cloud technologies. * Continuously improve systems through automation, performance tuning, and proactive issue resolution. * Communicate with clarity to ensure alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Basic Qualifications and Experience Requirement:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or equivalent work experience. * Overall 5\+ years of experience in data engineering using core technologies such as SQL, Python, PySpark, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) services including Lambda, Glue, EMR S3, Redshift, Athena, and IAM roles/policies. * 2\+ years of experience working in Agile environments, with hands\-on experience using GitHub and CI/CD pipelines for code deployment. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks, including workspace configuration, notebook development, Delta Lake, and performance optimization. * 1\+ years of experience with orchestration tools like Airflow or Databricks Workflows for workflow automation. · **Additional Skills/Preferences:** * Experience building high\-performance, scalable data pipelines following Data Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, and Data Mart standards and deep understanding of ETL/ELT workflows. * Strong expertise in data modelling, managing large datasets, and implementing secure, compliant data governance practices. * Working knowledge of data governance, security, and data quality practices, including handling sensitive data (PII/PHI) in a regulated environment. * Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to translate key business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders; a problem\-solving mindset and attention to detail. * Pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience, including privacy requirements such as HIPAA. * Hands\-on experience with Reltio (or a comparable MDM platform), including match and merge, survivorship, and integration patterns. * Familiarity with consent and preference management (for example opt\-in/opt\-out, purpose, and channel); experience with Transcend or a similar consent platform. * Familiarity with streaming frameworks such as Kafka, Kinesis, or MSK. * Experience with Unity Catalog, infrastructure\-as\-code (for example Terraform), and data quality frameworks (for example Great Expectations or dbt tests). * Partner with and influence vendor resources on solution development to ensure understanding of data and technical direction for solutions as well as delivery. * AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate * Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Associate or Professional) Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Ellipsis Health is creating cutting\-edge AI/ML products that solve healthcare staffing challenges and administrative burdens using conversational AI and our patented voice biomarker technology—helping deliver better healthcare for everyone. We are headquartered in Silicon Valley and are funded and supported by some of the most preeminent venture capital teams. In this role, you will be a core contributor and technical leader within our AI Research \& Engineering team. Operating at the sweet spot between cutting\-edge scientific research and production\-grade systems, you will drive the conceptualization, architecture, and deployment of frontier agentic systems. You will collaborate directly with core infrastructure and platform teams to translate algorithmic breakthroughs in LLMs and agentic AI into robust, secure, and low\-latency clinical applications. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Technical Leadership \& Vision:** Act as the technical authority for the Agentic AI roadmap, steering engineering pods from initial research prototyping through to production scale. * **Advanced Agentic Architecture:** Design, build, and optimize scalable systems and orchestration pipelines capable of deep multi\-step reasoning, dynamic memory allocation, long\-context evaluation, and high\-fidelity tool utilization. * **Research\-to\-Production Translation:** Bridge the gap between frontier machine learning research and enterprise software design. Implement and adapt state\-of\-the\-art techniques in post\-training fine\-tuning, preference alignment, and automated prompt optimization. * **Rigorous Evaluation \& Benchmarking:** Architect and maintain multi\-dimensional quantitative evaluation frameworks and continuous testing infrastructure. Implement state\-of\-the\-art LLM\-as\-a\-judge rubrics, and statistical tracking to evaluate agent capabilities and guarantee zero\-regression product updates. * **Data Mix Optimization:** Develop and scale automated data curation pipelines to extract, filter, and structure user feedback signals, execution logs, and expert labels into ultra\-high\-quality training datasets for model fine\-tuning. * **Cross\-Functional \& Clinical Collaboration:** Work closely within a highly matrixed, collaborative organization alongside clinical experts, product managers, and software engineers to ensure AI platforms operate safely and ground outputs in validated healthcare protocols. * **Mentorship \& Engineering Excellence:** Foster a culture of technical rigor by setting high coding standards, leading design reviews, standardizing tooling, and mentoring other ML and software engineers across the team. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of practical software development experience with a heavy emphasis on product design, core system architecture, and shipping scalable software platforms (or 2\+ years of post\-PhD industry experience in a dedicated AI research/engineering role). * Advanced programming proficiency in Python and deep hands\-on expertise with distributed machine learning or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow). * Proven track record of architecting, implementing, and deploying complex LLM\-powered applications, multi\-agent orchestrations, or autonomous systems in a production environment. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative technical field. * 8\+ years of industry experience specializing in advanced data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and heavy\-duty scalable ML infrastructure. * 3\+ years of technical leadership experience, including leading complex technical project workstreams, defining organizational engineering directions, or directly mentoring technical talent. * Experience working within complex, highly collaborative matrixed organizations on high\-acuity, deeply regulated technical integrations (e.g., healthcare, fintech, or aerospace). * Research Excellence: A solid track record of contributions or publications at top\-tier machine learning venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, KDD) with a specific focus on agentic frameworks, reinforcement learning, or data benchmark. **Salary and Benefits:** ------------------------ We offer competitive salary and benefits, including 401(k) matching, health, vision, and dental insurance, and very flexible paid time off. The typical salary range for this role is $160,000 to $210,000 USD, depending on skills, qualifications, and relevant experience. **Background Checks:** ---------------------- As a health technology company, we reserve the right to run background checks on candidates to whom we extend offers, in compliance with applicable laws. We evaluate candidates holistically and comply with all “ban the box” regulations. **Assistance:** --------------- If you have a disability or require accommodations during the application or recruitment process, please contact careers@ellipsishealth.com. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

With mentorship and regular code review, the associate delivers well\-defined features and fixes, builds technical proficiency, and develops increasing independence while supporting mission\-critical healthcare operations. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Platform Engineering** * **Full Stack:** Contribute to application features and fixes using the team's technology stack, including TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, GraphQL, C\# and Python. Follow documented release and rollback procedures, use approved AI tools to assist troubleshooting, and escalate issues to support reliable, compliant deployments. **Collaboration and Innovation** * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work with product, data, and engineering teams to clarify requirements and deliver assigned features. Relevant academic, personal, or open\-source projects may demonstrate foundational development skills. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and practical experience demonstrating foundational software engineering capabilities. * Strong collaboration, problem\-solving, and learning skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, incorporate feedback, and manage assigned tasks in a fast\-paced, evolving environment. * Exposure to headless web applications and REST APIs, with basic familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture through coursework, projects, internships, or professional experience. * **Nice to have:** Exposure to React Native for cross\-platform mobile application development. * Familiarity with healthcare standards and regulations such as Health Level Seven International (HL7\) and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) is a plus. **KEY COMPETENCIES:** * Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer\-centric solutions. * Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation. * jobs.title: AI Engineer (CCC Auto / Agentic)
jobs.description: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we're making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We're pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** As an AI Engineer you will build and ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end. Salary range is: $170,000 \- 195,000 This position is bonus eligible. **Key Responsibilities:** * Ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against. * Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets. * Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request. * Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs. * Build and operate durable, event\-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re\-invoke a completed LLM step. * Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts. * Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores. * Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least\-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider. * Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy\-in from the team before you build. * Take part in a shared on\-call rotation for the services you build. **Requirements:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM\-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production. * Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one. * Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped. * A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work. * Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding\-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM. * Services built on message\- or event\-driven architectures, including long\-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event\-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one. * Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition\-key, consistency, and tenant\-isolation calls you made. * Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. * Technical design documents you have written to get feedback and buy\-in from a team before building, and that the team then built to. * Clear writing and discussion for technical and non\-technical audiences, and code review you can give as well as take. **Even Better if You Have:** * React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full\-stack feature end to end. Chat, streaming, and citation\-heavy AI experiences especially. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code such as Terraform or Bicep. * Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command\-line tools, and microservices. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry\-based tracing. * Experience designing A/B tests for AI features, or what\-if simulations that replay historical claims through a proposed change before it ships. * Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains. **What Success Looks Like:** * In your first six months you ship an LLM\-powered feature, its evals run in CI, and you can name the metric it moved. * When a model migration or prompt change causes a regression, the evals you wrote catch it before a customer does. * You take ownership from concept to production with light direction, asking the right questions early. * You care that things hold up: the services you build survive retries, partial failures, and model migrations without incidents a customer can see. * When something goes wrong in production, the trace tells you which step and which model call, and you can show an auditor the same thing. * Privacy and security reviews of your features find nothing that was not already designed in. * You enjoy the craft, and it shows: engineers pick up your patterns without being told to. * You enjoy the back\-and\-forth that gets a feature scoped, and you can argue a position without needing to win it. * You embrace our ambitious, collaborative, and empathetic values, and you like problems where the answer has to be measured rather than argued. **Interview Policy \& Privacy Notice:** A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE. **About CCC's Commitment to Employees:** CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer\-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion \& Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real\-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC's success. CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including: * 401K Match * Paid time off * Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus * Comprehensive health insurance * Adoption Assistance * Tuition Reimbursement * Wellness Programs * Stock Purchase Plan options * Employee Resource Groups For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site. Here, you belong. You are seen, valued, and respected. We celebrate you for who you are and all you bring. Every voice is heard and is important to our success. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer

designing and conducting research; applying knowledge of product design, fabrication, assembly, tooling and materials. * Use lean tools and principles to reduce various forms of waste in manufacturing processes to reduce product cost and lead time, while maintaining or improving quality. * Develop prints, create BOMs and routings within the ERP system as needed. * Review prints for proper instrument function, manufacturability and inspection. * Participate to vendors’ evaluation and engineering management of them. * Assist ME’s, QE’s with a range of machine and process validation activities as needed (IQ,OQ,PQ). * Participate in design review with RD team and customers, validation process and continuous improvement activities. * Participate at vendors’ audits with quality, to insure all BMI requirements are fully understood and applied. * Manage the manufacturing processes for new orders from concept to production. Guarantor of processes within the company. * Create a part number data base to reflect whether product is manufactured in\-house or outside. * Analyze manufacturing performance through time studies and other engineering methods and independently identify, develop, and implement continuous\-improvement opportunities. * Partner with the programming department to develop/design custom tooling that would be required for machining, or purchase tooling as required. * Review subcontractor processes for efficiency and challenge the process when needed; participate in audits as needed. * Provide engineering analysis and technical input to support quoting, including evaluation of manufacturing methods, process requirements, tooling, equipment, and technical feasibility. * Process owner to improve Epicor utilization for the manufacturing engineers. * Assist with material review board when there is non\-conformance product. * Identify and justify new equipment reflective of process improvements. * Complaint handling support. * Lead and support the CAPA and Complaint processes to ensure timely closure, for engineering, subcontracting or manufacturing subjects. * Facilitate team meetings to actively manage the planning process for new projects. * Serve as the engineering technical authority for manufacturing issues, independently analyzing complex production problems and developing appropriate engineering solutions. * Assist with leading and developing the engineering team. * All other duties as assigned. **Knowledge, Skills \& Competencies:** * Minimum of 7 years of related experience in Manufacturing Engineering in a machining production and design facility. * Proficient with project planning; ability to effectively manage multiple projects; proven experience in leading process improvement projects required. * Experience in medical device manufacturing environment preferred. * Strong experience with planning, developing and conducting tests to validate machine and secondary processes. * Thorough understanding of raw materials, manufacturing processes, and quality control practices. * Extensive knowledge of CNC machining, tooling, processes and machining capabilities. * Advanced knowledge and understanding of blueprints and GD\&T. * Knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) is a plus. * Proficient in machine shop math. * Experience in ISO 13485 /FDA 21 CFR820 preferred. * Prior experience with CAPAs and complaints. * Ability to understand the technical attributes of a wide range of precision, mechanical products. * Strong root cause analysis skills and ability to identify complex problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions. * Ability to communicate effectively in multi\-discipline, cross cultural environment and levels of organization. * Ability to work in a team environment, as well as, autonomously. * Capable of handling stressful situations and manage conflict. * Ability to read and comprehend complex instructions. * Maintain sense of urgency and ability to prioritize work. * Proficient in SolidWorks. * Computer literate in various software applications (i.e. Microsoft Office). * Experience leading a team of engineers. * Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and or 6 Sigma. * Strong customer service and communication skills with both internal and external customers. **Work Environment:** * The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. * Work environment consists of time spent in both an office (50%) and manufacturing environment (50%). * Includes potential exposure to sounds and noise levels that can be distracting or uncomfortable. * Includes potential exposure to moving mechanical parts. * Includes potential exposure to coolants and oils. * Work environment is temperature controlled. The work environment described here is representative of that which an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Physical Job Requirements:** * While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to sit, stand or walk; use hands, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. * The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. * The employee must be able to sit or stand for up to 12 hours per day. * Ability to function in highly stressful situations. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (L4)
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI\-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550\+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80\+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management. **Location**: Remote or Hybrid (McLean, VA \| New York, NY \| Richmond, VA) **Who We Are:** Exiger transforms supply chains into a strategic advantage, advancing our mission to make the world a safer and more transparent place to succeed. Our AI platform, 1Exiger, delivers instant visibility into complex supplier ecosystems, leveraging proprietary data and advanced AI to surface risk, automate compliance, and unlock efficiencies and cost savings to strengthen long\-term resilience. Trusted by 550\+ global customers, including Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, Exiger is a recognized, award\-winning leader in supply chain AI and a FedRAMP® authorized provider to the federal government. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking talented and motivated Senior Software Engineers (L4\) to help build and scale the backend services powering our 1ExigerAI platform. As part of a collaborative engineering team, you'll design, develop, and maintain the services behind critical platform capabilities, including real\-time alerting, workflow automation, and supply chain investigation tools. Your work will help customers uncover risks, streamline complex processes, and make smarter decisions using AI\-powered technology. You'll work closely with a technical lead, product manager, product designer, and fellow engineers to deliver reliable, scalable, and high\-performing software. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with opportunities to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence technical decisions, and help shape how we build software. We're also embracing AI throughout our engineering organization. Our engineers actively use tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, improve code quality, and rethink traditional software development workflows. You'll have the opportunity to leverage these tools daily while helping evolve our AI\-enabled software development lifecycle. Whether you're an experienced engineer ready to take ownership of larger projects or a senior individual contributor looking to influence architecture and mentor others, we're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex problems and building impactful products. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, test, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs supporting the 1ExigerAI platform. * Develop and enhance product capabilities such as real\-time alerting, workflow builders, and supply chain investigation tools. * Take ownership of features and projects from technical design through development, deployment, and production support. * Collaborate with cross\-functional partners, including engineering, product management, and design, to turn business requirements into reliable technical solutions. * Build and maintain cloud\-native applications, leveraging microservices, containerization, and modern infrastructure practices. * Contribute to system design discussions, architectural improvements, and technical decisions that improve scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Troubleshoot production issues, improve observability, and proactively identify opportunities to strengthen system reliability. * Leverage AI\-powered development tools such as Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot throughout the software development lifecycle. * Help improve our AI\-enabled engineering workflows, including development, testing, code reviews, deployment, and automation. * Participate in a fast\-paced, collaborative engineering environment using Kanban, continuous delivery, and daily deployments. * Contribute to code reviews, share technical knowledge, and help maintain high standards for engineering quality. **What You Bring to the Team** ------------------------------ * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience, with a focus on backend development and building production\-grade applications. * Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, or strong experience with comparable backend technologies and a willingness to work in our core stack. * Experience designing, developing, and maintaining RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. * Solid understanding of databases, data modeling and SQL * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS and containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices. * Understanding of system design principles, application performance, scalability, and reliability. * Experience troubleshooting production issues and supporting applications in live environments. * Familiarity with messaging and asynchronous processing technologies such as Kafka, ActiveMQ, or Redis. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, or a strong interest in incorporating AI into everyday engineering workflows. * Strong problem\-solving skills, technical curiosity, and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code. * Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross\-functional stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment. * A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a willingness to continuously learn and improve. **What We're Looking for at this Level** ---------------------------------------- Senior Software Engineer (L4\) * Demonstrated ability to serve as a technical go\-to person for a team or product area, guiding the design and implementation of complex systems. * Experience designing reusable components, services, and architectural patterns that improve engineering efficiency and scalability. * Ability to navigate complex technical tradeoffs and influence architecture and engineering best practices. * Comfortable mentoring other engineers informally through technical guidance, code reviews, and collaborative problem\-solving. * Strong ownership of system quality, reliability, and long\-term maintainability. **Our Tech Stack** ------------------ * Backend: Java / Spring Boot * Data: Postgres * Frontend: TypeScript / Angular * Messaging \& Caching: ActiveMQ, Kafka, Redis * Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Argo CD * Observability: ELK, Grafana * AI Development Tools: Claude, Cursor * Development Practices: Kanban, CI/CD, daily deployments \#LI\-Remote Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50\+ awards. Learn more at **Exiger.com** and follow Exiger on **LinkedIn**. At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission\-inspired, imagination\-driven, trust\-anchored, and compassion\-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. *Exiger's hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.*
