jobs.title: Senior Director, Embedded Systems
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. **Senior Director, Embedded Systems** ===================================== Research \& Development \| San Diego, CA (global team including Singapore) **Position Summary** Illumina is seeking a Senior Director, Embedded Systems to lead the multidisciplinary engineering organization building the embedded architecture of our DNA sequencing instruments: the electronics, firmware, FPGA, custom silicon, and system engineering that acquire signals from novel sensors, drive precision motion, fluidics, thermal, and optics subsystems, and move high volumes of data from sensor through analysis. The Embedded Systems organization is a global team of electrical, FPGA, firmware, firmware test, hardware test, systems, and compute engineers across San Diego and Singapore that delivers the embedded platforms for every new Illumina sequencer and supports the installed base. In addition, this leader owns the architecture of the on\-instrument compute platform and leads a cross\-functional effort to define a compute roadmap that delivers the performance next\-generation sequencing demands at a sustainable cost. The role sits at an exciting intersection of genomics, advanced sensing, embedded systems, and high\-performance computing. As sequencing throughput continues to increase, we are pushing the boundaries of compute performance, memory and storage bandwidth, networking, and real\-time processing, as compute has become a major driver of instrument cost. The development of novel sensors and custom ASICs also creates opportunities to optimize the entire architecture from signal acquisition through genomic data processing. The Senior Director will define the technology strategy, build a world\-class engineering organization, and deliver embedded platforms that are reliable, secure, compliant, and manufacturable at scale. **Responsibilities** **Technical Leadership** ------------------------ Oversees the functional managers for electrical engineering, FPGA, firmware, systems engineering and test. Sets technical direction and standards, holding a high bar for architecture and design reviews, and manages process over technical decisions and escalations. * **Architecture and roadmap:** Define the embedded systems architecture and multi\-generation technology roadmap, including electrical architecture, power distribution, interconnects, embedded control, sensor interfaces, FPGA\-based data paths, and system management. This strategy includes platform reuse across programs, build\-vs\-buy and partner decisions, technology investment priorities, the cost and performance roadmap, and setting structure that enables strong execution and delivery. * **Electrical, FPGA, and firmware engineering:** Set technical direction and design standards for board\-level analog, digital, mixed\-signal, power, and high\-speed design, component selection, SI/PI, design for manufacturing, and supplier technical engagement through design release; for FPGA\-based data acquisition and processing from sensor to host, including FPGA design, drivers, data\-path bring\-up, benchmarks, and test frameworks that ensure data\-path robustness; and for the instrument firmware architecture and common codebase (RTOS\-based, spanning data path, precision motion, fluidics, optics, thermal, and power) and the agile development and release process that delivers it. * **Custom silicon and novel sensors:** Define what is possible for next generation custom devices. Partner with sensor and fabrication teams on interface architecture, test features, silicon bring\-up, and hardware/firmware integration of custom mixed\-signal ASICs. * **Compute platform and strategy:** Own the on\-instrument compute architecture (topology, modularity, CPUs, accelerators, memory, storage, and high\-speed I/O), sized from first\-principles models of the full data path, and partner with software and algorithm teams on hardware/software co\-design, including hardware acceleration of data\-intensive workloads. Lead a cross\-functional team spanning R\&D, software, supply chain, mechanical engineering, and operations to define a compute roadmap that balances performance, cost, and supply resilience, weighing architecture alternatives, off\-the\-shelf versus custom designs, sourcing strategy, and component lifecycle in a fas peed digital hardware, including analog, mixed\-signal, and power design * + Embedded firmware, RTOS, and real\-time control * + FPGA architecture and high\-bandwidth data acquisition * + Custom ASIC and/or advanced sensors * + Embedded and high\-performance computing architectures, including CPUs, accelerators, memory, storage, PCIe, and high\-speed networking * + Linux\-based embedded systems * + Systems engineering, integration, and verification * + Product safety, EMC, and global certification * + Cybersecurity, secure boot, and hardware root of trust * Demonstrated ability to make system\-level architectural trade\-offs spanning hardware, firmware, software, performance, power, thermal design, reliability, cost, supply continuity, and schedule. * Experience leading complex products from architecture through integration, verification, manufacturing, commercial release, and sustaining. * Experience developing technology roadmaps and working with semiconductor and computing technology partners. * Proven ability to build high\-performing technical organizations and develop engineering leaders. Strong executive communication and cross\-functional leadership skills. * The estimated base salary range for the Senior Director, Embedded Systems role based in the United States of America is: $224,900 \- $337,300\. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off. We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero\-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Intellibus Consulting is a boutique engineering and AI transformation firm that builds mission\-critical platforms for global financial institutions. We operate at the intersection of engineering excellence, business outcomes, and executive\-level delivery. At Intellibus, our leaders are hands\-on builders who understand technology deeply, engage confidently with senior executives, and take ownership of client success. We believe successful technology transformation requires leaders who can connect business strategy, architecture, engineering, and execution **Job Description** We are looking for exceptional **Forward Deployed Engineers** with deep hands\-on software engineering expertise, particularly in Java, backend engineering, full\-stack development, microservices, and distributed systems. This is a highly technical, client\-facing engineering role that requires someone who can move seamlessly between architecture, software development, solution delivery, and executive\-level client engagement. You will work directly with client engineering teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders to understand complex challenges, design technical solutions, and lead the development and implementation of enterprise\-grade platforms. Beyond engineering delivery, you will play an important role in expanding strategic client relationships by identifying technology opportunities, recommending solutions, demonstrating technical capabilities, and helping grow existing accounts. We are specifically looking for engineers who have worked in technology consulting or professional services environments and are comfortable taking ownership of both technical delivery and client relationships. **Key ResponsibilitiesHands\-on Software Engineering \& Architecture** * Design, develop, and deliver scalable enterprise applications using Java and modern software engineering technologies. * Demonstrate deep hands\-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, REST APIs, and backend application development. * Build complex microservices\-based architectures, distributed systems, and event\-driven applications. * Develop full\-stack solutions with strong backend capabilities and practical frontend development experience. * Work across the entire software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through coding, testing, deployment, and production support. * Lead technical implementation while remaining actively involved in writing and reviewing code. * Develop reusable components, APIs, integrations, and enterprise application frameworks. * Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges, concurrency issues, and complex production defects. **Backend, Frontend \& Full\-Stack Development** * Build backend services using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and related technologies. * Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations. * Develop frontend applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Integrate frontend applications with backend services and enterprise platforms. * Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, or similar technologies. * Implement authentication, authorization, security, and API integration patterns. * Ensure application performance, maintainability, reliability, and scalability. **Microservices \& Cloud\-Native Engineering** * Design and implement microservices architectures and distributed application platforms. * Work with messaging and event\-streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka. * Build asynchronous processing, event\-driven integrations, and resilient distributed services. * Apply design patterns for service discovery, fault tolerance, circuit breakers, and distributed transactions. * Deploy and operate applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Work with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation. * Apply observability practices using logging, monitoring, tracing, and performance management tools. * Understand cloud\-native architecture, scalability, availability, and system reliability. **AI \& Agentic Engineering** * Explore and implement AI\-powered enterprise applications and intelligent workflows. * Integrate LLMs and AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications and platforms. * Develop AI agents, tool\-calling workflows, and agent orchestration capabilities. * Work with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and enterprise data integrations. * Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to solve client business and technology challenges. * Build practical prototypes and take successful AI solutions through production implementation. **Client Consulting \& Strategic Account Growth** * Work directly with client CTOs, CIOs, engineering leaders, architects, and business stakeholders. * Understand client technology environments, business priorities, and strategic challenges. * Translate business problems into technical solutions ading, concurrency, collections, JVM fundamentals, and performance optimization. * Experience with REST APIs, Hibernate, JPA, and enterprise application development. * Strong knowledge of backend architecture and enterprise integration patterns. **Full\-Stack Development** * Experience building frontend applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Ability to independently work across backend and frontend components. * Strong understanding of API integration and application architecture. **Microservices \& Distributed Systems** * Deep experience designing and implementing microservices architectures. * Strong knowledge of Kafka, event\-driven systems, messaging, and distributed computing. * Understanding of scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and high\-availability architecture. **Cloud \& DevOps** * Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud\-native deployments. * Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure\-as\-code tools is preferred. **AI \& Modern Engineering** * Exposure to LLM integrations, generative AI, AI agents, and agentic workflows. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise software is highly desirable. **Required Consulting \& Client Engagement Experience** * Previous experience working for a technology consulting firm, systems integrator, or professional services organization is mandatory. * Demonstrated experience delivering technology solutions for external enterprise clients. * Ability to manage multiple technical stakeholders and work across different client environments. * Strong executive communication and presentation skills. * Ability to identify additional technology opportunities and contribute to account expansion. * Comfortable operating in fast\-paced consulting environments where priorities and client requirements can evolve. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Significant professional software engineering experience, ideally 8\+ years. * Extensive hands\-on Java and backend engineering experience. * Proven experience building enterprise\-grade microservices and distributed systems. * Full\-stack development experience with modern frontend frameworks. * Previous consulting or professional services experience is mandatory. * Experience working in financial services, banking, fintech, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred. **What Success Looks Like** * You can independently design, code, and deliver complex enterprise applications. * You bring deep technical expertise in Java, backend engineering, full\-stack development, and microservices. * You can engage with client engineering teams and senior executives with equal confidence. * You identify opportunities to solve broader client challenges beyond the immediate assignment. * You help strengthen client relationships and contribute to expanding strategic accounts. * You take ownership of solutions from initial discovery through architecture, implementation, and production deployment. **Who Should Apply?** We are looking for engineers who are not limited to writing code against predefined requirements. You should be someone who can understand a client's business, challenge existing technical approaches, design better architectures, build production\-ready solutions, and work with stakeholders to identify the next opportunity. **We want engineers who can build the technology, lead the technical conversation, and help grow the business.** **Our Hiring Process** * 15\-minute introductory call with Intellibus leadership * Proctored GQ assessment \+ Slideware (presentation) evaluation * Technical \& Delivery Leadership Interview (30–45 min) * Executive Interview * Offer If you are interested in reaching out to us, please apply, and our team will contact you within the hour. Pay: $80\.00 \- $95\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Event-Driven Architecture
jobs.description: Intellibus designs and engineers platforms trusted by some of the most established FinTech and financial trading firms in the world. Our engineering teams build systems that power high\-volume trading, real\-time financial data, and mission\-critical infrastructure. We expect our engineers to operate at a level where technical depth, sound judgment, and clear communication all carry weight — the problems are complex, the systems are production\-critical, and the people you work with will hold you to a high standard. **The Staff Engineer Role** We are hiring a Staff Engineer to design, build, and own full\-stack systems powering financial platforms — from frontend architecture to backend services to distributed event\-driven infrastructure. This is not a role where you pick up tickets and ship features. You will be expected to think end\-to\-end: to understand the business problem, design the system, make the trade\-offs, and deliver production\-grade software that performs reliably under heavy load.You will work directly with senior stakeholders across technical and non\-technical functions, often navigating competing priorities, ambiguity, and high\-pressure timelines. The ability to communicate clearly, manage complexity across people and systems, and maintain a high quality bar when things get difficult is essential. If you have built and shipped systems that mattered — at a startup, at a large company, or somewhere in between — and you are looking for a role where you will be challenged technically while also growing your ability to operate in complex, high\-stakes environments, we want to hear from you. **What You Will Do**Frontend Architecture * Build scalable frontend platforms using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Design modern UI architectures: server\-side rendering, component\-driven design, performance optimization, and state management patterns. * Develop reusable component systems and scalable frontend frameworks. Backend Engineering * Build backend services using Node.js and NestJS. * Design and implement REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous workflows, and high\-performance data processing systems. * Work with SQL and NoSQL databases using TypeORM, and optimize for throughput and reliability. Event\-Driven \& Distributed Systems * Design distributed systems built on event\-driven architecture using Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and messaging/queue systems. * Build services that process high\-volume financial events and real\-time trading data. Cloud \& Infrastructure * Deploy and operate systems on Microsoft Azure, including Azure App Services, Azure Data Fabric, messaging platforms, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux environments. * Design infrastructure that supports resilient, scalable distributed systems. **What Sets You Apart** We are looking for engineers who demonstrate several of the following: * You have designed and operated event\-driven distributed systems that process high\-volume real\-time data. * You have a deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and time complexity — and you apply that understanding to build systems, not just pass interviews. * You have built full\-stack platforms using React/Next.js and Node.js/NestJS that run reliably in production. * You have hands\-on experience with message queues, streaming platforms, and asynchronous workflows — Kafka, Azure Service Bus, BullMQ, or similar. * You reason clearly about system trade\-offs: latency vs. throughput, consistency vs. availability, speed vs. reliability. * You have operated systems in cloud environments like Microsoft Azure, including debugging production incidents and improving performance under pressure. * You design systems end\-to\-end and take ownership of architecture and production outcomes — not just the code you wrote. * You have mentored other engineers and contributed to architecture reviews, engineering standards, and technical decision\-making. * You communicate well under pressure. You can hold your ground in a room full of stakeholders, explain a technical decision to a non\-technical audience, and navigate situations where the right path forward is not obvious. **Technology Ecosystem** **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, HTML5, CSS3 **Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Microservices, BullMQ, TypeORM **Event\-Driven:** Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid **Infrastructure:** Microsoft Azure, Azure Data Fabric, Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Linux **Data:** SQL, NoSQL, Azure Data Fabric **Our Process** * 15\-minute video call with someone from our team * 4 Proctored GQ Tests (under 2 hours) * 30–45 minute final video interview * Job offer If this sounds like the kind of work you want to be doing, apply now. Our team will be in touch within the hour. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, CK Money
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ It is a pivotal moment in the modernization of consumer finance, and CK Money sits at the forefront of it. CK Money is the neobank within Intuit Credit Karma, delivering Checking and Savings accounts to 3\+ millions members. We're building the future of money movement — transforming how households and individuals interact with their finances through instant, low\-cost, unified payment rails — and connecting that experience into the broader Intuit ecosystem alongside QuickBooks and TurboTax. As a Staff Software Engineer on CK Money, you'll own the systems that hold our members' money: account origination and onboarding, deposits and transfers, card and payment flows, and the real\-time messaging backbone that keeps balances, notifications, and downstream systems consistent. These are systems where correctness, latency, and availability are not negotiable, and where the blast radius of a design decision is measured in millions of members and real dollars. You'll join a team building cloud\-native, AI\-native software on a modern stack: Scala and TypeScript on the back end, GraphQL at the API layer, Kafka for event streaming, all running on Google Cloud. We ship continuously, instrument everything, and lean into AI both in the products we build and in how we build them — including agentic development workflows that raise the whole team's velocity. If you're a hands\-on builder with depth in payments, banking, or distributed systems, who wants to raise the engineering bar around you and take end\-to\-end ownership of ambiguous, high\-stakes problems, this role is for you. **Responsibilities** * **Own critical banking systems end\-to\-end.** Drive significant technical initiatives across every layer of the stack — from data model and ledger design through GraphQL API contracts to the member\-facing experience — for Checking, Savings, and money movement. * **Architect for scale, correctness, and trust.** Create robust, scalable, and secure technical designs for high\-volume, low\-latency financial systems, balancing short\-term delivery against long\-term architectural health, and ensuring high availability and optimal performance. * **Stay hands\-on.** Spend roughly 60–70% of your time writing high\-quality, performant, production code while setting the technical direction for your team. * **Lead the event\-driven backbone.** Design and evolve Kafka\-based messaging and event\-streaming patterns that keep balances, transactions, notifications, and partner integrations consistent and idempotent at scale. * **Drive AI\-native innovation.** Identify high\-impact opportunities to apply AI and agentic capabilities — both in the product and in how we engineer — take AI\-powered features to production, and evaluate their impact with the right metrics. Coach the team on using AI development tools effectively and responsibly. * **Act as the technical subject\-matter expert.** Lead the design of complex features, run technical design reviews, and lead a small group of engineers through hard programming and design problems. * **Lead technical execution.** Own requirements gathering, technical design, project sequencing, and test planning; sequence complex dependencies and manage risk across multiple systems and teams. * **Partner with bank and network partners.** Work with our sponsor bank, processors, and payment network partners to integrate new capabilities and data, meeting the compliance, auditability, and regulatory obligations that come with holding member deposits. * **Champion engineering quality.** Set the bar on automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance, security, and accessibility, and own quality through the full lifecycle — QA, pre\-production, production, and post\-release. * **Elevate engineering talent.** Provide clear goals, mentor senior engineers to the point where they lead initiatives independently, and give actionable feedback. * **Solve systemic gaps.** Partner with cross\-functional leads and managers to systematically tackle technical debt, tooling deficiencies, and skill gaps that slow the team down. * **Communicate with clarity.** Produce crisp technical documents and design reviews, and communicate design choices persuasively to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives. **Qualifications** * 7\+ years delivering enterprise\-class applications, with a strong focus on backend software development, API design, and robust client/server contracts. * 5\+ years designing complex distributed systems that operate at scale. * BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Core languages:** strong proficiency in TypeScript and/or Scala (or another functional/JVM language with demonstrated ability to ramp quickly — we code primarily in Scala and TypeScript). * **APIs:** deep experience designing and consuming web APIs, with hands\-on GraphQL schema design and federation experience (REST and gRPC also relevant). * **Architecture \& infrastructure**: expertise in scalable microservices architectures, messaging patterns, container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform). * **Event streaming \& messaging**: production experience with Kafka (or Pub/Sub, SQS, RabbitMQ) and the design of idempotent, exactly\-once\-effective, event\-driven workflows. * **Cloud**: hands\-on development in a public cloud environment — Google Cloud strongly preferred (GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Spanner/Cloud SQL). * **Data**: strong relational schema design, NoSQL, and high\-volume low\-latency data pipelining. * **AI capability**: proficient in — or highly capable of — integrating and evaluating AI in production, including LLM prompting, tool/function calling, and agentic development workflows; a high\-level understanding of model types, their limitations, and how to measure accuracy. * **Foundational excellence**: solid grounding in OOP and functional design, algorithms, design patterns, test automation (TDD, unit/integration/functional), and CI/CD. * **Technical leadership:** a track record of setting direction, running design reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and serving as the cross\-functional go\-to person without relying on direct authority. * Communication: excellent written and verbal skills; able to explain complex technical topics clearly and persuasively to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: New York $202,500 \- $274,000

jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB218860 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? jobs.description: **About KPI Solutions** ----------------------- KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting, software, systems integration, and automation provider headquartered in Belton, Missouri. We help some of the country's leading retailers, e\-commerce brands, and distributors transform their warehouse and fulfillment operations — from initial consulting and engineered concept design through systems integration, intelligent warehouse software, robotics, and lifetime support services. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings decades of material handling expertise together with technology\-neutral, best\-of\-breed solutions. Our teams work across the country, with hubs in Cincinnati and Kansas City and remote colleagues nationwide, partnering with clients to boost fulfillment speed, reduce labor reliance, and build more resilient supply chains. **Position Summary** -------------------- As a Sr. Software Developer/Engineer for KPI, you will join a team to collaborate on analysis, design, development, and testing of our warehouse execution and control software. We build the central nervous system that coordinates robots, cranes, autonomous vehicles, conveyance, and a wide array of human interfaces. The challenge we face every day is to bring together best\-in\-class hardware solutions with intuitive human interfaces. Our customers rely on KPI to provide the most effective solutions to complex materials handling problems, and as part of the Software Group you will help us maintain the flexibility to always use the right tool for the job. * Design, develop, and customize our current Warehouse Execution/Control System (WES/WCS) software product for new and existing clients, as well as participate in the development of new industry leading products. * Work directly with customers to gather, analyze, and create functional requirements and integrate customizations into the current software base. * 25% Travel to client sites to perform system configuration and analysis of developed solutions and may include training end users. * Participate in architectural direction and evolution of software You'll sit on our growth team, working closely with our Head of Growth, product engineers, and designers, and you'll own growth problems end to end: from spotting the opportunity in the data, to shipping the experiment, to measuring the result. This is a hands\-on engineering role with real product and business ownership. You'll work primarily in SvelteKit and TypeScript (React experience also fine), with deep use of our event data in ClickHouse and Postgres. Success here is measured in activation, conversion, retention, and revenue, not tickets closed. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the funnel in code:** Build and iterate on signup, onboarding, activation, and upgrade flows so new users reach their first great creation faster and stay. * **Run experiments at speed:** Design, ship, and analyze A/B tests across pricing, paywalls, onboarding, and lifecycle touchpoints, and build the experimentation tooling that lets the whole team move faster. * **Build growth infrastructure:** Own event tracking, attribution, and analytics pipelines (ClickHouse, Postgres) so the growth team can trust its numbers on acquisition, ROAS, and retention. * **Scale acquisition channels with engineering:** Build programmatic SEO/AEO surfaces, shareable and remixable outputs, referral loops, and integrations that turn Krea creations into new users. * **Power lifecycle and monetization:** Ship triggered email and in\-product messaging, plan and billing improvements, and usage\-based nudges that lift conversion and expansion. * **Support launches:** Partner with product, marketing, and content on our ambitious launch calendar, building landing pages, waitlists, and launch mechanics that hold up under spikes in traffic. * **Automate with AI:** Use AI and agents to build internal tools and workflows that multiply the output of a small, high\-leverage growth team. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience, ideally including time on a growth, monetization, or activation team at a fast\-growing consumer or prosumer product * Real, significant Svelte or React experience: this isn't a pure\-backend role * Strong quantitative instincts: you're comfortable writing SQL, designing experiments, and separating signal from noise in the results * A track record of shipping changes that moved a metric, and the ability to explain exactly how and why * Comfort owning things end to end, from hypothesis to shipped, measured impact * High ownership and speed: you think like a founder and thrive in an ambitious, low\-ego culture * AI\-native: you actively use AI and agents to multiply your output * Clear written and verbal communication * Taste: a strong, well\-developed point of view on what good creative work and good product experiences look like **Nice to have** * Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flags, product analytics, or attribution tooling * Experience with billing and subscription systems (e.g. Stripe) * Programmatic SEO or lifecycle marketing infrastructure experience * A creative background (design, art, architecture, or similar) **Our stack** ------------- * SvelteKit, TypeScript, Python, Postgres (AWS Aurora), Redis, ClickHouse, Docker, Kubernetes, FluxCD **What we offer** ----------------- * **Team**: Work alongside a world\-class team building the future of AI creative tooling * **Impact**: Significant scope and company\-wide impact * **Competitive compensation**: generous salary \& equity packages * **Health \& wellness**: 100% health \& 99% dental/vision insurance premiums covered for employees, health FSA accounts, \& long\-term disability coverage * **Time off**: Flexible PTO policy * **Financial planning**: 401k with a 4% company\-sponsored match * **Meals in the office**: breakfast, lunch, dinner \- you name it, we'll cover it * **Transit**: Ubers covered to \& from the office * **Sponsorship**: We're open to sponsoring international visas where we can (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H\-1B, O\-1, E\-3\). * And more! *Please note the above benefits \& perks are for full\-time employees*

jobs.title: Sr. Solutions Architect/Sales Engineer-AI Infrastructure (GPU) -West Coast
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Liqid is doing for AI infrastructure what VMware did for x86 servers, bringing the agility of the cloud to the on\-prem datacenter to dynamically allocate and share GPUs, memory, and other resources. This functionality is critical in running AI and advanced\-data workloads in production (a.k.a. Inference). Liqid Matrix software enables global organizations to accelerate the adoption of AI, HPC and VDI by unlocking the bottleneck of GPU utilization and availability through dynamic pooling and sharing of AI resources for higher performance with less total cost, less power, and less hardware. **Reinvent How The World Runs AI Infrastructure** AI infrastructure is being rebuilt in real time. GPUs are scarce and expensive, HBM is supply\-constrained, and the economics of inference are forcing every serious operator to rethink how they architect compute. Liqid is one of the few credible answers at scale: we pool GPU and memory resources and assign them in software, so customers get 10x the tokens per second, 5x the tokens per dollar, and 2x the tokens per watt out of the infrastructure they already own. We are hiring a **Sr Solutions Architect** to lead technical pre\-sales engagement for Liqid’s most important customer opportunities. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can earn credibility with technical buyers, shape the solution architecture, lead proof\-of\-concept work, and turn complex infrastructure challenges into clear customer value. **Why Liqid, Why Now** AI infrastructure is being rebuilt in real time. GPUs are scarce and expensive, HBM is supply\-constrained, and the economics of inference are forcing every serious operator to rethink how they architect compute. Liqid’s pooling platform is one of the few credible answers to that problem at scale. This role is the technical front line of that conversation working with demanding customers across AI, federal, and HPC, on a small senior team where your work is visible and your field signal reaches the people who build the product. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing position. **About the Role** This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing position. You will partner closely with account executives on discovery, design, PoCs, RFP responses, and executive technical conversations. You will own the technical strategy across your territory from early qualification through technical close, reporting to the SVP of Worldwide Solutions Engineering and working directly with a small, senior SA team. **The location is primarily California with west mid\- west travel.** The right person can whiteboard a GPU inference cluster with a customer’s principal engineer, run a disciplined PoC against agreed success criteria, and translate the technical outcome into business language that resonates with a CFO, CIO, or program office. Customers will rely on this role to help them rethink GPU infrastructure as HBM, power, and utilization become primary constraints. The Solutions Architect translates Liqid’s capabilities into practical customer architectures, turns ambiguous requirements into deliverable solutions, and feeds field insight back into the evolution of the product. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the technical relationship for accounts across your territory from first discovery through technical close to deployment. * Partner with your AE on every meaningful opportunity: technical discovery, solution design, PoC scoping, RFP/RFI response, and executive technical engagement. * Run technical discovery that gets to the real requirement GPU utilization targets, workload mix, fabric constraints, and the economics behind the decision not just the stated spec. * Be accountable for technical win rate and PoC conversion in your territory, with clear visibility into where deals are won, lost, or stuck. * PoC’s will be delivered physically with Liqid hardware at a customer or partner venue. Also via a remote lab environment, hosted by Liqid. * Full ownership of the PoC process is expected including installation, configuration and testing. * Scope, run, and win proofs of concept against explicit, customer\-agreed success criteria and drive them to a decision. * Build and deliver compelling demos of Liqid Matrix tailored to the workload in front of you: AI training, inference at scale, HPC, and virtualization / VDI. * Contribute to and reuse the team’s library of reference architectures, sizing tools, TCO models, and PoC playbooks so the team scales faster than headcount and what worked once is repeatable. * Maintain credible working knowledge of the demo and lab environment and feedback what the field needs from it. * Operate as a true partner to sales. Help qualify hard, shape the technical strategy on a deal, and know when to walk away from a poor\-fit opportunity. * Carry a territory\-ownership mindset: understand your accounts, your competitive landscape, and your pipeline well enough to be proactive rather than reactive. * Engage credibly across the customer org from a principal engineer or chief architect to a CIO or CFO buying committee and adjust the message to the audience. * Be a structured voice of the customer back to Product and Engineering translating field signal into prioritized, evidence\-backed input rather than one\-off anecdotes. * Working closely with support, marketing and our OEM partners to educate, optimise and develop capabilities. * Surface roadmap gaps and integration priorities (e.g. SLURM, Kubernetes, virtualization / VDI, northbound integrations) clearly and early, with the customer context that makes them actionable. * Help close the loop between field PoCs and engineering on early\-access and design\-partner work. * Ensure a clean technical hand\-off from pre\-sales to deployment, customer success, and support so what the customer was sold matches what gets delivered. * Stay engaged on your most strategic deployments to protect against technical churn and to surface expansion opportunities. **Requirements** **What You Bring** **Experience** * 5\+ years in technical pre\-sales, solutions architecture, or field engineering at a B2B infrastructure, systems, or AI infrastructure company. * A track record of personally owning the technical work on competitive deals discovery, architecture, PoC, and technical close. * Experience working alongside or through tier\-one OEMs (Dell, HPE, Cisco, Supermicro, Lenovo, or equivalents) is a strong plus. **Technical depth** * Solid, current knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure: GPU systems (H100/H200/B100/B200 class and successors), the memory hierarchy, and cluster\-scale architecture for training and inference. * Working command of the modern data center stack: server platforms, fabric and networking (CXL, PCIe Gen5/6, NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE/Ethernet), and storage. * Hands\-on familiarity with virtualization and VDI (VMware and equivalents) and orchestration / scheduling (Kubernetes, SLURM) and an honest sense of where each is mature and where it isn’t. * Credible on the economics of infrastructure GPU utilization, cost\-per\-token, TCO not just the bits and bytes. **How you operate** * Consultative by instinct you listen for the real problem before you reach for the product. * A genuine sales partner you make your AE better, qualify honestly, and treat the number as partly yours. * Owner, not passenger you take responsibility for your territory and don’t wait to be told what the next move is. * Curious by default you stay current on the AI infrastructure landscape because you find it interesting, not because someone made you. * A clear communicator who can explain a composable architecture cleanly to an engineer, a CIO, or a CFO. **Benefits** **Join Us** Embrace the opportunity to be part of a dynamic team, driving innovation in a thriving industry. Apply now to shape the future of IT infrastructure with Liqid. We look forward to receiving your application and exploring how you can contribute to Liqid's growth. Compensation and Benefits * Base compensation: $155k\-175k depending on experience, plus unlimited commission * Generous Medical/Dental/Vision/Life/Disability benefits package * 401K * Unlimited PTO * Paid Company Holidays * Cell phone stipend * Flexible, casual work environment *Liqid is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Liqid provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training*

jobs.title: Network & Voice Operations Support Technician I (Floater)
jobs.description: We need a flexible, hands\-on Level 1 technician who can easily split their time between desk work and field visits. In this role, you’ll act as our primary floater—some mornings you’ll sit in the NOC handling ticket queues and phone calls; other afternoons you’ll throw your gear into a company truck to mount gear, run patch cables, or swap hardware at client sites across Tucson. You don’t need to know everything on day one, but you must be dependable, quick to learn, and comfortable switching gears throughout the day. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ ### **What the Job Looks Like Day\-to\-Day** NOC \& Help Desk Queue * Field incoming calls, emails, and tickets with a level head and a customer service focus, letting clients know what to expect and when. * Run initial connectivity checks using standard utilities (ping, traceroute) and monitoring dashboards (Zabbix, InControl, UniFi); document what you see and escalate cleanly when a problem needs senior eyes. * Address everyday VoIP tickets: dead handsets, bad call quality, SIP registration drops, extension reassignments, or basic call tree updates. * Log all notes, customer details, and config changes into our ticketing system as they happen—not hours later. * Help our managed services crew with everyday desktop tickets, including local printer issues, basic account lockouts, and workstation connectivity. Field Support \& Site Work * Act as on\-site "smart hands" for senior engineers—power\-cycling rack equipment, reseating transceivers, tracing patch cords, or reading out switch port status LEDs over the phone. * Physically rack, mount, cable, and test hardware on\-site: routers, switches, wireless access points, PoE gear, IP phones, and ATAs. * Run quick site readiness checks against our install checklists; upload clean photos and site notes to the ticket before leaving. * Handle de\-installs when clients offboard, safely box up gear, and log it back into inventory (Sonar). Gear \& Inventory Prep * Tag incoming hardware, log serial numbers, and keep track of where loaned gear goes. * Unbox, label, and stage hardware on the bench so it’s configured and ready for scheduled rollouts. * Keep install kits and company vehicles stocked with zip ties, RJ\-45 heads, patch leads, and basic hand tools. ### **Who We're Looking For** * Foundational Tech Sense: You understand IP addressing, subnets, DHCP, DNS, and the basics of how an IP phone talks across a local subnet. * Troubleshooting Instincts: You know how to isolate a bad cable or port before guessing at complex software bugs. * Customer Skills: You can talk someone through a reboot without sounding frustrated or speaking entirely in jargon. * Hands\-on Comfort: Fine with crimping Cat5e/Cat6, testing basic punch\-downs, running patch lines neatly, and working with common hand tools. * Adaptability: You don't mind starting a project in an air\-conditioned operations center and finishing your afternoon troubleshooting an AP on a 10\-foot ladder. * Requirements: High school diploma or GED; a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record; must be able to pass a standard background check. ### **Helpful Extras (Not Required)** * 6–12\+ months in an MSP, ISP, NOC, or help desk environment. * Entry certs like CompTIA A\+, Net\+, or basics from Cisco, MikroTik, or Ubiquiti. * Prior work inside hosted PBX or SIP admin panels. * Practical structured cabling or low\-voltage experience. * Bilingual Spanish/English is a definite plus in the Tucson market. ### **Physical Requirements \& Environment** * Split role: Operations center desk environment mixed with on\-site client visits across Tucson. * Field environments vary—you will occasionally work in warm server closets, drop ceilings, rooftops, and outdoor Arizona weather. * Must be comfortable carrying gear up to 50 lbs and working safely from ladders (up to 12 ft). * Must be open to occasional maintenance windows, after\-hours shifts, or being on\-call for sudden regional outages. * Company vehicle provided for all work\-related driving.

jobs.description: Welcome to The Liberty Company—a forward\-thinking, rapidly growing insurance brokerage built on a foundation of culture and collaboration. Our entrepreneurial, wellness\-focused environment is paired with competitive compensation, a generous benefits package, paid time off, and unique programs to support your professional and personal growth. We’re seeking a talented AI\-Enabled Developer to join our vibrant team. If our values resonate with you, and you’re looking for a workplace where culture comes first, we can’t wait to get to know you!**JOB SUMMARY** The Liberty Company Insurance Brokers is looking for an AI\-enabled developer to design, build, and ship the internal applications, integrations, and automations that power how our brokerage works. This role builds on Liberty’s internal platform: web applications, AI assistants, and tool servers that connect producers, account managers, and operations teams to data from our agency management systems, carrier feeds, document systems, and finance platforms. The ideal candidate has made AI coding assistants and agents a core part of how they build software, and pairs that speed with the engineering discipline to ship reliable, secure, production\-grade code. You will work across the stack, from SQL and APIs through the user interface, and be comfortable deploying and running what you build on Microsoft Azure. This is not an AI research role or a systems administration role. It is a hands\-on software engineering role for someone who builds with AI every day.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****AI\-Enabled Application Development*** Design, build, and maintain internal web applications, automations, and integrations, using AI coding assistants and agents (for example, Claude Code) as a primary part of the development workflow. * Turn business and operational needs from Operations, Sales, Finance, BI, and other Liberty teams into working software, from first prototype through production release. * Build AI\-powered features and assistants on large language model APIs, including tool calling, retrieval over company data, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that give AI assistants safe, scoped access to Liberty systems. * Build and maintain integrations with agency management systems, carrier platforms, document management, Microsoft 365, and other line\-of\-business tools through their APIs. * Write automated tests, and design evaluations for AI features so their behavior is measured rather than assumed. * Apply sound software engineering practice (code review, version control, pull requests, CI, and documentation) to everything shipped, regardless of how much of it was AI\-generated. **Platform, Data \& Delivery*** Deploy and operate the applications you build on Microsoft Azure (App Service, Entra ID, Key Vault, Application Insights), working with IT on infrastructure, identity, and security. * Write efficient SQL against Liberty’s SQL Server / Azure SQL data warehouse, and partner with the data team on the models, views, and pipelines your applications depend on. * Build role\-based access, audit logging, and data handling controls into applications that touch production, sensitive, or regulated data, within Liberty’s security and compliance guardrails. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production applications for performance, reliability, and cost. **AI Practice \& Enablement*** Evaluate and responsibly adopt new AI coding tools, models, and agent workflows, and share the practices that raise the team’s development speed and quality. * Help colleagues across the business get more from AI tools, and document reusable patterns, prompts, and skills. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years of professional software development experience building and shipping production applications. * Strong proficiency in Python or another modern language (for example, C\# or TypeScript), plus working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for web front ends. * Demonstrated experience building software with AI coding assistants or agents (for example, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, not just casual use, with examples you can walk us through. * Hands\-on experience building on large language model APIs (for example, Anthropic Claude or Azure OpenAI), including prompt design, tool calling, and handling model output safely. * Experience designing and integrating with REST APIs, including OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect authentication. * Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server. * Fluency with Git, pull request workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD. * Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort owning an application end to end, from requirements through production support. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience building or integrating with MCP (Model jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Product & Platform
jobs.description: LiteLLM is an open\-source AI Gateway that gives developers a unified interface to LLM providers. We’re looking for a Senior Security Engineer to secure our application, infrastructure, and software delivery pipeline. **About the role** ------------------ This is a hands\-on individual contributor role reporting to our security lead. You’ll work directly with engineers to review and harden LiteLLM’s Python codebase, secure releases, and make security part of how we build. San Francisco is preferred, but not required. You’ll own your roadmap, implement improvements yourself, and make day\-to\-day decisions independently. You should be comfortable prioritizing competing risks and explaining the tradeoffs behind your decisions. The ideal candidate has built and owned a product, platform, or infrastructure security program and knows how to turn security findings into lasting engineering improvements. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Review and harden LiteLLM’s Python codebase, fixing vulnerabilities and addressing their underlying causes. * Review sensitive pull requests and architecture changes before they reach production. * Harden our build and release pipeline, including GitHub Actions permissions, workload identity, signing, and credential handling. * Build and maintain automated controls for secrets detection, credential management, and software release integrity. * Review cloud architecture, IAM, secrets management, and workload identity, and implement security improvements. * Build guardrails and secure defaults that fit how engineers work. * Document our security architecture, decisions, and operating practices. * Own delivery and ongoing maintenance of product and pipeline security improvements. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * 7\+ years of relevant experience, including independent ownership of a security scope. * Experience hardening a production CI/CD pipeline, including GitHub Actions permissions and keyless signing. * Strong knowledge of a major cloud provider, preferably AWS, including IAM, secrets management, and workload identity. * Familiarity with Terraform. * Ability to read production Python web\-service code, identify vulnerabilities, and implement fixes. * Experience building security tooling and guardrails that engineering teams adopted. * Strong judgment about prioritization and risk when several problems need attention at once. * Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to coordinate across time zones independently. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience as the first or second security hire at a developer\-tools or open\-source company. * A background in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering. * Experience leading platform or infrastructure security, defining roadmaps, and owning the security of releases. **Why join LiteLLM?** --------------------- * Secure an open\-source product, its infrastructure, and its software delivery pipeline. * Work directly with engineers and influence how software gets designed and shipped. * Set priorities and implement the improvements you recommend. * Build security practices that become part of everyday engineering work. **About LiteLLM** ----------------- LiteLLM provides a unified API for LLM providers, along with routing, authentication, budgets, observability, and governance for production AI systems. Compensation Range: $220K \- $280K

This is a hands\-on individual contributor role reporting to our security lead. You’ll work directly with engineering to build and operate a detection and response function suited to a small company. San Francisco is preferred. You’ll own your roadmap, build and run the tooling yourself, and lead incidents with incomplete information. security log pipelines and document coverage gaps. * Build, validate, and tune detections across cloud infrastructure, CI systems, identity providers, and internal services. * Manage detections as code, with clear documentation and ongoing maintenance. * Write and maintain a runbook for every alert. * Define severity\-based alert response SLAs and own performance against them. * Lead incidents from investigation and containment through recovery and follow\-up. * Produce clear incident timelines, reports, and recommendations. * Measure and improve time to detect and contain threats. * Automate detection of unexpected identity and access changes and drive remediation. * Prioritize improvements based on risk and the needs of a small engineering organization. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of relevant experience. * Experience building a detection and response function from scratch. * Hands\-on experience building and tuning SIEM detections, preferably in Splunk, and managing them as code. * Experience building log pipelines from cloud and CI systems. * Strong familiarity with GitHub, Okta, and cloud audit logs, including their limitations. * Experience leading incidents end\-to\-end and making containment decisions on partial information. * Understanding of OAuth, personal access tokens, OIDC, and how attackers abuse authentication systems. * Ability to write Python scripts to investigate incidents and automate security operations. * Strong independent judgment and experience owning priorities with limited oversight. * Clear communication under pressure and a willingness to surface bad news early. * Availability to overlap with Pacific working hours. **Bonus points** ---------------- * You helped build a detection and response function at a growing technology company. * Experience in managed detection and response or incident response across multiple customer environments. * Experience partnering closely with engineers in a small, fast\-moving team. **Why join LiteLLM?** --------------------- * Own detection and response across the environment, from collecting logs to leading incidents. * Build a function around the needs of a small company. * Work directly with security and engineering to close the gaps you find. * Set priorities and implement improvements yourself. **About LiteLLM** ----------------- LiteLLM provides a unified API for LLM providers, along with routing, authentication, budgets, observability, and governance for production AI systems. jobs.title: AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: As MISO's **AI Governance Engineer**, you will help build and evolve the enterprise AI governance framework as the organization expands its use of generative and agentic AI. In this role, you will develop practical guardrails, controls, processes, and oversight mechanisms that enable responsible and secure use of AI while supporting innovation. You will help create a scalable, risk\-based approach for registering, evaluating, monitoring, and governing AI solutions, including internally developed, purchased, and vendor\-embedded technologies. Working closely with partners across technology, security, compliance, HR, and business teams, you will help establish governance practices that can be adopted across the organization. Because AI technologies and risks continue to evolve rapidly, this position requires ongoing learning, curiosity, and continuous refinement of governance processes and standards. The ideal candidate brings experience in AI engineering, software development, data engineering, or related disciplines, along with a collaborative, hands\-on approach to solving complex challenges and balancing innovation with risk management. Some of the impactful contributions you’ll make as MISO’s **AI Governance Engineer** include: * Owning the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the enterprise AI governance platform, building and operating it as a scalable internal product. * Defining a repeatable, risk‑tiered governance framework (including measurement, evaluation, monitoring, and incident response) to ensure teams can apply the right controls to any AI solution. * Delivering a central AI registry and intake process that identifies, registers, and tiers high‑risk and high‑visibility AI systems across the enterprise. * Building automated capabilities for registration, observability, and evidence capture, ensuring traceability across data, models, prompts, versions, and evaluations from deployment onward. * Creating reusable evaluation tooling for ML, generative AI, and agentic systems, and validate that governance measures and model‑based evaluations are accurate and continuously improving. * Defining monitoring thresholds, incident‑response protocols, and rollback runbooks for AI failure, degradation, or policy violations, validating them through exercises such as tabletop tests. * Providing transparency to leadership through reporting on AI quality, usage, cost, and value, while collaborating with security, privacy, compliance, risk, and the AI Working Group to drive consistent governance adoption. You’ll need the following skills to be successful as **AI Governance Engineer**: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field; a master’s degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent experience may also be considered. * 8\+ years of experience in software, data, or machine learning engineering, including at least 3 years building or evaluating production ML or AI solutions. * Experience designing, building, and operating shared platforms or internal products used across multiple teams. * Solid understanding of model training, evaluation, and failure modes, with the ability to design sound evaluation approaches. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools. Experience in two or more of the following: * Evaluating or monitoring ML, generative AI, retrieval\-augmented, or agentic systems. * Observability, telemetry, or alerting for production systems. * Test automation or quality engineering for non\-deterministic systems. * MLOps/LLMOps, including experiment tracking, versioning, and model or artifact registries. * Data quality and validation practices for AI‑relevant datasets. * Cloud cost management or usage analytics. Appropriate level will be determined based upon experience and knowledge. jobs.description: **Day\-in\-the\-life** ---------------------- You start your morning on the shop floor, reviewing Cp/Cpk dashboards and first\-article results. By midday, you’re shoulder\-to\-shoulder with machinists dialing in chatter mitigation and tool wear strategies. In the afternoon, you finalize new work instructions and control plans aligned to AS9100, close a corrective action from a recent audit, and finish the day evaluating a new 5\-axis platform for an upcoming program. ### **What you’ll own** * Developing and optimizing end\-to\-end manufacturing processes for precision aerospace components across CNC machining, secondary finishing, and assembly. * Specifying tooling, fixturing, and process parameters to consistently hit tight tolerances and surface finish requirements. * Reducing cycle times, improving yields, and minimizing scrap through robust methods and data\-driven experimentation. * Creating or supporting CNC programs in CAM and providing hands\-on technical support on the floor. * Troubleshooting cutting issues including tool wear, chatter, thermal/drift effects, and dimensional variation. * Maintaining rigorous process documentation (work instructions, control plans) aligned with aerospace standards such as AS9100 and specific customer requirements. * Leading root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective actions for non\-conformances. * Driving Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives; analyzing and improving capability (Cp/Cpk) to stabilize processes. * Partnering with Design Engineering to advance DFM and part producibility early in the lifecycle. * Collaborating with Quality, Production, and Supply Chain and interfacing with customers and auditors as required. * Assessing and introducing new CNC equipment, tooling, and technologies; supporting capital projects and process validation. ### **What you bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Aerospace Engineering (or equivalent experience). * 3–7 years working in aerospace or precision machining environments. * Deep knowledge of CNC milling, turning, and multi\-axis machining. * Fluency in interpreting complex engineering drawings and GD\&T. ### **Machines \& technologies you’ll use** * CNC Mill (3\-4 axis VMC) (Fanuc, Bridgeport, Mazak, ProtoTRAK, Haas, Okuma, Doosan, Kitamura, Makino, Brother, Hurco, Dmg Mori Seiki, Hwachon) * CNC Lathe (2\-4 axis) (Mazak, Haas, Okuma, Doosan, Takisawa, Dmg Mori Seiki, Samsung, Murata, Fuji, Nakamura, Hyundai \- Wia, Hwachon, Quick Tech) * CNC Swiss Lathe * CAM Software (Mastercam, Mazatrol, Autodesk Fusion 360\) * CNC Mill (5\+ axis VMC) * CNC Lathe (5\+ axis)

jobs.title: Embodied AI Real2Sim Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Job Description:** **Core Objective:** Build the digital pipeline from the real world to simulation space. Reconstruct and calibrate visual and physical properties of robots, objects and scenes, and deliver SimReady interactive assets to reduce the sim\-to\-real gap, supporting algorithm training, simulation evaluation and policy transfer to real hardware. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own the end\-to\-end Real2Sim workflow based on Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis, Blender and other simulation platforms, including 3D reconstruction, appearance reconstruction, dynamic identification, calibration of contact, friction and inertia parameters, to align dynamic and perceptual behaviors between simulation and real robots. * Create, validate and iterate SimReady assets following USD / URDF / MJCF standards. Configure joints, collision shapes, mass/inertia, joint limits, semantic labels and affordance properties for robots and interactive objects, to achieve physical parameter calibration of simulation assets, ensuring stable usability in simulation training. * Process multi\-modal real\-world captured data: camera calibration, point cloud \& mesh processing, texture and PBR material calibration. Leverage 3DGS / NeRF and related reconstruction methods to digitize real scenes and export assets compatible with simulation engines. * Develop automated tools for calibration, data processing and asset quality inspection. Document asset specifications, calibration workflows and evaluation metrics to improve pipeline throughput and sim\-real alignment accuracy. * Collaborate with perception, robot learning, simulation engine and hardware teams, design quantitative sim\-real benchmark experiments, identify simulation bias, and continuously improve calibration protocols and asset standards for closed\-loop data iteration. * Design excitation trajectories for robot system identification, collect time\-series dynamic data from physical robots, calibrate and reproduce non\-ideal dynamic behaviors including nonlinear joint friction and transmission backlash. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Must\-have** * Proficiency in at least one simulation/graphics tool such as Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis or Blender, with solid understanding of computer graphics and rigid\-body dynamics. Familiar with physics simulation engines such as PhysX and Newton. * Hands\-on experience with Real2Sim pipelines and SimReady asset standards; capable of independently building, configuring and validating robot or object assets including joint setup and physical property tuning. * Knowledge of 3D reconstruction, camera imaging, point cloud processing and camera calibration; fundamental understanding of system identification, parameter calibration and contact/friction models for physical simulation. Familiar with PBR rendering and material creation. * Ability to decompose requirements, implement technical solutions, run comparative experiments and root\-cause sim\-real mismatches from visual reconstruction or physical simulation. * Capable of designing dynamic system identification experiments, analyzing measured hardware data, and quantifying sim\-real errors introduced by nonlinear dynamics. **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Proven track record delivering Real2Sim projects, especially for robotic arms, dexterous hands or humanoid robots. * Deep familiarity with USD / URDF / MJCF, experience building asset libraries and automated asset validation pipelines. * Skilled in Python / C\+\+ for calibration scripts, engine extensions and data processing tools. * Experience with 3DGS, NeRF, PBR reconstruction and photogrammetry. * Background in system identification, excitation trajectory design, dynamic parameter estimation and contact model tuning. * Understanding of Sim2Real, reinforcement learning and embodied AI closed\-loop systems. * Experience with motion capture, multi\-sensor calibration and real robot hardware experiments. * Familiar with nonlinear friction models such as LuGre and Stribeck, with experience modeling and tuning joint hysteresis and backlash. **Default Benefits:** ===================== * Health insurance * Vision care * Dental coverage * 401(k) * Paid holidays * PTO (Paid Time Off) * Sick leave

jobs.title: Information Security Engineer – Global Security Infrastructure
jobs.description: Job ID JR116695 **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Micron is expanding and modernizing its global footprint, and physical security technology has to keep pace. Sites today run a mix of systems at different ages and maturity levels. Our goal is a consistent, standards\-based security infrastructure everywhere we operate, covering video surveillance and analytics, access control, intrusion detection, visitor management, and perimeter protection. Modern security systems are connected, technology\-based platforms, and we want them deployed on predictable schedules and managed as a product, not a collection of one\-off projects. In partnership with the Global Security Operations leadership team, you will own that rollout end to end: planning, sequencing, site readiness, execution, and measurement. You will treat security operators and site leaders as your customers, gather their requirements, and make sure what we deploy works for them. **Responsibilities:** * **Own the global rollout program.** Build and run the multi\-year, multi\-site deployment plan for physical security infrastructure upgrades. Sequence sites by risk and readiness, manage scope, schedule, budget, and dependencies, and keep simultaneous projects across regions moving. * **Turn standards into repeatable deployments.** Partner with security engineering to translate technology standards and reference designs into deployment playbooks, site readiness checklists, and acceptance criteria so that every site rollout looks the same and gets faster over time. * **Bring a product mindset.** Gather requirements from security operators, site security leaders, and regional teams. Run the program with agile practices: prioritize a backlog, define what "done" looks like for each site, iterate on the playbook, and measure whether deployed systems deliver the expected operational outcomes. * **Build AI\-enabled tooling and automation.** Develop or adopt tools for deployment tracking, configuration standards checks, device health monitoring, and asset and lifecycle management across the global fleet. Use AI tools and agents to speed up program work such as site assessments, status reporting, risk identification, and documentation. Ensure deployed systems, including AI video analytics, produce data that integrates cleanly with the team's security operations data platform. * **Coordinate partners and integrators.** Manage external integrators and contractors through statements of work, schedules, and quality checks. Coordinate closely with IT and network teams, Information Security (for device hardening and network segmentation), Facilities and construction teams (especially for new fab builds), and EHS. * **Govern and verify.** Establish a governance cadence for the program, track site compliance against security technology standards, and run post\-deployment audits to confirm systems are installed, configured, and operating as designed. * **Manage risk and change.** Identify and raise program risks early, drive decisions to resolution, and plan for operator training and cutover so new systems are adopted, not just installed. * **Report to leadership.** Build clear metrics and dashboards on rollout progress, spend, site compliance, and system health. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Overview** Help build the infrastructure that trains the next generation of agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) models at Microsoft. The Cloud \+ AI (C\+AI) organization builds the end\-to\-end AI stack that powers innovation across Azure and Microsoft. The Foundry, Inference and Training (FIT) Training Team is where frontier\-scale model training meets production\-grade engineering. You will work alongside engineers and researchers to advance the scientific methods and scalable infrastructure used to train Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and agentic models, spanning both proprietary and open\-weight models and building on open\-source training frameworks. Your work will directly shape how reliable, enterprise\-grade agentic workflows are built across the company and experienced by the customers who depend on them. As a Principal Software Engineer on this team, you will own the architecture and technical direction of major components of the training platform and drive them from ambiguous problem statements through production operation. You will keep the customer at the center of every decision, partnering directly with the researchers and product teams who rely on the platform to understand their needs, remove friction, and measure success by their outcomes. You will set the technical bar for the team through design leadership, code and test\-strategy reviews, and mentorship, and you will partner across C\+AI and with partner organizations to align infrastructure roadmaps with model training and evaluation needs. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your expertise in large\-scale distributed systems for AI training, develop firsthand understanding of how frontier proprietary and open\-weight models are trained and evaluated, and grow your influence as a technical leader who shapes architecture, engineering practices, and the next generation of engineers on a fast\-moving, startup\-style team. We are looking for a curious, independent, adaptable, and customer\-obsessed problem\-solver who thrives on continuous learning, is energized by evolving priorities, and is motivated by the impact your work has on the people who use it. You write efficient, well\-tested code, enjoy debugging hard problems in complex distributed systems, and share what you learn. You iterate quickly, adjust course when the evidence calls for it, and collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond **Responsibilities** * Own the architecture and technical direction of major components of the training platform for Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), multimodal, code\-specific, and open\-weight models, ensuring designs meet scalability, reliability, security, and cost\-efficiency requirements. * Partner directly with customers, including researchers and product teams across Microsoft, to understand their training and evaluation needs, translate them into platform requirements, and measure success through customer experience and outcomes. * Drive ambiguous, multi\-quarter initiatives from proposal to production, breaking work into milestones, identifying dependencies, and negotiating ownership and delivery commitments with partner teams across Cloud \+ AI (C\+AI). * Build on and extend open\-source training frameworks (for example, PyTorch, DeepSpeed, Megatron\-LM, and Hugging Face libraries), adapting them for proprietary and open\-weight models and contributing improvements back to the community where appropriate. * Design and build services that serve production traffic while meeting Microsoft security, privacy, Responsible AI, and compliance requirements, including auditable evidence of compliance. * Lead debugging and resolution of complex issues in distributed training jobs and production services;
