jobs.title: SecOps Engineer
jobs.description: **SECOPS ENGINEER** **Location:** Burlington, VT **WHO WE ARE** Open Approach is a values\-driven, client\-focused IT services company based in Burlington, Vermont. We deliver exceptional managed technology and phenomenal client support to organizations across New England and beyond. Our focus is on long\-term partnerships built on trust, transparency, and shared success, not sales quotas. We earn our client's business every month by staying relentlessly focused on their success. From the very first interaction to ongoing evolution, we aim to provide seamless experiences grounded in understanding, integrity, and practical solutions. We believe in making thoughtful, informed decisions and creating a lasting impact instead of quick fixes. This translates into long\-term relationships with our clients that are rewarding on many levels. At our core, we value equity, humility, excellence, accountability, innovation, and openness. These guide everything we do, from how we collaborate internally to how we support clients through complex technical challenges. We are continually refining our team, enhancing our capabilities, and investing in talent to drive forward meaningful change. We embrace candid feedback, own our outcomes, and strive to improve every day. If that sounds like the kind of company you want to grow with, we would love to hear from you. **THE ROLE** This isn't a traditional SOC role where you sit and watch dashboards all day. Yes, you'll be involved in incident response, but your real focus is on building, improving, and evolving the security systems and processes behind everything we do at Open Approach and for our clients. You'll serve as the primary escalation point for our Security Operations Analyst. When things get complex, they will come to you. You will own the deeper investigations, lead advanced response efforts, and ensure we deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes every time. Outside of incidents, you'll spend your time designing, implementing, and optimizing our security stack: SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, and the rest. You'll tune out the noise, sharpen detection, and make our tools work the way they should. A big part of this role is research and automation. We want someone who looks at a manual process and immediately thinks, "How do I make this faster, better, or unnecessary?" You'll identify gaps, evaluate new tools, and build the automation that makes the whole Security Operations team more effective. You'll also support compliance work, including the technical implementation and validation of controls across frameworks such as CMMC, HIPAA, and CJIS. Not the paperwork side. The hands\-on, make\-it\-actually\-work side. You should be someone who enjoys building better systems, not just reacting to alerts. Specifically: * Highly technical and genuinely passionate about cybersecurity * Curious, always poking at systems and looking for ways to improve them * Comfortable digging into complex problems and owning them from start to finish * A strong collaborator who works well alongside others * Motivated to automate and optimize, not just maintain * Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical audiences **A note on experience:** We need someone with a solid technical foundation, but if you're the right person and you're missing a few of the skills listed below, that's okay. We're happy to train, guide, and invest in you. What we can't teach is the mindset. **THE SPECIFICS OF THE JOB** **Responsibilities** * Act as the escalation point for complex security incidents and investigations * Design, implement, and optimize security tools and platforms (SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, etc.) * Lead advanced incident response investigation, containment, remediation * Develop automation and improve processes to reduce manual effort and increase efficiency * Research and evaluate new security tools and technologies * Tune alerts, cut false positives, and sharpen detection capabilities * Support compliance initiatives through technical control implementation and validation * Collaborate with internal teams to ensure security solutions are properly deployed and maintained * Create and maintain documentation, standards, and repeatable processes * Contribute to the ongoing maturity of the Security Operations program **Job Requirements** * A working understanding of firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, and other core security technologies. * The ability to look at security events and incidents and connect the dots by identifying threats, patterns, and vulnerabilities. * Security work lives and dies in the details. Incidents need to be thoroughly investigated and properly resolved. * You uphold our operational and security standards and have a sharp eye for where they're not being met. * This field moves fast. You need to genuinely enjoy keeping up with new technologies, trends, and best practices. * The ability to prioritize effectively, especially when multip  hybrid identity environments and synchronization between on\-prem AD and Azure/Entra ID. Ability to spot and fix common identity and access risks. * Solid grasp of core networking (DHCP, DNS, routing, switching) and how it all ties into security. Familiarity with remote access technologies (SSL VPN, IPSec VPN). Understanding of segmentation, least privilege, and traffic flow analysis. Ability to troubleshoot network related security issues across layered environments. * Strong understanding of M365 and Intune security capabilities such as device management, policy enforcement, Conditional Access, authentication methods, identity protection. Familiarity with email security, mail flow, and integration with security platforms. Ability to assess and improve security posture across Microsoft cloud environments. * Hands\-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability management tools. Ability to analyze alerts, investigate incidents, and track threats across platforms. Understanding of alert tuning, noise reduction, and detection and response fundamentals. Familiarity with vulnerability assessments and risk analysis. Basic understanding of cryptographic concepts and their practical applications. * Experience with IR processes: triage, containment, investigation, and recovery. Ability to analyze complex incidents, determine root cause, and drive remediation. Understanding of the IR lifecycle and how to reduce impact while improving future response. **Additional Experience and Skills** * Familiarity with platforms like Hyper\-V or VMware. Understanding of how virtualized environments affect security isolation, snapshotting, and investigation workflows. Comfortable using virtualization tools for testing and validating security configurations. * Understanding of firewall technologies, rule creation, and policy management. Ability to implement rules aligned with best practices and troubleshoot traffic to catch misconfigurations or threats. * Understanding of public vs. private DNS architecture. Knowledge of common record types (A, CNAME, MX, SPF, DKIM, TXT) and their role in email security. Comfortable troubleshooting DNS issues using command\-line and diagnostic tools. * Working knowledge of NIST, CIS, and ISO frameworks. Familiarity with compliance driven environments and how technical controls map to regulatory requirements. Ability to support implementation and validation of controls for CMMC, HIPAA, or CJIS. **Experience \& Certifications** We require at least 3 years of cybersecurity experience, preferably with an MSP or past MSP experience outside of cybersecurity. Life in an MSP demands deep, wide technical knowledge, and it can be overwhelming without the right foundation. We want this to be the right fit for you, not a sink\-or\-swim situation. Certifications aren't required, but they're strongly encouraged and show commitment to growth. Relevant certifications include Security\+, Microsoft Security (SC\-series), or similar foundational cybersecurity and cloud certifications. More advanced certs like CISSP or CCSP are a plus for experienced candidates. **BENEFITS** * Health, dental, and vision coverage with generous employer contributions * Company\-sponsored Life, STD/LTD Disability, and Workers’ Compensation * 401(k) with 4% match starting day one * Generous PTO (starting at 16 days, plus paid holidays. 20 days on your 1 year anniversary) * Fully paid parental leave * Smartphone stipend for on\-call rotation * Weekly company lunches, coffee, snacks, and a pet\-friendly office **HOW NOT TO APPLY** * Forget to write a good cover letter, so that we have no way of knowing how articulate you really are * Include a lot of grammatical and structural errors in your letter and resume * Hide your personality so we can’t tell a thing about you, other than that you are highly efficient in Microsoft Word Thank you for your interest, and best of luck in your search for work. Learn more about us at www.openapproach.com

We provide the platform that enables agents to execute code, use tools, and interact with software reliably and securely at scale. We work closely with product, research, and infrastructure teams to turn new agent capabilities into dependable product experiences. Our work spans the execution environments, APIs, and integrations that support agentic products such as Codex and tool use in ChatGPT. We focus on how agents run in production: making it easy to launch new capabilitiesance and reliability of the systems behind user experiences. Some of the hardest problems in making agents useful emerge when they meet real\-world workloads. We build the platform that helps agents handle those workloads safely, recover when things go wrong, and deliver consistent results. **About the Role** As a Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will build and scale the services that power agentic products at OpenAI. You’ll work closely with product engineers, researchers, and infrastructure engineers to bring new capabilities from early prototypes to production. Your work will include designing APIs and services underneath them. We’re looking for engineers with experience building large\-scale backend systems or infrastructure who enjoy working close to products and users. You should be comfortable moving quickly through ambiguous problems while making thoughtful decisions about securityance, and long\-term maintainability. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. **In this role, you will:** * Build and operate production services that enable agents to execute code, use tools, and interact with external systems. * Design APIs and platform abstractions that make it easier for product teams to build and launch agentic experiences. * Develop orchestration systems that manage agent execution, state, resource allocation, retries, and recovery. * Improve platform reliabilityance optimization, observability, and capacity planning. * Partner with product, research, security, and infrastructure teams to bring new agent capabilities into production. * Own systems through their full lifecycle, from design and implementation to rollout, monitoring, and ongoing operation. **You might thrive in this role if you:** * Have experience building and operating large\-scale backend services, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure. * Enjoy building shared platforms and APIs that help other engineers move faster. * Can take an early prototype, turn it into a reliable service, and evolve it as usage grows. * Have a strong understanding of system performance, concurrency, failure modes, and resource management. * Care about how infrastructure decisions affect the user experience, including responsiveness, reliability, and predictable behavior. * Are comfortable working across service boundaries and collaborating with teams to solve problems from end to end. * Have experience with cloud platforms. * Are interested in secure execution environments, sandboxing, and the challenges of running agent workloads in production. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. **Compensation** $230K – $385K \+ Offers Equity The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance\-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts * Pre\-tax accounts for Health FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter expenses (parking and transit) * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Paid parental leave (up to 24 weeks for birth parents and 20 weeks for non\-birthing parents), plus paid medical and caregiver leave (up to 8 weeks) * Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non\-exempt employees * 13\+ paid company holidays, and multiple paid coordinated company office closures throughout the year for focus and recharge, plus paid sick or safe time (1 hour per 30 hours worked, or more, as required by applicable state or local law) * Mental health and wellness support * Employer\-paid basic life and disability coverage * Annual learning and development stipend to fuel your professional growth * Daily meals in our offices, and meal delivery credits as eligible * Relocation support for eligible employees * Additional taxable fringe benefits, such as charitable donation matching and wellness stipends, may also be provided. More details about our benefits are available to candidates during the hiring process. This role is at\-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. **About the Role** Forward Deployed Engineering is how we build our platform with real clients instead of guessing. An FDE embeds with a client, works in their codebase, and builds their integration against OpenLoop’s production API. Anything the platform can’t do yet is filed as a gap and built once, centrally, so every client inherits it. The real work product isn’t the integration. It’s the reusable asset that client forced into existence. As Senior Engineering Manager, you own this team and you’re measured on two things: clients going live with a clean handoff, and a team that gets better at it every quarter. The team is already delivering and growing fast. Your job is to turn strong individuals into a function, and to scale it without lowering the bar. This is a player\-coach role, coaching first. You stay technical through review, not by owning a client yourself. You read integration designs, adjudicate platform gaps, and stay credible with both client engineering leaders and our platform engineers. If you want to stop reviewing code entirely, or to write code instead of managing people, this isn’t the role. You’ll report into Engineering and work daily with platform, implementation, customer success and sales. **What You'll Do** * **Own client outcomes across the portfolio.** Every client in build has a named owner and a go\-live date. Spot a troubled deployment before the client does, and report it with the date, impact and trade\-off. * **Allocate capacity.** Assign new clients on the day they arrive, with an owner and a clear statement of what they displace. When client, migration and platform work compete, you make the call. * **Lead pods through their architects.** Each pod has an FDE acting as technical architect. Give them clear ownership, real decision rights, and a habit of escalating early. * **Migrate existing clients onto the Partner API.** Move them in cohorts with implementation, platform engineering and the client’s team. Respect change calendars, and measure each move by its first production patient. * **Own the seam with platform teams.** Each gap names the capability it stands in for. Decide who builds it, and escalate stalled reviews with a date. * **Give every go\-live an exit.** Clients leave hypercare on a set date, documented and signed off, so the team doesn’t become the support desk. * **Hire and develop.** You’re the hiring manager for FDEs and Deployment Strategists at every level. Coach toward scope, run hard conversations on time, defend leveling decisions, and run reviews with no surprises. * **Own the agent roster.** The team runs deployments on agents (readiness, conformance, seeding, docs, gap filing, client comms), and a human approves every output. You own adoption, measurement and where the human sits. * **Protect the discipline.** Never wire around the platform. Make changes additive or explicitly superseding. Anything that would break a live client becomes a proposal, not a merge, even under deadline pressure. * **Partner with go\-to\-market.** Be in the room before commitments are made. Distinguish “can’t,” “shouldn’t” and “won’t fit the timeline,” and turn the prioritized client list into a dated plan. * **Write the playbook.** Turn how your best engineers deploy into how the team deploys, so each new deployment needs less of you. **Who You Are** * 8\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers: hiring, performance, leveling and promotions, and growing a team. * You’ve led teams delivering in customers’ environments, and you can talk through deployments that went badly and what you changed. * You’ve run a migration or re\-platforming program with customers who could say no, and you’ve allocated a team against more demand than supply. * You’re still technical: deep in integrations (APIs, auth, webhooks vs. polling, idempotency, schema drift, reconciliation) and able to change a design with one question. * You build with AI agents and have a view on human\-in\-the\-loop design, evaluation, and handling confident errors. * You’re security\-first with sensitive data and treat compliance as a design input. * You’ve told customers or sales “no” or “not in that timeline” and kept the relationship, and you can name things you descoped and why. * You’ve had impact beyond your own team through tooling, practices or platform changes. **Preferred** ------------- * Healthcare or other regulated\-domain experience; EHR, scheduling, pharmacy or payments integrations (FHIR a plus). * You’ve managed managers, led teams through organizational change, or scaled an FDE, solutions engineering or professional services function. * Developer platform experience (SDKs, CLIs, API conventions, tested docs). * Comfortable in pre\-sales technical conversations. * BS in CS or Engineering, or equivalent experience. **Our Benefits** ---------------- In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Project Manager I
jobs.description: Description: We are seeking a Project Manager to support the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple, R\&D\-type programs primarily in Directed Energy and NewSpace. The Project Manager will support project scope, schedule, and performance while ensuring compliance with policies, contractual requirements, and organizational standards. This role requires strong organizational and leadership skills to support the Program Manager and Engineering Team to manage project plans, schedules, and deliveries. The Project Manager must be an expert at working with Office\-based tools (Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint, Word) to support bill of materials management, and schedule management and controls. The ideal candidate has a technical background, project management experience, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Requirements: * Support Program Manager and Engineering Team * Assist with program planning, budgeting, scheduling, and performance tracking * Help manage day\-to\-day operations and facility needs to complete tasks on schedule * Develop necessary documentation to ensure efficient execution of multiple projects in parallel (schedules, task lists) * Provide regular written and verbal reports to peers and management. * Maintain appropriate business and operations systems in support of program execution needs. * Work with engineering, operations, accounting, and supply chain to equip team with needed resources * Support the hiring process and onboarding/offboarding of employees * Manage R\&D inventories of parts, equipment, and assets **Basic Qualifications** * 3\+ years working in a technical environment * 3\+ years of experience managing Government/Military, Directed Energy, Aerospace, or Space/NewSpace programs * Bachelor's degree in project management, business, or technical field * Demonstrated experience working with customers and suppliers * Proven ability to support complex programs with cross\-functional teams * Strong communication, negotiation, and leadership skills * Proficiency with program management tools (MS Project, Jira, ClickUp, Excel, etc.). * Ability to work in a dynamic environment and maintain composure and good working relationships under pressure. * Strong problem\-solving ability and ability to absorb information from multiple sources to reach a solution. * Maintain documentation in support of customer needs and design reviews (i.e. PDR, CDR, ICD, etc.) * Strong technical presentation and writing skills * Ability to work with and learn new ERP and programmatic software programs **Desired Skills** * Bachelor's or Advanced degree in technical field (Engineering, Physics, or related). * Experience with design challenges of High Energy Laser systems and Space applications * Proven record interfacing with Government, Space, and Aerospace customers * Growing knowledge of Directed Energy and NewSpace directives **Benefits** * 4 weeks of Paid Time Off per year * 9 paid Holidays per year * Health, Vision and Dental Care paid 100% by employer * 401k with company matching * Tuition Assistance for Continuing Education **About OEI** Optical Engines is an engineering firm specializing in photonic devices for the commercial, industrial, space, and defense sectors, located right in Old Colorado City in Colorado Springs, CO, just a few minutes from Garden of the Gods and Red Rock Canyon Open Space. In 2005, Optical Engines was founded with a vision to become the destination for ambitious engineers to see how far they could push fiber and photonic technologies. Since then, we have continued to grow and work tirelessly to demonstrate what we can do for our customers. We are a solution\-focused company in an industry with no limit on the potential or impact. That provides us with the unique opportunity to both set the standards and then surpass them. Most of all, it allows us to connect with people who are as passionate as we are.

jobs.title: Early Career Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget. Our Science \& Technology directorates include National Security, Earth and Biological Sciences, Physical and Computational Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus. The National Security Directorate (NSD) drives science\-based, mission\-focused solutions to take on complex, real\-world threats to our nation and the world. The AI and Data Analytics Division, part of the National Security Directorate, combines profound domain expertise and creative integration of advanced hardware and software to deliver computational solutions that address complex data and analytic challenges. Working in multidisciplinary teams, we connect foundational research to engineering to operations, providing the tools to innovate quickly and field results faster. Our strengths are integrated across the data analytics lifecycle, from data acquisition and management to analysis and decision support. Rockstar Rewards: Employees and their families are offered medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, robust telehealth care options, several mental health benefits, free wellness coaching, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, basic life insurance, disability insurance\*, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, tuition assistance, relocation, backup childcare, legal benefits, supplemental parental bonding leave, surrogacy and adoption assistance, and fertility support. Employees are automatically enrolled in our company\-funded pension plan\* and may enroll in our 401 (k) savings plan with company match\*. Employees may accrue up to 120 vacation hours per year and may receive ten paid holidays per year. * Research Associates excluded. \*\*All benefits are dependent upon eligibility. Click Here For Rockstar Rewards Responsibilities: We are seeking a motivated Early Career Software Engineer to join our dynamic team at PNNL and contribute to cutting\-edge projects that shape the future of critical technology supporting national security and intelligence. In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and optimize scalable systems for processing multi\-modal intelligence data at a remarkable scale and speed. This hands\-on position offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills in SI/ML engineering, data orchestration, and system architecture while delivering impactful solutions in a fast\-paced environment where agility and reliability are key to success. As a Software Engineer on PNNL's Software Engineering and Architectures (SEA) team, you'll have the chance to shape mission\-critical SI systems, help build enterprise\-scale data platforms, and gain hands\-on experience with some of the nation's most sophisticated intelligence and security applications. You'll receive mentorship from senior engineers, collaborate with research scientists, and see your code deployed in production systems that directly support national security missions. **What You’ll Build \& Learn:** * SI\-Powered Software – Help develop applications that use SI agents and large language models (LLMs). Gain hands\-on experience with LLM integrations, evaluation, testing, and foundational MLOps practices. * Intelligence Platform Development – Contribute to software that combines multiple sources of intelligence, supports geospatial analysis, and helps users understand complex information. * Data Engineering – Build and maintain data pipelines, develop analytics workflows, and learn how cloud\-native systems process and manage data at scale. * Collaborative Software Development – Work alongside experienced engineers, participate in code reviews and design discussions, and build your skills in testing, debugging, documentation, and enterprise software development. * Professional Growth – Receive mentorship, take on increasing responsibility, and learn how to design, build, deploy, and support production\-quality software. **Technical Skills We’ll Help You Grow:** * Programming Foundation – Solid Python skills and experience with at least one additional language, such as Go, Rust, C\#/.NET, C\+\+, or a similar language. * Platform Experience – Exposure to at least one cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and familiarity with Linux environments. * Development Practices – Understanding of Git and version control, exposure to CI/CD practices, and familiarity with Agile or Scrum development environments. * Data and Databases – Experience writing SQL and a basic understanding of data modeling, data processing, or data pipeline concepts. * SI\-Assisted Development – Familiarity with SI coding tools such as Claude Cod gram. About PNNL: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world\-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them! At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. jobs.title: Plant Optimization Engineer (Chicago, IL)
jobs.description: As a Fortune 500 company, Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is an ideas and solutions company. Our corrugated packaging business seeks to be the leader in helping our customers — large and small — package, transport and display products of all kinds. Our white paper business delivers Paper With Purpose by providing the highest level of customer service and operational excellence. We have approximately 15,000 team members in more than 100 locations in the United States that strive to meet the local needs of our customers. Our mission is to serve the needs of our customers, today and tomorrow, with products and services that exceed expectations for performance and environmental responsibility. People • Customers • Trust PCA is currently recruiting for a Plant Optimization Engineer based at the Chicago, IL corrugated box plant facility. **Description of role:** The Plant Optimization Engineer Position (POE) is a developmental program which focuses on hiring recent college graduates with degrees in engineering (0\-2 years experience) into a rotational training experience with the goal of developing them into well\-rounded employees and future leaders at PCA. This is a full\-time, salaried position with benefits. What is PCA’s POE Program? The POE Program is a 2\-year rotational training program designed to give recent engineering graduates in depth, hands\-on technical training in the Maintenance and Production departments of a corrugated box plant, and a well\-rounded understanding of the corrugated packaging industry as a whole. In addition, POEs will complete engineering process optimization projects throughout the box plant, typically in areas of scrap reduction, throughput improvements, downtime reduction, etc., and will provide engineering support to all plant functions as needed. Upon successful completion of the program, the Plant Optimization Engineer will transition into a new full\-time role in the chosen career path either at their current plant, or another plant or paper mill that has an opening that aligns with their skills and interests. Typical career paths for those who have completed the POE Program include box plant leadership/management positions in Production or Maintenance. **Principle Accountabilities:** * Rotate through all departments at a corrugated plant, completing assigned learning objectives and technical training in each area. * Organize and implement moderate to large process improvements, problem elimination and capital/expense projects focusing on asset health and overall improved reliability. * Recommend and help drive, or implement innovative solutions to improve equipment, facility, and plant operations. * Attend and participate in POE program conferences and assigned off\-site training. * Collaborate with other Plant Optimization Engineers, the plant leadership team, and machine and maintenance operators to complete projects. * Work with the POE Mentor/manager to conceptualize a career path to follow the POE program. * Know and follow policies and procedures of the company, share information that would benefit other members of the team and find ways to improve the delivery of service to our customers. * Strive to continually strengthen PCA’s business philosophy of meeting needs and exceeding expectations for customers specifically supporting PCA’s Commitment to Service that involves doing what is right for our customers, focusing on strategies that add value and support growth, and keeping the promises that we make. **Basic Qualifications:** * A Bachelor of Science degree in engineering is required prior to starting the position. * 0\-2 years previous engineering experience, including internships and co\-ops, providing technical support in a manufacturing plant or industrial environment. * Ability to work first, second, or third shift during the production department rotation as needed. * Must be self\-driven and passionate about working in a hands\-on, manufacturing environment. * Must be able to travel as necessary and possess valid documents for travel via air and car. **Preferred Qualifications:** * A minimum of one Internship or Co\-op is preferred, especially in a manufacturing environment. * Obtaining a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Paper Engineering, Industrial \& Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Engineering Technology is preferred. Other engineering majors will be considered depending on experience. * Experience with programs such as AutoCAD, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook as well as experience with manufacturing systems like shop floor software, maintenance work order systems, etc. is preferred. * Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing or Statistical Process Control (SPC) experience preferred. The successful candidate MUST possess the following Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities: * Solid interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with production team and management. * Ability to learn quickly and put new knowledge into practice. * Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with individuals throughout the company on departmental procedures, policies, practices, and requests for information. * Strong listening, evaluating, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to create alternative solutions and meet deadlines. * Leadership experience or strong leadership skills with the drive to lead others. * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to network and build relationships with individuals of various experiences and professional levels both within and outside of the company. * Previous work experience as a member of a team, or a strong understanding of the importance of open communication and information sharing between team members. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS * Starting salary range for position: 83,000\-87,000\. * Bonus: Annual – Based upon individual contribution and overall, Company performance. * Paid Vacation: Three (3\) weeks per calendar year. Pro\-rata Vacation during the initial year of hire based upon start date within the calendar year. * Paid Holidays. * Within the first 30 days of employment, an employee (and their dependents) is eligible to enroll in certain benefit coverages \-\- medical, dental, and vision – and are automatically enrolled in life, AD\&D, and disability coverages. * Upon hire, an employee is automatically enrolled in the 401k plan. The plan offers both pre\-tax and Roth contribution options along with employer provided matching contributions. * Disclaimer: The Compensation and Benefits information in this posting represents PCA’s good faith and reasonable estimate of what it may pay for this position. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law. PCA is an Equal Opportunity Employer Qualified Applicants must apply at careers.packagingcorp.com to be considered.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
jobs.description: **A World\-Changing Company** Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data\-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. **The Role** The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real\-time events and user\-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP. You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first\-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software. A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share. ### **Technologies We Use** * Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs * Open\-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg * Industry\-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub * Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms ### **Core Responsibilities** * Build and maintain Foundry’s first\-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve. * Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo. * Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain. * Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms. * Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on. * Develop reusable security frameworks and tooling that make secure connectivity a consistent part of connector development and execution. * Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability. * Establish shared testing frameworks, compatibility checks, and release practices that keep a large connector portfolio reliable and maintainable. * Help prepare and maintain Palantir connectivity software for open\-source use, including its APIs, packaging, jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Perry Weather** Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on\-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%\+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow. We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk. **About the Role** You will lead the team that builds and improves the systems deciding when weather is unsafe at a stadium, a school, or a job site, and what happens next. You set technical direction, write production code most weeks, and lead through designs, reviews, and coaching. You will move the team toward one shared rule for when conditions are unsafe, alerts that reach the right siren exactly once, and closed deals that reach the ERP without manual entry. The team owns the policy engine, the policy templates customers configure, the sirens and strobes that act on each decision, partner integrations such as Singlewire, and the HubSpot to Acumatica sync for closed deals. Hardware, support, sales, and finance all depend on these systems. Stack: C\# and .NET on Azure Kubernetes, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, React and React Native, and Terraform. You will build with AI coding agents every day. **Responsibilities** * Make one source of truth for "conditions are unsafe." Several services keep their own copy of that rule today, and the copies can disagree. Pick the version, move callers to it one at a time, and delete the rest. * Make the message paths reliable end to end. When a command to a siren is sent twice or never, or a partner webhook carries the wrong trigger, find the shared cause and fix it in the design so that whole class of failure stops. * Co\-own the service that sends commands to field hardware with our hardware team, from the software decision to the device that acts on it. * Finish the HubSpot to Acumatica sync so every closed deal reaches the ERP on its own, failures alert and can be replayed, and manual order entry goes away. * Write designs that other teams review, push back on, and build on. * Bring down reliability numbers several teams share (incidents customers find before we do, pages per day, time to detect) and keep them down after you move on. * Coach senior engineers until they own systems and designs of their own. * Review closely, take your turn on call, and help set how the team works with AI agents. **Requirements** * 8\+ years shipping production software, including time as technical lead for four to six engineers while you still wrote code. * Event\-driven systems you designed and ran in production: services that talk through queues, consumers that handle the same message twice safely, retries, and dead\-letter queues. * A system you split into services along domain lines. You can say where each boundary sits and why. * Backend depth in a statically typed language. We use C\#; strong Java, Go, or Kotlin carries over. * Judgment with AI\-generated code. Agent output often looks right when the logic is wrong. You check it against the requirement and can explain every line you ship. * Willingness to be on call. Our customers get alerts during severe weather, and a dropped alert can put someone at risk. **Nice to have:** Azure Service Bus or MassTransit, Kubernetes, SQL Server, IoT or field\-deployed hardware, real\-time weather or geospatial data, and React or React Native. **Benefits** * **You'll want to come into the office.** Our Oak Lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. The whole team is here Monday through Friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over Slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days. * **Your wellbeing is covered.** Competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics. * **Good people, good times.** Monthly All\-Hands, Office Olympics, happy hours, and more. We take the work seriously and the culture seriously too. * **You're getting in early, and that matters.** We're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. The people joining now will help shape what Perry Weather becomes.

jobs.title: Design Verification Engineer, New Grad (AI-Driven)
jobs.description: Who we are: Persimmons is building the infrastructure that will power the next decade of AI. Founded in 2023 by veteran technologists from the worlds of semiconductors, AI systems, and software innovation, We're on a mission to enable smarter devices, more sustainable data centers, and entirely new applications the world hasn't imagined yet. Why join us: We're growing fast and looking for bold thinkers, builders, and curious problem\-solvers who want to push the limits of AI hardware and software. If you're ready to join a world\-class team and play a critical role in making a global impact \- we want to talk to you. What you'll do: As a Design Verification Engineer, New Grad (AI\-Driven), you will be responsible for running and sharpening the tools that check our RTL designs against physical implementation, catching issues early and helping the team move with confidence. Your primary duties and responsibilities include: * Run daily RTL\-to\-physical\-design verification checks using our design tool suite, flagging discrepancies before they become costly problems downstream. * Leverage AI\-powered tools to speed up error detection, root\-cause analysis, and iteration cycles across design checks. * Partner with senior RTL and physical design engineers to understand what correct looks like for each block, building judgment that goes beyond a checklist. * Investigate unfamiliar problems by pulling together documentation, team knowledge, and AI tooling to find the fastest path to a working answer. * Build lightweight scripts and automations that make the next design check faster and more reliable than the last one. * Communicate clearly with the design and verification teams about what you found, why it matters, and what should happen next. * Grow into broader RTL and verification responsibilities as you build hands\-on fluency with our toolchain and design flow. **Requirements** What You Bring To The Table: * + Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Math, or a related technical field, and a track record of picking up new tools or subjects quickly and running with them. + Problem\-Solving Mindset: A track record of picking up new tools or subjects quickly and running with them, whether that came from coursework, personal projects, research, or somewhere else entirely. You like testing yourself on new kinds of problems, whether they turn out to be electrical, algorithmic, or software. We care much less about which specific tool or language you’ve already used and much more about how fast you can get up to speed on the next one. + AI Tool Fluency: Genuine comfort and curiosity using AI\-assisted tools to work through unfamiliar problems; you don’t just use AI, you know how to get real answers out of it. + Technical Foundation: Exposure to digital logic design, computer architecture, or hardware description languages. + Systems Comfort: Working familiarity with SystemVerilog. Nice\-to\-have experience with Linux/bash environments and basic scripting. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and benefits package * Flexible PTO * 401k Please note: Our organization does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from external recruiters or agencies. Any such submissions, regardless of form (including but not limited to email, direct messaging, or social media), shall be deemed voluntary and shall not create any express or implied obligation on the part of the organization to pay any fees, commissions, or other compensation. Direct contact of employees, officers, or board members regarding employment opportunities is strictly prohibited and will not receive a response.

jobs.title: .Net Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Team** It’s an exciting time in technology, and that buzz is felt throughout PetSmart! We are continuing to grow at a faster pace and we want to continue to provide best\-in\-class experiences for pets and pet parents. Our **Technology team**has 6 different departments: Information Security, Service Delivery, Business Enabling Systems, eCommerce \& Marketing Technology, Data and Stores, Services \& Supply Chain. Whether it’s online or in our stores, the work that the IT team does is instrumental in PetSmart’s success. We have a strategic and actionable plan underway and are looking for associates who are just as excited about it as we are. **About the Location** **Collaborative Work Environment:** At PetSmart, teamwork and connection are core to how we thrive. This role is based at our Phoenix Home Office, with an expectation of working a minimum of four days in the office each week. In a standard work week, associates may work up to one remote “flex day” (with leader approval). Our hybrid approach is designed to foster strong collaboration while also supporting flexibility and individual success. **About the Job** The .NET Engineer develops, maintains, and enhances PetSmart’s custom applications and Point of Sales/Cash Register (POS) integrations, working on a mix of existing solutions and future capabilities. The role includes front\-end development and responsibility for application uptime, reliability, security, and maintainability. This engineer partners with the SRE and other technology teams to deliver dependable applications and resolve production issues across the supported environment. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Lead analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of custom C\#/.NET applications and POS integrations, including workloads in GCP. * Develop and maintain application front ends and backend functionality, translating business needs into usable, maintainable solutions. * Enhance existing applications and build new solutions; address defects, technical debt, dependency updates, and supported runtime upgrades. * Own application\-level diagnosis, code fixes, uptime, and reliability improvements; complete monitoring work identified by the SRE and collaborate on service recovery. * Develop and troubleshoot APIs, workers, services, and integrations, including GCP workloads using Kubernetes, Apigee, Cloud SQL, service mesh, Pub/Sub, and Gemini AI. * Support the team’s application landscape, which includes .NET web applications, React/JavaScript, Node.js services, SQL databases, and MongoDB. * Write and maintain automated tests, conduct code reviews, and establish application design and coding practices with the engineering team. * Review and approve releases with senior engineers; validate application quality, plan safe deployments and rollback procedures, and support POS lab testing. * Lead monitoring and observability across POS applications, integrations, store\-device signals, cloud workloads, and vendor\-hosted services; develop actionable dashboards and alerts. * Lead reliability practices, service health measurement, and coordination of recovery across systems. * Provide Level 3 incident response, coordinate technical diagnosis and recovery with internal teams and vendors, and communicate service impact and recovery progress. * Lead root cause analysis, identify recurring failure patterns, and drive corrective actions that prevent incidents and reduce operational risk. * Automate repetitive operational work and improve health checks, troubleshooting procedures, and incident runbooks. * Improve recovery readiness and identify monitoring work for application engineers; guide implementation and validate that resulting monitoring supports reliable operations. * Mentor associate engineers, document application behavior and dependencies, and share knowledge with analysts, engineers, and support partners. * Use ServiceNow as the primary incident management and ticketing system, and Jira and Confluence for project management, work tracking, and documentation. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with at least five years of C\# software development experience. * Experience developing and maintaining C\#/.NET web applications, including front\-end functionality, APIs, and SQL databases. * Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent cloud platform. * Experience troubleshooting production applications and improving uptime, performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Strong object\-oriented programming, application design, automated testing, code review, and software development lifecycle skills. * Ability to provide technical guidance, collaborate across teams, and communicate clearly through technical documentation and incident updates. **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Experience with React or JavaScript, Node.js, MongoDB, and existing .NET Framework/MVC applications, and messaging platforms is highly desired. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience with retail/POS systems. **Location and Work Schedule** ============================== This role is remote within Costa Rica. Primary working hours align with Mountain Standard Time (MST) in Phoenix, Arizona. On\-site attendance is required as needed for POS lab testing and during visits by company vice presidents; there is no fixed on\-site schedule. Participation in a rotating on\-call schedule is required, providing 24/7 coverage for one week, currently estimated at approximately once per month. Additional after\-hours work may be required based on business needs. Opportunities to work voluntarily on holidays will be offered. **About Technology Operations** =============================== This role is part of Technology Operations, which keeps PetSmart’s systems within our area of responsibility reliable, available, and running efficiently so store and home office associates can do their work. You will navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and help teams move issues toward resolution. At times, you will lead discussions about unfamiliar systems or problems, ask focused questions, and coordinate internal teams and external partners with urgency. Restoring service may require occasional work outside regular hours, including evenings, weekends, and participation in the required on\-call rotation. **About the Culture** Our associates are the heart of Team PetSmart. Together, we’re building the best team in retail through our values\-based culture, connection, and teamwork. Our goal is to create a culture where associates learn and grow together, thrive as effective teams and challenge each other to be the best they can be. Our Costa Rica office offers outstanding amenities in a fun and rewarding workplace including: * You will be able to bring your pets to work! * Free access to UltraPark gym facility * Learn more about \#Life AtPetSmart here: https://www.lifeatpetsmart.com/life\-at\-petsmart/ * Check out Associate stories and share in some celebrations at PetSmart: https://www.blog.lifeatpetsmart.com/ * Will have medical, dental \& vision benefits for all associates * Offer paid time off including holidays and discretionary days PetSmart provides an equal opportunity for all associates and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics.

coroutines and Flow, including cancellation, error handling, and safe UI updates. * An understanding of the Android application lifecycle, navigation, and state management, with experience structuring features into maintainable, testable components. * Experience integrating APIs and handling loading states, errors, and local data persistence. * Experience writing automated tests and using Android debugging and profiling tools to investigate defects and performance issues. * Familiarity with Git, pull requests, continuous integration, automated builds, and Android release workflows. * Experience working in an Agile team and contributing to refinement, estimation, and delivery. * The ability to understand business requirements, explain technical choices clearly, and collaborate with engineering and non\-engineering partners. * A practical approach to balancing delivery needs with maintainability and longer\-term technical direction. * Relevant software engineering knowledge gained through professional experience, education, or a combination of both. **Helpful experience**These are additional strengths, rather than requirements for every candidate: * Experience building native Android applications with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. * Building accessible mobile interfaces and supporting assistive technologies. * Working with app store submissions, release automation, and staged rollouts. * Using crash reporting, analytics, and performance monitoring to improve released features. * Building retail, e\-commerce, loyalty, or appointment\-booking experiences. * Working on applications with a large customer base or integrations across multiple enterprise systems. * Improving development practices, evaluating new technologies, or mentoring junior engineers. **Bring your perspective**Great mobile experiences come from people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking. Even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, if you can independently deliver quality mobile software, enjoy collaborating, and want to make everyday experiences better for pet parents, we’d love to hear from you. **About the Culture** Our associates are the heart of Team PetSmart. Together, we’re building the best team in retail through our values\-based culture, connection, and teamwork. Our goal is to create a culture where associates learn and grow together, thrive as effective teams and challenge each other to be the best they can be. jobs.title: Software Development Process – Engineer
jobs.description: **Title**: Software Development Process – Engineer **Location**: **Wabtec** (formerly GE Transportation), Erie, PA **Job Description**: Our company is seeking a high\-caliber Software Development Process Engineer to assist driving software process engineering and quality governance support across our global Controls Software teams. In this role, you will work to standardize, deploy, and continuously improve engineering frameworks across the organization to ensure world\-class product quality. Your mission is to act as a catalyst for organizational change by institutionalizing development best practices, leveraging deep root\-cause analysis, and managing data\-driven quality systems at scale. You will support defined software quality assurance parameters that are executed, with success measured by the visible first\-time yield analysis of the released products. **Key Responsibilities** * **Process Governance \& QMS:** Oversee the tailored documentation and maintenance of the Documents Inventory List within a large, matrixed Quality Management System (QMS). * **Metrics \& Analytics:** Define, deploy, and track software metrics, converting complex performance data into actionable Software Quality Governance Reports. * **Continuous Improvement:** Support cross\-functional optimization projects of varying size and complexity, keeping a systematic track of progress in the continuous process improvement project report. * **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** work on risk assessments and process gap analyses utilizing professional quality control tools (e.g., 5\-Why, Fishbone diagrams). * **Training \& Coaching:** Instruct diverse software teams to ensure comprehensive process adherence, while standardizing official training records. * **Operational Leadership:** Assist cultural and technical alignment across multiple development methodologies (including Waterfall, Iterative, and Agile) to balance delivery priorities and protect project timelines. **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** Educational background in Engineering, Software Development, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. * **Experience Baseline:** 2–3 years of overall experience working within Software Development or Software Quality Assurance environments. * **Governance Specialization:** At least 1\+ year of dedicated experience focused strictly on Software Quality Assurance, software process auditing, or quality governance. * **Methodology Expertise:** Hands\-on experience navigating and implementing diverse development frameworks (Waterfall, Iterative, Agile/Scrum, etc.). * **Organizational Change:** A proven track record of deploying industry\-leading development techniques and driving process adoption across varying team cultures and complex environments. * **Quality \& Planning Tools:** Practical experience using traditional QC problem\-solving toolsets along with strong day\-to\-day proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Visio for mapping and data organization. * **Leadership \& Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills jobs.title: Performance & Debug Software Engineer – AI Inference
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** ===================== Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Our first\-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting\-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway. **Role Overview** ================= This engineer will improve end\-to\-end large language model (LLM) inference performance on Positron's custom AI accelerators, including our FPGA\-based Atlas systems and our Titan systems built on the Asimov ASIC. The work spans hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, distributed KV cache, and scalable inference serving architectures. It covers profiling, algorithms, GPU\-side data preparation, host\-to\-device data movement, runtime behavior, and measurement on production\-relevant models. You will join a small, performance\-focused team that is expected to optimize the whole stack, and not merely tune isolated kernel interfaces. The goal is to sustain a repeatable path from observing workload symptoms to identifying root causes and creating measured improvements. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Performance Profiling and Optimization** * Profile and optimize latency, throughput, utilization, and efficiency across hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator configuration, the device runtime, host software, and on\-device execution. * Use performance counters, hardware and software traces, telemetry, and simulation to isolate regressions and validate fixes. ### **Distributed Inference and KV Cache** * Develop and optimize distributed inference capabilities, including efficient KV cache management and data movement across heterogeneous hardware. ### **Benchmarking and Test Infrastructure** * Build representative benchmarks and workload traces that expose bottlenecks in compute, memory, chip\-to\-chip interconnect, networking, scheduling, and model loading. * Partner with test engineers embedded in the team to turn performance findings into durable regression tests and release gates. ### **Architecture Influence** * Influence hardware and software architecture and interfaces where measured performance reveals a structural limitation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Strong C\+\+ and Python skills, with hands\-on experience profiling and optimizing complex systems that exercise Linux VFIO interfaces.. * Deep understanding of memory hierarchy, concurrency, data movement, batching, scheduling, and performance measurement. * Hands\-on experience using profilers, counters, traces, and statistical methods to distinguish signal from noise. * Demonstrated ability to debug across application, runtime, driver, firmware, and hardware boundaries. * Experience bringing up software on new silicon, and debugging and analyzing performance optimizations in customer production deployments. * Enthusiasm for AI\-accelerated software development, including using coding agents and orchestrating subagents to move faster without compromising engineering outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with CUDA, HIP, Triton, GPU kernel development, distributed inference, or KV cache systems. * Familiarity with transformer inference, mixture\-of\-experts (MoE) models, model serving, FPGA or ASIC accelerators. * Working knowledge of Perfetto, Linux perf, eBPF, simulation, or hardware performance counters. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Within the first 12 months: * A baseline performance scorecard exists for priority workloads, with repeatable measurement and clearly identified bottlenecks. * At least one major bottleneck in hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, or distributed inference has been removed, with an automated regression guard in place. * A key distributed inference data path has a working implementation with quantified end\-to\-end cost. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Work on a small, high\-leverage performance team with the mandate to debug and improve the full stack, from application code down to firmware and hardware, rather than being confined to a single layer. * Help shape the distributed inference architecture and KV cache strategy for a custom inference accelerator at a formative stage, with direct influence over interfaces and system design. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $300,000\. jobs.title: QA/QC Program Engineer
jobs.description: **About Prime Data Centers** Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15\-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership. **About the role** The Quality Assurance/ Quality Control (QA/QC) Program Engineer serves as the quality authority across the full equipment lifecycle — from factory floor through energization, integrated systems testing, and turnover to Operations. The QA Engineer role owns the verification chain that confirms every piece of Owner Furnished / Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment is built, tested, documented, tagged, installed, and turned over exactly as specified in the approved submittals and drawings. **What you'll do** Working in close partnership with Procurement, Engineering, Commissioning, Construction, the General Contractor (GC), and Site Engineering, the QE manages the factory witness and acceptance test program, performs audits of documentation, drives Root Cause Analysis and enforces accountability against the construction and commissioning plans. The position is fundamentally an Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) role: findings must be documented, traceable, and pursued to 100% closure — not observed and set aside. Prime is strategically placing quality engineering personnel in each of its domestic development hubs: Denver, Phoenix, Chicago, Dallas, and Austin. * Manage and maintain all vendor factory visits through the Factory Witness Test/ Factory Acceptance Test (FWT/FAT) Tracker, including scheduling, scope, and assignment of responsible parties from the Procurement and Engineering teams. * Assist in providing factories with current standard operating procedures and approved test scripts in advance of the visit, ensuring a controlled testing environment and meaningful, usable data takeaways. * Partner with Procurement and Engineering to conduct a high\-quality review of the equipment. * Identify and document all deficiencies discovered during onsite factory visits, propose corrective next steps * Document OFCI equipment findings establishing the objective evidence trail from factory to field. * Ensure asset tag data for OFCI gear for traceability and verify that nomenclature matches the approved RFI drawings or the superseding approved revision. * Verify entry of the same asset tag data into the site equipment management system. * Reconcile discrepancies between tag data, submittals, and drawing revisions before they propagate downstream into maintenance and asset management records. * Direct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for inconsistencies and errors discovered during QAQC review of GC documentation and confirming corrective action effectiveness. * Escalate systemic documentation failures to Operations management with supporting data. * Conduct a review of OFCI set\-in\-place equipment * Document all field discrepancies. * Participate in and document pre\-energization cleanliness walks. * Attend and document the energization event for gear. * Coordinate with Construction and Commissioning personnel to conduct the Pre\-IST Open Issues Review. * Coordinate with Construction and Commissioning personnel to conduct the Post\-IST Lessons Learned session * Conduct weekly Lessons Learned Follow\-Up Meetings with the project team to review the status of open follow\-up actions. * Perform a quality and accuracy review of the switch, breaker, and valve As\-Found / As\-Left line\-ups. * Coordinate the turnover walk with the site operations team prior to their assuming custody of the equipment * Ensure material condition is maintained current with accurate ticket numbers, status, and defined next steps. * Coordinate with site engineers to routine material condition status calls addressing OFCI open issues. * Generate material condition reports for Operations management. * Participate in GC meetings and calls for the project, representing the owner's interests, and ensuring that every effort is made to correct outstanding issues. * Enforce accountability for parties responsible for failures in execution of the construction and commissioning plan and for delays to schedule, supported by documented evidence rather than assertion. * Lead or support audits, reviews, and working discussions with Site Engineers targeting the resolution of open issues. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline — or equivalent combination of military technical training (e.g., Navy Nuclear Power Program) and directly relevant field experience. * 7\+ years of QA/QC experience in mission critical, data center, industrial, or comparable high\-reliability construction environments. * Demonstrated experience in RFP review, equipment submittal review, and in\-depth equipment inspection. * Working command of Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) principles and documentation standards. * Direct experience witnessing factory acceptance testing of electrical and mechanical gear (switchgear, UPS, generators, transformers, switchboards, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, valves). * Practical fluency with commissioning Levels 1–5, IST execution, and pre\-energization safety and cleanliness protocols. * Proficiency with Cx Alloy or an equivalent commissioning management platform; ability to become proficient in MCIM and MCAP. * Demonstrated ability to lead formal Root Cause Analysis using structured methodology (5\-Why, Fishbone, Fault Tree, or equivalent). * Ability to read and interpret single\-line diagrams, P\&IDs, sequences of operation, control drawings, and submittal packages. * Strong command of/subject matter expertise in mission\-critical MEP systems — power distribution, UPSs, generators, switchgear/ATSs, chilled\-water and air/liquid cooling systems, controls (BMS/EPMS), and fire/life safety, etc. * Comfort executing responsibilities in a professional leadership role while acting as a representative of Prime * Willing and able to travel to project sites (domestic; international as the portfolio requires). **Preferred** * Professional and commissioning certifications (CxA, CQM, ACG CxA, BCxP, EIT, PE, ASQ CQE/CQA, PMP, etc) * Prior experience in an owner's representative or owner\-side quality role. * Familiarity with NETA, NFPA 70E, IEEE, and ASHRAE standards as applied to acceptance testing. * Experience implementing asset tagging and traceability programs at scale. * Experience with hyperscale and high\-density AI/GPU data center applications, including air/liquid/DTC thermal management systems. **Benefits** * Competitive salary range of $100k \- $160k along with an annual performance bonus program * 401k fully vested upon enrollment, up to a 4% employer match * 100% employee premiums paid by employer for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability * Paid Time Off \+ Sick time *Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.* Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants are considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, protected veteran or military status, disability status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. \#LI\-Onsite
