jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: Provn is helping Envorso Sports recruit a Founding AI Engineer. Please apply on our home page on Provn and take the challenge to stand\-out from competition. **About Envorso Sports** ------------------------ Envorso Sports is building the platform that runs a professional sports team's entire fan\-facing business: ticketing, website, mobile app, and increasingly commerce, CRM, and marketing, from one system instead of six disconnected vendors. Today, most teams run a fragmented stack: a website vendor, a ticketing provider, a separate mobile app, CRM tools, marketing automation, and game\-day engagement solutions bolted together. Teams don't want to pay five vendors and contractors to stitch the data together. That creates a disconnected fan journey and leaves revenue on the table. Our platform is live today with the Seattle Seawolves of Major League Rugby, and the league itself is now on the platform, with individual teams onboarding through the season. Ticketing, website, and mobile app are shipped and in production with paying customers. CRM, marketing automation, personalization, and revenue operations are what we build next, AI\-native from the start. We want candidates to know exactly where the product stands before they join. **About the Founding Engineer Role** ------------------------------------ You'll be our first in\-house engineer. This is a founding role: you'll own the fan data platform for the long term and help shape how we grow engineering, not ship one feature and move on. The problem is simple to state. Our teams and the league sit on a large fan database: ticket transactions, web and app activity, shop purchases, and email engagement. Today almost none of it is used. One salesperson calls season\-pass holders; one marketer sends a broadcast email and sees who bites. Your job is to turn that data into revenue: unify what we know about each fan across ticketing, web, app, shop, and email; decide which fans should get which offer; and deliver it through email and in\-app offers or push. Offers are concrete: a promo code for an abandoned cart, a season pass or match pass, a merch bundle, a seat upgrade. Getting the wrong offer to the wrong fan costs real money and real trust with a small, loyal fan base. You'll build for a three\-to\-five\-year horizon, not just this quarter. We need someone who thinks like an architect (data model, scale, failure handling, consent, cost) while still shipping something a team can use in weeks. You'll also be the engineer closest to our customers' front offices. Part of the job is understanding how a team's revenue and marketing operations actually work, and helping decide what we build first based on impact and effort. You'll report to Gopal Rao and work alongside our five\-engineer team in Argentina as one small group. Expect real overlap\-hours collaboration, and expect to take a problem, make the call, and ship without waiting on someone else. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the fan data platform end to end: a unified fan record across ticketing, web, app, and email, designed to hold up as we grow from one team's list to a whole league's * Ship fan segmentation and a targeted offers engine that decides which fans get which offer, and delivers it by email reactivation and in\-app offers or push * Build marketing ops and revenue ops driven by agentic AI: fan identity, segments, campaign builder and automation, and propensity, churn, and pricing models * Bring commerce into the fan record: shop purchases alongside tickets, so offers can cross\-sell merch, passes, and seat upgrades * Build the surfaces people use, in TypeScript and Next.js on web and in our mobile app, so offers are something a marketer reviews and a fan acts on, not just an API response * Design for production from day one: consent and opt\-in enforcement, no duplicate sends, failures that are visible instead of silent, and costs you can explain * Work with team front offices to understand their revenue goals, and sequence the roadmap by impact and effort * Make AI how we ship: build an AI\-native product where models change the outcome for a marketer or a fan, and run an agentic development process (AI\-SDLC) with coding agents, specs and tests as guardrails, and human review before anything reaches a fan * Help decide how engineering grows: how we scale with our Argentina team, what we build in\-house, and who we hire next **How We Hire** --------------- Apply through Provn by completing a short challenge and video walkthrough. If your submission clears the bar, you'll move straight to a conversation with our team. We don't wait to batch candidates. The process: a screen with Gopal, a technical interview, then a panel with engineering and product leaders. **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Must be authorized to work in the US. No employer\-sponsored visas for this role.

Optimize container image builds, build caching, and cluster resource scaling (e.g., Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler). * **Observability \& SRE:** Instrument system\-wide observability using OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or AWS CloudWatch. Manage centralized identity, role\-based access controls (RBAC), and secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault). * **Automation \& Internal Tooling:** Develop custom automation scripts and micro\-tools using Python (boto3\) or Go to eliminate manual toil, support automated backups, and validate disaster recovery procedures. * **Cloud Cost Governance (FinOps):** Partner with engineering teams to monitor cloud consumption, optimize resource allocation, and implement automated scaling policies to maintain cost\-efficient infrastructure. ### **Role Requirements** * **Cloud Architecture:** 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise\-grade systems on AWS (VPC, IAM, EKS/ECS, RDS, S3, EventBridge). * **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** experience with Kubernetes (EKS) or AWS ECS, including Helm templating. * **CI/CD \& Delivery:** Extensive experience implementing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) with automated testing, linting, security scanning, and artifact management (JFrog Artifactory, Sonatype Nexus, or GitHub Packages). * **Systems Programming / Scripting:** Proficiency in Python (including AWS SDK/boto3\) or Go, alongside Linux shell scripting (Bash). * **Telemetry \& Reliability:** Proven experience implementing logging, metrics, and tracing platforms (Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana) and designing structured on\-call incident responses. ### **Preferred Skills** * Experience implementing GitOps workflows with Argo CD or Flux. * Familiarity with Policy\-as\-Code frameworks (Open Policy Agent/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or Checkov). * Understanding of MLOps pipelines and supporting infrastructure for machine learning workloads (e.g., Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker). * Practical experience running OpenSearch/Elasticsearch clusters at scale. * AWS Certified Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer Professional (or other Cloud Certifications). **Travel Requirements** ----------------------- jobs.description: **Title: Sr Solution Architect (AI / Cybersecurity) \- Irving, TX (Hybrid)** Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to lead the technical design and execution of a strategic, AI\-driven cybersecurity initiative. This program aims to automate the remediation of enterprise cryptographic vulnerabilities across a portfolio of \~200 applications using autonomous LLM agents. Operating initially within an isolated InfoVision AWS Sandbox before scaling to enterprise production, you will be the definitive technical authority driving this initiative. You will architect the multi\-agent orchestration pipeline, integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), and ensure the seamless translation of enterprise security rules into executable Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) templates. This role requires a hands\-on architectural leader who can bridge the gap between DevSecOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and Generative AI to deliver a scalable, long\-term solution. Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities 1\. AI \& Agentic Orchestration Architecture Design the Agent Pipeline: Architect the cyclic graph state machines using LangGraph on AWS ECS Fargate, defining the exact hand\-offs between the Scan, Classify, Plan, and Execute agents. LLM Integration: Oversee the integration of Amazon Bedrock (Claude/Gemini APIs), designing the prompt structures and context\-handling logic required to parse complex Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and Cryptography Bill of Materials (CBOM) outputs. RAG Implementation: Architect a Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) vector system using OpenSearch to dynamically map scan findings against the established North Star rule dictionary. 2\. Cloud Infrastructure \& Security Design Infrastructure Architecture: Design and govern the secure AWS environment (VPC, IAM, CloudWatch) to initially isolate the development sandbox and eventually scale into production pipelines. State \& Approval Management: Architect the state\-management layer using DynamoDB to track remediation checkpoints \[cite: 3]. Design the "Reviewer Dashboard" using API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Cognito to enforce human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates. CI/CD \& DevOps Integration: Oversee the offshore AWS Cloud/DevOps engineers building the automated execution pipelines (AWS CodeBuild, SSM, Git PR automation). 3\. Technical Strategy \& Template Governance Rule\-to\-Template Mapping: Own the baseline mapping table. Translate the characteristic maps (provided by the on\-site data analysis team) into the logical frameworks required for the IaC remediation templates. Vulnerability Simulation \& Testing: Guide the engineering team on how to accurately inject industry\-standard cryptographic vulnerabilities (e.g., TLS 1\.2, AES\-128, hardcoded secrets) into reference applications to simulate real\-world conditions during the initial build phase. Cross\-Functional Technical Alignment: Act as the technical bridge between the on\-site secure analysis teams and the offshore AI engineering teams, ensuring the AI agents are being built to solve the correct enterprise constraints. Required Qualifications Experience: 10\+ years of progressive experience in Cloud and Software Architecture. AWS Mastery: Deep, demonstrable expertise in AWS networking, compute (ECS/Fargate), and serverless data stores (DynamoDB, OpenSearch, API Gateway, Lambda) \[cite: 3]. AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification is highly preferred. Generative AI: Hands\-on architectural experience with Generative AI orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain) and LLM APIs (Amazon Bedrock, Claude, Gemini). DevSecOps: Strong foundation in DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform), and automated remediation pipelines. Security Acumen: Ability to understand complex enterprise encryption standards (TLS, IPsec, AES\-256\) and how they translate to infrastructure configurations. Pay: $60\.00 \- $65\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

distributing technical ownership and raising the capabilities of the team. * Collaborate across engineering specialties, product, and other departments to deliver cohesive customer experiences. ### **Who You Are** * An experienced engineer who has shaped architecture and technical direction for significant production systems. * A hands\-on builder who uses AI extensively in engineering work and critically evaluates its output. * Curious and adaptable, eager to learn new technologies, languages, and approaches without becoming attached to any one of them. * Grounded in strong backend, distributed\-systems, and modern web application fundamentals. * Pragmatic about engineering tradeoffs, balancing speed, maintainability, security, and long\-term system health. * A technical leader who earns trust through judgment, collaboration, and execution rather than formal authority. * Motivated by creating meaningful products, improving how teams work, and helping other engineers succeed. jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 49613 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. **What You’ll Do:** Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy. We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero\-balanced, double\-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026\. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature. **You Have:** * 4\+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs). * Strong problem\-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems. * Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams. * Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field. * Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non\-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double\-entry system at another company is a strong plus. * Experience with large\-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event\-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement. **You will**: * Work closely with Finance, product, and other economy engineering teams to make every movement of value correct at the source. * Architect, design, implement, and operate the ledger services that record every movement of value on Roblox. * Proactively identify and address correctness, performance, auditability, and operational risks in systems where a single bad entry is a financial incident. * Design idempotent, exactly\-once write paths, plus the reconciliation that proves the books balance and the precision guarantees other teams build on. * Own both sides of the ledger: the write path that records value, and the read path that serves balances, history, and analytics from the same source of truth. * Uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and maintainability, fostering the culture of engineering excellence. jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: **About SkyPilot** ------------------ SkyPilot accelerates the world's most ambitious AI teams. SkyPilot turns fragmented AI compute across clusters into one optimized, highly available and easy\-to\-use pool: a single AI supercomputer. SkyPilot (10k\+ GitHub stars, 18M\+ downloads) manages the GPU fleets of 100s of companies, from Fortune 500s to top AI\-natives like Abridge, Applied Compute, Mistral, Unconventional AI, H Company, and Nubank, with usage growing exponentially. Born in the UC Berkeley lab behind Spark and Databricks, our growing team includes top\-tier talent from Databricks, Google, Berkeley, MIT, CMU, and Cornell. To date, SkyPilot has raised over $20M in seed funding from top investors (incl. Lux, Coatue, Amplify) and operators (incl. Ali Ghodsi, Jeff Dean, Guillermo Rauch, Amjad Masad, Clem Delangue, Aaron Levie). **The role** ------------ SkyPilot already runs inside some of the most advanced AI teams in the world, and we're hiring our Account Executive to turn that adoption into revenue. You'll own the full cycle — sourcing the pipeline, running technical sales, and closing net\-new business with AI\-native companies, foundation labs, and enterprises. You'll build SkyPilot's sales motion from the ground up, partner directly with the founders, and write the playbook the whole sales org will run as we scale. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the full cycle**: prospect, qualify, run technical evaluations alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers, and close net\-new business. * **Win the frontier AI teams**: land and expand the kinds of accounts already running SkyPilot — Abridge, Applied Compute, Mistral, and others — where the buyer is a technical leader choosing the backbone for their most important workloads. * **Wear many hats**: source your own pipeline, build the deck and the process, and own every lever of the deal from first touch to signature. * **Write the playbook**: turn what closes into a repeatable motion — messaging, qualification, pricing feedback — that the growing GTM team runs. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * A track record of closing net\-new business, ideally selling technical infrastructure or developer and data platforms to technical buyers. * **Strongly preferred:** you've sold compute, GPUs, or infrastructure to frontier AI teams or large GPU\-consuming organizations. * You've carried a number without a big machine behind you and want to build the next one from scratch. * Genuinely fluent with engineers and technical leaders — you can run a credible conversation about infrastructure. * Comfortable co\-owning the motion with founders and bringing field signal back into the product. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision coverage for you and your dependents. * Company 401(k) plan. * The chance to work with some of the best minds in cloud, distributed, and AI systems — with significant autonomy and ownership. * A front\-row seat at the latest open\-source infra startup from Berkeley. * Gourmet lunch \& dinner for the team to do their best work. **Location:** San Mateo, CA. Remote will be considered for exceptional candidates.

The role focuses on designing and building cloud\-based data pipelines, integrating data from multiple sources, and addressing data quality issues. The analyst will also develop dashboards, reports, and analytical products that deliver actionable insights from large, confidential datasets. This position partners with data scientists, research and policy analysts, and cross\-functional stakeholders, and supports data conversions tied to system modernization efforts. **Key Responsibilities** **Data Pipeline Engineering \& Cloud Solutions** * Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture. * Design and implement cloud\-based data solutions using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, EMR, Athena, Kinesis, and Lambda. * Build and maintain data orchestration workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar services. * Build the infrastructure required to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources using SQL and big data technologies. * Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional and non\-functional business requirements. **Data Quality, Monitoring \& Governance** * Develop and maintain pipeline monitoring, alerting, and logging frameworks. * Implement data quality checks and validation frameworks across pipelines. * Ensure compliance with applicable policies, data governance standards, privacy requirements, security controls, and data\-sharing agreements. * Automate manual processes, optimize data delivery, and redesign infrastructure for greater scalability. **Analytics \& Insights Delivery** * Develop dashboards, reports, analytical models, and other decision\-support products. * Build analytics tools on top of the data pipeline to provide insights into education and workforce outcomes, operational efficiency, and key performance metrics. * Engineer analytical data environments that support statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, and evidence\-building activities. * Create data tools that help analysts and data scientists build and optimize data products. **Collaboration \& Delivery** * Partner with data scientists, research analysts, and policy analysts to support reproducible research and statistical modeling. * Work with executive, data, design, and support teams to resolve data\-related technical issues and meet data infrastructure needs. * Support data conversions associated with system modernization or replacement efforts. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data services such as AWS (S3, EC2, Glue, EMR, RDS, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, DynamoDB). * 5\+ years of proficiency in object\-oriented or functional scripting languages such as Python, R, Java, C\+\+, or Scala. * 5\+ years of proficiency in relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including Oracle, MS SQL Server, Postgres, and Cassandra, with advanced SQL and query authoring skills. * 5\+ years of experience with version control systems such as Git and CI/CD pipelines. * 5\+ years of knowledge of data modeling techniques, including dimensional modeling, data vault, and star/snowflake schemas. * 5\+ years of familiarity with data cataloging and metadata management tools such as AWS Glue Data Catalog. * 5\+ years of understanding of data governance, data lineage, and data quality frameworks. * 5\+ years of knowledge of REST API design and integration patterns. * 5\+ years of experience with big data tools such as Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka. * 5\+ years of experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Azkaban, Luigi, and Airflow. * 5\+ years of experience with data integration solutions from vendors such as Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, and TIBCO. * 5\+ years of experience with stream\-processing systems such as Storm and Spark\-Streaming. * Experience building and optimizing big data pipelines, architectures, and data sets, including processes for data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency, and workload management. * Advanced proficiency designing, building, and refining dashboards, reports, analytical models, and decision\-support products for executive and non\-technical users. * Experience working with student\-level higher education data, including linking it to other sources such as employment and wage data to measure outcomes. * Experience performing root\-cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer business questions and identify improvement opportunities. * Strong analytic skills with unstructured datasets and a history of extracting value from large, disconnected datasets. * Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable big data stores. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with student\-level higher education data and linkages to employment and wage data. * Experience supporting data conversions associated with system modernization or replacement efforts. **Core Skills \& Attributes** * Work in a self\-directed manner while supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems, and products. * Apply strong analytical judgment when working with large, complex, and confidential datasets. * Demonstrate strong project management and organizational skills. * Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment. * Communicate insights clearly to executive and non\-technical audiences. * Pursue continuous improvement of data systems and functionality. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value\-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately close business. As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the database space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:** --------------------------------- * Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers * Work hands\-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation * Immerse yourself in the ever\-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them. * Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing **ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:** ------------------------------------------ * 6\+ years of industry experience with a minimum of 5 years within a pre\-sales environment * Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos. * 5\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning and generative AI solutions in the cloud. * Possesses a proactive curiosity for the AI landscape, striving to be a visionary and technical thought partner for customers navigating the space. * A proven ability to leverage AI code generation tools to accelerate productivity and efficiency. * Broad range of experience within large\-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies. For example, Data Lake, Data Mesh, Data Fabric * Hands\-on expertise with SQL,SQL analytics, and Python. * Ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solutions * Ability to do deep discovery of customer’s architecture framework and connect those with Snowflake Data Architecture. * University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred. Masters in DataScience or Business Administration is a plus. * Experience with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, etc), would be beneficial, but not required * Expect approximately 30% travel **ABOUT OUR TEAM** ------------------ Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone. *Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.* Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on\-target earnings of $220,000 \- $288,750\. The estimated base salary for this role is $165,000 \- $216,562\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Graph Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Socure?** --------------- Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. **About the Job** ----------------- Build the graph that decides who’s real. Every day, Socure’s Identity Graph helps businesses decide whether to trust the person on the other side of a screen. It links billions of signals (names, addresses, devices, emails, phones) into one picture of identity, and it does this in milliseconds. Fraudsters move fast. The graph has to be faster. As a Staff Engineer on this team, you’ll set the technical direction for the platform behind that decision. You’ll own hard problems end to end, work across Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Security, and see your work shape the products that protect millions of people. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Shape the graph. Define the schemas, relationships, and ontology that make identity data consistent and extensible. * Own entity resolution at scale. Decide how records, people, devices, and addresses connect, and how confident we are, across data that is messy, sparse, and sometimes adversarial. * Build for speed and volume. Design batch and real\-time pipelines, low\-latency APIs, and serving systems that hold up under heavy load. * Power fraud intelligence. Ship the production systems behind our ML features, model inference, and graph analytics. * Move the numbers. Improve performance, reliability, and cost, and prove it with measurements. * Set the direction. Lead architecture decisions, document the tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from first design through production rollout. * Raise the bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, and operations. * Protect identity data. Build privacy, security, and PII protection into every system from day one. * Your toolkit:Java, Scala, or Python. Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and AWS, including EMR. Graph technologies like Neo4j and Amazon Neptune. **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field * 7\+ years building and running distributed systems in the cloud, with at least 2 at Staff or Senior Staff scope, or the equivalent * Production scale you can quantify. You can tell us what you built, how big it was, and how much you improved latency, reliability, or cost * Deep Spark, Kafka, or Flink experience in both batch and streaming, including debugging them in production * Low\-latency serving. You have built and tuned APIs where milliseconds matter * Graph or entity\-resolution experience. You have modeled connected data, matched records across noisy sources, or built an identity graph. Fraud or identity verification is a strong plus * Cloud and operations fluency. AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and real production observability * ML data pipelines on Databricks, SageMaker, or similar, plus orchestration with Airflow or equivalent * Technical leadership. You have led ambiguous, cross\-team work, mentored engineers, and changed the direction of a system through design docs and influence, not authority **What This Job is Not** ------------------------ * It’s not a role for someone who hasn’t owned a system end to end in production, including being on call for it. * It’s not feature work on platforms someone else designed. * It’s not a defined backlog. You’ll frame ambiguous problems yourself. * It’s not a place to treat data privacy as a compliance checkbox. *Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.* **Follow Us!** YouTube \| LinkedIn \| X (Twitter) \| Facebook Compensation Range: $225K \- $250K

jobs.description: **About the Job** As a Full\-Stack Engineer at Splitero, you will play a crucial role in architecting, developing, and maintaining our software from marketing through origination. The salary range for this position is $140,000 \- $155,000\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **About You** * 4\-6 years of experience as a full\-stack engineer with a strong focus on back\-end technologies * Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript for front\-end and back\-end development * Strong experience with Node.js for building server\-side applications * Expertise in PostgreSQL (or similar) and database design * Experience with cloud computing platforms, specifically AWS Lambda * Extensive experience working with Claude Code (or similar) to build tools and workflows that accelerate the development lifecycle; not just individual chat use or vibe coding * Hands\-on experience working with Infrastructure\-as\-Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation * Experience implementing and working with modern analytics tools for event tracking and reporting (Mixpanel, Posthog, Google Analytics, etc) * Strong experience working with testing and quality engineering tools such as Playwright, Jest, and/or Mocha * Solid understanding of modern cloud computing pipelines and the full software development lifecycle * Proven experience working directly with product and QA teams to ensure high\-quality software delivery * Experience with Heroku Connect and Salesforce platforms is a plus * Candidates must be located in the United States. Success requires progressive cybersecurity experience, advanced knowledge of AI security and risk management, strong analytical and strategic planning capabilities, and demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive enterprise\-wide security initiatives. jobs.title: Staff Firmware Engineer - AMR
jobs.description: **About Standard Bots** ----------------------- Standard Bots' mission is to significantly lower the barrier to entry to real\-world automation, bringing the power of bits to the world of atoms and unlocking productivity for entire new industries and users. Bolt is our mobile manipulation platform: two of our robot arms on an upper body, riding an autonomous mobile base that we are designing and building in\-house. Control systems and embedded engineering are the basis of the entire company's mission, and the mobile base is built on them. **What you'll do** ------------------ We're looking for an exceptional Staff Firmware Engineer to lead the firmware of Bolt's mobile base. This role sets the firmware architecture for that base from the first prototype: drive and motor control, power and battery systems, sensors and I/O, and the communication that ties them to the robot's compute. Your impact will be measured by how quickly the first AMRs come to life on the bench and the test floor, how reliably they run once they leave it, and how strong the firmware team around you becomes. ### **Responsibilities** **Bring\-up and architecture** * **Define the Architecture:** Own the firmware architecture across every controller on the base: partitioning, communication buses, timing, update paths, and diagnostics * **Bring Up the Fleet:** Lead firmware bring\-up for each prototype build with the electrical and mechanical teams, on a hardware schedule that doesn't move. That includes board support packages, drivers, and bootloaders * **Pragmatic Trade\-Offs:** Make clear, pragmatic calls on what each build needs now and what can wait, balancing long\-term vision with timely delivery * **Shape the Hardware:** Partner with electrical engineers from schematic review onward, so every board is easy to bring up, test, and debug * **Standard Setter:** Set the coding standards, review practices, test expectations, and release process for all AMR firmware **Motion, power, and sensors** * **Motion Foundations:** Own firmware for the drive modules and their motor control. That covers current, velocity, and steering loops, encoder feedback, and coordinated control of all wheels * **Power and Batteries:** Own firmware for power sequencing, battery management communication, charging and docking, and battery swap * **Sensors and I/O:** Integrate the sensors and peripherals on the base, and deliver their data reliably to the robot's compute * **Cross\-Team Interfaces:** Define the interfaces between firmware and the navigation, fleet, and safety software, and between the base and Bolt's upper body **Quality and leverage** * **Debug Across Boundaries:** Root\-cause problems that span firmware, electrical, mechanical, and component behavior. Drive them to closure and turn them into prioritized work that prevents recurrence across the fleet * **Systemic Quality:** Build hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, fault injection, production test firmware, and diagnostic tools that catch problems before they reach a robot * **Technical Multiplier:** Mentor the AMR embedded engineers, review their designs, and help grow the team ### **Software Stack and Ownership Areas** This role owns board bring\-up, motor control, power and battery systems, sensors and I/O, and firmware test tooling for Bolt's mobile base. **Tech Stack** * **Embedded:** STM32 or similar, C / C\+\+, FreeRTOS or similar * **Communications:** CAN, EtherCAT, Ethernet * **Infrastructure \& Tooling:** Python, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, hardware\-in\-the\-loop rigs **Location** ------------ This is an on\-site role at our new Boston\-area office, where Bolt's mobile base is designed, built, and tested. There's some flexibility on days in the office once you're up to speed. The build area, electronics lab, test floor, and robots are steps from your desk. **Who you are** --------------- We're looking for a firmware leader who has taken a battery\-powered robot or vehicle from first boards to a fielded fleet. You lead by writing the hard parts yourself, and you know what it takes for firmware to survive thousands of hours on a factory floor. You're comfortable operating with complete independence. ### **Skills you'll bring** * **Experience:** 8\+ years of embedded firmware development, including leading firmware for a battery\-powered product with motors through production * **Motor Control:** Hands\-on motor control firmware experience (FOC, current sensing, encoders), ideally for traction or steering drives * **Embedded Depth:** Mastery of C / C\+\+ on microcontrollers, RTOS design, real\-time scheduling, interrupts and DMA, and peripheral drivers * **Bring\-Up Skills:** Fluent with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, and schematics. You diagnose timing, signaling, and electrical issues at the bench * **Power Systems:** Experience with power sequencing, BMS communication, and charging * **Leadership:** You've led engineers through an NPI cycle and made them better * **Cross\-Functional Influence:** Proven ability to influence technical direction without direct authority and successfully partner with hardware engineering, motion planning, safety, and executive leadership * **Clarity of Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of synthesizing complex technical risks and strategies for non\-technical leadership * **Impact Driven:** You relentlessly seek user impact and value execution over technical idealism * **Proactive Simplicity:** A relentless drive to reduce complexity, improve operational simplicity, and proactively identify organizational\-level technical risks and address them before they become crises * **Excelling in Ambitious Environments:** Your best work happened where hardware deadlines were real and the plan changed weekly ### **Nice to have** * Prior work on mobile robots, AGVs, or autonomous vehicles * Swerve, omnidirectional, or other multi\-wheel steering drive control * Functional safety development (ISO 13849, IEC 61508\) * Over\-the\-air firmware update systems for fielded fleets **Compensation** ---------------- The base salary range for this role is \[$200,000 to $230,000], depending on experience. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All full\-time employees are eligible for employee stock options. We also offer paid time off, medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and a 401(k) to regular full\-time employees. Compensation Range: $180K \- $215K

jobs.description: **About Stem** \- *Driven by human and artificial intelligence – Stem is unlocking energy intelligence.* Stem is a global leader reimagining technology to support the energy transition. We help asset owners, operators and stakeholders benefit from the full value of their energy portfolio by enabling the intelligent development, deployment, and operation of clean energy assets. At our core, Stem is at the momentous intersection of clean energy and software technology where diverse ideas, experiences, and professional skills converge to make the inclusive culture we have today. Together, we are turning old school thoughts about software and energy into progressive, collaborative, and innovative solutions. By joining our team, you will be collaborating with data scientists, energy experts, skilled salespeople, thought\-leading executives and more from a range of backgrounds. This intersection of ideas, beliefs, and skills is what makes us unique enough to lead the world’s largest network of digitally connected energy storage systems. **Position Overview:** ---------------------- As Director, Project Engineering – Americas, you will lead the Americas engineering organization and own the technical design and implementation of Data Acquisition Systems (DAS), SCADA, Power Plant Controllers (PPC), Energy Management Systems (EMS), and site networking for solar, energy storage, and hybrid projects across BTM and FTM, C\&I, and utility\-scale work. You will ensure engineering deliverables are technically correct, built to standard, and released on time and within budget, and you will scale the organization by turning custom engineering into standard designs and repeatable workflows. This role is the engineering counterpart to the Director of PMO. The PMO owns schedule, scope, and customer delivery. This role owns technical design, engineering quality, and engineering standards. Together, the two roles form the Americas delivery leadership team. The ideal leader is a hands\-on technical expert who can also run an organization. This is someone who enjoys solving hard controls and SCADA problems, and who wants to build the processes, standards, and people that let the team deliver more projects at higher quality. **Organizational Scope:** ------------------------- ### **Direct reports (all based in Broomfield, CO)** * **Manager, Drafting \& Design:** Single\-line diagrams, IFC packages, panel layouts, communication schematics, BOMs, and as\-builts * **Manager, Project Engineering – C\&I:** DAS and monitoring, BTM storage, and C\&I controls and export limiting * **Manager, Project Engineering – Utility:** Utility SCADA, PPC, EMS, FTM BESS, interconnection and grid code compliance, and substation integration ### **Key partners (no direct reporting line)** * Sales, Technical Sales Engineering, PMO, Field Services, Support, and Project Delivery – EMEA **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * **Technical escalation:** Act as the engineering escalation point for complex sites, non\-standard configurations, and technical customer issues, working with Development on advanced product issues. Stay current on grid technology, grid codes, and microgrid architectures, and translate them into design standards. * **Global alignment:** Align engineering procedures and best practices with the EMEA, India, and Japan engineering teams to support a consistent global delivery model. * **Sales support:** Provide engineering review during the sales process, including intake forms, SOWs, risk identification, and budgetary proposals, and gate non\-standard scope before contract. * **Cross\-functional handoffs:** Define clear handoffs with partner teams: field learnings into Product roadmaps, BOM accuracy and engineering change notices with Production, resource loading and engineering hour estimates with the PMO, and Tier 3 escalation paths with Support and Field Services. Measure process performance and improve the highest\-cost handoff points. * **Drafting \& Design:** Maintain drawing standards, symbol libraries, and design templates, and drive automation and reuse of standard design blocks to increase throughput. * **C\ t engineering in business reviews, acting on the SVP’s behalf as delegated. * **Team development:** Lead, mentor, and develop engineering managers, and build growth tracks that develop entry\-level engineers and drafters into senior and leadership roles. **Qualifications:** ------------------- ### **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field. * 12\+ years of engineering experience in solar, energy storage, or a related power industry. * 5\+ years directly managing engineers, including managers of engineering teams, plus experience managing departmental budget and headcount. * 5\+ years designing or delivering utility\-scale SCADA, PPC, or EMS solutions. * Experience overseeing drafting and design teams producing SLDs, IFC packages, and BOMs. * Knowledge of grid stability, interconnection requirements, and grid codes such as IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800, and NERC IBR requirements. * Demonstrated experience with closed\-loop control design, tuning, and troubleshooting, including PID and feed\-forward architectures. * Working knowledge of Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850, and OPC protocols; serial, fiber, and Ethernet standards; and OT networking (switches, modems, firewalls, VPNs, LANs, VLANs). * Experience working within a quality management system (design control, change management, RCA/corrective action) and building scalable processes in a growing organization. * Strong communication skills with technical and non\-technical audiences, from field engineers to executives and customers. ### **Preferred** * Experience supporting ISO 9001 or supplier quality audits; internal auditor or ASQ certification. * Experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, SEL controllers, or IEC 61131 programming; Python or C\# scripting. * Background in BESS and hybrid solar\-plus\-storage projects, including OEM integration. * Familiarity with market and regulatory frameworks (CAISO, ERCOT, PJM) and OT cybersecurity standards (NERC CIP, IEC 62443\). * Experience with new market entry or international deployments, especially LATAM; Spanish or Portuguese skills; experience leading globally distributed teams. * Knowledge of PowerTrack, NetSuite, Jira, Confluence, and AutoCAD Electrical. **Location \& Travel** ---------------------- **Location:** Broomfield, CO (Hybrid, 2–3 days per week in office) **Travel:** 10–20%, including customer sites, commissioning, the production facility, and new market development To learn more about Stem, visit our stem.com where you’ll find information about our solutions, technology, partners, case studies, resources, latest news and more. Here are some relevant links: * Company Overview * Newsroom * Insights * LinkedIn **What We Offer:** **At Stem,** you will work in a growing, innovative, mission\-driven company with talented colleagues that have a passion for building renewable energy systems. Stem offers competitive compensation as well as a comprehensive set of benefits to support the health and wellness of our employee including: * A competitive compensation package, including eligibility for a bonus or commission based on the role. * Full health benefits on the first day of employment (several medical plan options\-HDHP and PPO, dental plans, FSA/HSA\-with employer contribution, employer paid vision/LTD/STD/Life, variety of voluntary coverage) * 401k (pre\- or post\-tax) on first day of employment * 12 paid calendar holidays per year * Flexible time\-off **Stem, Inc**. is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, pregnancy, religion, national origin, ethnicity, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, military status, protected veteran status or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. **The pay range for this role is:** 162,480 \- 243,720 USD per year(US National)

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Core AI
jobs.description: **About Sycamore** ================== Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need. We are a small, engineering\-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders. **Where you could focus** ========================= Core AI owns the horizontal runtime, intelligence, and improvement capabilities that Product and Infrastructure both depend on, along with the Sycamore Forge experiences that make them usable. Engineers here own end\-to\-end slices, from cloud service and API design through the React interface. The team covers four related areas, and you do not have to pick one to apply. Tell us what you have built and we will work out the fit together. **The agent runtime.** Multi\-turn sessions, model routing, tool execution, memory, durable workflows, and the APIs that expose them. The hard part is correctness across long horizons: surviving retries, provider interruptions, partial failure, and context growth without losing the thread. **Harnesses and environments.** An agent that writes and runs code needs somewhere to do it. That environment has to start fast, isolate genuinely untrusted execution, reach only the services it legitimately needs, and carry credentials it can use but never read. The same area owns the verification layer that decides whether what an agent produced actually works rather than only appears to. **Evaluation.** Agent quality is genuinely hard to measure. A change that looks better on a handful of examples often is not, and a judge model can be confidently wrong in the same direction as the system it grades. This is where the offline suites, replay corpora, and statistical discipline that gate a release come from. **Self\-improving systems.** Every agent run produces evidence, and almost all of it is currently thrown away. This area turns it into improvement: structured trajectories at fleet scale, failure clusters surfaced from production rather than guessed at, and proposed changes that are versioned, measured, staged, and reversible. **What you will do** ==================== * Develop the learning data plane around agents: structured trajectories, feedback and outcome signals, offline datasets, lineage, privacy controls, and reliable links between an agent version and its behavior. * Create evaluation systems for task completion, tool use, long\-horizon behavior, safety, latency, and cost, and own the credibility of the numbers they produce. * Design experiment and versioning systems for comparing changes through replay, shadow traffic, canaries, or controlled rollouts, with clear promotion and rollback criteria. * Build durable orchestration for long\-running tasks, checkpoints, approvals, handoffs, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions, with typed tool interfaces, protocol\-based execution, and memory retrieval that enforces tenant, user, and project visibility boundaries. * Own the execution environments agents run in, including isolation, startup performance, resource limits, and cost, and the policy layer that gates self\-modification so a proposed change is staged and tested rather than applied silently. * Publish reliable APIs, event\-driven interfaces, and reusable libraries that work across agent categories and enterprise deployments. **The environment you will work in** ==================================== Our current Core AI environment includes Python cloud services; React and TypeScript product surfaces in Sycamore Forge; asynchronous and streaming systems; typed APIs and data models; relational and vector data; durable workflows; protocol\-based tool execution; multiple model providers; and cloud\-native deployment. We use coding agents, automated tests, traces, evaluations, browser automation, offline replay, cost and latency signals, and production feedback as part of everyday engineering. We are building toward a governed collect, learn, evaluate, and apply loop rather than a single monolithic training system. This is context, not a checklist. We do not require previous experience with every language, framework, model provider, cloud platform, database, or infrastructure tool in our stack. Comparable experience building distributed runtimes, experimentation platforms, retrieval or recommendation systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or production AI systems is highly relevant. **What we are looking for** =========================== * 5\-12 years of software engineering experience. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction. * Strong backend and distributed\-systems fundamentals, including typed API design, asynchronous workflows, persistence, reliability, and production debugging. * Real depth in at least one of the areas above, and genuine interest in working across the others. * An empirical approach to AI quality: you can form a hypothesis, design a useful evaluation, interpret noisy evidence, and distinguish a real improvement from movement in a proxy metric. * The ability to reason about retries, idempotency, partial failure, long\-running state, concurrency, latency, cost, experiment design, and safe rollout. * A security\-minded approach to multi\-tenant systems, identity, authorization, credentials, tool execution, privacy, and auditability. * Product judgment. You can find a durable abstraction behind a real requirement without generalizing too early or freezing customer\-specific behavior into the platform. * AI\-native. You use coding agents and modern models as a force multiplier while still owning architecture, correctness, evidence, and operational outcomes. * Comfort building product\-facing software. You can work in React and TypeScript when a capability needs a great interface, and reason about streaming state and accessibility. * Comfort with startup ambiguity, fast feedback loops, and broad ownership. None of the following is required, and any of them is a strong signal for a particular area: production Kubernetes work deep enough to have written controllers rather than only configured them; a real understanding of isolation boundaries and what each one does and does not contain; comfort with statistics, including the ways an experiment can mislead you; trajectory or event data at scale, including the joins, lineage, and privacy handling that make it usable; or reinforcement learning, post\-training, or large\-scale experimentation. We care more about the systems you personally built, measured, and operated than a particular company, school, language, or model vendor. **Interview process** ===================== * A 30\-minute introductory conversation. * Two 60\-minute technical interviews, one focused on systems design and one on coding. * A take\-home assignment where you build and present a real solution using the tools you would use on the job. **Why join** ============ * Build the cloud services that help enterprise agents learn from production experience. * Ship Core AI capabilities end to end in Sycamore Forge, from cloud service and API design through the React experience customers use. * Turn production outcomes into governed improvements used across customers. * Shape how feedback\-driven learning, agent evaluation, and safe self\-improvement work in a high\-trust enterprise setting. * Join early enough to shape the Core AI architecture and engineering team. * Receive competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity in the company you are helping build.

SAP experience is a plus. * Self\-motivated, able to follow directions and meet deadlines * Strong background in control systems, ladder logic, and drive systems * Ability to create, read, and update blueprints, P\&ID’s, schematics, and other drawings * Develop creative and innovative approaches to addressing issues * Strong problem\-solving abilities for controls and electrical applications **You will get:** * Competitive salary and benefits package. * The U.S. base salary range reasonably expected to be paid for this position is $99,000\.00 \- $123,000\.00 per year. Since actual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted base salary range. Total compensation for this role also includes bonus and/or other incentives. * 16, or more, weeks of maternity/paternity and co\-parenting leave, according to local regulations * Training platform for all employees * Free well\-being sessions (physical and psychological) About us * Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, NLP
jobs.description: **Our company** At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. **What You’ll Do** We are building the next generation of AI\-powered knowledge, reasoning, and autonomous agent platforms that operate at enterprise scale. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal NLP Engineer** to own and lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced natural language technologies powering semantic and context graphs, context analysis, intelligent search, retrieval, question answering, knowledge extraction, reasoning systems, AI agents, and enterprise copilots for Teradata Context Engine, our Autonomous Knowledge Platform. Context Engine is a platform that converts enterprise data estates into governed, agent\-ready knowledge. Built for organizations where AI reliability and auditability are non\-negotiable, Context Engine enables companies to deploy AI workflows on the data they already own — without rebuilding their infrastructure, without retraining their models, and without waiting for generic AI synthesis to learn the business terminology that took their analysts years to master. This is a deeply hands\-on technical leadership role for a recognized expert in Natural Language Processing who combines strong research foundations with proven experience shipping production systems that serve millions of users and process billions of documents. You will work at the intersection of large language models, information retrieval, knowledge graphs, semantic understanding, and agentic AI. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving breakthrough NLP capabilities from research to production and possesses deep expertise across classical NLP, modern transformer architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), multimodal understanding, information extraction, and large\-scale language model systems. Technical Leadership * Define and execute the strategic roadmap for NLP and language understanding capabilities across our Knowledge Platform. * Serve as the technical authority for large\-scale NLP architecture, algorithms, and production deployment. * Drive innovation in enterprise language understanding, semantic search, retrieval systems, knowledge extraction, and AI reasoning. NLP and Language Intelligence * Design and build advanced NLP systems for: * + Entity extraction + Relationship extraction + Information extraction + Document understanding + Semantic indexing + Context understanding and representation + Text classification + Topic modeling + Summarization + Question answering + Conversational AI + Knowledge grounding + Multi\-document reasoning + Extracting context from multi\-modal sources of language + Multi\-lingual solutions + Machine translation * Develop systems that transform unstructured enterprise content into structured knowledge assets. * Advance techniques for long\-context understanding, document intelligence, and multi\-hop reasoning. * Build domain\-adaptive language understanding models across diverse enterprise data sources. * Develop solutions with highest quality and performance * Develop solutions that are tested and validated Large Language Models * Design and optimize applications built on frontier foundation models. * Build advanced retrieval\-augmented generation architectures for enterprise\-scale environments. * Develop agentic workflows that leverage LLMs for planning, reasoning, execution, and tool usage. * Create evaluation methodologies that measure factuality, grounding, trustworthiness, and task completion. * Improve model performance through prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, continued pretraining, synthetic data generation, and reinforcement\-learning\-based approaches. Knowledge and Semantic Systems * Design NLP pipelines that power enterprise knowledge graphs and semantic layers. * Develop ontology\-aware language understanding systems. * Build entity resolution, canonicalization, taxonomy mapping, and concept extraction capabilities. * Connect language understanding with graph\-based reasoning and enterprise knowledge discovery platforms. Platform and Scale * Build highly scalable distributed NLP systems processing petabytes of enterprise content. * Optimize inference architectures for latency, throughput, cost efficiency, and reliability. * Lead deployment strategies across on\-prem, cloud\-native, hybrid, and enterprise environments. * Partner closely with platform engineering teams to operationalize NLP services at global scale. Research and Innovation * Stay at the forefront of advances in: * + Foundation models + Agentic AI + Retrieval systems + r enterprise copilots, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agents. * Expertise in enterprise search and knowledge management systems. * Experience with graph\-based reasoning and knowledge graph technologies. * Patent portfolio in NLP, machine learning, search, or language understanding. **What You’ll Bring** * Established reputation as an industry expert in NLP and language AI. * Proven record of taking breakthrough research into production at scale. * Experience building state\-of\-the\-art systems involving: * + Enterprise search + Enterprise copilots + Document intelligence + Retrieval systems + Knowledge extraction + AI agents + Semantic reasoning + Knowledge graphs * Ability to influence technical strategy across multiple organizations. * Strong balance of scientific rigor, engineering excellence, and product impact. Success Metrics Within 12 months, you will: * Define next\-generation NLP and language intelligence architecture for the platform. * Deliver measurable improvements in retrieval quality, answer accuracy, grounding, and user satisfaction. * Establish world\-class evaluation and benchmarking frameworks. * Lead development of enterprise\-scale knowledge extraction and semantic understanding capabilities. * Enable agentic AI experiences that leverage enterprise knowledge with high trust, transparency, and precision. * Raise the organization's NLP and AI capabilities to industry\-leading levels. **Why We Think You'll Love Teradata** We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users. You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data. With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R\&D domain, you bridge understanding between present\-day pain points and generalizable solutions. You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains. You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML. This role will require extreme self\-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry. **Requirements** ### **What You Have Done** You deeply understand the life science R\&D data ecosystem – you’ve felt the pain of brittle, bespoke workflows with fractured data, and you’ve actively worked to solve this. In our experience, the candidates with this experience bring the following background: * PhD with \+4 years, Masters with \+6 years, or Bachelors with \+8 years of industry experience in life sciences with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), product quality testing, or pharma manufacturing. * Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML\-driven use cases in cloud environments * Designed scalable and reusable data architecture * Collaborated with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders. * Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible. * Engage diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities. * Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes. * Augmented your technical, business, and communication work through agentic development and knowledge work * Nice to have: Hybrid dry lab / wet lab experience ### **What You Will Do** * You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI. As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the assigned geographic region, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions. * Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability. * Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform. * Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including: * + Data model design + Python\-based pipeline development. + Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs. + Data visualization and app development + Scientific agents * Leverage agentic development tools like Claude Code and Codex to contribute to discovery, prototyping, and development * Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid) and agents * Interface directly with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings * Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders. * Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform. * Rapidly learn new technologies to develop and troubleshoot use cases * Must be able to travel to client sites in local geographic areas 3\-4 days per week **Benefits** * 100% employer\-paid benefits for all eligible employees and immediate family members * Unlimited paid time off (PTO) * 401K * Company paid Life Insurance, LTD/STD * A culture of continuous improvement where you can grow your career and get coaching We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position.
