jobs.title: Manager, Software Development
jobs.description: **Join the future of news** =========================== We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most. **About Our Team** ------------------ The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award\-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand \& Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering \& Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing \& Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- The Washington Post is seeking a Manager, Software Development to lead the engineering team responsible for our iOS app, the foundation for personalization, ads, sections, articles, App Store subscription management, analytics, audio, video and more, and one of The Post’s most important channels for reader engagement. This role provides dedicated people and delivery leadership for the team while partnering closely with Android, Staff Engineering, Product, and shared engineering teams to deliver high\-quality mobile experiences quickly and predictably. This is a hands\-on engineering management role. The Manager, Software Development will set priorities and assignments, develop engineers, remove blockers, identify delivery risks early, and establish clear accountability for delivering approved work to readers, while remaining close enough to the technology to guide difficult engineering decisions. The manager is expected to write code, build prototypes, and review pull requests on a regular basis, and will partner with Staff Engineers and feature leads to verify progress, identify misalignment, and follow work through to release. The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep iOS engineering knowledge, sound technical judgment, and a disciplined approach to execution. This manager will help the team ship faster while maintaining the architecture, performance, reliability, quality, and technical health readers expect from The Washington Post’s flagship mobile experience. The role is data\-driven: priorities, estimates, improvements, and results are tracked against agreed baselines and measured by evidence, such as time to users, commitments met, blocker resolution time, and app stability and performance, not by activity or opinion. **What Motivates You** * You want to help bring The Washington Post’s journalism to readers through high\-quality mobile experiences. * You measure success by the value delivered to users and how quickly it reaches them. * You develop engineers through direct feedback and clear expectations, and you judge your impact by their growth. * You care about predictable execution. You know the real remaining work, test whether estimates and status reports are credible, and surface risk before it becomes a missed commitment. * You want to stay technically hands\-on, writing code, prototyping, and reviewing pull requests to solve problems, evaluate approaches, and stay connected to the systems your team builds. * You care deeply about mobile architecture, application quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability. * You enjoy removing blockers and working across engineering and product teams to move complex work forward, while leaving ownership with the people who hold it. * You hold yourself to the standard you set for others: you own your commitments, communicate risk early, and confirm that issues are closed. * You look for wasted effort and ways to improve how teams work, and you measure whether those improvements create value. * You enjoy building AI agents and automation that solve real mobile engineering problems, and you care about proving that they work and that people actually use them. * You stay current on the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple platform releases, Swift language and concurrency changes, and AI\-assisted development in Xcode, and you know which changes are worth adopting and when. **How You’ll Support the Mission** * Lead and develop the software engineers responsible for The Washington Post’s iOS app, providing timely feedback, career development, performance management, and coaching that builds independent ownership and accountability. * Establish priorities and assignments, set delivery baselines, and track progress against estimates through to availability for users. Report on measures such as time to users, commitments met by the agreed date, and blocker resolution time, and surface material delivery risks early with clear facts, tradeoffs, and decisions needed. * Address performance concerns promptly and directly, set clear expectations, and confirm that behavior and results improve. * Partner with the Android Manager, Staff Engineers, Product, feature leads, and shared teams to se e changes. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, version control, and software delivery practices for production mobile applications. * Strong communication and problem\-solving skills, with experience partnering effectively with Product, senior technical contributors, other engineering teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders, including escalating material risks promptly. * Experience defining and using engineering metrics and delivery data, including baselines and targets, to identify bottlenecks, make decisions, and demonstrate improvement in team effectiveness. * Working knowledge of the current iOS platform, Swift, and Xcode tooling. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep experience developing and releasing large\-scale consumer iOS applications to the App Store. * Experience with modern iOS technologies such as SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, App Intents, Apple’s latest design system, on\-device AI frameworks, or comparable technologies; familiarity with Objective\-C and Kotlin Multiplatform. * Experience with mobile performance optimization, debugging, memory management, and application reliability. * Experience integrating RESTful APIs, third\-party SDKs, or other services into native mobile applications. * Experience leading teams responsible for the full mobile application lifecycle, including architecture, development, automated testing, CI/CD, release, observability, and production support. * Experience coordinating engineering work across iOS, Android, backend, platform, or other shared technical teams. * Experience improving engineering productivity, delivery predictability, or development processes and measuring the impact of those improvements. * Experience mentoring engineers across career levels and partnering effectively with Staff\-level or other senior technical contributors. * Hands\-on experience building AI agents or automation that solve real iOS or mobile engineering problems, with verification of the output and measured benefit. * Experience with agentic development workflows in Xcode and with connecting agents to engineering tools such as issue trackers, CI, crash reporting, and source control, for example through Model Context Protocol (MCP). **Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on\-site five days a week.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey: * Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage * Company\-paid pension and 401(k) match * Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave * Nine paid holidays and two personal days * 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent * Robust mental health resources * Backup care and caregiver concierge services * Gender affirming services * Pet insurance * Free Post digital subscription * Leadership and career development programs *Benefits may vary based on the job, full\-time or part\-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.* The salary range for this position is: $144,600 \- $241,100 Annual The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process. **Your story awaits. Apply today!** =================================== Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

jobs.title: Principal Real-Time Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Thea Energy:** Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer\-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future. **Position Overview:** We are seeking a Principal Real\-Time Software Engineer to design, develop, and deploy the real\-time software framework supporting the Eos Control System. Working with the controls and physics teams, you will develop the common execution environment, interfaces, and engineering practices that allow plasma control, magnet and power supply control, real\-time diagnostics, and other time\-critical applications to operate as an integrated system. This role combines substantial hands\-on software development with architecture, hardware integration, verification, commissioning, and operational support. You will work closely with controls engineers, plasma physicists, diagnostic specialists, electrical engineers, and subsystem owners to turn experimental and plant requirements into reliable, maintainable real\-time software. ### **Key Responsibility Areas:** * Develop the architecture and implementation of the Eos real\-time framework in collaboration with controls and subsystem engineers, including execution services, component interfaces, configuration, deployment, diagnostics, and integration across control subsystems. * Evaluate MARTe2 and other established fusion real\-time frameworks against Eos requirements. Develop prototypes and performance measurements to support engineering decisions on reuse, adaptation, and custom development. * Translate control and diagnostic needs into measurable requirements for cycle times, end\-to\-end latency, jitter, synchronization accuracy, throughput, availability, and resource margins. Define timing budgets and acceptance criteria by application. * Establish modular boundaries between control algorithms, hardware interfaces, operating\-system services, and supervisory functions so components can be tested independently and reused across Eos. Build deterministic execution services * Develop production\-quality C/C\+\+ framework components for multirate execution, scheduling, interprocess communication, shared memory, signal exchange, and controlled application lifecycle transitions. * Engineer and tune real\-time Linux platforms, including CPU and interrupt affinity, memory locking, NUMA placement, scheduling policies, and bounded concurrency. Identify and remove sources of unpredictable latency. * Develop reusable hardware abstraction and I/O interfaces for digitizers, FPGA systems, timing hardware, power supply controllers, and diagnostic equipment; address drivers, DMA, buffering, and data movement where required. * Design distributed data exchange and timing interfaces, selecting shared memory, deterministic networks, PCIe, RDMA, or other technologies according to measured latency and reliability needs. * Work with physics and controls specialists to deploy control algorithms, observers, estimators, and real\-time diagnostic processing. Support interfaces to model\-based development and generated code where appropriate. * Define interfaces with supervisory control, PLCs, interlocks, machine protection, and independent safety systems. Document command authority, permissives, fault propagation, and responsibility for safe responses. * Integrate time stamps, data quality indicators, configuration provenance, and data capture with the Eos data infrastructure to support reproducible experiments and fault investigation. * Provide simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop interfaces that allow the framework and subsystem applications to be exercised before integrated plant operation. * Develop automated functional, integration, regression, and timing tests on representative hardware. Assess worst\-case execution behavior, latency distributions, jitter, and deadline compliance under realistic workloads. * Create fault\-injection, endurance, and recovery tests covering device failures, dropped or delayed data, process and network faults, and loss of timing synchronization. * Participate directly in laboratory integration and commissioning. Diagnose issues across application software, operating systems, networks, and hardware, and turn operational findings into durable improvements. * Contribute to architecture and design reviews, develop coding and interface standards, and produce clear architecture documents, interface specifications, developer guidance, and operating procedures. * Engage with fusion laboratories, framework maintainers, research collaborators, and suppliers to assess technology maturity and incorporate relevant experience into the Eos  urrency, atomic operations, memory models, resource ownership, and techniques for controlling execution time and memory use. * Deep practical experience with Linux\-based real\-time systems, such as RedHawk Linux or PREEMPT\_RT, and diagnosing latency across application code, the kernel, hardware, and I/O. * Experience with an established fusion real\-time framework or plasma control infrastructure, such as MARTe2, ITER real\-time infrastructure, or an equivalent deployed system. * Experience integrating high\-speed data acquisition and hardware I/O, along with distributed communication, timing, and synchronization for feedback control. * Strong software engineering practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, reproducible builds, configuration management, and technical documentation. * Ability to translate scientific and engineering requirements into implementable software, communicate architectural tradeoffs clearly, and carry complex technical work through deployment. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Direct MARTe2 development experience, including Generic Application Modules, DataSources, brokers, real\-time states and threads, custom components, and integration with external systems. * Experience with stellarators, superconducting magnet systems, high\-current power supplies, plasma heating systems, or coordinated control across multiple fusion subsystems. * Familiarity with EPICS, MDSplus, ITER CODAC, or comparable supervisory control and scientific data environments. * Experience with NI PXI or CompactRIO, Speedgoat, MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW Real\-Time, FPGA interfaces, or integration of automatically generated control code. * Experience with PTP, hardware triggers, event timing systems, PCIe/DMA, RDMA, or high\-performance diagnostic data paths. * Experience deploying AI/ML inference or computationally intensive physics algorithms within measured timing and resource limits, including CPU/GPU integration where appropriate. * Contributions to reusable scientific software, real\-time frameworks, open\-source projects, or relevant fusion controls publications. ### **Company Benefits:** * Salary Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 per year * Comprehensive health benefits (e.g. medical/dental/vision) * Employee equity stock options * 20 days PTO ### **Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs. * Ability to perform activities such as typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time. * Willingness to occasionally travel or work required nights/weekends/on\-call. * Ability to work in a facility that contains industrial hazards including heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, high voltage, high current, pressure systems, and cryogenics. It’s not necessary to meet all of the skillsets outlined above. Please feel free to send us a note and tell us why you would still be a great fit for this role or Thea Energy. **Diversity and Inclusion:**Thea Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a company of diverse backgrounds. By creating a diverse environment, we will bring new ideas and approaches to solving some of the world’s hardest (and most important) problems. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, family or marital status, age, disability, veteran’s status, or other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: ### **Our Mission** As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2\+ billion swipes per day, 20\+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190\+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real\-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. ### **Our Values** * **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down. * **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today. * **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate. * **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same. * **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us. * **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters. **The Team or Role** -------------------- Agents now do real work at Tinder. They review code, security risks, accessibility, make UI improvements, help marketing teams with their workflows, and run inside engineers' coding tools and in Slack. Every one of them reaches our internal systems through our agent platform: a gateway, a growing set of MCP connectors, and the identity, policy and observability layers around them. We're hiring the engineer who owns that platform's design and functions by closely collaborating with internal teams on real use cases. You'll make it safe by default for agents that can read sensitive data and take consequential actions, fast and reliable enough that teams want to build on it, and simple enough that the next connector or agent takes days, not weeks. **Where you’ll work:** ---------------------- This is a hybrid role and requires in\-office collaboration three times per week in our Palo Alto, California jobs.title: Staff Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI\-driven internet. World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate. Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI. TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global\-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100\. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event. **About the Team** The Security team at Tools for Humanity operates at a level far beyond a regular company. Our objective is not just to secure an organization, but to build the trusted, foundational infrastructure for the world's largest identity and financial network. Our seasoned engineers are central to the success of the World protocol. We tackle a unique and complex threat landscape that spans state\-of\-the\-art hardware security for the Orb, advanced cryptography including new zero\-knowledge proofs, and the security of a global, distributed cloud and mobile ecosystem. Our work is critical to enabling the protocol to scale to billions of users while upholding an unwavering commitment to fail\-safe security and privacy. **About the Opportunity** As a Product Security Engineer, you will be a hands\-on technical leader responsible for safeguarding the products and services that power the World project. You will be "In the Driver's Seat," proactively embedding security into every stage of the development lifecycle. This is not a role for box\-tickers; you will be expected to think from first principles to solve novel security challenges at a global scale. Your work will directly protect our users and ensure the integrity of a protocol designed for the majority of humanity. You will: * Lead secure architecture reviews and threat modeling sessions for new applications and services. * Build and operate security automation pipelines using AI agents to scale vulnerability detection \& triage, code review, and remediation. * Engineer and implement automated security guardrails and reusable tools and libraries to make the secure path the easy path for developers. * Perform deep\-dive, security\-focused code and infrastructure reviews in languages like Rust, Go, and Python. * Own the vulnerability management process, from triaging bug bounty submissions to driving remediation efforts with engineering teams. * Mature and scale our Secure SDLC and bug bounty programs to keep pace with a rapidly growing engineering organization. **About You** You are a pragmatic and deeply technical security engineer who thrives on solving complex problems. You have a builder's mindset and are passionate about shipping secure products with "Extreme Urgency." You are comfortable with ambiguity and are driven by the opportunity to secure systems with world\-changing potential. * You have 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Product Security or Application Security * You have experience building and operating security automation pipelines using AI agents for vulnerability detection \& triage, code review, and remediation. * You are proficient in code review and development in languages like Rust, Go, and Python. * You have extensive experience securing modern AWS architectures and developing secure infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform and CDK). * You can assess exploitability, prioritize security risks, and explain practical tradeoffs to engineering teams. * You have a strong background in implementing and managing security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) and embedding security into CI/CD pipelines. * You have a deep understanding of web and API security principles (OWASP Top 10\) and have experience securing distributed, mobile\-first systems. **Nice to have:** particular interest in securing mobile applications or smart contracts. **What we offer** The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Tools for Humanity ranges from **$293,000 \- $325,000** plus a competitive long\-term incentive package. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Tools for Humanity offers a wide range of best\-in\-class, comprehensive, and inclusive employee benefits for this role, including healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) plan and match, life insurance, flexible time off, commuter benefits, professional development stipend, and much more.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Generalist
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- As a Generalist Engineer at Trajectory, you will craft the product experience that makes continual learning legible and intuitive. You will own the **SDK**, **API surfaces**, and **integration infrastructure** that help customers understand, debug, and trust continually improving models. This includes trajectory visualization, evaluation workflows, monitoring dashboards, and the core product interfaces that sit on top of our leading RL infrastructure. You’ll work directly with the founders and **industry\-leading design partners (Series B\+ AI vertical product companies)** to translate frontier RL systems into a clean, developer\-first product experience. You will help define the visual language, interaction patterns, and product philosophy of Trajectory. We are building **the interface for continual learning**. This role sets that bar. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Strong full\-stack or backend engineering experience * Experience building AI\-powered products or agent systems \- you actively experiment with new frameworks for fun * Experience building developer\-facing products or SDKs * Experience with data pipelines, telemetry systems, or event infrastructure * Ability to move quickly in a zero\-to\-one environment **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building observability, tracing, or monitoring systems * Experience at early\-stage developer tooling startups * Strong product instincts and ability to work directly with customers * Experience owning SDK design and developer ergonomics **About Trajectory** -------------------- **Trajectory is a research and product lab creating the platform for continual learning.** AI is the most capable software ever built, and the least able to learn. Every valuable correction and edit that happens in a product evaporates at the next session. A few teams have closed this gap by hand\-coupling their models to their products: Composer, Claude Code, Windsurf SWE\-1\. Trajectory is the first scalable approach for every company: our platform unlocks the signal already sitting in product use, so companies can continuously post\-train large\-scale agentic models that outperform the frontier. Working with leading AI companies, including Decagon, Clay, Harvey, Mercor, and Rogo. Founded by researchers from Deepmind, OpenAI, Meta, Apple, Amazon, and Scale. $15M led by Conviction, with Fei\-Fei Li, Jeff Dean, and founders of Notion, Braintrust, Modal, Hugging Face, and Dropbox.

jobs.title: Dev Ops Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **Dev Ops Engineer** Hybrid – Paoli, PA The DevOps Engineer plays a critical role in Turn5's E\-Commerce development organization, owning the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and runtime environments that power our e\-commerce platform and supporting services. Reporting to the Sr. Technical Delivery Manager and working closely with developers, architects, and the IT support team, this role keeps development and production environments reliable, observable, and fast, and helps the team ship changes with confidence. **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that provide reliable, repeatable builds, testing, and deployments for ASP.NET and C\# applications. * Manage and support Kubernetes clusters through Rancher, including workload deployment, scaling, upgrades, and overall cluster health. * Build, maintain, and optimize Docker images and container configurations for development and production workloads. * Administer our internal container and NuGet package repositories (ProGet), including feeds, access, retention, and package promotion across environments. * Configure and maintain load balancers to ensure high availability, proper traffic distribution, and consistent performance of production services. * Manage Cloudflare configuration, including DNS, caching, security rules, and traffic routing, to protect and accelerate our e\-commerce sites. * Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting across applications and infrastructure, respond to alerts, and tune thresholds to surface real issues without excess noise. * Troubleshoot and resolve production and development environment issues, partnering with developers to identify root causes and prevent recurrence. * Analyze performance and monitoring data, and funnel findings and improvement recommendations back to the development team. * Support the E\-Commerce Development team day to day by providing environments, tooling, and technical guidance that keep development work moving. * Work with the IT support team on networking, access, server, and environment needs, coordinating handoffs and resolving shared issues. * Document environments, deployment processes, and runbooks so knowledge is shared and incident response is consistent. * Participate in incident response and an after\-hours support rotation as needed for critical production issues. **What We’re Looking For** We value strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to grow. If you’re stronger on some of these and lighter on others, that’s perfectly fine – we’re more interested in your ability to solve problems, collaborate, and grow with the team. If you have a solid foundation and are excited to learn, we want to hear from you. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows with a modern CI/CD platform. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes and a management platform such as Rancher, including deploying and troubleshooting containerized workloads. * Proficiency with Docker or similar container tooling and container\-based development and deployment practices. * Experience configuring and managing load balancers and web traffic routing. * Experience with Cloudflare or a similar CDN provider, including DNS, caching, and security features. * Experience managing private container registries and NuGet package repositories, such as ProGet or similar artifact management tools. * Experience with monitoring and alerting tools and practices, and a data\-driven approach to performance tuning. * Familiarity with ASP.NET Core on .NET 10 and C\# sufficient to build, debug, and troubleshoot application issues alongside developers. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to stay calm and methodical during production incidents. * Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, IT support, and non\-technical stakeholders. **Who You’ll Work With** You’ll join an eCommerce Development group made up of senior and mid\-level developers, and you’ll work closely with our IT Development and IT Support teams. We prioritize work\-life balance, clear communication, and helping each other succeed. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * Hybrid schedule: * Local (within 50 miles of our HQ in Paoli, PA): typically 2 days onsite per month (yes, month!) * Remote: 2 weeks onsite per year * Competitive compensation in\-line with experience \& impact, plus a quarterly bonus program * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision plus immediate vesting on your 401k match * A people\-first culture where curiosity, ownership, and collaboration are valued * Opportunities to grow your technical skillset and contribute to impactful, high\-visibility products **About Turn5** Turn5 is one of the largest and fastest growing eCommerce retailers in the Greater Philadelphia area. Best known for our award\-winning, eCommerce platforms, AmericanMuscle.com, ExtremeTerrain.com, and AmericanTrucks.com, we’ve been engaging muscle car, truck, and off\-road enthusiasts with exceptional products, services, and experiences since 2004\. With the acquisition of Eckler’s in 2022, a pioneer in classic car restoration \& modification for over 60 years, Turn5’s catalog of brands has expanded to now offer aftermarket automotive products for vehicles as classic as the Model T. Our purpose, however, extends beyond selling car parts. We have a commitment to creating meaningful customer experiences at every step of their journey. Whether it’s supplying a unique product that customizes the look and feel of their ride, providing thousands of educational videos for the DIYer or leveraging user generated content to inspire even the most experienced owner, we are obsessed with ensuring we reach as many like\-minded gearheads across the globe as we can.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer I - Colorado
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** * *This position is based out of our Greenwood Village, Colorado office and requires regular, in‑person attendance.* Ulteig is looking for a Software Engineer who is a Computer Science graduate seeking their first professional software engineering role and who is excited to build with modern AI technologies. This position is within Digital Transformation; Ulteig defines digital transformation as: The deliberate use of digital technologies to modify or create business processes, customer experiences, and enable organizational culture in response to or anticipation of changes in the market, customer insights, and business needs. This role is ideal for graduates who are AI builders—engineers who actively leverage AI tools such as agents, large language models, and modern AI frameworks to create software, while also understanding the core computer science principles, patterns, and practices that make solutions reliable, scalable, and safe. You will work closely with experienced software engineers and AI leaders, learning how to translate real business problems into AI‑enabled solutions, contributing code, prototypes, and experiments while growing your technical depth and professional confidence. **What You’ll Do** Hands‑On Development \& Learning * Contribute to the design, development, and testing of AI‑enabled software solutions under the guidance of senior engineers. * Write production‑quality code using languages and technologies such as C\#, Python, React, APIs, and modern AI tooling. * Build and enhance features that incorporate AI capabilities such as large language models, agents, vision, and automation. * Assist with prototypes and proofs‑of‑concept to explore new use cases and validate feasibility. * Learn how to apply software engineering fundamentals—readability, testability, performance, and maintainability—even when using AI‑assisted development tools. AI Builder Mindset * Leverage AI coding assistants and techniques to accelerate development while understanding *why* the generated code works. * Apply emerging AI patterns (such as prompt design, retrieval, and tool‑use concepts) in practical, supervised settings. * Learn when AI is the right tool—and when traditional software patterns are more appropriate. * Develop an ethical, secure, and responsible approach to using AI in real business workflows. Collaboration \& Growth * Collaborate with software engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders in a team‑based environment. * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint ceremonies. * Ask thoughtful questions, seek feedback, and continuously improve your technical skills. * Engage in training, workshops, and learning opportunities focused on AI, cloud, and modern software development. **What We Expect from You** Education \& Early Experience * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field. * This role is intended for new or recent graduates (internships, co‑ops, academic projects, or personal projects are great). * Demonstrated interest in AI and modern software development through coursework, projects, hackathons, research, or self‑directed learning. Technical Foundations * Working knowledge of at least one programming language, such as C\#, Python, Java, or similar. * Solid understanding of core computer science concepts, including: * + Data structures and data handling + APIs and basic system design + Basic design patterns * Introductory exposure to AI / Machine Learning or Generative AI concepts is strongly preferred (academic or hands‑on). * Familiarity with using AI tools (copilots, chat‑based assistants, etc.) for coding or problem\-solving is a requirement. Mindset \& Potential * Strong curiosity and enthusiasm for building, experimenting, and learning. * Comfortable using AI to accelerate work while valuing engineering fundamentals and good design. * Growth mindset with openness to coaching, feedback, and continuous improvement. * Responsible and thoughtful approach to using AI technologies. * Motivated self‑starter who takes ownership of learning and assigned work. * Demonstrates openness to innovation by embracing and applying evolving technology and AI tools to enhance workflows, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement. * Must have authorization to work permanently in the U.S. Why This Role This role is intentionally designed as a launchpad. You won’t be expected to be an AI expert on day one. Instead, you’ll be supported through: * Mentorship from experienced software and AI engineers * Structured learning and hands‑on exposure to real use cases * Increasing responsibility as your skills and confidence grow * Successful candidates will grow into more advanced software engineering roles, contributing to the evolution of Ulteig’s capabilities while building a strong foundation for a long‑term engineering career. *As you consider applying for a position at Ulteig, we encourage you to think outside the box – because we do! You might not meet 100% of the skills listed in a description, but we are committed to hiring people with exceptional talent, ability and potential, and then creating an environment where they can become the best versions of themselves. We don’t want to miss out on the possibility of speaking with the next outstanding Ulteig team members, so please apply if you think this role is a great match for your unique skills and strengths. And, yes, relevant military experience is absolutely considered for transitioning service members.* **What You Can Expect from Ulteig** Ulteig is a purpose\-driven organization that has built a culture focused on people, both our clients and our employees, for over 80 years. Working at Ulteig is more than a job, opening opportunities to make an impact by creating and solving for a sustainable future. We recognize our success relies heavily on the dedication and focus of our workforce; this is why we make investing in our employees a top priority. We prioritize flexibility and staying connected to meeting your needs and help you achieve your goals. We value your unique perspective, respect your individuality, and celebrate your contributions. At Ulteig, we take our success and the success of our clients personally. **We offer our team members:** * Flexible Workplace * Employee Ownership * Competitive Pay * Comprehensive Benefits Package * Collaborative Environment * Innovative Culture Our vision is to be the most trusted partners transforming our world’s critical infrastructure. Ulteig connects people and resources to develop compelling, integrated solutions across multiple Lifeline Sectors®, including Power, Renewables, Transportation and Water. Ulteig is a trusted partner in engineering North America’s essential infrastructure and leverages its expertise with a wide range of public and private clients. At Ulteig, we care deeply about our team, listening to their needs and ensuring they have the tools necessary to be productive, whether they choose to work remotely, hybrid, or in the office. Regardless of where you work, you are empowered to build a workday that best suits your strengths. We strive to ensure a balance and separation between home and work life. We support a flexible working schedule, so employees are able to focus on what's important to them. If you would like to be a part of a company that empowers their employees, apply today! ***Ulteig is a Drug\-Free Workplace*** **ACHIEVE \| GROW \| COLLABORATE** Additional Opportunity Details: **Target Base Compensation Range for this role is $80,000 \- $120,000** * *Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary include your job\-specific skills, education, training, job location, number of years of experience related to this role, and comparison to other employees already in this role.* This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 60 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer I
jobs.description: **Rapidly Growing Life Sciences Technology Company** Ultima Genomics is a rapidly growing company that is developing ground\-breaking genomics technologies. Our mission is to continuously drive the scale of genomic information to enable unprecedented advances in biology and improvements in human health. We have developed a foundational new approach to sequencing at scale that overcomes limitations due to the high costs of current technologies. We are well\-funded and have raised approximately $600 million from global top\-tier investors. Our team brings together unique and diverse expertise across multiple disciplines, from healthcare and life sciences, to engineering, to technology and software and beyond. We are a collaborative group, including successful entrepreneurs, chemists, hardware and software engineers, genomics and biotechnology experts, molecular and computational biologists, software and algorithm experts, and operations and commercial leaders. Join us to develop and commercialize technologies that unleash the power of genomics at scale and empower the future of human health. We are looking for a highly motivated **Firmware Engineer I** to join our team! As a Firmware Engineer I, you will help develop firmware for our next\-generation automated sequencing instruments. This role is ideal for an early\-career engineer who enjoys hands\-on development, connecting software with hardware, and applying engineering skills to next\-generation sequencing technology. This is a full\-time onsite position at our Fremont, CA location. **How You'll Contribute** * Develop and maintain embedded firmware for automated sequencing instruments, including sensor and actuator interfaces, robotics, precision motion control, high\-speed data acquisition, and mixed\-signal electronics * Work with electrical engineers to integrate firmware and hardware, contributing to design discussions about interfaces, communication protocols, and system robustness * Develop automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) firmware tests to validate board\-level functionality and support reliable instrument operation and develop automated software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) testing to identify regressions early in the development process * Help evaluate new hardware components and reduce integration risks by reviewing datasheets and errata, assembling development boards or prototype electronics, and writing firmware to assess functionality and reliability * Run hands\-on experiments to verify hardware and firmware functionality, characterize performance, and investigate board\-level failures * Other job duties as assigned **Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities** * BS in coursework, academic or personal projects, internships, or industry work, involving interfacing with sensors, motors or other actuators * Working knowledge of C programming and microcontroller fundamentals * Ability to use a digital voltmeter (DVM), oscilloscope, and logic analyzers to measure and interpret physical signals and distinguish firmware bugs from hardware issues * A hands\-on approach to problem\-solving, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to work independently and collaborate with others * Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as CAN or EtherCAT. * Ability to read electrical schematics and printed circuit board (PCB) layouts to support firmware integration and debugging * Experience with Python for test automation or data analysis, or with automated test platforms and reliability testing At Ultima Genomics, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. jobs.title: CONSULTANCY - Senior Full-stack Software Developer - Climpact Modernization - SSA 2026-CRI-SSCD-4
jobs.description: **Background** Climate science information plays a critical role in supporting evidence\-based climate adaptation, risk management and sustainable development. The effective use of climate observations, analyses and indices enables National Meteorological and Hydrological Services (NMHSs) to contribute more effectively to national planning and decision\-making processes, particularly the development and implementation of National Adaptation Plans (NAPs) and Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs). Strengthening NMHSs' capacity to generate and communicate reliable climate science information is therefore essential to informing climate\-resilient policies, sectoral services and engagement, and investment decisions. To strengthen the capacities of Members, particularly in Least Developed Countries (LDCs) and Small Island Developing States (SIDS), the WMO has organized more than twenty training workshops on Climate Science Information for Climate Action (CSICA) and related topics over the past decade. These workshops provide practical methodologies and hands\-on training in climate data quality control and homogenization, climate indices calculation, co\-creation cross sectors, and the interpretation and application of climate information for adaptation planning and climate services. Climpact has been a core software tool supporting these activities, enabling NMHSs to the best\-available climate science information, calculate climate indices and generate information relevant to national and sectoral planning. Climpact evolved from international efforts to standardize climate extremes indices, initially advanced through the Working Group on Climate Change Detection (WGCCD) and subsequently the Expert Team on Climate Change Detection and Indices (ETCCDI). Building on RClimDEX, Climpact incorporated both core climate extremes indices and sector\-specific indices to support the growing demand for climate services. Over recent years, feedback from workshop participants and NMHSs has highlighted a growing need to modernize Climpact and improve its functionality, accessibility and user experience. In particular, the online version faces performance and stability challenges in countries with limited internet bandwidth, while the desktop version requires complex installation and dependency management, posing difficulties for users, particularly those working in Windows environments. Members have also expressed the need for more efficient quality control workflows, improved visualization and greater flexibility to incorporate new scientific functions. These challenges have reinforced the need for a more reliable, user\-friendly and sustainable software platform. This consultancy is looking for a full\-stack developer to redesign the Climpact web portal. The redesigned portal should consist of a Python\-based backend for calculating climate indices (based on user\-provided climate data), and a front\-end based on the latest internet standards for accessibility and security. Key priorities are interactive visualisations, bandwidth efficiency, low maintenance and modular code, scalable performance, containerization and an emphasis on open\-source technologies. In parallel, the consultant is also expected to work with climate indices scientific community on the scientific computing of climate indices. **Duties and Responsibilities** The Consultant will work under the overall supervision of the Chief of the Climate Research and Information Section and will report monthly to the Junior Professional Officer of the Section. The Consultant shall work collaboratively with WMO staff and external Climpact experts on technical requirements, software integration and scientific consultations. The development process will follow an iterative approach, with periodic joint reviews, testing and revisions coordinated by the WMO Secretariat. Under this structure, the consultant will: * **Review the existing Climpact software** , including its source code, architecture, dependencies, scientific calculation modules, user interface and deployment arrangements, and identify technical limitations and opportunities for modernization and reuse of existing components. * **Design a modern, modular, and maintainable back\-end architecture** for the upgraded Climpact, leveraging established open\-source scientific computing libraries, particularly the Python\-based xclim package. Define the core framework, data processing workflows, module interfaces, and integration strategy, ensuring compatibility with existing and future scientific functions. * **Develop and implement the core software functions** , supporting climate data calculation workflows for station\-based and gridded datasets, and enabling the modular integration of quality control, climate indices calculation and homogeneity assessment functions in collaboration with WMO climate indices experts. * **Develop a user\-friendly front\-end with interactive visualizations** , enabling users to  7 working days) * Online deployment of the initial Climpact application, integrating the developed software framework and essential functionalities, with consideration for accessibility, low\-bandwidth environments, system stability and future offline deployment compatibility. (Estimated 5 working days) Technical testing, documentation and handover, including unit and integration testing, verification of essential workflows, resolution of identified technical issues, source code and repository documentation, deployment instructions, and recommendations for further development and scientific validation. (Estimated 3 working days) * **Required Skills and Experience** **Education:** A university degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a closely related field. **Experience:** * At least five years of full\-stack experience demonstrated in designing, implementing and deploying modular and scalable web\-based applications, preferably involving scientific computing, to platforms such as Amazon web services. * Proven experience in Python programming and developing modular, containerized and maintainable software applications using open\-source libraries and frameworks. * Experience in developing user\-friendly web interfaces with a focus on data visualization functions and interactive data\-processing workflows. **Other Requirements:** * Familiarity with scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, pandas and xarray. Experience with climate data processing and visualisation, particularly including xclim or similar libraries would be an advantage. * Experience working with time\-series and gridded datasets, particularly NetCDF or other climate and environmental data formats, would be an advantage. * Knowledge of R programming and experience integrating R\-based functionalities into Python applications would be an advantage. * Good understanding of software quality assurance, dependency management, automated testing and open\-source development practices. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently, communicate effectively with scientific experts and deliver results within agreed timelines. **Languages:** Excellent command of written and spoken English required. Knowledge of another UN language is an asset. (Note: the official languages of the Organization are Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish.) **Salary and Allowances:** Pay band C \- USD 390\.\- / USD 560\.\- **Duration** : 40 days over a period of 6 months **Focal point:** Xinrui WU, xwu@wmo.int **Applications:** Applications should be made online through the WMO e\-recruitment system. Do not send your application via multiple routes. WMO no longer accepts applications via post or email. Only applicants for whom WMO has a further interest will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be required to sit a written test and/or an interview. **Statements:** WMO is committed to achieving diversity and a balanced workforce. Applications are welcome from qualified women and men, including those with disabilities. The statutory retirement age is 65\. Pursuant to WMO Standing Instructions, the minimum age to be eligible for consideration for vacant positions is 18, and the maximum age must enable the candidate to serve for at least the term of the contract before reaching mandatory age of separation. **Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority** WMO does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles. **Scam alert** WMO does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). WMO will not ask for applicants’ bank account information.

jobs.description: **Explore opportunities with the Enterprise Information Security (EIS) team** at UnitedHealth Group. We are focused on strengthening our cyber defenses, ransomware resiliency, vulnerability mitigation, and securing all aspects of our systems and data globally. We are passionate about protecting the sensitive data of our members and providers. We are committed to leveraging every tool, partnership and process needed to enhance our security posture. It is our duty to protect the information of those we serve while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** The Enterprise Information Security (EIS) team is responsible for cybersecurity across our organization. We support our business and members by reducing risk, rapidly responding to threats, focusing on business resiliency and securing new acquisitions. Join our team of cyber security professionals who are deeply engaged in determining how we can change and improve health care. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. What is it like to work in Technology at UHG? Combine two of the fastest\-growing fields on the planet \- technology and health care \- with a culture of performance, collaboration, and opportunity and this is what you get: leading\-edge solutions that improve the lives of millions. At UHG, our approach to technology isn't about designing another app to fix health care. It's about connecting patients to their physician and connecting a disconnected health system so that it works better for the people it was created to serve. Our global technology team consists of more than 35,000 innovators from around the world passionate about using technology to improve the lives of people and communities. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Products - MCP Manager
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hybrid: New York, NY (2\-3 days per week in office). The office is located in Midtown West, less than a 10\-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square. **SHAPE THE FUTURE OF AI GOVERNANCE WITH USERCENTRICS** ------------------------------------------------------- Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub. As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections. This is a category\-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Software Engineer who wants to be on the ground floor of defining that category and to build the product enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents. **THE ROLE** ------------ As a Software Engineer on the MCP Manager team, you will build the features customers use to govern their AI agents, such as gateway configuration, identity and access policies, and audit logging. You will split your time evenly between our Vue.js front end and our Python/Django and TypeScript back end, all running on Google Cloud Platform. You will work closely with our Product Manager, our designer, and your fellow engineers to take features from spec to production, and you will own the quality of what you ship. You will join a small, high\-ownership engineering team that operates like a startup inside a larger company, with a short path from customer feedback to shipped code. The role exists now because buyers are moving from AI experiments to production agent rollouts, and they need the governance layer beneath those agents to keep pace with new MCP servers, clients, and security requirements. **YOUR TASKS** -------------- ### **Feature Development** * Design, build, and ship features across the full stack, from Vue.js interfaces to Python/Django and TypeScript services. * Turn product specs and designs into working software, raising questions and tradeoffs early with product and design. * Design clear APIs and data models that other engineers can understand and extend. ### **Quality \& Reliability** * Write automated tests alongside your code and help keep the test suite fast and reliable. * Review teammates' pull requests thoughtfully and respond constructively to feedback on your own. * Investigate and fix bugs, including issues escalated from customers, by tracing problems across the front end, back end, and infrastructure. ### **AI\-Assisted Development** * Use Claude Code and other AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code, while taking full ownership of everything you ship. * Share techniques that make the team faster and help refine how we use AI tooling in our engineering practices. ### **Collaboration \& Growth** * Contribute to planning and technical discussions with honest estimates and early warnings about risk. * Build a working understanding of MCP and of how enterprises connect AI agents to their business systems. * Document what you build so that teammates and future engineers can pick it up quickly. **Requirements** * 3 or more years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production web applications. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript and experience with a modern front\-end framework, ideally Vue.js. * Experience building back\-end services and APIs in Python, ideally with Django. * A solid understanding of relational databases, schema design, and query performance. * Experience deploying and operating software in a cloud environment, ideally Google Cloud Platform. * Daily, hands\-on use of Claude Code and other AI coding assistants, with the judgment to review, test, and stand behind AI\-generated code. * Ideally, experience with the Model Context Protocol, AI agent tooling, or AI gateways, or a background in developer tools, security, or governance software. * Comfort operating in an early\-stage, category\-creation environment where the playbook is still being written. * Clear written and spoken communication in English, and a habit of giving and asking for feedback directly. **Benefits** * 401(k) plan contribution with employer match * Commuter allowance (transit stipend) * 18 paid vacation days (PTO) * Health insurance * Personal development budget for every employee * Hybrid workplace * Online wellness sessions * Team events including team buildings, happy hours, company breakfasts/lunches, in\-person and virtual * Refreshments: snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office Salary Range: $170,000 \- $185,000 The annual base salary range is determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, role\-specific skills, relevant experience, and internal equity. jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City\-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2\.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States. Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace\-delivered retirement plans, employer\-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities. Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third\-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com **Who Are We Looking For?** We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to help secure the applications and identity integrations that power our products. This role will focus on analyzing and protecting our NestJS applications, applying strong application security practices across the software development lifecycle, and supporting the security of our identity capabilities as both an identity provider (IdP) and a relying party (RP) in OIDC integrations and internal application usage. You will work closely with software engineering, platform, infrastructure, and product teams to identify risk, implement practical mitigations, and make secure\-by\-default development easier. The ideal candidate combines solid hands\-on application security skills with a working knowledge of modern authentication and authorization protocols, and is eager to grow deeper expertise in identity security. **What Will You Be Doing?** * Analyze NestJS and TypeScript applications for authentication, authorization, input validation, injection, session, API, business\-logic, and data\-protection vulnerabilities. * Apply and help refine secure development patterns for NestJS, including guards, interceptors, middleware, decorators, validation, error handling, logging, configuration, and dependency management. * Contribute to the security of our OIDC integrations and identity platform capabilities when we operate as: * + An identity provider, including authorization, token, user\-info, discovery, key\-set, and logout endpoints. + A relying party, including client registration, redirect handling, authorization\-code flows, token exchange, session establishment, and logout. * Review OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect flows, including authorization code with PKCE, refresh tokens, client authentication, scopes, consent, state, nonce, redirect URI validation, and token lifetimes, under guidance from senior team members for more complex cases. * Help apply and maintain authorization models using RBAC and, where appropriate, claims\-based or policy\-based access control. * Review access\-control boundaries across services, APIs, tenants, users, roles, permissions, and administrative functions. * Participate in threat modeling, security design reviews, architecture reviews, and secure code reviews. * Contribute to security requirements, reusable libraries, reference implementations, and developer guidance that reduce recurring risk. * Support security testing and detection efforts, including SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning, API testing, dependency monitoring, and targeted security testing. * Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities, help prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact, and verify fixes. * Monitor relevant application and identity security signals, support incident investigations, and help maintain playbooks for account takeover, token compromise, authorization bypass, credential abuse, and related events. * Help maintain security documentation, standards, risk exceptions, and evidence needed for audits and customer assurance. * Stay current on application security, identity, OAuth/OIDC, browser security, API security, cloud security, and emerging attack techniques. **Requirements** The Necessities * 2\-4 years of professional experience in application security, product security, software engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Experience securing Node.js and TypeScript applications; familiarity with NestJS is a strong plus. * Working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect concepts and common implementation pitfalls. * Exposure to IdP and/or RP implementations, integrations, or security assessments. * Solid understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including RBAC, least privilege, claims, scopes, permissions, sessions, and tokens. * Ability to review code across APIs, web applications, and background jobs, with support from senior engineers on more complex architectural or distributed\-systems questions. * Familiarity with web and API security risks, including OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, broken access control, SSRF, injection, XSS, CSRF, insecure deserialization, and misconfiguration. * Basic understanding of secure token handling, JWT validation, JWKS, signing algorithms, and token storage considerations. * Some experience working with CI/CD and developer workflows, or a willingness to learn how to integrate security into them with minimal friction. * Good communication skills and the ability to explain security findings and risk to technical teammates. * A pragmatic, collaborative approach: eager to learn, ask good questions, and work with more senior engineers to propose and implement proportional controls. The Extras * Exposure to identity platforms or libraries such as Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, Cognito, Azure AD/Entra ID, or comparable systems. * Familiarity with SAML integrations for single sign\-on solutions. * Exposure to API gateways, microservices, event\-driven systems, and cloud\-native deployments. * Familiarity with containers, infrastructure as code, secrets management, and cloud IAM basics. * Experience with security tooling such as Burp Suite, Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Dependabot, OWASP ZAP, or equivalent tools. * Familiarity with security standards such as OWASP ASVS or NIST SSDF. * Interest in pursuing relevant security certifications. This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in\-office operation. The expected base salary range for this position is $140K \- $150K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits** We're an innovative, high\-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan. **Interview Process** Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1\-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience\-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in\-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises. For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team. *Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

access, workflows, automations, dashboards, and reports. * Troubleshoot application, integration, performance, and data issues, correcting recurring root causes. * Maintain appropriate development, testing, validation, change management, and release practices. * Apply WPI standards for access, data handling, change management, documentation, and support in partnership with Information
