jobs.title: Sr. Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to help drive automation strategy and execution across our building products manufacturing operations. In this role, you will execute automation projects from concept through commissioning, improve plant safety and performance, and partner cross\-functionally with engineering, operations, IT, and manufacturing teams to implement practical, high\-impact solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced engineer who thrives in a hands\-on manufacturing environment and wants to make a meaningful impact across multiple sites. Westlake Royal Building Products offers a broad range of exterior siding and trim solutions designed for beauty, durability, and low maintenance. Our innovative vinyl, composite, and specialty materials support residential and commercial construction across diverse styles and climates. We promote a culture centered on innovation, collaboration, and growth.##### **What You’ll Do:** * Lead automation projects from concept and design through installation, commissioning, and startup. * Develop solutions that improve safety, reliability, productivity, and operational efficiency. * Partner with engineering, manufacturing, IT, and project teams to identify automation and AI opportunities. * Manage scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder communication. * Perform feasibility studies and technical assessments to support sound engineering decisions. * Troubleshoot complex issues and provide post\-implementation support. * Provide technical guidance and training to plant teams. * Collaborate with production teams to identify and implement process improvements through automation. ##### **What We’re Looking For:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 10\+ years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment. * 5\+ years of experience in automation, capital project management, engineering design, and equipment integration. * Hands\-on knowledge of PLC/HMI programming, ladder logic, and industrial robotics such as FANUC, ABB, or KUKA. * Strong project leadership, troubleshooting, and communication skills. * Experience with project planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk assessment, and technical documentation. * AutoCAD experience is a plus. ##### **Why Join Us?** This is an opportunity to take on visible, high\-impact work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment. You’ll partner with cross\-functional teams, help shape automation strategy across multiple sites, and play a key role in driving meaningful operational improvement.##### **Work Environment \& Travel:** This role includes both office and plant\-floor work. Travel is expected approximately 40–50%, and candidates should be comfortable working in an industrial environment and using required PPE. If you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges and leading impactful automation projects, we encourage you to apply. **Competitive Pay \& Benefits:*** Benefits effective day one. * Medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 401(k) with company match. * Annual retirement contribution. * Life and AD\&D insurance. * Paid vacation. * Tuition assistance program. * Fitness reimbursement program. * Career growth and advancement opportunities.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Red Team
jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- * Plan and run authorized red team operations across cloud (AWS), Kubernetes, networks, identity systems, SaaS, and internal applications, under written rules of engagement. * Build and maintain AI\-assisted testing harnesses: agent loops that run recon, attack\-path discovery, fuzzing, and exploit validation with logging, scoping controls, and human approval gates. * Use LLMs and agentic tools to speed up vulnerability research, payload and test\-case generation, code review, and report drafting, and measure where they help and where they mislead. * Red team our own AI systems: prompt injection, tool and connector abuse, data exfiltration, model and agent permission boundaries, and supply chain risk in AI dependencies. * Emulate realistic adversaries using MITRE ATT\&CK and ATLAS, chaining findings into end\-to\-end attack paths rather than isolated bugs. * Run purple team exercises with detection engineering and incident response, and tune detections based on what your tests evade. * Write clear findings with reproduction steps, impact, and recommended fixes; track remediation to closure and retest. * Automate regression tests so fixed weaknesses stay fixed, and feed results into CI/CD pipelines. * Document and share techniques, tooling, and lessons learned with engineering teams. * Work collaboratively with Whatnot’s Blue Team on Purple Team engagements to help strengthen Whatnot’s overall security posture. **You** ------- Curious about who thrives at Whatnot? We’ve found that low ego, a growth mindset, and leaning into action and high impact goes a long way here. As our next Red Team Engineer you’ll find weaknesses in our infrastructure before real attackers do. You will use AI tools and agents to scale offensive testing, build the harnesses that run it, and turn findings into fixes across cloud, network, application, identity and CI/CD layers. * 3\+ years in offensive security, red teaming, or penetration testing, with real engagements against production\-scale environments. * Strong programming skills in Python; you write your own tooling instead of only running others. * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered workflows or agents (tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails), not just prompting a chat window. * Deep knowledge of at least two areas: cloud security and IAM abuse, Active Directory or identity attacks, Kubernetes and container escapes, web and API exploitation, CI/CD and supply chain attacks. * Working knowledge of AI\-specific risks: prompt injection, insecure tool use, data leakage, excessive agent permissions, and model supply chain issues. * Sound judgment on scope, safety, and blast radius; you know how to test production\-adjacent systems without causing outages. * Clear written communication: reports an engineer can act on and an executive can skim. **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $210K \- $290K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) organization sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution across Agent Factory, Sana, Data Cloud, and the Developer Platform. When Workday launches new AI agents and platform capabilities, early deployments surface complex real\-world challenges, from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge\-case enterprise workflows. The Developer Platform FDE team focuses on agent development: custom AI agents and agentic apps that run on Workday rails and surface anywhere. We work with the customers building their own agents on the Workday Developer Platform, using the same infrastructure Workday uses to power its own agents. Every agent we help ship inherits the security model, business process controls, and audit trail of the system of record for people and money at some of the world’s largest organizations, and thanks to open protocols, those agents can show up in Workday, in Sana, or inside the AI tools people already use every day. FDEs also serve as a critical feedback engine for Product and Engineering. On the Developer Platform team, you’ll build production agents with Developer Agent, Agent\-Ready Tools, and the Agent Harness, and work directly with the product and engineering teams behind those tools. Field insights, recurring customer friction, and proven build patterns become scalable, out\-of\-the\-box capabilities that reach every developer building on Workday. It’s a team where deep technical skill meets real customer impact every day, with direct influence over where the platform goes next. **About the Role** As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Developer Platform FDE team, you’ll combine hands\-on agent engineering with direct customer work. Working alongside senior FDEs, you’ll help enterprise customers build, deploy, and optimize custom AI agents and agentic apps inside live customer environments. You’ll work with the full Workday Developer Platform stack. You’ll run custom agents on the Workday Agent Harness, the same agent runtime and infrastructure Workday uses internally. You’ll build agents, apps, and orchestrations in plain language with Developer Agent, from the Workday Developer Site, a VS Code–compatible IDE plug\-in, or any other MCP\-compatible agentic tool, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. You’ll wire agents into hundreds of governed, LLM\-native Agent\-Ready Tools for HR and finance data over MCP, and build with industry\-leading ADKs and agent frameworks. You’ll connect agents to each other and to the places people work using open standards like MCP, A2A, and A2UI, alongside REST APIs. And you’ll do it with governance built in, not bolted on, through Workday Extend AI, the Agent System of Record, Agent Passport, and Workday Data Cloud. You’ll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside senior FDEs, AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. You’ll help drive immediate customer success while building deep expertise in enterprise agent engineering, and every engagement will sharpen both your technical skills and your sense of what makes a platform great to build on. **What you'll do:** * **Agent Engineering \& Deployment:** Build, configure, test, and debug custom AI agents and agentic apps inside live enterprise tenants, working against live data, business processes, and security configurations. * **Customer Discovery \& Solution Support:** Participate in technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders, and help translate business requirements into product configurations, POCs, and integration specs. * **Developer Toolkit Feedback:** Be a hands\-on, everyday user of Developer Agent, Agent\-Ready Tools, and the Agent Harness. Document bugs, edge\-case failures, and friction points with h Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent2Agent (A2A), including building or consuming MCP servers. * Experience with one or more agent development kits or orchestration frameworks. * Familiarity with evaluating and testing LLM\-powered systems. * Experience with Workday Extend, Workday Orchestrate, or Workday Integrations. Open\-source contributions, side projects, or hackathon work involving AI agents or developer tooling. * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton Primary Location Base Pay Range: $148,000 USD \- $222,000 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $123,900 USD \- $222,000 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law. adoption of generative and agentic AI technologies. * Design and support AI solutions connecting to enterprise systems such as Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, IBM i (iSeries), and Ansible, PowerShell, Python) to deliver repeatable, version\-controlled, and policy\-compliant cloud deployments. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) for Response** * Implement enterprise cloud monitoring and observability (e.g., Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, CloudWatch, SolarWinds) to drive proactive alerting, root\-cause analysis, and capacity business continuity capabilities for critical workloads. * Participate in major incident response, problem management, and post\-incident reviews; follow ServiceNow ITSM change, incident, and CMDB Compliance** * Apply cloud security best practices, including Zero Trust principles, least\-privilege access, network segmentation, encryption, and secure configuration baselines, in partnership with Cybersecurity. * Implement and maintain cloud governance guardrails using Azure Policy, AWS Organizations/SCPs, tagging standards, and role\-based access control. * Remediate cloud vulnerabilities and configuration findings, and support compliance and audit requirements (e.g., NIST CSF, SOX ITGC, PCI DSS). **Collaboration \& Technical Leadership** * Independently plan and deliver complex cloud engineering projects from design through implementation and post\-deployment optimization, providing regular status updates to leadership. * Provide indirect leadership, technical mentoring, and effectively with cloud providers, managed service partners, and vendors, ensuring accountability for service quality, scope, and cost. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** * 10\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud engineering, or cloud operations roles, including at least 5 years hands\-on with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS in production environments. * Deep hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Azure (Landing Zones, VNets, Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, compute, storage, and PaaS services), with working knowledge of AWS. * Experience enabling infrastructure for AI/GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Platform Vertex AI), AI gateways, MCP servers, and agentic AI technologies. * Strong experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and automation tools such as Terraform, Bicep/ARM, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python. * Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and Git\-based workflows. * Experience with containers and Kubernetes (AKS and/or EKS) in production. * Solid understanding of cloud networking, including hybrid connectivity (ExpressRoute, VPN), DNS, load balancing, routing (BGP), and network security controls. * Strong knowledge of cloud security, identity and access management, and governance best practices. * Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management tools and ITIL\-aligned processes (e.g., ServiceNow, PagerDuty). * Experience with cloud FinOps practices and tools. * Proven track record of jobs.title: Enterprise AI and Data Architect
jobs.description: **Company Description** Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI\-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership\-based and service\-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. **Job Description** **About the opportunity** You’ll be the enterprise architect for data and AI across all seven of our business units. You’ll set the architecture, standards and shared platform that every team builds on, so business units can focus on building products that set them apart, within clear guardrails for security, governance and interoperability. A big part of the job is drawing the line between what we build once centrally (the shared foundation, platform services and standards) and what each business unit owns and builds for itself. You’ll be accountable for making sure our AI and data investments deliver measurable business results and a lasting competitive advantage. This is a hands\-on role. You’ll spend 60 to 80% of your time building. **What you’ll do** ***Architecture and standards*** * Own the enterprise target architecture for data and AI, and publish and maintain reference architectures, standards and decision records * Set architectural principles: modularity, API\-first design, interoperability, reuse, portability and lifecycle management * Decide what’s central by default, what becomes central once reuse is proven, what stays with business units, and what’s jointly owned * Give clear guidance on which technologies, models and patterns to use for which job * Keep a forward\-looking view of AI technologies, vendors, models and frameworks ***Agentic AI platform*** * Help shape the reference architecture for model access, context management, orchestration, retrieval, evaluations, guardrails, identity and telemetry * Help design multi\-tenancy patterns that scale to 130,000\+ businesses, including agents built by customers and partners * Set release requirements for agents: approvals, versioning, rollback, guardrails as policy code and evaluation gates ***Data architecture*** * Set enterprise data standards on Snowflake: semantic layer, governed metrics, data contracts, quality rules, lineage, retention and deletion * Define the split between central standards and business\-unit domain models, and review those models for consistency * Define the technical criteria for data readiness used in product planning * Work with Legal and Privacy on the data architecture for our industry insights product, covering rights, aggregation, consent and lineage ***Standards for AI\-assisted development*** * Turn standards into context that AI coding agents use: repository instruction files, reusable skills and prompts, MCP tool definitions and starter templates * Build architecture rules into CI: policy as code, fitness functions, scans on AI\-generated code, and evaluation gates before release * Define what coding and runtime agents can do in each environment, including tool allow\-lists, least\-privilege access, no secrets or card data in prompts or logs, and human review based on risk * Set patterns for wrapping legacy products with MCP and for AI\-assisted migration * Track delivery metrics such as PR\-to\-production rate, rework within 21 days, change failure rate and AI cost per accepted change ***Security, privacy and responsible AI*** * Work with the AI Security Architect, CISO, Legal and Privacy to build security into every reference architecture: threat models, least privilege, tenant isolation, prompt\-injection defences and server\-side action validation * Make sure the architecture supports data residency, tenant isolation, retention, deletion and contractual data\-use limits * Assess risks from model providers, external AI services, open\-source models, training data, dependencies and third\-party integrations ***Cost, observability and reliability*** * Design cost control into the platform: cost tracking by business unit, product and workflow, token and latency budgets, caching and kill switches * Optimise token use, model choice, context size, retrieval efficiency and compute * Define a standard telemetry schema in Datadog covering outcome, quality, cost and security signals * Set service\-level objectives for central platform services ***Governance and vendors*** * Set up an AI and data governance framework covering ownership, accountability, decision rights, data quality and escalation * Chair the fortnightly Data and AI Architecture, Security and Risk Council, and present trade\-offs to the Executive AI Steering group * Lead technical evaluation of AI platforms, models and data tools, and reduce overlap and lock\-in (one gateway, abstraction layers, a tested exit plan) * Set technical standards for consultants, including code in Xplor repos, pairing with our engineers and k Modernised legacy monoliths, including wrapping them with APIs so agents can use them At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersection of differences \- people of different cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you don’t quite tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. **Additional Information** **Values and Life at Xplor** Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: * Find a better way * Do the right thing * Say it straight * Win together * Own the outcome If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. jobs.description: **Company Description** At Xplor, we believe that helping people make the most of each day is the most rewarding way to spend ours. We give small and medium\-sized businesses cloud\-based, intuitive technology solutions that enable them to manage all the hassles of running and growing a business, so business owners can get back to doing what they love. With Xplor Pay, we help businesses get paid quickly and securely – without hidden fees. We built the tech ourselves, and our platform delivers secure, transparent, fast, and accurate payments. We are unified by our purpose of helping people to succeed. So, when you become part of our team, you also become part of the personal connection that strengthens the relationship people have with Xplor products. **Job Description** **Position overview** The Head of AI/ML R\&D decides, with evidence, whether an AI system works, how well, for whom, and at what cost. They come from data science and machine learning, and they build today with AI\-native tools and agentic development. The role owns the science of evaluation across every agent, the predictive and decision models behind the shared agents (churn, demand, payment recovery, fraud), and the experiment design that lets Finance count AI value once, against a holdout. The role is hands\-on. At least 50% of time goes to building models, evals and experiments; the rest to setting methods, reviewing, and growing a small team. This role makes what engineers ship measurable, cheaper and trustworthy, and supplies the models where an LLM alone is the wrong tool. **Key responsibilities** **1\. Evaluation science for every agent** o Set the enterprise eval methodology: golden\-set design, sampling, labelling and inter\-rater agreement, LLM\-as\-judge validation, slice analysis and statistical thresholds. o Own the quality signals in the minimum telemetry contract: task success, groundedness, hallucination and escalation rates. o Re\-run evals per BU and tenant on every agent\-core upgrade; catch regressions before customers do. **2\. Predictive and decision models behind the shared agents** o Build and run the models the horizontal pods need: churn and retention uplift, payment\-recovery propensity and timing, demand and capacity forecasting, later fraud and onboarding risk. o Choose the right tool per task: classical ML, a small or fine\-tuned model, retrieval, or a frontier LLM. o Ship models to production on the golden path, with monitoring for drift and feedback loops. **3\. Model economics** o Build the evidence behind model routing: accuracy, cost and latency per task, so routing is a measured decision. o Drive cost per successful task down through distillation, caching strategy, smaller models and prompt and context optimization. **4\. AI\-native R\&D and horizon scanning** o Prototype varied techniques (agent memory, planning, multi\-agent patterns, synthetic data) against real Xplor problems. o Turn what works into reference implementations in the golden path; retire what doesn't. o Bring a monthly view of what has changed in models and methods, and what it means for our roadmap. **5\. Data science for Data\-as\-a\-Service** o Shape the statistical design of benchmarks and indices: cohort minimums, anonymization, and comparability across businesses. o Lead entity\-resolution modeling with the data team. 6\. Raise the ML fluency of the whole R\&D organization o Teach evals, experimentation and probabilistic thinking through the AI\-P/SDLC training and office hours. o Pair with BU engineers on hard model problems in lighthouse BUs; reviews others' code credibly. * Has worked on SaaS or marketplace data at scale: multi\-tenant, messy, many products. * Explains model trade\-offs and uncertainty to executives in business terms (revenue, margin, risk). **Preferred** * Churn, retention, propensity or pricing models in subscription or SMB software. * Payments ML: recovery, dunning optimization, fraud or risk scoring. * Fine\-tuning, distillation or small\-model work to cut inference cost. * LLM\-as\-judge design and validation; red\-teaming of model behavior. * Snowflake (or similar) and feature stores; Datadog or OpenTelemetry for model monitoring. * Familiar with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and with privacy rules for analytics across AU, NZ, US, UK and EU. * Published research or open\-source work is a plus, not a requirement. **Competencies and behaviors** * Evidence first. We're not only the largest Mexican\-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we're also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands. We're a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self\-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we're at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más. ***At Taco Bell, we're Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion\-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.*** **About the Job** The SOFTWARE ENGINEER III is responsible for developing, testing, deploying, and supporting scalable software and integration services within Taco Bell's Customer Middleware platform, helping connect digital ordering, loyalty, customer identity, messaging, and restaurant experiences. product and business requirements into technical designs, API contracts, implementation plans, and well\-defined engineering stories, working with senior engineers, architects, and partner teams to identify integration dependencies, edge cases, and operational risks. * Partner with software engineers, quality engineers, product leaders, platform teams, vendors, and external delivery teams to coordinate implementation, testing, defect resolution, and production validation across connected systems (including E\-Commerce, Braze, Akamai, and AWS). * Participate in code and technical design reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers, and apply and contribute to established engineering standards for reliability, security, maintainability, observability, automated testing, and deployment. * Investigate and help resolve complex production and non\-production issues using application logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and test results; collaborate with engineering and platform teams on remediation of environment\-dependent behavior, rate limits, integration failures, and security findings. * Contribute to improvements in the engineering lifecycle by addressing technical debt, applying reusable software patterns, expanding automation, documenting system behavior, and supporting secure, dependable releases through CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. **Is This You?** * At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience developing and supporting production applications, APIs, distributed services, or integration platforms, with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent years of experience. * Hands\-on experience with a modern server\-side programming language and ecosystem (preferably TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js), including automated unit and integration testing, debugging, dependency management, and maintainable software\-development practices. * Experience developing and integrating REST or GraphQL APIs, asynchronous events, queues, and service\-to\-service integrations, with an understanding of authentication, error handling, retry behavior, idempotency, and API\-contract management. * Experience building or operating applications on a major cloud platform, preferably AWS, using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, education benefits * Generous parental leave for all new parents and adoption assistance program * 401(k) with a 6% matching contribution from Yum! jobs.title: Senior Quality Supplier Engineer
jobs.description: About Zenflow Zenflow, Inc. is a privately held medical device company dedicated to improving treatment for patients suffering from urinary obstruction caused by enlarged prostate. The innovative Spring® technology was designed with the patient experience in mind and relies on a small spring\-like coil that gently props open the urethra, restoring its normal function while preserving the natural anatomy. The Zenflow Spring System is now FDA approved for commercial sale. **PURPOSE OF JOB**: The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving the supplier quality program as the company commercializes its first product. While supplier quality is the core focus of this role, the Sr. QE is expected to contribute to the broader quality function as needed, including support for internal audits, CAPA, nonconformance management, and quality system improvements. This role ensures that all components, sub\-assemblies, and materials sourced from external suppliers consistently meet Zenflow's quality, safety, and regulatory requirements. The Sr. QE works cross\-functionally with R\&D, Manufacturing Operations, and Regulatory to qualify new suppliers, manage supplier performance, and drive resolution of supply chain quality issues. This role is expected to operate with a high degree of independence and ownership, helping to build scalable supplier quality systems that will support Zenflow's next\-generation product pipeline. **MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: **Supplier Qualification \& Onboarding** * Lead the qualification of new suppliers, including the development and execution of Supplier Qualification Plans (SQPs) and associated audits. * Evaluate supplier quality systems, manufacturing capabilities, and risk profiles through desk assessments, on\-site audits, and technical reviews. * Manage Approved Supplier List (ASL) maintenance and ensure supplier files are complete, current, and compliant with QMS requirements. * Collaborate with Procurement and R\&D to identify, evaluate, and qualify suppliers for new product introductions and design changes. **Incoming Quality \& Inspection*** Develop, implement, and maintain Incoming Quality Control (IQC) processes, inspection plans, and acceptance criteria for purchased components and materials. * Review and approve First Article Inspection Reports (FAIRs), Certificates of Conformance (CoC), and material/dimensional data packages. * Drive resolution of incoming inspection failures and nonconforming material with suppliers in a timely and documented manner. * Support the implementation and validation of statistical sampling plans (e.g., ANSI/ASQ Z1\.4, Z1\.9\) appropriate for a commercial\-stage medical device company. **Supplier Performance Management*** Establish and maintain supplier scorecards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) including quality, delivery, and responsiveness metrics. * Lead Supplier Corrective Action Request (SCAR) processes; work directly with suppliers to ensure timely, effective root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA). * Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews and communicate findings to internal stakeholders. * Escalate chronic supplier performance issues and recommend re\-qualification, resource changes, or supplier transitions as appropriate. **Quality System \& Regulatory Compliance*** Ensure all supplier quality activities are performed in compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation), ISO 13485, and applicable international standards. * Author, review, and maintain supplier quality SOPs, work instructions, and quality records within the Zenflow Quality Management System (QMS). * Support internal and external audits (FDA inspections, Notified Body audits) with supplier quality documentation and evidence. * Participate in Management Review and Quality meetings as a supplier quality subject matter expert. **Broader Quality Function Support*** Contribute to internal audit programs, nonconformance investigations, and CAPA processes as capacity and business needs require. * Support quality system improvements and QMS maintenance activities in collaboration with the broader Quality team. * Provide quality engineering input to design control, risk management, and design transfer activities. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Partner with R\&D to review supplier\-related design inputs, specifications, and drawing requirements to ensure manufacturability and quality at source. * Support Manufacturing Operations a in resolving supply chain disruptions, material shortages, and nonconformance events. * Contribute to product risk assessments and FMEAs with supply chain quality inputs. * Provide supplier quality input to new product development and design transfer activities. **Continuous Improvement*** Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives within the supplier base and internal receiving/inspection processes. * Apply quality tools such as 8D, Fishbone/Ishikawa, 5\-Why, FMEA, and SPC to solve supplier quality problems. * Benchmark supplier quality best practices and recommend enhancements to Zenflow's supplier quality program as the company scales. **General*** Perform all duties in compliance with Zenflow's QMS and applicable regulatory requirements. * Travel to supplier sites as required to conduct audits, support qualification activities, or resolve quality issues (estimated 20–30%). **EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**: * Bachelor's degree required in Engineering, Materials Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree a plus. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or equivalent certification preferred. **EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:*** Minimum 5\+ of quality engineering experience in the medical device industry, with a primary focus in supplier quality. * Demonstrated senior\-level ownership of supplier quality programs; experience building or significantly improving supplier quality processes strongly preferred. * Hands\-on experience with hardware/electromechanical medical device components and manufacturing processes (e.g., machined parts, molded components, electromechanical assemblies, sterile packaging). * Demonstrated experience conducting supplier audits (ISO 13485 / FDA QSR) and managing Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs). * Experience supporting or leading first\-product commercialization in a medical device startup or small company environment strongly preferred. * Proficiency with quality tools including FMEA, SPC, 8D, root cause analysis, and sampling plans. * Familiarity with FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 (Risk Management), and applicable standards. * Exposure to broader quality engineering functions (internal audits, CAPA, nonconformance management) is a plus. * Experience building or significantly improving a supplier quality program from the ground up, ideally in a small\- to mid\-size medical device company. * Proven ability to manage supplier relationships independently, including difficult conversations around performance, corrective actions, and escalations. * Comfort supporting the broader QMS and contributing to quality functions beyond supplier quality when business needs require it. * Strong technical writing skills; ability to author clear, audit\-ready quality documentation (SOPs, work instructions, qualification reports). * Proficiency with eQMS platforms (e.g., Greenlight Guru, MasterControl, Veeva Vault, or similar) and standard office/data tools. * Excellent verbal and written skills, with the ability to convey complex quality issues in clear, concise terms. **OTHER QUALIFICATIONS**: * Self\-directed, detail\-oriented, and highly organized. * Proactive ownership mindset, with the ability to identify problems early, develop practical solutions, and drives issues to closure. * Collaborative team player who works well in a small, cross\-functional team; able and willing to flex into broader quality responsibilities as the business requires. * High integrity and commitment to patient safety as the ultimate driver of all quality decisions. This position is based in South San Francisco, CA. The expected salary range for this position is $120,000\-$135,000, plus comprehensive benefits and equity. The base pay range reflects the target range for this position, but individual pay will be determined by additional factors such as job\-related skills, experience and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ At Zillow Group, our mission is to help more people get home. The CoreTech Org delivers on this mission by building the foundational platforms, data, and developer capabilities that power every consumer, partner, and employee experience at Zillow. You will work most closely with the Connections Platform (CP) — the engine that turns consumer interest into a connection with the right partner, owning the conversational experience, the lead funnel and follow\-up workflows, and the shared agent services that sit underneath both. Increasingly, that experience is powered by LLM\-based and agentic systems: agents that qualify leads, summarize and extract intelligence from conversations for partner teams, and drive proactive outreach. Beyond CP, you will be a measurement partner for the broader CoreTech Org — the foundational platforms every consumer, partner, and employee experience at Zillow is built on — wherever a hard data science problem needs an owner. These are platforms with hundreds of touchpoints and dozens of dependent teams — and they have historically been among the hardest places at Zillow to measure well. CP itself is mid\-transformation, shifting from NLP to LLM and agent\-based systems, with agents increasingly built and relied on in production but no rigorous way to evaluate them yet. That combination — high dependency, hard\-to\-measure, and changing fast — is exactly where rigorous measurement creates the most leverage. **About the role** ------------------ We are seeking a **Principal Data Scientist** to be a measurement and impact partner in CoreTech. This is a senior individual\-contributor role embedded with the Data \& Infrastructure Platform team and who will partner tightly with Product leadership. You will own four outcomes: (1\) make the impact of platform work legible — quantifying what shipped, what moved, and what didn’t, in terms leaders can act on; (2\) define the metrics that matter for CP and the other platforms you take on — what belongs on a progress dashboard, what is a leading vs. lagging indicator, and what is vanity; (3\) build the evaluation layer CP is missing — standing up rigorous, repeatable evals for its LLM and agentic systems (including LLM\-as\-a\-judge) so the team can tell whether an agent actually works, not just that it shipped; and (4\) operationalize and instrument those metrics and evals in partnership with engineering — getting the events emitted, the pipelines stable, the dashboards live, and the data trusted. The defining challenge of this role is twofold. The first is **measuring causal impact** : CP has live, expensive, executive\-facing questions that hinge on making a credible impact claim when a clean A/B test isn’t available — conversational and agent\-driven flows that span a lead’s journey across sessions and channels, and changes that roll out to everyone at once. The second is **establishing an** **evaluation feedback loop** : much of CP now runs on LLM\-based and agentic systems that were built by engineers with no rigorous way to measure whether they actually work. You will own how we evaluate these systems — defining the signals that matter, standing up eval and experimentation frameworks (including LLM\-as\-a\-judge), and separating activity and adoption from genuine quality and outcomes. The same question recurs across CoreTech in many different areas, and you will need to help prove whether new features or infrastructure actually pay off, rather than trusting activity or adoption as proof. Owning these questions is the heart of the job. This is a high\-leverage, cross\-Zillow role: your work will set the measurement bar for platforms every product team at Zillow depends on, and your point of view will directly shape how Data \& Infrastructure Platform OKRs are written and reviewed at the executive level. **You will:** * Define and operationalize the measurement strategy for the Connections Platform and the broader Data \& Infrastructure Platform team — owning the throughline from raw events to executive dashboards and causal inference attribution. * Own the evaluation of CP’s LLM\-based and agentic systems: design the evals, define the quality signals, and build the frameworks (including LLM\-as\-a\-judge and using tooling such as Braintrust) that tell us whether an agent is actually working. * Own the causal inference and experimentation program for these teams: design and analyze A/B tests where you can, and where you can’t, build the quasi\-experimental causal inference design (switchbacks, difference\-in\-difference, synthetic control, interrupted time\-series) that produces a defensible estimate of impact. Know which method the situation calls for, what assumptions it rests on, and make the call for the best method to answer each hard question. * Be the credible authority on “what to measure” and “what to experiment on” for these teams — pushing back on vanity metrics, identifying the leading indi s, Econometrics, Data Science, User Experience Research, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. * Direct experience measuring complex, production user\-facing systems – for example, non\-deterministic ones such as conversational, LLM\-based, or agentic products (chat and voice assistants, lead or conversation funnels, agent\-driven workflows). * Fluency with modern evaluation methods and the judgment to know which signals to trust – approaches like LLM\-as\-a\-judge and offline/online eval harnesses, or adjacent evaluation experience. * Experience measuring the impact of AI or agentic tooling on real outcomes — separating adoption and activity from genuine productivity or quality gain, and reasoning about ROI against spend. * Experience operating inside a Platform\-as\-a\-Product model with internal teams as customers. * Fluency with quasi\-experimental and causal inference methods for when randomization isn’t possible — difference\-in\-difference, synthetic control, interrupted time\-series, and switchback or interleaved designs — including the discipline to state assumptions explicitly and be clear about what you can and cannot measure. **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

comparable solutions. * Strong understanding of testing, debugging, security, and performance optimization. * Experience working in fast\-paced environments with changing priorities. * Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills. **Strongly Preferred** * Experience working at an early\-stage SaaS startup. * Experience building multi\-tenant software platforms. * Experience integrating LLM APIs, AI agents, or workflow automation. * Experience with AI orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or tool calling. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated QA, and infrastructure as code. * Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, or other data\-security and compliance frameworks. * Experience building legal technology, healthcare technology, or other complex workflow products. * Experience working directly with founders or small product teams. **Who Thrives Here** You're likely a great fit if you: * Love building software more than talking about building software. * Are naturally curious about AI and use it regularly. * Prefer ownership and accountability over layers of management. * Can make pragmatic technical decisions without overengineering. * Enjoy platform, and admin tooling. * Design, build, and maintain high\-performance, reusable, and reliable code in multiple programming languages and platforms. * Help establish a supported web\-platform jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gravitee** ------------------ Recognized in Gartner's inaugural 2026 Magic Quadrant for AI Agent Management Platforms and named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for API Management for three consecutive years, Gravitee brings AI agents and the APIs they rely on under one unified control plane. We provide a platform for managing and securing APIs, event streams, and AI agent interactions. Organizations including Michelin, Roche, and Blue Yonder use Gravitee to control and observe systems their businesses depend on. **Why join us?** * **The mission:** Help define how enterprises securely adopt AI agents, alongside the APIs and event streams they already rely on. * **The momentum:** Join a high\-growth market leader that combines proven technology and customer trust with the pace of a scale\-up. * **The culture:** We hire pragmatic builders who take ownership, collaborate openly, and Hold Nothing Back. **The Role \& Why It Exists** ----------------------------- We are looking for Senior Software Engineers to build Gravitee's core products and the next\-generation product surface in Gamma. You will join one of three areas: API Management (APIM) and the gateway runtime, Access Management (AM), or the Event Gateway for Kafka. The work sits where API governance, identity, event streaming, and AI agent management meet. These are new roles in the US. Today, most core platform engineering is based in Europe. These hires build US\-hours ownership of Level 3 and Level 4 escalations for our products, and add delivery capacity toward parity in Gamma and the AI Agent Management roadmap. You will split your time roughly 80% feature delivery and 20% L3/L4 support and bug fixing (it varies week to week), working as an embedded member of a product team based in Europe. We will match you to the area that best fits your experience. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable moving between services, APIs, data models, and technical design. **Location:** Denver, Colorado preferred. Elsewhere in the US is acceptable, with monthly travel to the Denver hub. **What You Will Be Doing** -------------------------- **In this role, you will:** * Design and deliver features end to end, from technical design through implementation, testing, release, and iteration, on one of Gravitee's product areas: API Management and the gateway runtime, Access Management, or the Event Gateway for Kafka. * Build and evolve Java services and APIs, including performance\-sensitive, asynchronous code in the runtime. * Contribute to the customer experience in the Gamma console, across backend APIs and TypeScript and Angular interfaces, as your team needs. * Keep security behavior and upgrades safe: secure defaults, certificate and secret handling, audit logs, safe migrations, and backward compatibility. * Own US\-hours Level 3 and Level 4 escalations for your product as part of the L3 pager duty rotation. * Help bring AI agent management to the platform, including AI Gateways, MCP, and agent\-to\-agent interactions. * Use LLMs and AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully for prototyping, implementation, testing, and debugging, applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI\-generated work. * Write meaningful automated tests and contribute to reliable delivery, across Gravitee's open\-source platform and Enterprise Edition. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers, including teams based in Europe, and improve solutions through code and design reviews. **Essential Skills** -------------------- **We are looking for evidence that you can succeed in the role, whether gained through employment, open\-source work, or equivalent practical experience:** * 5\+ years building and operating production software, on a team that ships and supports its own product; you have personally resolved production incidents. * Strong Java experience, including maintainable REST APIs and backend services. Strong C\# with the same object\-oriented depth is also considered. * A solid understanding of API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and asynchronous workflows. * Experience with relational or document data stores, including safe migrations and backward compatibility. * A security\-first mindset: authentication and authorization fundamentals, secure defaults, and certificate and secret handling. * Experience with automated testing, Git\-based development, code review, and iterative product delivery. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants as part of an engineering workflow, combined with the judgment to review and improve their output. * Clear communication, and the ability to take an ambiguous problem through to production. * Willingness to join an L3 pager duty rotation in US hours. **Desired Skills** ------------------ **You do not need to match every item. We would be especially interested in experience with:** * Gateways and runtimes: reactive Java (Vert.x, RxJava, Netty), or an API gateway, proxy, or service\-mesh vendor or platform team (for example Kong, Google Apigee, MuleSoft, Tyk, Solo.io, Traefik, WSO2\). * Identity: implementing OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows, SAML 2\.0, SCIM, MFA, WebAuthn/FIDO2, or FAPI, CIBA, and UMA profiles. * Event streaming: Kafka internals, binary protocols, backpressure, and performance under load. * Frontend: TypeScript with Angular or another component\-based framework, including data\-rich interfaces. * Cloud native: Docker, Kubernetes, operators and CRDs, and Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. * AI: MCP, Agent2Agent (A2A), tool calling, LLM proxies, or building LLM\-powered applications. Prior production experience is not required. * Open\-source software or enterprise developer platforms. **Who Thrives at Gravitee** --------------------------- Our growth is powered by people who bring passion to what they build, professionalism to how they work, and a commitment to doing things well**.** **You will thrive here if you:** * Bring energy and a constructive attitude to the team. * Adapt quickly and enjoy learning unfamiliar technologies and domains. * Take ownership, communicate clearly, and follow through with urgency. * Balance delivery speed with thoughtful engineering judgment. * Start with the customer problem and care about the quality of the experience you create. * Enjoy working in a fast\-moving, collaborative, international environment. **Life at Gravitee** -------------------- At Gravitee, we invest in humans, not just roles. **You'll get:** * Competitive medical coverage. * Pension / 401(k) program options. * Stock options \- you build it, you own it. * 25 days of holiday plus in\-country national holidays. * Three mental health days and a wellness allowance. * Your birthday off. * A professional development budget to support your growth. * A hybrid work culture with hubs across regions. * Quarterly team events and an annual company offsite. * A collaborative, international company culture. * Opportunities to grow your scope and career as Gravitee grows. *At Gravitee, we believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams.* *No employee or applicant will be treated less favorably on the grounds of sex, marital status, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, religion, or belief.* *By applying, you consent to Gravitee storing and processing the personal information you submit as part of the recruitment process.*

jobs.title: Software Integration Engineer - Associate
jobs.description: **About the Role** iCapital is looking to hire a Software Integration Engineer \- Associate to join the Annuities Platform Team. This role develops, tests and supports well\-defined integration solutions that connect client and product systems. The work spans application, API, and database layers and follows established engineering, quality and integration standards. This role will provide exposure to ownership of development, testing, deployment support and troubleshooting over time. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain integrations of moderate complexity independently using C\#, .NET, REST APIs, XML, JSON, Entity Framework, LINQ and SQL. * Clarify integration requirements, API contracts, data mappings, validations and expected system behavior by taking an active part in story grooming and technical discussions. * Develop, consume, and validate REST APIs, applying knowledge of HTTP methods, request and response structures, status codes, authentication concepts, headers and error handling. * Use Postman to test different payloads, analyze API responses and troubleshoot integration failures. * Work with XML and JSON data structures, mappings, transformations and validation, and troubleshoot malformed or unexpected data. * Apply Entity Framework and LINQ for application data access, querying and manipulation * Use SQL to investigate data\-related issues, validate integration results, troubleshoot application behavior and support development and testing activities. * Troubleshoot integration issues and resolve defects across development, QA, UAT and production support scenarios within established team processes. Analyze application logs, API requests and responses, XML and JSON payloads, database records, configuration and error messages. * Manage source control in Git, including branching, committing, pulling, merging, resolving basic conflicts and following established source\-control practices. * Use Azure DevOps for CI/CD activities, builds, deployments, work tracking and troubleshooting basic pipeline or deployment issues. * Understand and make basic React frontend changes when integration functionality requires matching UI updates. * Manage assigned Jira tickets and follow issues through development, testing and deployment. * Take part in peer code reviews, applying coding, security, maintainability and integration best practices. * Build knowledge of core product and integration workflows and the business domain. * Support critical production issues, deployments and business\-critical activities during occasional weekends or off\-hours, as needed. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software development or integration engineering experience, preferably involving API\-based and enterprise application integrations * Strong working knowledge of C\#, .NET, object\-oriented programming and common design principles * Hands\-on experience developing and consuming REST APIs, with an understanding of API error handling, logging, validation, authentication, configuration management and reusable integration practices * Strong working knowledge of XML and JSON, including parsing, validation, data mapping and troubleshooting payload\-related issues * Good working knowledge of SQL, including joins, filtering, data validation and troubleshooting application or integration\-related data issues * Experience using Postman for API testing, request configuration, payload validation, authentication and response analysis * Solid understanding of Git, including branching, commits, pull requests, merging and resolving basic merge conflicts * Agile and Scrum processes, sprint planning, story grooming and iterative software delivery * Strong problem\-solving skills, and able to trace failures across systems rather than focusing only on individual application components. This includes troubleshooting across the API, application code, XML and JSON payload, database, configuration and deployment layers * Able to work with the Product, QA, DevOps, Integration and Support Teams to investigate and resolve end\-to\-end integration issues * Willingness to work occasional weekends or off\-hours on rotation, as required. * Hands\-on experience with Entity Framework and LINQ for retrieving and manipulating application data is *nice to have.* * Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, including repositories, build and release pipelines, work items and basic CI/CD concepts is *nice to have.* * Familiarity with React and modern web application concepts, and able to understand or support integration\-related frontend changes is *nice to have,* * Experience using Visual Studio and standard debugging, logging and error\-analysis techniques is *nice to have.* * Able to write clean, maintainable, testable code and create appropriate unit tests using frameworks such as NUnit or xUnit is *nice to have* * Working knowledge of Jira or similar ticketing systems is *nice to have* * Familiar with Copilot or similar AI\-assisted development tools for development, troubleshooting and productivity is *nice to have* **Benefits** The base salary range for this role is $80,000 to $95,000 USD. This position is paid on an hourly basis and is classified as non\-exempt. Employees in this role are eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable law. iCapital offers a compensation package that includes equity for all full\-time employees and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer\-matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer\-paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and paid time off (PTO). We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday\-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday. This position is based in our Salt Lake City office. For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us X: @icapitalnetwork \| LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital\-network\-inc \| Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us/recognition/ iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer.
