jobs.title: People Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Nscale is building an AI\-native People function. As a People Systems Engineer, you'll build the custom tools, integrations, and AI agents that make our People platforms work as one system and help our teams support a growing global workforce. This is a greenfield opportunity to shape how we build. You'll have meaningful ownership of technical design, tooling, and delivery, with room to experiment with frontier AI capabilities and take promising ideas into production. Your scope includes extending Workday and Greenhouse, connecting systems, and independently developing applications and services beyond existing platforms. Working alongside the People Systems Product Manager and Corporate Engineering partners, you'll build agentic workflows that answer questions, complete tasks, and bring people in when judgment is needed. Trusted workforce data and permission\-aware access are foundations for this work, allowing agents to act under the user's identity and within applicable permissions, business rules, and approval requirements. Our engineering principles are straightforward: use proven platforms where the problem is solved, build where we need something new, and make agentic workflows a core part of how we scale. Everything we deploy must be something we can support. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Independently design, build, and support custom People tools, applications, and services * Develop agentic workflows and People capabilities for Nscale's shared employee agent, taking emerging models and AI tooling from experimentation into production * Build integrations and automations across Workday, Greenhouse, and adjacent systems, connecting employee lifecycle processes around authoritative data sources * Partner with Security and Corporate Engineering on reusable access services for applications and agents, enforcing user permissions and business approval requirements, and capturing audit evidence * Make technical design and build\-versus\-buy decisions through shared architecture and security reviews, accounting for existing capabilities and total cost of ownership * Own delivery from design through business acceptance, release, evaluation, and ongoing support, retiring redundant tools and manual processes as capabilities mature **What You Bring** ------------------ * A track record of independently shipping and supporting custom applications, enterprise integrations, or automation solutions * Strong technical skills across application development, APIs, data flows, and automation tooling, with judgment about when to configure, integrate, or build * Demonstrated ability to build production\-grade LLM applications and tool\-using AI agents, with hands\-on experience using integration protocols such as MCP to integrate agents with enterprise systems * Practical Workday expertise across integrations, security, business processes, and workforce data, supported by a working knowledge of the employee lifecycle * Ability to translate ambiguous needs into maintainable solutions, secure access patterns, and achievable delivery commitments * Clear communication with engineers, People partners, and senior stakeholders about architecture, trade\-offs, total cost of ownership, and risk **Outcomes You'll Own** ----------------------- * Greater operational capacity through custom tooling, automation, and agent\-led self\-service, measured by successful task completion and reduced manual effort * Useful AI capabilities in production, with performance measured against defined success criteria, appropriate guardrails, and effective human escalation * Trusted workforce data and secure access across connected systems, with clear authority, enforced permissions, and traceable actions * Reliable services and predictable delivery, measured against published service levels, agreed dates, and measurable business impact * A simpler, supportable technology estate, with reusable capabilities, fewer redundant tools, understood operating costs, and clear ownership **What we can offer you** ------------------------- At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core. Highly competitive US compensation package (base \+ bonus \+ equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. Join one of the fastest\-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨ Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross\-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support. Human\-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments. **Equal Opportunities Statement** --------------------------------- We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ\+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio\-economic backgrounds. If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role. *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Traffic Studies
jobs.description: **About Obvio AI** ------------------ Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar\-powered, AI\-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable, automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. Our approach has already led to a 50% reduction in reckless driving in early partner cities. Founded by the team behind Motive's AI dashcam and backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Khosla Ventures, we are building the intelligence layer for safer streets globally. **About The Role** ------------------ Obvio's traffic studies team runs short, camera\- and radar\-based data studies that measure speeding, red\-light, stop\-sign and crosswalk behavior at specific locations in a city before any enforcement program starts. Cities rely on these results, so accuracy and timely delivery matter. Today the pipeline works, but it scales with people rather than software. We are hiring a **Full\-Stack Engineer** to change that. You will own the software that takes a study from field deployment to a published report, make the routine path repeatable and largely automated, and make ad\-hoc requests (a new city, a new sensor, a new metric, a tighter timeline) something the system takes on through configuration and small extensions rather than one\-off engineering effort. You will work alongside computer\-vision engineers who hand you detectors and trackers, an annotation team that reviews and audits the results, field operations who deploy the hardware, and a go\-to\-market team that sets delivery dates with cities. Your job is the connective tissue between them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own the traffic\-study backend end to end:** ingestion from multiple sensor types, vision\-pipeline orchestration on our ML servers and cloud compute, event extraction, annotation hand\-off, statistics, and publishing to the city\-facing portal (e.g., Python services on AWS ECS/EC2, S3 event data, Postgres). * **Scale the routine path:** turn manual steps (stats entry, reprocessing, report assembly) into automated, auditable ones so a study runs the same way every time with minimal engineer involvement. * **Handle ad\-hoc requests:** new sensors (each with its own data layout and quirks), new metrics, new report formats and shorter timelines. Design the system so these become configuration and small extensions rather than rewrites. * **Design and evolve the data model:** schema design, indexing, and query performance on growing Postgres datasets that back both the pipeline and the internal tools built on top of it. * **Own pipeline health:** maintain monitoring and alerting for the vision and event\-extraction services, catch stuck or failed studies early, and drive fixes to root cause. * **Make the numbers defensible:** implement counting and violation logic from written specifications, version it, and make every reported figure traceable to the raw data and the logic that produced it. * **Coordinate across teams:** work with the annotation team on intake, view\-quality gates and delivery dates, and with field operations on deployment timing and data hand\-off; give the go\-to\-market team realistic capacity and lead\-time answers. * **Support internal tooling as a backend:** expose the APIs and data endpoints that the annotation and operations teams' tools (e.g., built in Retool) consume — presentation and review managers, calibration tools, audit dashboards, capacity and status views. **Who You Are** --------------- * **An end\-to\-end owner:** you prefer to be accountable for a whole system and its output rather than a single layer of it. * **Pragmatic:** you balance shipping fixes quickly with leaving the codebase in better shape than you found it. * **Automation\-minded:** when you see a recurring manual step, your instinct is to design it out of the process. * **Rigorous with data:** you understand that an inaccurate count delivered to a city is a credibility problem, and you build for traceability and auditability from the start. * **A clear communicator:** you write things down, make requirements explicit before implementing them, and work well across engineering, annotation, operations and go\-to\-market teams. * **Comfortable with ambiguity:** priorities shift with customer needs, and you can re\-plan without losing momentum. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful full\-stack ownership: backend services and data pipelines, plus the internal tools and front ends people use to operate them. * Experience building and operating services on a major cloud (AWS preferred: ECS/EC2, S3, IAM). * Solid database skills: schema design, indexing and query performance on growing datasets (Postgres or similar). * Experience building internal tools or dashboards, whether on a low\-code platform such as Retool or with a modern web framework. * Experience running production systems: monitoring, alerting, incident response and post\-incident fixes. * Experience orchestrating batch or compute\-heavy workloads (job queues, workers, GPU/ML servers, or similar). * Based in Islamabad or Lahore and able to work from the office. **Bonus Points** * Experience with pipelines that consume computer\-vision or sensor outputs (detections, tracks, radar), or with video and imagery at volume. * Experience with data\-quality, annotation or audit workflows. * Familiarity with IoT or edge devices and their operational quirks (timestamps, connectivity, uploads). * Startup or small\-team experience where you owned a system end to end. **Why Obvio** ------------- * Your work will help save lives and improve road safety * Series A of $54M * Fast\-moving startup environment with meaningful ownership * Competitive compensation and early\-stage equity Obvio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Obvio considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. Obvio is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are seeking a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer to lead end\-to\-end test strategy, design, development, and deployment of production test solutions for ŌURA products, working closely with internal cross\-functional teams and global Contract Manufacturers (CMs). As a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer at ŌURA, you will own the design, development, and optimization of manufacturing test solutions across the full product lifecycle — from early concept through mass production. You will be a technical leader responsible for test architecture, test software, CM execution, data analytics, and continuous quality improvement. This role requires strong hands\-on engineering skills, systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively across design, operations, quality, and external manufacturing partners. **This is a hybrid role requiring 2\-3 days a week in our San Francisco office.** ### **What You Will Do:** * Drive early and ongoing Design for Testability (DFT) engagement with Hardware, Systems, and Product teams to ensure robust, scalable, and cost\-effective product testing. * Define test requirements aligned with product specifications and quality targets, incorporating DFMEA/PFMEA, engineering specifications, and test coverage analysis into product development. * Own test engineering across the full product lifecycle, from POC and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, production ramp, and mass production. * Architect, design, and deploy manufacturing test stations, equipment, fixtures, and processes to support high\-volume production. * Develop and maintain test software and automation using Python, TestStand, and LabVIEW, including instrument control, data acquisition, test sequencing, error handling, and factory data integration. * Build modular, scalable, and maintainable test frameworks that support manufacturing efficiency, repeatability, and long\-term production needs. * Apply statistical methods including GR\&R, SPC, Cp/Cpk, correlation analysis, and DOE to validate test capability, drive process improvements, and ensure production readiness. * Lead failure analysis, root cause investigations, and resolution of complex production issues, including yield excursions, test coverage gaps, and correlation discrepancies across internal labs and external factories. Drive continuous improvement in product quality, manufacturing yield, and test cost. * Serve as the primary technical interface to Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and test equipment vendors, leading test development, qualification, deployment, sustaining, and technical issue resolution. * Partner cross\-functionally with Hardware, Firmware, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams; communicate test readiness, production risks, and technical recommendations to leadership and executive stakeholders. ### **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, test engineering, or automation (assembly, inspection, test station design, or factory deployment). * Hands\-on experience developing manufacturing test software in Python, C, C\+\+, Rust. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience supporting development builds and mass production with global manufacturing partners. * Willingness to travel upto 25% across domestic and international factory sites. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience working with wearables, consumer electronics, sensors, or embedded systems. * Strong background in test station qualification and correlation (calibration, GR\&R, Cp/Cpk, DOE). * Experience working cross\-functionally with hardware, firmware, systems, quality, and operations teams. * Familiarity with optical, RF, or semiconductor\-based test methodologies. * Proven ability to operate effectively in a global, fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills across cultures and time zones. ### **What Success Looks Like:** * First 90 Days: You've completed a DFT review on at least one active program, built working relationships with CM test teams and cross\-functional partners (Hardware, Quality, Operations), and audited existing test stations, fixtures, and software for coverage gaps. * 6 Months: You've architected and deployed a production test station or major test software release, closed at least one significant correlation or test gap between internal labs and CM factories, and shown measurable improvement in yield or false\-call rate on an owned product line. * 12 Months: You're the recognized technical authority for test engineering on your product line(s), CM teams can sustain your test solutions independently, and you've contributed reusable test frameworks or playbooks adopted by other programs. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. * **San Francisco Salary Range: $172,550 \- $203,000** A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Security
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote: United States **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- EngineeringSecurity Compliance \& ITSecurity Compliance \& IT **Compensation** ---------------- * $200K – $275K • Offers Equity *Our openings span more than one career level. The provided salary depends on many factors, such as work experience and transferable skills, business needs and impact, location, and market demands.* At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Trust \& Safety within Render’s Security team. Your mission is to keep Render a trusted place to build and run applications by preventing fraud and abuse, protecting customers from malicious activity, and making it harder for attackers to use our platform. You’ll lead a team of engineers who build and operate the systems behind this work: detection pipelines, investigation tools, automated enforcement, and protections across the customer lifecycle. You’ll combine strong people leadership with technical judgement, helping the team respond effectively to incidents while investing in systems that prevent recurring problems. You’ll partner closely with Product, Infrastructure, customer\-facing teams, Finance, and Legal to translate emerging threats and customer needs into practical engineering work. The decisions your team makes will directly affect customer safety, platform reputation, fraud losses, and the experience of legitimate developers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead and grow the Trust \& Safety engineering team through hiring, mentorship, regular feedback, performance management, and career development. * Define the team’s roadmap, balancing investigations and operational needs with sustained investments in prevention, automation, and platform protections. * Guide the design and delivery of systems that detect phishing, malicious workloads, payment fraud, and other forms of platform abuse. * Build investigation and enforcement tooling that gives responders the context to act quickly, records decisions, and supports consistent handling of escalations and appeals. * Lead the team’s response to significant fraud and abuse incidents, coordinating with other Security teams, Infrastructure, Support, Finance, and Legal. * Establish sustainable on\-call and response practices, including clear ownership, runbooks, escalation paths, and learning from incidents. * Partner with Product and Engineering to introduce protections at the right points in the customer lifecycle, balancing prevention with onboarding friction and false positives. * Turn knowledge of attacker behavior and recurring abuse campaigns into improvements that protect ence managing and developing engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and building a healthy, inclusive team. * A strong background in software and security engineering, with the ability to guide system design, review technical proposals, and make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs. * Experience building or operating systems for fraud prevention, abuse detection, Trust \& Safety, or adversarial security problems. * Experience leading teams with on\-call or incident response responsibilities, and sound judgement when decisions must be made with incomplete information. * The ability to translate ambiguous threats and business needs into clear priorities, incremental milestones, and shipped improvements. * Experience using data to evaluate detection quality, understand operational problems, and measure whether interventions work. * Clear communication and effective collaboration across engineering and business teams, including explaining risks and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical partners. * Empathy for customers and responders, high integrity, and a strong sense of ownership for both team outcomes and long\-term system health. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience with cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or services that run customer\-controlled code and workloads. * Experience addressing payment fraud, phishing, malware hosting, account compromise, or coordinated abuse campaigns. * Experience building threat intelligence pipelines, linking related malicious accounts, or integrating external reputation signals. * Familiarity with Go, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Postgres, Terraform, or Temporal. * Experience partnering with Legal and customer\-facing teams on sensitive enforcement decisions and external abuse reports. * Experience building and scaling a team at a growing company. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship. jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Full Stack AI Engineer** **Remote Opportunity** As the industry's pioneering value\-based care (VBC) technology platform, Reveleer is purpose\-built to solve the most pressing real\-world challenges faced by providers and health\-plan organizations today. By unifying retrieval, clinical intelligence, risk adjustment, quality improvement, and member management solutions into one intelligent, AI\-powered system, Reveleer streamlines fragmented workflows to supercharge productivity, enhance care quality, and optimize performance on high\-priority value\-based initiatives. **About the Team:** You will be joining a small team within Reveleer AI division, in charge of developing the next generation agentic model for clinical prospective suspecting. As a full stack software developer in our team, you will be working in the unique environment of a small team with large scale impact to enable the expansion of our product and fast growth of our users. **Responsibilities** * Apply first\-principles thinking to break down hard problems and ship durable solutions. * Understand business needs and build end\-to\-end product experiences across the stack — backend services, data pipelines, and frontend interfaces. * Build, scale, and maintain infrastructure — containerized microservices, orchestration pipelines, cloud\-native architecture. * Develop and continually improve observability of systems and infrastructure at scale. * Partner closely with clinical experts and other engineers to build highly scalable, clinically accurate systems that surface actionable insights. * Challenge the status quo. If something is slow, fragile, or over\-engineered, fix it. * Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve production issues daily. Own the problem from alert to root cause to prevention. **Required Skills** * 5\+ years of experience building high\-quality code and infrastructure. * 3\+ years of experience working with large\-scale distributed systems — microservices, event\-driven architecture, or pipeline orchestration. * 2\+ years of experience with AWS or Google Cloud. * Hands\-on experience building across the stack: backend services (Python, Node, or similar) and frontend interfaces (React, TypeScript, CSS). * Familiarity with containerization, cloud\-native deployment patterns, and common architectural patterns for scalable systems. * Strong debugging instincts — you can trace a problem through multiple services, read logs, form hypotheses, and fix things under pressure without relying on an LLM to do the thinking for you. * Proven curiosity with the latest generative AI advances and a thoughtful perspective on where AI tools help and where they don't. * High ownership and accountability. You treat the systems you build as yours **Nice to Have** * Experience in healthcare, clinical data, or value\-based care. * Experience with pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar). * Experience with Firestore, BigQuery, or other GCP data services. **WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE:** * Competitive salary * Medical, Dental and Vision benefits * 401k match * Generous PTO plan Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Reveleer E\-Verifies all new hires. Reveleer is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description: **About weavix** **Connected by our Shared vision** Our purpose is to improve work through disruptive innovation. We believe the frontline workforce is the greatest asset an enterprise has, and we’re here to support them. Guided by our founding principles, weavix™ is pioneering the future of work to create advanced technologies that empower and connect the worker, not just things. **Building Each Other Up** We’re bringing entire enterprises closer together, and you can’t do that alone. Our offices offer a dynamic community full of opportunity, empowerment and dedication to grow and refine your talents. weavix™ isn’t just your next job. What you’ll find is a team encouraging you every step of the way as you become part of the next generation of industry leaders. **The Good Stuff** When you’re part of the weavix™ team, you’re given the tools and freedom to succeed. We offer competitive salaries, flexible time off and comprehensive benefits packages to attract the best talent out there. Plus, we encourage continuing development to stay sharp and current as you grow into tomorrow’s industry leader. Our people deserve the best, so we give it to them. Simple as that. **Position Summary** The Associate Product Manager joins the Product \& Engineering organization and works alongside experienced Product Managers to turn what weavix hears from the field into features that ship. This is a hands\-on role built to grow into a full Product Manager position. The role owns well\-scoped features end to end, keeps engineering unblocked, and ensures every release lands cleanly with customers, Customer Success, and Sales. The team works AI\-first, using AI daily to research, write, and build working prototypes that show engineering exactly what to build. **Key Responsibilities** **Customer \& Field Insight** * Join customer calls, site visits, and ride\-alongs with Customer Success and Field Solutions to see how crews use Walt on plant floors and job sites. * Turn field tickets, support trends, usage data, and sales feedback into clear problem statements the team can prioritize. * Track competing radio and frontline communication products and summarize what matters for the roadmap. **Execution \& Engineering Alignment** * Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and lightweight specs for owned features, and keep them current in Jira. * Attend Scrum ceremonies with the assigned pod, answer product questions quickly, and escalate trade\-offs to the Product Team and the Engineering Manager before they affect a milestone. * Understand how each feature touches Walt firmware, Cloud, Mobile, and Data so nothing ships half\-integrated. * Test features in development, join QA reviews, and confirm that what shipped matches what the customer needed. **Launch \& Adoption** * Prepare release notes, internal enablement, and FAQs for features as they are released. * Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success so they can explain and sell what ships. * Define success metrics with the Product Manager and report on adoption after launch. **AI\-Powered Product Work** * Use AI tools to research customers, markets, and competitors, synthesize field feedback, and draft PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria; validate the output and own the final document. * Build clickable or working prototypes of specific features with AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, to test ideas before engineering commits. * Package each prototype with the user flow, features demonstrated, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and known gaps so engineers can build the production version without guesswork. **Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years in product management, business analysis, QA, software engineering, technical support, solutions consulting, or a similar role. * Technical fluency: understands the basics of how software is built, tested, and released, and is comfortable reading API documentation or asking engineers the right follow\-up questions. * Clear writing: able to write a user story, a release note, and a short decision memo that people read. * Analytical habits: comfortable pulling and interpreting data; SQL is a plus. * AI fluency: demonstrated history of using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) daily to research, write, and analyze, with the judgment to check AI output for accuracy. * Able to build a working prototype of a feature with AI\-assisted coding or design tools. * Follows through without being chased, raises risks early, and stays calm when priorities shift. * Willing to travel to customer sites (manufacturing plants, job sites, distribution centers) up to 25% of the time. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in industrial or frontline sectors (manufacturing, construction, logistics, oil and gas), or firsthand familiarity with how work gets done on a plant floor or job site. * Exposure to products that combine hardware and software, or to IoT, telecom, or mobile apps. * Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools, and with Agile/Scrum teams. * Familiarity with enterprise B2B SaaS concepts such as SSO, admin permissions, APIs, and integrations. * Bilingual, especially in Spanish. * Side projects or internal tools built with AI coding assistants, or working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or React. * Experience prompting LLM APIs or shipping simple AI\-powered features. *The above statements are not an exhaustive list of job duties and responsibilities of this position. They only reflect the general duties and responsibilities necessary to describe the principal functions of the job. Responsibilities of the position are subject to change as determined necessary.* *At weavix, diversity fuels innovation. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where every team member is empowered to contribute to our mission to connect every disconnected worker. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.*

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are seeking a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer to lead end\-to\-end test strategy, design, development, and deployment of production test solutions for ŌURA products, working closely with internal cross\-functional teams and global Contract Manufacturers (CMs). As a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer at ŌURA, you will own the design, development, and optimization of manufacturing test solutions across the full product lifecycle — from early concept through mass production. You will be a technical leader responsible for test architecture, test software, CM execution, data analytics, and continuous quality improvement. This role requires strong hands\-on engineering skills, systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively across design, operations, quality, and external manufacturing partners. **This is a hybrid role requiring 2\-3 days a week in our San Francisco office.** ### **What You Will Do:** * Drive early and ongoing Design for Testability (DFT) engagement with Hardware, Systems, and Product teams to ensure robust, scalable, and cost\-effective product testing. * Define test requirements aligned with product specifications and quality targets, incorporating DFMEA/PFMEA, engineering specifications, and test coverage analysis into product development. * Own test engineering across the full product lifecycle, from POC and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, production ramp, and mass production. * Architect, design, and deploy manufacturing test stations, equipment, fixtures, and processes to support high\-volume production. * Develop and maintain test software and automation using Python, TestStand, and LabVIEW, including instrument control, data acquisition, test sequencing, error handling, and factory data integration. * Build modular, scalable, and maintainable test frameworks that support manufacturing efficiency, repeatability, and long\-term production needs. * Apply statistical methods including GR\&R, SPC, Cp/Cpk, correlation analysis, and DOE to validate test capability, drive process improvements, and ensure production readiness. * Lead failure analysis, root cause investigations, and resolution of complex production issues, including yield excursions, test coverage gaps, and correlation discrepancies across internal labs and external factories. Drive continuous improvement in product quality, manufacturing yield, and test cost. * Serve as the primary technical interface to Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and test equipment vendors, leading test development, qualification, deployment, sustaining, and technical issue resolution. * Partner cross\-functionally with Hardware, Firmware, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams; communicate test readiness, production risks, and technical recommendations to leadership and executive stakeholders. ### **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, test engineering, or automation (assembly, inspection, test station design, or factory deployment). * Hands\-on experience developing manufacturing test software in Python, C, C\+\+, Rust. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience supporting development builds and mass production with global manufacturing partners. * Willingness to travel upto 25% across domestic and international factory sites. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience working with wearables, consumer electronics, sensors, or embedded systems. * Strong background in test station qualification and correlation (calibration, GR\&R, Cp/Cpk, DOE). * Experience working cross\-functionally with hardware, firmware, systems, quality, and operations teams. * Familiarity with optical, RF, or semiconductor\-based test methodologies. * Proven ability to operate effectively in a global, fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills across cultures and time zones. ### **What Success Looks Like:** * First 90 Days: You've completed a DFT review on at least one active program, built working relationships with CM test teams and cross\-functional partners (Hardware, Quality, Operations), and audited existing test stations, fixtures, and software for coverage gaps. * 6 Months: You've architected and deployed a production test station or major test software release, closed at least one significant correlation or test gap between internal labs and CM factories, and shown measurable improvement in yield or false\-call rate on an owned product line. * 12 Months: You're the recognized technical authority for test engineering on your product line(s), CM teams can sustain your test solutions independently, and you've contributed reusable test frameworks or playbooks adopted by other programs. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. * **San Francisco Salary Range: $172,550 \- $203,000** A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We've been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
